turns.english: The sick child's foot has become ice-cold ('kana siidhe gidis'); is that a danger sign?
turns.fst_morpheme_notes: hargganchcha na7a-a geda-y (sick child-GEN foot-NOM) + kana siidhe gid-is (idiom: became a dog's nose = ice-cold, Gr8 Ch.10 p. 145) + wolqqaama malaat-ee (serious sign-INTER).

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.gofatho_latin: Ee! Geday irxxoynne ayfey xuummoy wolqqaama haatha dhayo malaata. Na7aa ho77o ma7on xaaxada ha77i eesuwan aakime keethi efa!
turns.gofatho_fidel: እእ! ጌደይ ኢርጥጦይንኔ አይፌይ ጡኡምሞይ ዎልቅቀአመ ሀአꬃ ꬋዮ መለአተ። ነዓአ ሆዕዖ መዖን ጠአጠደ ሀዕዒ እእሱወን አአኪሜ ኬእꬂ እፈ!
turns.amharic: አዎ! የእግር መቀዝቀዝና የዓይን መሰርጎድ የከፍተኛ ውኃ ማነስ ምልክት ነው። ልጁን በሙቅ ልብስ ጠቅልለህ አሁኑኑ በፍጥነት ወደ ሐኪም ቤት ውሰደው!

turns.speaker: user
turns.gofatho_latin: Ta machchiyaa shahaara gidadasu. Aakime keethan shahaara aayee kaalluwaa awde doommanaw bessii?

turns.gofatho_fidel: ሻሀአረ ጊዲዶኦገአ እሪዶኦገአረ ኮይሮ አጊነአፕፔ ዶኦምሚዲ አአኪሜ ኬእꬂ በአነው ቤስሴእስ። አአኪሜይ ሱኡꬃአ፣ ሱኡꬃ ሱጊየአንኔ ነዓአ ዲችቻአ ቆረጵጴእስ።

turns.english: As soon as pregnancy is known, she should go to the clinic starting from the first month. The doctor examines blood levels, blood pressure, and the baby's growth.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.gofatho_latin: Santhi, uphpha, maatha, atare, muzenne geeshsha haatha daro maanaw bessees; qassi deexo tooho tookkoppa, aakimey immiyaa birata xaliyaa ubba galla uya!

turns.amharic: ጎመን፣ እንቁላል፣ ወተት፣ አተር፣ ሙዝና ንጹሕ ውኃ በብዛት መመገብ ይገባል፤ ደግሞም ከባድ ሸክም አትሸከም፣ ሐኪሙ የሚሰጣትን የደም ማነስ መድኃኒት (አይረን) በየቀኑ ትዋጥ!
turns.english: She should eat plenty of greens, eggs, milk, peas, bananas, and clean water; she should not carry heavy loads, and should take the iron/folate tablets given by the clinic every day!

turns.speaker: user
turns.gofatho_latin: Uddufuntho kifile Shemppo 7 giddon "goofina", "kilaho" nne "doona gultte" giyaa payyatetha qaalati de7oosona. Entta birshshethay aybee?

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.gofatho_latin: Uddufuntho kifile maxaafaa (p. 59-60) maaran: "goofina" guussay shemppo ekkiyaa kifile; "kilaho" guussay bolla geeshshiyaa kifile; "doona gultte" qassi doonaanne siidhiyaa kammiyaa ma7o.
turns.gofatho_fidel: ኡድዱፉንꬆ ኪፊሌ መጠአፈአ (ፕ። 59-60) መአረን፦ "ጎኦፊነ" ጉኡስሰይ ሼምፕፖ እክኪየአ ኪፊሌ፤ "ኪለሆ" ጉኡስሰይ ቦልለ ጌእሽሺየአ ኪፊሌ፤ "ዶኦነ ጉልትቴ" ቀስሲ ዶኦነአንኔ ሲኢꬊየአ ከምሚየአ መዖ።
turns.amharic: በዘጠነኛ ክፍል መጽሐፍ (ገጽ 59–60) መሠረት፦ «ጎፊና» ማለት ትንፋሽ የሚወስድ ሳምባ፤ «ኪላሆ» ማለት ኩላሊት፤ «ዶና ጉልቴ» ደግሞ አፍና አፍንጫን የሚሸፍን ጭምብል (ማስክ) ነው።
turns.english: According to the Grade 9 textbook (pp. 59–60): 'goofina' means the lungs that breathe air; 'kilaho' means kidney; and 'doona gultte' means a face mask covering the mouth and nose.
turns.fst_morpheme_notes: shemppo ekk-iyaa (breath take-PRES.REL) + doona-a-nne siidhiya-a (mouth-ACC-and nose-ACC.M.DEF) + kamm-iyaa (cover-PRES.REL).

turns.speaker: user
turns.gofatho_latin: Shemppuwaara aathiyaa qufanne goofina harggetappe naagettanaw ayba maara kaalloo?
turns.gofatho_fidel: ሼምፕፑወአረ አአꬂየአ ቁፈንኔ ጎኦፊነ ሀርግጌተፕፔ ነአጌትተነው አይበ መአረ ከአልሎኦ?
turns.amharic: በትንፋሽ ከሚተላለፉ የሳልና የሳምባ በሽታዎች ለመጠበቅ ምን ዓይነት መመሪያ እንከተል?
turns.english: What guidelines should we follow to protect ourselves from airborne cough and respiratory diseases?
turns.fst_morpheme_notes: shemppuwaa-ra (breath-INST, MP-10) + aath-iyaa (pass-PRES.REL) + qufa-nne goofina hargge-tappe (cough-and lung disease-PL.ABL) + naag-ett-anaw (guard-REFL-FUT.PURP).

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.gofatho_latin: Kushe geeshshatethaa saamunaaranne haathaara naagite, daro asay shiiqiyaa bessan doona gultte ma77ite, qassi qufay gam77ikko aakime keethi biidi qoraphphite!
turns.gofatho_fidel: ኩሼ ጌእሽሻቴꬃአ ሰአሙነአረንኔ ሀአꬃአረ ነአጊቴ፣ ደሮ አሰይ ሺኢቂየአ ቤስሰን ዶኦነ ጉልትቴ መዕዒቴ፣ ቀስሲ ቁፈይ ገምዕዒክኮ አአኪሜ ኬእꬂ ቢኢዲ ቆረጵጪቴ!
turns.amharic: የእጅ ንጽሕናን በሳሙናና በውኃ ጠብቁ፣ ብዙ ሰው በሚሰበሰብበት ቦታ የአፍና አፍንጫ ጭምብል (ዶና ጉልቴ) አድርጉ፣ ደግሞም ሳሉ ከቆየ ወደ ሐኪም ቤት ሄዳችሁ ተመርመሩ!
turns.english: Maintain hand hygiene with soap and water, wear a face mask (doona gultte) in crowded places, and if a cough persists, go to the clinic and get examined!
turns.fst_morpheme_notes: kushe geeshshatetha-a (hand cleanliness-ACC, PHR-036) + saamunaa-ra-nne haathaa-ra (soap-INST-and water-INST) + naag-ite (guard-IMP.2PL); gam77-ikko (persist/stay-COND.REAL) + qoraphph-ite (examine-IMP.2PL).

dialogues.domain_name: Primary Healthcare & Maternal/Clinic Triage (Aakime Keethi)
dialogues.subtopic: Pharmacy Prescription Instructions & Dosage Schedule
dialogues.source_grounding: Phrasebook PHR-034, PHR-035 & PHR-040; Sellassie Cheru (2015, p. 142)
rag_retrieval_anchors: PHR-035: Ha xaliyaa gallassan heedzu toho uya

turns.speaker: user
turns.gofatho_latin: Aakimey xaliyaa xaafidi taaw immiis. Xale keethan xaliyaa waani uyanaakko waatada oychchoo?
turns.gofatho_fidel: አአኪሜይ ጠሊየአ ጠአፊዲ ተአው ኢምሚኢስ። ጠሌ ኬእꬃን ጠሊየአ ወአኒ ኡየነአክኮ ወአተደ ኦይችቾኦ?
turns.amharic: ሐኪሙ መድኃኒት ጽፎ ሰጠኝ። በፋርማሲ (መድኃኒት ቤት) መድኃኒቱን እንዴት እንደምውጥ እንዴት ልጠይቅ?
turns.english: The doctor wrote a prescription and gave it to me. At the pharmacy, how do I ask how to take the medicine?
turns.fst_morpheme_notes: aakime-y xaliya-a xaaf-idi (doctor-NOM medicine-ACC write-CNV2.ANT) + taa-w imm-iis (1S-DAT give-PAST.3MS, PHR-034); waan-i uy-ana-akko (how-CNV2 drink/take-FUT-COMP) + oychch-oo (ask-1S.INTER.JUSS).

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.gofatho_latin: Xale oosanchchaakko: "Hayyanaa, ha xaliyaa gallassan aappun toho uyoo? Quumaappe kaseeye quumaappe guyye uyoo?" gada oychcha.
turns.gofatho_fidel: ጠሌ ኦኦሰንችቻአክኮ፦ "ሀይየነአ፣ ሀ ጠሊየአ ገልለስሰን አአፕፑን ቶሆ ኡዮኦ? ቁኡመአፕፔ ከሴእዬ ቁኡመአፕፔ ጉይዬ ኡዮኦ?" ገደ ኦይችቻ።
turns.amharic: የፋርማሲ ባለሙያውን፦ «እባክህ፣ ይህን መድኃኒት በቀን ስንት ጊዜ ልዋጥ? ከምግብ በፊት ነው ወይስ ከምግብ በኋላ የምውጠው?» ብለህ ጠይቅ።
turns.english: Ask the pharmacist: 'Please, how many times a day should I take this medicine? Should I take it before food or after food?'
turns.fst_morpheme_notes: gallassa-n aappun toho (day-LOC how.many times, PHR-035) + uy-oo (take-1S.INTER.JUSS); quumaa-ppe kase-eye quumaa-ppe guyye (food-ABL before-INTER.OR food-ABL after).

turns.speaker: user
turns.gofatho_latin: Iikka "Ha xaliyaa quumaappe guyye gallassan heedzu toho - maallado, gallassanne omarssi - ichchashu gallassa gakkanaw uya" giis.
turns.gofatho_fidel: ኢኢክከ "ሀ ጠሊየአ ቁኡመአፕፔ ጉይዬ ገልለስሰን ሄእꬑ ቶሆ - መአልለዶ፣ ገልለስሰንኔ ኦመርስሲ - ኢችቻሹ ገልለስሰ ገክከነው ኡየ" ጊኢስ።
turns.amharic: እርሱም «ይህን መድኃኒት ከምግብ በኋላ በቀን ሦስት ጊዜ—ጠዋት፣ ቀንና ማታ—እስከ አምስት ቀን ድረስ ዋጥ» አለኝ።
turns.english: And he said, 'Take this medicine after meals three times a day—morning, midday, and evening—for five days.'
turns.fst_morpheme_notes: quumaa-ppe guyye (food-ABL after) + gallassa-n heedzu toho (day-LOC three times, PHR-035) + ichchashu gallassa gakk-anaw (five days reach-UNTIL) + uy-a (take-IMP.2S).

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.gofatho_latin: Aakimey azazidoogaadan xaliyaa wurssana gakkanaw uya! Paxida milatikkokka xaliyaa giddon aggoppa.
turns.gofatho_fidel: አአኪሜይ አዘዚዶኦገአደን ጠሊየአ ዉርስሰነ ገክከነው ኡየ! ፐጢደ ሚለቲክኮክከ ጠሊየአ ጊድዶን አግጎፕፐ።
turns.amharic: ሐኪሙ እንዳዘዘው መድኃኒቱን እስኪያልቅ ድረስ ዋጥ! የዳንክ ቢመስልህም መድኃኒቱን በመካከል አታቋርጥ።
turns.english: Take the medicine until you finish the full course just as the doctor ordered! Even if you feel better, do not stop the medicine midway.
turns.fst_morpheme_notes: azaz-idoogaa-dan (order-PAST.REL-EQU) + wurss-ana gakk-anaw (finish-FUT reach-UNTIL); pax-ida milat-ikko-kka (heal-PAST.REL seem-COND-EVEN) + agg-oppa (leave/stop-PROH.2S).

dialogues.subtopic: Eye Care & Vision Examination (Ayfe Qorapho)
dialogues.source_grounding: Phrasebook PHR-044; Grade 8 Ch. 10 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/160NHNy-4orPcAIk-L5t6tOEtZoWemz_-/view?usp=drivesdk, p. 145: Ayfe caddana mithi ayfes beetenna)
rag_retrieval_anchors: Gr8_Ch10 Proverb: Ayfe caddana mithi ayfes beetenna

turns.speaker: user
turns.gofatho_latin: Ta maayzaa ayfey haahuwaa loythi xeellenna, qassi afuxees. Ayfe aakimeekko efaanaw ay goo?
turns.gofatho_fidel: ተ መአይዘአ አይፌይ ሀአሁወአ ሎይꬂ ጤእልሌንነ፣ ቀስሲ አፉጤእስ። አይፌ አአኪሜእክኮ እፈአነው አይ ጎኦ?
turns.amharic: የአያቴ ዓይን ሩቅ በደንብ አያይም፣ ደግሞም እንባ ይፈሰዋል። ወደ ዓይን ሐኪም ለመውሰድ ምን ልበል?
turns.english: My grandfather's eyes do not see far distances well, and they water. What should I say when taking him to the eye doctor?
turns.fst_morpheme_notes: ta maayza-a ayfe-y (my grandfather-GEN eye-NOM) + haahuwa-a (far.distance-ACC.M.DEF) + loythi xeell-enna (well see-PRES.3MS.NEG, PHR-044); ayfe aakimee-kko (eye doctor-DIR) + ef-aanaw (take-FUT.PURP).

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.gofatho_latin: Ayfe aakimeekko: "Ta maayzaa ayfey loythi xeellenna; puuray de7iyaakko hayyanaa qoraphpharkkii?" gada oychcha.
turns.gofatho_fidel: አይፌ አአኪሜእክኮ፦ "ተ መአይዘአ አይፌይ ሎይꬂ ጤእልሌንነ፤ ፑኡረይ ዴዒየአክኮ ሀይየነአ ቆረጵጳርክኪኢ?" ገደ ኦይችቻ።
turns.amharic: ለዓይን ሐኪሙ፦ «የአያቴ ዓይን በደንብ አያይም፤ የዓይን ሞራ እንዳለበት እባክህ ትመረምርልኛለህ?» ብለህ ጠይቅ።
turns.english: Say to the eye specialist: 'My grandfather's eyes do not see clearly; please could you examine whether he has a cataract?'
turns.fst_morpheme_notes: loythi xeell-enna (well see-PRES.3MS.NEG) + de7-iyaa-kko (exist-PRES.REL-COMP) + qoraphph-arkkii (examine-2S.POT.INTER).

turns.speaker: user
turns.gofatho_latin: Ayfiyaa qohoppe naagettanaabaa Hosppuntho kifile Shemppo 10 giddon de7iyaa tossey ay gii?
turns.gofatho_fidel: አይፊየአ ቆሆፕፔ ነአጌትተነአበአ ሆስፕፑንꬆ ኪፊሌ ሼምፕፖ 10 ጊድዶን ዴዒየአ ቶስሴይ አይ ጊኢ?
turns.amharic: ዓይንን ከጉዳት ስለ መጠበቅ በስምንተኛ ክፍል ምዕራፍ 10 ውስጥ ያለው ምሳሌያዊ ንግግር ምን ይላል?
turns.english: What does the proverb in Grade 8 Chapter 10 say about guarding the eye from unexpected harm?
turns.fst_morpheme_notes: ayfiya-a qoho-ppe (eye-ACC.M.DEF harm-ABL) + naag-ett-anaa-baa (guard-REFL-FUT.NMZ-ABOUT).

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.gofatho_latin: Hosppuntho kifile Shemppo 10 (p. 145) tossey: "Ayfe caddana mithi ayfes beetenna" gees; hessa gisho ayfe payyatethaa kasetidi naaganaw bessees.
turns.gofatho_fidel: ሆስፕፑንꬆ ኪፊሌ ሼምፕፖ 10 (ፕ። 145) ቶስሴይ፦ "አይፌ ጨድደነ ሚꬂ አይፌስ ቤእቴንነ" ጌእስ፤ ሄስሰ ጊሾ አይፌ ፐይየቴꬃአ ከሴቲዲ ነአገነው ቤስሴእስ።
turns.amharic: የስምንተኛ ክፍል ምዕራፍ 10 (ገጽ 145) ምሳሌ፦ «አይፌ ጫዳና ሚꬂ አይፌስ ቤቴና» (ዓይንን የሚወጋ እንጨት ለዓይን አይታይም) ይላል፤ ስለዚህ የዓይንን ጤንነት አስቀድሞ መጠበቅ ይገባል።
turns.english: The Grade 8 Chapter 10 (p. 145) proverb says: 'Ayfe caddana mithi ayfes beetenna' ('The twig that will poke the eye is not visible to the eye'); therefore one must protect eye health proactively.
turns.fst_morpheme_notes: ayfe cadd-ana mithi (eye poke/stab-FUT.REL wood/twig) + ayfe-s (eye-DAT) + beet-enna (be.seen-PRES.3MS.NEG < be7- + -ett- + -enna, MP-06).

dialogues.domain_name: Primary Healthcare & Maternal/Clinic Triage (Aakime Keethi)
dialogues.subtopic: Medical Confidentiality & Professional Healthcare Ethics (Aakime Ooso Woga)
dialogues.source_grounding: Grade 8 Goofatho Doona Ch. 1 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/160NHNy-4orPcAIk-L5t6tOEtZoWemz_-/view?usp=drivesdk, pp. 3–5, 11: Aakime keethan oothiya aakimeti hargganchcha xuura naaganaas bessees)
rag_retrieval_anchors: Gr8_Ch1 Meeze 1 p. 11: Aakime keethan oothiya aakimeti hargganchcha xuura naaganaas bessees

turns.speaker: user
turns.gofatho_latin: Hosppuntho kifile Shemppo 1 ("Ooso Woga") giddon aakime keethan oothiyaa aakimeta ooso wogaabaa ay gii?
turns.gofatho_fidel: ሆስፕፑንꬆ ኪፊሌ ሼምፕፖ 1 ("ኦኦሶ ዎገ") ጊድዶን አአኪሜ ኬእꬃን ኦኦꬂየአ አአኪሜተ ኦኦሶ ዎገአበአ አይ ጊኢ?
turns.amharic: በስምንተኛ ክፍል ምዕራፍ 1 («የሥራ ሥነ-ምግባር») ውስጥ በሕክምና ተቋም ስለሚሠሩ ሐኪሞች የሥራ ሥነ-ምግባር ምን ይላል?
turns.english: In Grade 8 Chapter 1 ('Work Ethics'), what does it say about the professional ethics of doctors working in a healthcare facility?
turns.fst_morpheme_notes: aakime keetha-n ooth-iyaa aakime-ta (clinic-LOC work-PRES.REL doctor-PL.GEN) + ooso wogaa-baa (work ethics-ABOUT, Gr8 Ch.1 pp. 3–5).

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.gofatho_latin: Hosppuntho kifile maxaafaa (p. 4 & p. 11) maaran: aakimeti hargganchchata ubbaa issi gina bonchchon mokkidi akkamoosonanne hargganchcha xuura loythi naagoosona.
turns.gofatho_fidel: ሆስፕፑንꬆ ኪፊሌ መጠአፈአ (ፕ። 4 & ፕ። 11) መአረን፦ አአኪሜቲ ሀርግገንችቻተ ኡብበአ ኢስሲ ጊነ ቦንችቾን ሞክኪዲ አክከሞኦሶነንኔ ሀርግገንችቻ ጡኡረ ሎይꬂ ነአጎኦሶነ።
turns.amharic: በስምንተኛ ክፍል መጽሐፍ (ገጽ 4 እና 11) መሠረት፦ ሐኪሞች ታካሚዎችን ሁሉ በእኩል አክብሮት ተቀብለው ያክማሉ እንዲሁም የታካሚውን ምሥጢር (ጡኡራ) በጥብቅ ይጠብቃሉ።
turns.english: According to the Grade 8 textbook (pp. 4 & 11): doctors welcome and treat all patients with equal respect and strictly safeguard patient confidentiality ('hargganchcha xuura').
turns.fst_morpheme_notes: hargganchcha-ta ubba-a (patient-PL.ACC all-ACC) + issi gina bonchcho-n (equal respect-INST) + mokk-idi (welcome-CNV2.ANT) + hargganchcha xuura (patient secret/confidentiality, Gr8 Ch.1 p. 11) + naag-oosona (keep-PRES.3PL).

turns.speaker: user
turns.gofatho_latin: Hargganchchaykka aakime keethan ba harggiyaabaa qonccissiyaa wode ay oothanaw bessii?
turns.gofatho_fidel: ሀርግገንችቻይክከ አአኪሜ ኬእꬃን በ ሀርግጊየአበአ ቆንጭጪስሲየአ ዎዴ አይ ኦኦꬃነው ቤስሲኢ?
turns.amharic: ታካሚውም በሐኪም ቤት ስለ ሕመሙ ሲገልጽ ምን ማድረግ ይገባዋል?
turns.english: And when the patient explains his illness at the clinic, what should he do?
turns.fst_morpheme_notes: hargganchcha-y-kka (patient-NOM-ADD) + ba harggiyaa-baa (3REFL.GEN illness-ABOUT) + qoncc-iss-iyaa wode (explain-CAUS-PRES.REL when) + ay ooth-anaw bess-ii (what do-FUT.PURP ought-PRES.3MS.INTER).

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.gofatho_latin: Aakimey hargganchcha xuura naagiyaa gishshaw, hargganchchay yayyonnaaninne qottanabaa aggonnaan ba sakkoy awannne awde doommidaakko suure odanaw bessees.
turns.gofatho_fidel: አአኪሜይ ሀርግገንችቻ ጡኡረ ነአጊየአ ጊሽሻው፣ ሀርግገንችቻይ የይዮንነአኒንኔ ቆትተነበአ አግጎንነአን በ ሰክኮይ አወንንኔ አውዴ ዶኦምሚደአክኮ ሱኡሬ ኦደነው ቤስሴእስ።
turns.amharic: ሐኪሙ የታካሚውን ምሥጢር ስለሚጠብቅ፣ ታካሚው ሳይፈራና ምንም ሳይደብቅ ሕመሙ የትና መቼ እንደጀመረ በትክክል መናገር ይገባዋል።
turns.english: Because the doctor protects patient confidentiality, the patient should speak honestly without fear or hiding anything about where and when his pain started.
turns.fst_morpheme_notes: yayy-onnaan-inne (fear-NEG.CNV-and) + ba sakko-y (3REFL.GEN pain-NOM) + awde doomm-ida-akko (when start-PAST.REL-COMP) + suure od-anaw bess-ees (honestly tell-FUT.PURP ought-PRES.3MS).

dialogues.subtopic: First Aid for Farm Cuts & Snake/Insect Bite Emergency (Shemppuwaa Ashshiyaa Maaduwaa)
dialogues.source_grounding: Phrasebook PHR-042; Grade 8 Ch. 1 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/160NHNy-4orPcAIk-L5t6tOEtZoWemz_-/view?usp=drivesdk, p. 15: dano)

turns.speaker: user
turns.gofatho_latin: Goshshan oothishe waley goshshanchcha kushiyaa qanxxiis; suuthay daro gukkees. Koyro maaduwaa ay oothoo?
turns.gofatho_fidel: ጎሽሻን ኦኦꬂሼ ወሌይ ጎሽሻንችቻ ኩሺየአ ቀንጥጢኢስ፤ ሱኡꬃይ ደሮ ጉክኬእስ። ኮይሮ መአዱወአ አይ ኦኦꬆኦ?
turns.amharic: በእርሻ ላይ እየሠራ ሳለ ማጭዱ የገበሬውን እጅ ቆረጠው፤ ደም በብዛት ይፈሳል። የመጀመሪያ እርዳታ ምን እናድርግ?
turns.english: While working on the farm, a sickle cut a farmer's hand and it is bleeding heavily. What first aid should we perform?
turns.fst_morpheme_notes: goshsha-n ooth-ishe (farm-LOC work-CNV.SIM) + wale-y (sickle-NOM, Gr10 Ch.5 p. 39) + kushiya-a qanxx-iis (hand-ACC cut-PAST.3MS); suutha-y daro gukk-ees (blood-NOM much pour/bleed-PRES.3MS).

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.gofatho_latin: Shemppuwaa ashshiyaa koyro maaduwaas: geeshsha haathaara madhdhaa meecada, geeshsha puutto ma7on minnada qachchidi suuthaa essa! Biitta woy qita madhdhaa bolla wothoppa.
turns.gofatho_fidel: ሼምፕፑወአ አሽሺየአ ኮይሮ መአዱወአስ፦ ጌእሽሻ ሀአꬃአረ መꬍꬋአ ሜእጨደ፣ ጌእሽሻ ፑኡትቶ መዖን ሚንነደ ቀችቺዲ ሱኡꬃአ እስሰ! ቢኢትተ ዎይ ቂተ መꬍꬋአ ቦልለ ዎꬆፕፐ።
turns.amharic: ሕይወት አድን የመጀመሪያ እርዳታ ለመስጠት፦ ቁስሉን በንጹሕ ውኃ አጥበህ፣ በንጹሕ የጥጥ ጨርቅ አጥብቀህ በማሰር ደሙን አቁም! አፈር ወይም ቆሻሻ ቁስሉ ላይ አታድርግ።
turns.english: For life-saving first aid: wash the wound with clean water, bind it firmly with a clean cotton cloth, and stop the bleeding! Do not put soil or dirt on the wound.
turns.fst_morpheme_notes: shemppuwa-a ashsh-iyaa (life-ACC save-PRES.REL, PHR-042) + madhdha-a (wound-ACC) + meec-ada (wash-CNV1.ANT.2S) + qachch-idi (bind/tie-CNV2.ANT) + suutha-a ess-a (blood-ACC stop.CAUS-IMP.2S, MP-05 < eqq- + -iss-); woth-oppa (put-PROH.2S).

turns.speaker: user
turns.gofatho_latin: Madhdhay ciimma gidikko, teetanasi marppiyaa cadettanaw aakime keethi efoo?
turns.gofatho_fidel: መꬍꬋይ ጪኢምመ ጊዲክኮ፣ ቴእተነሲ መርፕፒየአ ጨዴትተነው አአኪሜ ኬእꬂ እፎኦ?
turns.amharic: ቁስሉ ጥልቅ ከሆነ፣ የቴታነስ መርፌ እንዲወጋ ወደ ሐኪም ቤት እንውሰደው?
turns.english: If the wound is deep, should we take him to the clinic to get a tetanus injection and stitches?
turns.fst_morpheme_notes: madhdha-y ciimma gid-ikko (wound-NOM deep be-COND.REAL) + cad-ett-anaw (inject/stab-PASS-FUT.PURP, MP-06 < cadd- + -ett-) + ef-oo (take-1PL.INTER.JUSS).

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.gofatho_latin: Ee! Birata miishshan qanxxettida ciimma madhdhaas aakime keethan sikkonne teetanasi naago marppey daro koshshees; ha77i efite!
turns.gofatho_fidel: እእ! ቢረተ ሚኢሽሻን ቀንጥጤትቲደ ጪኢምመ መꬍꬋአስ አአኪሜ ኬእꬃን ሲክኮንኔ ቴእተነሲ ነአጎ መርፕፔይ ደሮ ኮሽሼእስ፤ ሀዕዒ እፊቴ!
turns.amharic: አዎ! በብረት መሣሪያ ለተቆረጠ ጥልቅ ቁስል በሐኪም ቤት መሰፋትና የቴታነስ መከላከያ መርፌ በጣም ያስፈልጋል፤ አሁኑኑ ውሰዱት!
turns.english: Yes! For a deep wound cut by an iron tool, stitching and a tetanus vaccination at the clinic are essential; take him right now!
turns.fst_morpheme_notes: birata miishsha-n (iron tool-INST) + qanxx-ett-ida (cut-PASS-PAST.REL) + daro koshsh-ees (very be.needed-PRES.3MS); ef-ite (take-IMP.2PL).

dialogues.source_grounding: Phrasebook PHR-039 & PHR-043; Grade 8 Ch. 5 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/160NHNy-4orPcAIk-L5t6tOEtZoWemz_-/view?usp=drivesdk, p. 75: nayta payyatetha)

turns.speaker: user
turns.gofatho_latin: Ooratha yelettida guutha na7aas hargge naago kittibaate awde doommii?
turns.gofatho_fidel: ኦኦረꬃ ዬሌትቲደ ጉኡꬃ ነዓአስ ሀርግጌ ነአጎ ኪትቲበአቴ አውዴ ዶኦምሚኢ?
turns.amharic: አዲስ ለተወለደ ሕፃን ልጅ የበሽታ መከላከያ ክትባት መቼ ይጀምራል?
turns.english: When does the disease-prevention vaccination schedule start for a newborn baby?
turns.fst_morpheme_notes: ooratha yel-ett-ida (newly bear-PASS-PAST.REL) + guutha na7a-as (small child-DAT, ZARA-03 7) + hargge naago (disease protection) + awde doomm-ii (when start-PRES.3MS.INTER).

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.gofatho_latin: Kittibaatey na7ay yelettido gallassan doommidi, usuppun saaminttan, tamma saaminttan, tamma-oyddu saaminttaninne uddufun aginan xenaa keethan imettees.
turns.gofatho_fidel: ኪትቲበአቴይ ነዓይ ዬሌትቲዶ ገልለስሰን ዶኦምሚዲ፣ ኡሱፕፑን ሰአሚንትተን፣ ተምመ ሰአሚንትተን፣ ተምመ-ኦይድዱ ሰአሚንትተኒንኔ ኡድዱፉን አጊነን ጤነአ ኬእꬃን ኢሜትቴእስ።
turns.amharic: ክትባቱ ሕፃኑ በተወለደበት ቀን ጀምሮ፣ በስድስት ሳምንት፣ በአሥር ሳምንት፣ በአሥራ አራት ሳምንትና በዘጠኝ ወር በጤና ጣቢያ ይሰጣል።
turns.english: Vaccination starts on the day the baby is born, and continues at six weeks, ten weeks, fourteen weeks, and nine months at the health center.
turns.fst_morpheme_notes: yel-ett-ido gallassa-n (bear-PASS-PAST.REL day-LOC) + doomm-idi (start-CNV2.ANT) + uddufun agina-n (nine month-LOC) + im-ett-ees (give-PASS-PRES.3MS, MP-06).

turns.speaker: user
turns.gofatho_latin: Kittibaate kaarddiyaa oyqqidi baanaw bessii?
turns.gofatho_fidel: ኪትቲበአቴ ከአርድዲየአ ኦይቅቂዲ በአነው ቤስሲኢ?
turns.amharic: የክትባት ካርዱን ይዞ መሄድ ይገባል?
turns.english: Is it necessary to bring the immunization card along?
turns.fst_morpheme_notes: kittibaate kaarddiya-a (vaccination card-ACC.M.DEF, MP-10) + oyqq-idi (hold-CNV2.ANT) + ba-anaw bess-ii (go-FUT.PURP ought-PRES.3MS.INTER).

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.gofatho_latin: Ee! Kittibaate kaarddiyaa ubba wode oyqqada ba; xenaa oosanchchati na7aa deexuwaa miizaanidi kaarddiyaa bolla xaafosona.
turns.gofatho_fidel: እእ! ኪትቲበአቴ ከአርድዲየአ ኡብበ ዎዴ ኦይቅቀደ በ፤ ጤነአ ኦኦሰንችቻቲ ነዓአ ዴእጡወአ ሚኢዘአኒዲ ከአርድዲየአ ቦልለ ጠአፎሶነ።
turns.amharic: አዎ! የክትባት ካርዱን ሁልጊዜ ይዘህ ሂድ፤ የጤና ባለሙያዎቹ የሕፃኑን ክብደት መዝነው ካርዱ ላይ ይጽፋሉ።
turns.english: Yes! Always bring the immunization card with you; the health workers weigh the baby and record the weight on the card.
turns.fst_morpheme_notes: oyqq-ada ba (hold-CNV1.ANT.2S go.IMP.2S); na7a-a deexuwa-a (child-GEN weight-ACC.M.DEF) + miizaan-idi (weigh-CNV2.ANT) + xaaf-oosona (write-PRES.3PL).

dialogues.domain_name: Primary Healthcare & Maternal/Clinic Triage (Aakime Keethi)
dialogues.subtopic: Clean Drinking Water & Waterborne Illness Prevention
dialogues.source_grounding: Phrasebook PHR-030 & PHR-036; Grade 8 Ch. 1 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/160NHNy-4orPcAIk-L5t6tOEtZoWemz_-/view?usp=drivesdk, p. 11: Heera geeshshatethaa naago)

turns.speaker: user
turns.gofatho_latin: Gaxare heeran pultto haathaa uyanaappe kase geeshshanaw ay oothanaw bessii?
turns.gofatho_fidel: ገጠሬ ሄእረን ፑልትቶ ሀአꬃአ ኡየነአፕፔ ከሴ ጌእሽሻነው አይ ኦኦꬃነው ቤስሲኢ?
turns.amharic: በገጠር አካባቢ የምንጭ ውኃ ከመጠጣታችን በፊት ለማጽዳት (ለማከም) ምን ማድረግ ይገባል?
turns.english: In rural areas, before drinking spring water, what should we do to make it safe and clean?
turns.fst_morpheme_notes: gaxare heera-n (rural area-LOC) + pultto haatha-a (spring water-ACC) + uy-anaa-ppe kase (drink-FUT.NMZ-ABL before) + geeshsh-anaw (clean/purify-FUT.PURP).

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.gofatho_latin: Haathaa taman loythi kathidi irxxissidi uyo, woykko haatha xaliyaa gujjidi geeshsha miishshan kamidi oyqqo!
turns.gofatho_fidel: ሀአꬃአ ተመን ሎይꬂ ከꬂዲ ኢርጥጢስሲዲ ኡዮ፣ ዎይክኮ ሀአꬃ ጠሊየአ ጉጅጂዲ ጌእሽሻ ሚኢሽሻን ከሚዲ ኦይቅቆ!
turns.amharic: ውኃውን በእሳት በደንብ አፍልቶ አቀዝቅዞ መጠጣት፣ ወይም የውኃ ማከሚያ መድኃኒት (ውኃ አጋር) ጨምሮ በንጹሕ ዕቃ ከድኖ መያዝ ይገባል!
turns.english: Boil the water thoroughly on the fire and let it cool before drinking, or treat it with water purification drops and keep it covered in a clean container!
turns.fst_morpheme_notes: haatha-a tama-n loythi kath-idi (water-ACC fire-LOC well boil-CNV2.ANT) + irxx-iss-idi (cool-CAUS-CNV2.ANT) + kamm-idi oyqq-o (cover-CNV2 keep-NMZ/JUSS).

turns.speaker: user
turns.gofatho_latin: Pultto haathaa yuushuwaa geeshshatethaa naaganaw deretethay ay oothii?
turns.gofatho_fidel: ፑልትቶ ሀአꬃአ ዩኡሹወአ ጌእሽሻቴꬃአ ነአገነው ዴሬቴꬃይ አይ ኦኦꬂኢ?
turns.amharic: የምንጭ ውኃ አካባቢን ንጽሕና ለመጠበቅ ማኅበረሰቡ ምን ያደርጋል?
turns.english: What does the community do to protect the cleanliness around a water spring?
turns.fst_morpheme_notes: pultto haatha-a yuushuwa-a (spring water-GEN surroundings-ACC.M.DEF) + geeshshatetha-a naag-anaw (cleanliness-ACC protect-FUT.PURP) + deretetha-y (community-NOM, Gr10 Ch.1 p. 6).

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.gofatho_latin: Pulttuwaa yuushuwan meheti gelonna mala dirssa diridi, bolla baggaara di7oy qita gelissonna mala boohuwaa bookkoosona.
turns.gofatho_fidel: ፑልትቱወአ ዩኡሹወን ሜሄቲ ጌሎንነ መለ ዲርስሰ ዲሪዲ፣ ቦልለ በግገአረ ዲዖይ ቂተ ጌሊስሶንነ መለ ቦኦሁወአ ቦኦክኮኦሶነ።
turns.amharic: በምንጩ ዙሪያ ከብቶች እንዳይገቡ አጥር አጥረው፣ ከላይ በኩል ጎርፍ ቆሻሻ እንዳያስገባ ቦይ ይቆፍራሉ።
turns.english: They fence the area around the spring so livestock cannot enter, and dig drainage channels above it so runoff (di7o) does not wash dirt into the water.

dialogues.subtopic: Malaria Prevention & Bednet Usage in Lowland Gofa (Gadha Shekkeere)
dialogues.source_grounding: Grade 8 Ch. 5 & Ch. 9 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/160NHNy-4orPcAIk-L5t6tOEtZoWemz_-/view?usp=drivesdk, pp. 76, 127: gadha vs. gezze); Phrasebook PHR-038

turns.speaker: user
turns.gofatho_latin: Gadha heeran irathay bukkiyaa wode shekkeere harggey darees. So asaa shekkeereppe waatidi naagoo?
turns.gofatho_fidel: ገꬋ ሄእረን ኢረꬃይ ቡክኪየአ ዎዴ ሼክኬእሬ ሀርግጌይ ደሬእስ። ሶ አሰአ ሼክኬእሬፕፔ ወአቲዲ ነአጎኦ?
turns.amharic: በቆላ አካባቢ ዝናብ በሚዘንብበት ወቅት የወባ በሽታ ይበዛል። ቤተሰብን ከወባ እንዴት እንጠብቅ?
turns.english: In the lowland areas (gadha), when the rains fall, malaria increases. How do we protect the family from malaria?
turns.fst_morpheme_notes: gadha heera-n (lowland area-LOC, Gr8 Ch.5 p. 76) + iratha-y bukk-iyaa wode (rain-NOM fall-PRES.REL when) + shekkeere hargge-y (malaria disease-NOM) + dar-ees (abound-PRES.3MS); waat-idi naag-oo (how-CNV2 protect-1PL.INTER).

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.gofatho_latin: Ubba qamma xaliyaara giigettida agobariyaa hiixxidi zin77ite; qassi keetha yuushuwan eqqida haathaa gukkissidi melissite.
turns.gofatho_fidel: ኡብበ ቀምመ ጠሊየአረ ጊኢጌትቲደ አጎበሪየአ ሂኢጥጢዲ ዚንዕዒቴ፤ ቀስሲ ኬእꬃ ዩኡሹወን እቅቂደ ሀአꬃአ ጉክኪስሲዲ ሜሊስሲቴ።
turns.amharic: በየምሽቱ በመድኃኒት የተነከረ አጎበር ዘርግታችሁ ተኙ፤ ደግሞም በቤት ዙሪያ የቆመ ውኃን አፋስሳችሁ አድርቁ።
turns.english: Every night sleep under an insecticide-treated bednet (agobariyaa); and drain and dry up any stagnant water around the house.
turns.fst_morpheme_notes: ubba qamma (every night) + hiixx-idi zin77-ite (spread-CNV2.ANT sleep-IMP.2PL, ZARA-03 77); eqq-ida haatha-a (stand-PAST.REL water-ACC) + mel-iss-ite (dry-CAUS-IMP.2PL).

turns.speaker: user
turns.gofatho_latin: Shahaara aayeenne guutha nayti agobariyaa garssan zin77oy ubbaappe aadhdhi koshshii?
turns.gofatho_fidel: ሻሀአረ አአዬእንኔ ጉኡꬃ ነይቲ አጎበሪየአ ገርስሰን ዚንዕዖይ ኡብበአፕፔ አአꬍꬊ ኮሽሺኢ?
turns.amharic: ነፍሰ ጡር እናትና ሕፃናት ልጆች በአጎበር ውስጥ መተኛታቸው ከሁሉም በላይ ያስፈልጋል?
turns.english: Is it especially important for pregnant mothers and young children to sleep under a bednet?
turns.fst_morpheme_notes: shahaara aayee-nne guutha nay-ti (pregnant mother-and young child-PL.NOM) + agobariya-a garssa-n (bednet-GEN under-LOC) + zin77o-y (sleeping-NOM) + aadhdh-i koshsh-ii (surpass-CNV2 be.needed-PRES.3MS.INTER).

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.gofatho_latin: Ee! Shekkeerey shahaara aayeenne guutha nayta bolla suutha dhayo ehiyaa gishshaw, entti ubba qamma agobariyaa garssan zin77anaw bessees.
turns.gofatho_fidel: እእ! ሼክኬእሬይ ሻሀአረ አአዬእንኔ ጉኡꬃ ነይተ ቦልለ ሱኡꬃ ꬋዮ እሂየአ ጊሽሻው፣ እንትቲ ኡብበ ቀምመ አጎበሪየአ ገርስሰን ዚንዕዓነው ቤስሴእስ።
turns.amharic: አዎ! ወባ በነፍሰ ጡር እናትና በሕፃናት ልጆች ላይ የደም ማነስ ስለሚያመጣ፣ እነርሱ በየምሽቱ በአጎበር ውስጥ መተኛት ይገባቸዋል።
turns.english: Yes! Because malaria causes severe anemia in pregnant mothers and young children, they must sleep under a bednet every single night.
turns.fst_morpheme_notes: suutha dhayo (blood lack / anemia) + eh-iyaa gishshaw (bring-PRES.REL because) + zin77-anaw bess-ees (sleep-FUT.PURP ought-PRES.3MS).

dialogues.source_grounding: Grade 9 Goofatho Doona Ch. 4 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/1uvGaBT4-O_Jn7oQbuNl1W88lFBFiHULU/view?usp=drivesdk, pp. 30–31: Hargge machcho gidis, Bollay layti uttis); Phrasebook PHR-040 & PHR-045
rag_retrieval_anchors: Gr9_Ch4 Idioms: Hargge machcho gidis; Bollay layti uttis

turns.speaker: user
turns.gofatho_latin: Uddufuntho kifile Shemppo 4 ("Darota", p. 30) giddon "Hargge machcho gidis" nne "Bollay layti uttis" giyaa aaqe odati de7oosona. Entta birshshethay aybee?
turns.gofatho_fidel: ኡድዱፉንꬆ ኪፊሌ ሼምፕፖ 4 ("ደሮተ"፣ ፕ። 30) ጊድዶን "ሀርግጌ መችቾ ጊዲስ" ንኔ "ቦልለይ ለይቲ ኡትቲስ" ጊየአ አአቄ ኦደቲ ዴዖኦሶነ። እንትተ ቢርሽሼꬃይ አይቤእ?
turns.amharic: በዘጠነኛ ክፍል ምዕራፍ 4 («ዳሮታ»፣ ገጽ 30) ውስጥ «ሃርጌ ማቾ ጊዲስ» እና «ቦላይ ላይቲ ኡቲስ» የሚሉ ፈሊጣዊ ንግግሮች አሉ። ትርጉማቸው ምንድን ነው?
turns.english: In Grade 9 Chapter 4 ('Darota', p. 30), there are the idioms 'Hargge machcho gidis' and 'Bollay layti uttis'. What do they mean?
turns.fst_morpheme_notes: hargge machcho gid-is (illness spouse become-PAST.3MS, Gr9 Ch.4 p. 30) + bolla-y layt-i utt-is (body-NOM waste.away-CNV2 sit-PAST.3MS, Gr9 Ch.4 p. 30).

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.gofatho_latin: "Hargge machcho gidis" guussay adussa wode harggiyaan oyqqettidi de7iis guussa; "Bollay layti uttis" guussay qassi harggeppe denddidayssaan asatethay laafidi daaburiis guussa.
turns.gofatho_fidel: "ሀርግጌ መችቾ ጊዲስ" ጉኡስሰይ አዱስሰ ዎዴ ሀርግጊየአን ኦይቅቄትቲዲ ዴዒኢስ ጉኡስሰ፤ "ቦልለይ ለይቲ ኡትቲስ" ጉኡስሰይ ቀስሲ ሀርግጌፕፔ ዴንድዲደይስሰአን አሰቴꬃይ ለአፊዲ ደአቡሪኢስ ጉኡስሰ።
turns.amharic: «ሃርጌ ማቾ ጊዲስ» ማለት ለረጅም ጊዜ በበሽታ ተይዞ ቆየ (የበሽታ ጓደኛ ሆነ) ማለት ነው፤ «ቦላይ ላይቲ ኡቲስ» ማለት ደግሞ ከሕመሙ የተነሣ ሰውነቱ ከስቶ ደከመ ማለት ነው።
turns.english: 'Hargge machcho gidis' (lit. 'became a spouse of illness') means suffering from a prolonged chronic illness; and 'Bollay layti uttis' means the body became frail and weakened from illness.
turns.fst_morpheme_notes: adussa wode (long time) + harggiya-an oyqq-ett-idi (illness-INST seize-PASS-CNV2.ANT); hargge-ppe dendd-idayssaa-n (illness-ABL arise-PAST.REL.NMZ-LOC) + daabur-iis (tire/weaken-PAST.3MS).

turns.speaker: user
turns.gofatho_latin: Adussa harggeppe paxiyaa uraas ("Hargganchchay ha77i paxees") asatethaa minthanaw ay koshshii?
turns.gofatho_fidel: አዱስሰ ሀርግጌፕፔ ፐጢየአ ኡረአስ ("ሀርግገንችቻይ ሀዕዒ ፐጤእስ") አሰቴꬃአ ሚንꬃነው አይ ኮሽሺኢ?
turns.amharic: ከረጅም ሕመም እያገገመ ላለ ሰው («በሽተኛው አሁን እየዳነ ነው») ሰውነቱን ለማጠንከር ምን ያስፈልጋል?
turns.english: For a person recovering from a long illness ('Hargganchchay ha77i paxees'), what is needed to rebuild bodily strength?
turns.fst_morpheme_notes: hargganchcha-y ha77i pax-ees (patient-NOM now recover-PRES.3MS, PHR-040) + asatetha-a minth-anaw (body-ACC strengthen-FUT.PURP, PHR-043).

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.gofatho_latin: Geeshsha quumaa - asho suuphe, maatha, itima ukkenne gommane - maanaw, guutha wode shemppanawinne aakime kaalluwaa naaganaw bessees.
turns.gofatho_fidel: ጌእሽሻ ቁኡመአ - አሾ ሱኡጴ፣ መአꬃ፣ ኢቲመ ኡክኬንኔ ጎምመኔ - መአነው፣ ጉኡꬃ ዎዴ ሼምፕፐነዊንኔ አአኪሜ ከአልሉወአ ነአገነው ቤስሴእስ።
turns.amharic: ንጹሕና ገንቢ ምግብ—የሥጋ መረቅ፣ ወተት፣ የቡላ ገንፎና ጎመን—መመገብ፣ ለትንሽ ጊዜ ማረፍና የሐኪም ክትትልን መጠበቅ ይገባል።
turns.english: He should eat nourishing food—meat broth, milk, bulla porridge, and greens—rest adequately, and keep up with medical follow-ups.
turns.fst_morpheme_notes: geeshsha quuma-a ma-anaw (nutritious food-ACC eat-FUT.PURP, PHR-043) + shempp-anaw-inne (rest-FUT.PURP-and, PHR-045) + naag-anaw bess-ees (keep-FUT.PURP ought-PRES.3MS).

turns.speaker: user
turns.gofatho_latin: Qamma ta achchey daro sakkidi zin77ibekke. Achche aakimeekko baada ay gada qonccissoo?
turns.gofatho_fidel: ቀምመ ተ አችቼይ ደሮ ሰክኪዲ ዚንዕዒቤክኬ። አችቼ አአኪሜእክኮ በአደ አይ ገደ ቆንጭጪስሶኦ?
turns.amharic: ማታ ጥርሴ በጣም አሞኝ አልተኛሁም። ወደ ጥርስ ሐኪም ሄጄ ምን ብዬ ላስረዳ?
turns.english: Last night my tooth hurt badly and I did not sleep. When I go to the dentist, how should I explain it?
turns.fst_morpheme_notes: qamma ta achche-y (night my tooth-NOM, geminate chch) + daro sakk-idi (very ache-CNV2.ANT) + zin77-ibekke (sleep-PAST.1S.NEG.DCL); achche aakimee-kko (tooth doctor-DIR) + qoncc-iss-oo (explain-CAUS-1S.INTER).

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.gofatho_latin: Achche aakimeekko: "Haddirssa bagga gaxa achchey daro sakkees; irxxa haatha uyiyaa wodekka qanxxees" gada qonccissa.
turns.gofatho_fidel: አችቼ አአኪሜእክኮ፦ "ሀድዲርስሰ በግገ ገጠ አችቼይ ደሮ ሰክኬእስ፤ ኢርጥጠ ሀአꬃ ኡዪየአ ዎዴክከ ቀንጥጤእስ" ገደ ቆንጭጪስሰ።
turns.amharic: ለጥርስ ሐኪሙ፦ «በግራ በኩል ያለው የመንጋጋ ጥርሴ በጣም ያመኛል፤ ቀዝቃዛ ውኃ ስጠጣም ይሰቀጥጠኛል» ብለህ አስረዳ።
turns.english: Explain to the dentist: 'My left back molar hurts very much; and when I drink cold water, it gives a sharp pain.'
turns.fst_morpheme_notes: haddirssa bagga (left side, PHR-083) + gaxa achche-y (molar tooth-NOM) + irxxa haatha uy-iyaa wode-kka (cold water drink-PRES.REL when-ADD) + qanxx-ees (cut/sting-PRES.3MS).

turns.speaker: user
turns.gofatho_latin: Achche payyatethaa ubba galla naaganaw Goofatho doonan nayta ay zoroo?
turns.gofatho_fidel: አችቼ ፐይየቴꬃአ ኡብበ ገልለ ነአገነው ጎኦፈꬆ ዶኦነን ነይተ አይ ዞሮኦ?
turns.amharic: የጥርስ ጤንነትን በየቀኑ ለመጠበቅ በጎፋኛ ልጆችን ምን እንምከር?
turns.english: How should we advise children in Gofatho to care for their dental health every day?
turns.fst_morpheme_notes: achche payyatetha-a (tooth health-ACC) + ubba galla naag-anaw (every day guard-FUT.PURP) + nay-ta ay zor-oo (child-PL.ACC what advise-1PL.INTER).

turns.gofatho_fidel: ኢረꬃይ ዶኦምሚሺን ገዲየአ ጎሽሻነው ጊኢጌትተይስ። ዘሪየአ ዜረነአፕፔ ከሴ ቢኢትተአ ወአተደ ጊኢጊስሶኦ?

turns.gofatho_fidel: ደግጎ ዎገን ሾኦሮቲ በንትተ ቦኦረተንኔ ቤእጤተ እክኪዲ ሺኢቂዲ፣ ኢስሲ ገልለ ኢስሲ ኡረአ ገዲየአ፣ ዎንትቴꬃ ገልለ ሀረአ ገዲየአ ዬትꬃአኒንኔ ኡፈይስሰን ጎሽሾኦሶነ!
turns.amharic: በዳጎ (ደቦ) ባህል ጎረቤቶች በሬዎቻቸውንና ዶማዎቻቸውን ይዘው ተሰብስበው፣ አንድ ቀን የአንዱን ሰው ማሳ፣ በማግስቱ የሌላውን ማሳ በዘፈንና በደስታ ያርሳሉ!
turns.english: In the 'daggo' cooperative tradition, neighbors gather with their oxen and hoes, plowing one person's field one day and another's the next day with song and joy!
turns.fst_morpheme_notes: bantta boora-ta-nne beexe-ta (3PL.REFL.GEN ox-PL.ACC-and hoe-PL.ACC) + ekk-idi shiiq-idi (take-CNV2 gather-CNV2) + yetthaa-n-nne ufayssa-n (song-INST-and joy-INST) + goshsh-oosona (plow-PRES.3PL.A.DCL).

Gr9_Ch5 Proverb: Dure duufoy uutha giddo

turns.speaker: user
turns.gofatho_latin: Goofa gaden "uutha" goshshay so asaa duussaas aybis hessa keena koshshii?
turns.gofatho_fidel: ጎኦፈ ገዴን "ኡኡꬃ" ጎሽሻይ ሶ አሰአ ዱኡስሰአስ አይቢስ ሄስሰ ኬእነ ኮሽሺኢ?
turns.amharic: በጎፋ ምድር የእንሰት («ኡꬃ») እርሻ ለቤተሰብ ኑሮ ለምን ያህል አስፈላጊ ነው?
turns.english: In the land of Gofa, why is enset ('uutha') cultivation so vital for family livelihood?
turns.fst_morpheme_notes: Goofa gade-n (Gofa land-LOC, PHR-048) + uutha goshsha-y (enset farming-NOM) + so asaa duussa-as (family livelihood-DAT) + aybis (why) + koshsh-ii (be.needed-PRES.3MS.INTER).

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.gofatho_latin: Uuthay boniyaa dandda7iyaa mithaa; uuthaappe eesay, itimay, gollaay, mehe maatanne wodoro oothettiyaa goliyaa beettees.
turns.gofatho_fidel: ኡኡꬃይ ቦኒየአ ደንድደዒየአ ሚꬃአ፤ ኡኡꬃአፕፔ እእሰይ፣ ኢቲመይ፣ ጎልለአይ፣ ሜሄ መአተንኔ ዎዶሮ ኦኦꬄትቲየአ ጎሊየአ ቤእትቴእስ።
turns.amharic: እንሰት ድርቅን (በጋን) የሚቋቋም ተክል ነው፤ ከእንሰት ቆጮ (ኤሳ)፣ ቡላ (ኢቲማ)፣ አሚቾ፣ የከብት መኖና ገመድ የሚሠራበት ቃጫ ይገኛል።
turns.english: Enset is a drought-resilient plant; from enset come kocho ('eesa'), bulla ('itima'), boiled corm, livestock fodder, and strong fiber for rope ('wodoro').
turns.fst_morpheme_notes: boniya-a dandda7-iyaa mitha-a (dry.season-ACC endure-PRES.REL plant-PRED, ZARA-03 7); uuthaa-ppe (enset-ABL) + ooth-ett-iyaa (make-PASS-PRES.REL) + beett-ees (be.found-PRES.3MS).

turns.speaker: user
turns.gofatho_latin: Uddufuntho kifile Shemppo 5 (p. 41) giddon uutha bonchchuwaa qonccisiyaa tossey ay gii?
turns.gofatho_fidel: ኡድዱፉንꬆ ኪፊሌ ሼምፕፖ 5 (ፕ። 41) ጊድዶን ኡኡꬃ ቦንችቹወአ ቆንጭጪሲየአ ቶስሴይ አይ ጊኢ?
turns.amharic: በዘጠነኛ ክፍል ምዕራፍ 5 (ገጽ 41) ውስጥ የእንሰትን ክብር የሚገልጸው ምሳሌ ምን ይላል?
turns.english: What does the proverb in Grade 9 Chapter 5 (p. 41) say about the prestige of an enset garden?
turns.fst_morpheme_notes: uutha bonchchuwa-a (enset honor-ACC.M.DEF, MP-10) + qoncc-is-iyaa tosse-y (express-CAUS-PRES.REL proverb-NOM).

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.gofatho_latin: Tossey: "Dure duufoy uutha giddo" gees; hegeekka keetha yuushuwan daro uutha tokkiyaa asi nam77ettenna guussa.
turns.gofatho_fidel: ቶስሴይ፦ "ዱሬ ዱኡፎይ ኡኡꬃ ጊድዶ" ጌእስ፤ ሄጌእክከ ኬእꬃ ዩኡሹወን ደሮ ኡኡꬃ ቶክኪየአ አሲ ነምዕዔትቴንነ ጉኡስሰ።
turns.amharic: ምሳሌው፦ «ዱሬ ዱፎይ ኡꬃ ጊዶ» (የሀብታም መቃብሩ በእንሰት አትክልት መካከል ነው) ይላል፤ ይህም በቤቱ ዙሪያ ብዙ እንሰት የተከለ ሰው አይራብም ማለት ነው።
turns.english: The proverb says: 'Dure duufoy uutha giddo' ('A prosperous person's resting place is amidst the flourishing enset garden'); meaning a household surrounded by thriving enset never suffers hunger.
turns.fst_morpheme_notes: dure duufo-y (rich.person grave-NOM, Gr9 Ch.5 p. 41) + uutha giddo (enset inside); tokki-yaa as-i (plant-PRES.REL person-NOM) + nam77-ett-enna (hunger-PASS-PRES.3MS.NEG).

dialogues.source_grounding: Grade 10 Goofatho Doona Ch. 2 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/1mKIcfMoMgnZ9Pa657NWmE-OGND2wlveM/view?usp=drivesdk, pp. 12–13: cumo/cumees); Phrasebook PHR-048
rag_retrieval_anchors: Gr10_Ch2 Vocab: cumo / cumees (pre-marital homestead planting of coffee, enset, and fruit trees)

turns.speaker: user
turns.gofatho_latin: Tammantho kifile Shemppo 2 (p. 12) giddon "cumo / cumees" giyaa Goofa goshshaanne eko gelo wogay ay guussee?
turns.gofatho_fidel: ተምመንꬆ ኪፊሌ ሼምፕፖ 2 (ፕ። 12) ጊድዶን "ጩሞ / ጩሜእስ" ጊየአ ጎኦፈ ጎሽሻአንኔ እኮ ጌሎ ዎገይ አይ ጉኡስሴእ?
turns.amharic: በአሥረኛ ክፍል ምዕራፍ 2 (ገጽ 12) ውስጥ «ጩሞ / ጩሜስ» የሚለው የጎፋ የእርሻና የጋብቻ ባህል ምን ማለት ነው?
turns.english: In Grade 10 Chapter 2 (p. 12), what does the Gofa agricultural and marriage custom 'cumo / cumees' mean?
turns.fst_morpheme_notes: cumo / cum-ees (groom's pre-marital planting of perennial crops around his new homestead, Gr10 Ch.2 p. 12); ay guuss-ee (what meaning-COP.INTER).

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.gofatho_latin: "Cumo" guussay attuma na7ay machcho ekkanaappe kase ba ooratha keetha yuushuwan uutha, tukke, muze, boyenne suunqqo mithata tokkiyaa woga.
turns.gofatho_fidel: "ጩሞ" ጉኡስሰይ አትቱመ ነዓይ መችቾ እክከነአፕፔ ከሴ በ ኦኦረꬃ ኬእꬃ ዩኡሹወን ኡኡꬃ፣ ቱክኬ፣ ሙዜ፣ ቦዬንኔ ሱኡንቅቆ ሚꬃተ ቶክኪየአ ዎገ።
turns.amharic: «ጩሞ» ማለት ወንድ ልጅ ሚስት ከማግባቱ በፊት በአዲሱ ቤቱ ዙሪያ እንሰት፣ ቡና (ቱኬ)፣ ሙዝ፣ ቦዬና የቅመም ተክሎችን የሚተክልበት ባህል ነው።
turns.english: 'Cumo' is the custom whereby a young man, before marrying, plants enset, coffee ('tukke'), bananas, yam ('boye'), and spice plants around his new homestead.
turns.fst_morpheme_notes: machcho ekk-anaa-ppe kase (wife take/marry-FUT.NMZ-ABL before) + ba ooratha keetha yuushuwa-n (3REFL.GEN new house surroundings-LOC) + tokk-iyaa woga (plant-PRES.REL custom).

turns.speaker: user
turns.gofatho_latin: Tukke mithay keyan melonna mala ayba kuya mithata garssan tokkettii?
turns.gofatho_fidel: ቱክኬ ሚꬃይ ኬየን ሜሎንነ መለ አይበ ኩየ ሚꬃተ ገርስሰን ቶክኬትቲኢ?
turns.amharic: የቡና ተክሉ በፀሐይ እንዳይደርቅ በምን ዓይነት የጥላ ዛፎች ስር ይተከላል?
turns.english: So that coffee plants do not wither in the hot sun, under what kind of shade trees are they planted?
turns.fst_morpheme_notes: tukke mitha-y (coffee tree-NOM) + keya-n (sun-LOC, PHR-058) + mel-onna mala (dry-NEG.PURP) + kuya mitha-ta garssa-n (shade tree-PL.GEN under-LOC, Gr8 Ch.2 p. 34 kuya) + tokk-ett-ii (plant-PASS-PRES.3MS.INTER).

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.gofatho_latin: Goofa gaden tukkey wola, korddo, zigaanne muziyaa kuya garssan tokkettees; mithaa haythay wukkidi biittaa marqqees.
turns.gofatho_fidel: ጎኦፈ ገዴን ቱክኬይ ዎለ፣ ኮርድዶ፣ ዚገአንኔ ሙዚየአ ኩየ ገርስሰን ቶክኬትቴእስ፤ ሚꬃአ ሀይꬃይ ዉክኪዲ ቢኢትተአ መርቅቄእስ።
turns.amharic: በጎፋ ምድር ቡና በዋርካ (ዎላ)፣ በዋንዛ፣ በዝግባና በሙዝ ጥላ ስር ይተከላል፤ የዛፉ ቅጠልም ረግፎ አፈሩን ያዳብራል።
turns.english: In Gofa, coffee is planted under the shade of sycamore fig ('wola', Gr8 Ch.5 p. 76), cordia, podocarpus, and banana trees; the fallen leaves also enrich the soil.
turns.fst_morpheme_notes: wola (sycamore fig tree, Gr8 Ch.5 p. 76) + kuya garssa-n (shade under-LOC) + tokk-ett-ees (plant-PASS-PRES.3MS); biitta-a marqq-ees (soil-ACC fertilize-PRES.3MS).

dialogues.source_grounding: Grade 8 Goofatho Doona Ch. 1, Ch. 6 & Ch. 9 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/160NHNy-4orPcAIk-L5t6tOEtZoWemz_-/view?usp=drivesdk, pp. 11, 82–94, 127); Phrasebook PHR-049
rag_retrieval_anchors: Gr8_Ch1: Biittay di7on meecettonna mela naago

turns.speaker: user
turns.gofatho_latin: Hosppuntho kifile Shemppo 6 ("Bazzotethi", p. 82) giddon woray qeexettiyaa wodenne xaraga tamay medhettiyaa wode biittaa bolla ayba qohoy gakkii?
turns.gofatho_fidel: ሆስፕፑንꬆ ኪፊሌ ሼምፕፖ 6 ("በዝዞቴꬂ"፣ ፕ። 82) ጊድዶን ዎረይ ቄእጤትቲየአ ዎዴንኔ ጠረገ ተመይ ሜꬌትቲየአ ዎዴ ቢኢትተአ ቦልለ አይበ ቆሆይ ገክኪኢ?
turns.amharic: በስምንተኛ ክፍል ምዕራፍ 6 («በረሃማነት»፣ ገጽ 82) ውስጥ ደን ሲጨፈጨፍና የሰደድ እሳት ሲነሣ በመሬቱ ላይ ምን ጉዳት ይደርሳል?
turns.english: In Grade 8 Chapter 6 ('Desertification', p. 82), when forests are cut down and wildfires occur, what damage happens to the land?
turns.fst_morpheme_notes: wora-y qeex-ett-iyaa wode-nne (forest-NOM clear/cut-PASS-PRES.REL when-and, Gr8 Ch.9 p. 128) + xaraga tama-y (wildfire-NOM, Gr8 Ch.6 p. 83) + bazzotethi (desertification, Gr8 Ch.6 p. 82).

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.gofatho_latin: Woray qeexettiyaa wode iratha di7oy marqqa biittaa meecidi efees, pulttoti meloosona, wora do7ati betoosonanne bazzotethay daayees.
turns.gofatho_fidel: ዎረይ ቄእጤትቲየአ ዎዴ ኢረꬃ ዲዖይ መርቅቀ ቢኢትተአ ሜእጪዲ እፌእስ፣ ፑልትቶቲ ሜሎኦሶነ፣ ዎረ ዶዓቲ ቤቶኦሶነንኔ በዝዞቴꬃይ ደአዬእስ።
turns.amharic: ደን ሲጨፈጨፍ የዝናብ ጎርፍ ለም አፈሩን አጥቦ ይወስዳል፣ ምንጮች ይደርቃሉ፣ የዱር እንስሳት ይሰደዳሉ እንዲሁም በረሃማነት ይስፋፋል።
turns.english: When forests are cleared, rain runoff washes away fertile topsoil, springs dry up, wild animals flee, and desertification spreads ('daayees').
turns.fst_morpheme_notes: iratha di7o-y (rain flood-NOM, Gr8 Ch.1 p. 11) + marqqa biitta-a meec-idi ef-ees (fertile soil-ACC wash-CNV2 take-PRES.3MS); mel-oosona (dry-PRES.3PL); daay-ees (spread-PRES.3MS, Gr8 Ch.8 p. 114).

turns.speaker: user
turns.gofatho_latin: Deretethay biittay di7on meecettonna malaanne bazzotethaa teqqanaw ay oothanaw bessii?
turns.gofatho_fidel: ዴሬቴꬃይ ቢኢትተይ ዲዖን ሜእጬትቶንነ መለአንኔ በዝዞቴꬃአ ቴቅቀነው አይ ኦኦꬃነው ቤስሲኢ?
turns.amharic: ማኅበረሰቡ አፈሩ በጎርፍ እንዳይታጠብና በረሃማነትን ለመከላከል ምን ማድረግ ይገባዋል?
turns.english: What must the community do so that the soil is not eroded by runoff and to halt desertification?
turns.fst_morpheme_notes: biitta-y di7o-n meec-ett-onna mala-anne (soil-NOM flood-INST wash-PASS-NEG.PURP-and, Gr8 Ch.1 p. 11) + teqq-anaw (prevent/block-FUT.PURP).

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.gofatho_latin: Dere zumata bolla keela keexxanaw, xaraga tamaappe woraa naaganawinne ubba balgguwan ooratha mitha xeerata tokkanaw bessees. "Mithaa tokkoy biittaa naagees!"
turns.gofatho_fidel: ዴሬ ዙመተ ቦልለ ኬእለ ኬእጥጠነው፣ ጠረገ ተመአፕፔ ዎረአ ነአገነዊንኔ ኡብበ በልግጉወን ኦኦረꬃ ሚꬃ ጤእረተ ቶክከነው ቤስሴእስ። "ሚꬃአ ቶክኮይ ቢኢትተአ ነአጌእስ!"

turns.english: According to the Grade 8 textbook (p. 123), it is classified into alpine frost ('ceco-gezze'), highland ('gezze'), mid-altitude ('giddo-gezze'), lowland ('gadha'), and desert ('bazzo').
turns.fst_morpheme_notes: ceco-gezze (alpine frost zone, Gr8 Ch.9 p. 123) + gezze (highland) + gadha (lowland) + bazzo (desert) + shaak-ett-ees (divide-PASS-PRES.3MS).

turns.speaker: user
turns.gofatho_latin: Goofa Zooniyan Bulqinne Melo Koza xoqqa gezzen, qassi Sawulanne Laha giddo-gezzeninne gadhan ayba katthati diccoikonaa?
turns.gofatho_fidel: ጎኦፈ ዞኦኒየን ቡልቂንኔ ሜሎ ኮዘ ጦቅቀ ጌዝዜን፣ ቀስሲ ሰዉለንኔ ለሀ ጊድዶ-ጌዝዜኒንኔ ገꬋን አይበ ከትꬃቲ ዲጭጮኢኮነአ?

turns.english: In Gofa Zone, what crops grow in the Bulqi and Melo Koza highlands versus the Sawla and Laha midlands and lowlands?

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.gofatho_latin: Bulqi gezzen bangga, qamade, atare, baqeelanne uutha daro diccees; Sawulanne Laha heeran qassi tukke, xaafe, badalla, muze, maangonne kassava loythi diccees!
turns.gofatho_fidel: ቡልቂ ጌዝዜን በንግገ፣ ቀመዴ፣ አተሬ፣ በቄእለንኔ ኡኡꬃ ደሮ ዲጭጬእስ፤ ሰዉለንኔ ለሀ ሄእረን ቀስሲ ቱክኬ፣ ጠአፌ፣ በደልለ፣ ሙዜ፣ መአንጎንኔ ከስሰvአ ሎይꬂ ዲጭጬእስ!

turns.english: In the Bulqi highlands, barley, wheat, peas, fava beans, and enset flourish; while around Sawla and Laha, coffee, teff, maize, bananas, mangoes, and cassava grow abundantly!

dialogues.source_grounding: Phrasebook PHR-047, PHR-051 & PHR-058; Grade 8 Ch. 9 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/160NHNy-4orPcAIk-L5t6tOEtZoWemz_-/view?usp=drivesdk)

dialogues.source_grounding: Phrasebook PHR-052 & PHR-057; Grade 9 Ch. 5 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/1uvGaBT4-O_Jn7oQbuNl1W88lFBFiHULU/view?usp=drivesdk, p. 41: Maathiw ixxanaa miiziya maatiw ixxawsu)

turns.speaker: user
turns.gofatho_latin: Nuuni soo meheta - miizzata, dorssatanne deeshshata - heemmoos. Miizziyaa daro maatha immana mala ay oothoo?
turns.gofatho_fidel: ኑኡኒ ሶኦ ሜሄተ - ሚኢዝዘተ፣ ዶርስሰተንኔ ዴእሽሻተ - ሄእምሞኦስ። ሚኢዝዚየአ ደሮ መአꬃ ኢምመነ መለ አይ ኦኦꬆኦ?

turns.fst_morpheme_notes: soo mehe-ta (domestic livestock-PL.ACC, Gr8 Ch.5 p. 76) + miizza-ta, dorssa-ta-nne deeshsha-ta (cow-PL.ACC, sheep-PL.ACC-and goat-PL.ACC, PHR-052) + heemm-oos (herd-PRES.1PL); daro maatha imm-ana mala (much milk give-FUT.PURP).

turns.speaker: assistant

turns.gofatho_fidel: ሚኢዝዘአስ ጌእሽሻ መአተአ፣ ኡኡꬃ ሀይꬃአ፣ መጢኒየአንኔ ጌእሽሻ ሀአꬃአ ኡብበ ገልለ ኢምመ፤ ቀስሲ ዚንዕዒየአ ጎለይ ጌእሽሻ ጊዶ!

turns.amharic: አዎ! መብረቅ በሚብለጨለጭበት ጊዜ በረጅም ዛፍ ስር አትቁሙ፤ በሬዎቹንና መሣሪያዎቹን ይዛችሁ በፍጥነት ወደ ቤት ግቡ። «ሊሄድ ያለ ዝናብ እያለፈ ይዘንባል!»
turns.english: Yes! When lightning is flashing, do not stand under tall trees; take the oxen and tools and head indoors quickly. 'Passing rain pours as it moves on!'

turns.english: In passive voice ('Ost-meqo'), it becomes: 'Ashoy Shaashshotan mettis' ('The meat was eaten by Shaashshota')! 'Asho' becomes 'Asho-y' (NOM.M), 'Shaashshota' takes '-n' (instrumental agent), and 'm-asu' becomes 'm-ett-is' (eat-PASS-PAST.3MS).
turns.fst_morpheme_notes: Full passive morphosyntactic derivation (Gr8 Ch.5 p. 85 & Gr10 Ch.9 p. 86): Patient promoted to NOM (-y), Agent demoted to INST (-n), Verb takes -ett- + 3MS agreement (-is).

turns.gofatho_fidel: ኡድዱፉንꬆ ኪፊሌ መጠአፈአ (ፕፕ። 62-65) መአረን፦ (1) ኢስሲ ቆምሞ ኡስትተቲ ነዕዓአ ገክከነአሺን ጠልለ ከአልሊዲ ጠአፌትቶኦሶነ (አአ፣ እእ፣ ኢኢ፣ ኦኦ፣ ኡኡ) - ሄእꬑ ኡስትቲ ኢስሲፕፔ ጠአፌትቴንነ (ዘረ-01)፤ (2) ዱምመትቲየአ ነዕዑ ኡስትተቲ ኢስሲፕፔ እቅቆክኮነ፤ እንትተ ጊድዶን "ዕ"፣ "ይ" ዎይ "ው" ጌሌእስ (ዘረ-03፦ ሌእሚሶስ 'ቤዔእስ'፣ 'ሎዕዖ')።
turns.amharic: በዘጠነኛ ክፍል መጽሐፍ (ገጽ 62–65) መሠረት፦ (1) ተመሳሳይ አናባቢዎች እስከ ሁለት ድረስ ብቻ ተከታትለው ይጻፋሉ (aa, ee, ii, oo, uu) — ሦስት አናባቢ አንድ ላይ አይጻፍም፤ (2) የተለያዩ ሁለት አናባቢዎች አንድ ላይ አይቆሙም፤ በመካከላቸው «7» (/ʔ/)፣ «y» ወይም «w» ይገባል (ለምሳሌ 'be7ees'፣ 'lo77o')።
turns.english: According to the Grade 9 textbook (pp. 62–65): (1) Identical vowels are written at most two in a row (aa, ee, ii, oo, uu) — three vowels never occur together (ZARA-01); (2) Two dissimilar vowels never stand adjacent; '7' (/ʔ/), 'y', or 'w' intervenes between them (ZARA-03, e.g., 'be7ees', 'lo77o').
turns.fst_morpheme_notes: ZARA-01 (no *VVV), ZARA-02 (no word-initial geminate *CCV), ZARA-03 (no dissimilar vowel hiatus *V1V2; requires glottal '7' or glide y/w).

turns.gofatho_fidel: ተምመንꬆ ኪፊሌ ሼምፕፖ 6 (ፕፕ። 60-61) ጊድዶን "ፒንኒየአ ፔእሾ" ንኔ "ፒንኖንነ ፔእሾ" ወአቲዲ ሻአክኮኦ?

turns.speaker: assistant

turns.amharic: «ፒኒያ ፔሾ» (ተሻጋሪ ግስ) ማለት ተሳቢ (ካሎዴ) የሚፈልግ ግስ ነው፦ ለምሳሌ «ሻሚስ» (ገዛ)፣ «ሜጫሱ» (አጠበች)፣ «ኬጢስ» (ሠራ)፤ «ፒኖና ፔሾ» (ኢ-ተሻጋሪ ግስ) ደግሞ ተሳቢ የማይፈልግ ግስ ነው፦ ለምሳሌ «ዚንዒስ» (ተኛ)፣ «ዬኪስ» (አለቀሰ)፣ «ሚኢጫሱ» (ሳቀች)፣ «ኤቂስ» (ቆመ)።
turns.english: 'Pinniyaa peesho' (transitive verb) is a verb that requires a direct object ('kaalodde'), such as 'shammis' (bought), 'meecasu' (washed), 'keexxis' (built); whereas 'Pinnonna peesho' (intransitive verb) does not take an object, such as 'zin77is' (slept), 'yeekkis' (wept), 'miiccasu' (laughed), 'eqqis' (stood).
turns.fst_morpheme_notes: kaalodde koy-iyaa peesho (object want-PRES.REL verb) vs. kaalodde koy-onna peesho (object want-NEG.REL verb, Gr10 Ch.6 p. 60).

turns.gofatho_fidel: ፔእሹወአ ጠጱወን "-ኢስስ-" ጉጅጀ! ሌእሚሶስ፦ "ዚንዕዕ-ኢስ" (ፒንኖንነ) -> "አአዪየአ ነዓአ ዚንዕዕ-ኢስስ-አሱ" (ፒንኒየአ)፤ "ሚኢጭጭ-ኢስ" -> "ሚኢጭጭ-ኢስስ-ኢስ"!
turns.amharic: በግሱ ሥር ላይ «-iss-» (የአስደራጊ ቅጥያ) ጨምር! ለምሳሌ፦ «ዚንዒስ» (ተኛ - ኢ-ተሻጋሪ) -> «አዪያ ናዓ ዚንዒሳሱ» (እናቲቱ ልጁን አስተኛችው - ተሻጋሪ)፤ «ሚኢጪስ» (ሳቀ) -> «ሚኢጪሲስ» (አሳቀ)!

turns.gofatho_latin: Meega qofay go77an oyddu qommo: (1) "Qoncciso / Paate" (selle cachchan '.' wurssettees), (2) "Oysho" ('?' wurssettees), (3) "Kiita / Azazo" nne (4) "Malalo" ('!' wurssettees).

turns.english: By function, sentences have four types: (1) Declarative ('Qoncciso / Paate', ending with '.'), (2) Interrogative ('Oysho', ending with '?'), (3) Imperative ('Kiita / Azazo'), and (4) Exclamative ('Malalo', ending with '!').

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.gofatho_latin: "Balakko pacce meega qofa" barkka eqqidi kumetta qofa immenna: leemisos "Biri taw de7iyaakko..."; "La77a pacce meega qofa" qassi pana dandda7idi kumetta qofa immees: leemisos "...maxaafa shammays"!
turns.gofatho_fidel: "በለክኮ ፐጭጬ ሜእገ ቆፈ" በርክከ እቅቂዲ ኩሜትተ ቆፈ ኢምሜንነ፦ ሌእሚሶስ "ቢሪ ተው ዴዒየአክኮ።።።"፤ "ለዕዓ ፐጭጬ ሜእገ ቆፈ" ቀስሲ ፐነ ደንድደዒዲ ኩሜትተ ቆፈ ኢምሜእስ፦ ሌእሚሶስ "።።።መጠአፈ ሻምመይስ"!
turns.amharic: «ባላኮ ፓቼ ሜጋ ቆፋ» (ጥገኛ ዓረፍተ ነገር) ብቻውን ቆሞ ሙሉ ሐሳብ አይሰጥም፦ ለምሳሌ «ቢሪ ታው ዴዒያኮ...» (ገንዘብ ቢኖረኝ...)፤ «ላዓ ፓቼ ሜጋ ቆፋ» (ነጻ ዓረፍተ ነገር) ደግሞ ራሱን ችሎ ሙሉ ሐሳብ ይሰጣል፦ ለምሳሌ «...ማጣፋ ሻማይስ» (...መጽሐፍ እገዛለሁ)!
turns.english: 'Balakko pacce meega qofa' (dependent clause) cannot stand alone to give a complete thought, e.g., 'Biri taw de7iyaakko...' ('If I have money...'); whereas 'La77a pacce meega qofa' (independent clause) stands on its own and completes the predication, e.g., '...maxaafa shammays' ('...I buy a book')!
turns.fst_morpheme_notes: bir-i ta-w de7-iyaakko (money-NOM 1S-DAT exist-COND, Gr9 Ch.9 p. 80) = Balakko; maxaafa shamm-ays (book.ACC buy-PRES.1S) = La77a.

turns.amharic: ባለቤት (ዮሃዴ) ከሆነ «-ti» ይጨመራል (ለምሳሌ፦ 'ካፎይ' -> 'ካፎቲ' ወፎቹ፣ 'ታማሬይ' -> 'ታማሬቲ' ተማሪዎቹ)፤ ተሳቢ (ካሎዴ) ከሆነ ደግሞ «-ta» ይጨመራል ('ካፉዋ' -> 'ካፎታ' ወፎቹን፣ 'ታማሪያ' -> 'ታማሬታ' ተማሪዎቹን)!

turns.english: In Grade 9 Chapter 6 ('Poetry', pp. 47–53), what do the elements of Gofatho poetry—'keso', 'tura', 'zira', 'kure', 'mixe', and 'polo'—mean?
turns.fst_morpheme_notes: ginxxo yara-ti (poetry element-PL.NOM, Gr9 Ch.6 p. 51): keso, tura, zira, kure, mixe, eedo, polo/dinxxo.

turns.amharic: በዘጠነኛ ክፍል መጽሐፍ (ገጽ 51–53) መሠረት፦ «ኬሶ» = ቀለም (በአንድ ትንፋሽ የሚጠራ ድምፅ)፤ «ቱራ» = ሐረግ (የስንኝ ግማሽ)፤ «ዚራ» = ስንኝ (አንድ መስመር)፤ «ኩሬ» = አንጓ፤ «ሚጤ» = ምጣኔ (ለምሳሌ 6/6)፤ «ፖሎ / ዲንጦ» = ቤት መምታት (መድረሻ ድምፅ)!

turns.fst_morpheme_notes: Complete prosodic and poetic terminology of Gofatho (Gr9 Ch.6 pp. 51–53).

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.gofatho_latin: Bertte gasethoti: (1) Gaaso/Muruuta: "hessa gisho", "...gishshaw"; (2) Phalqqe/Qeeletho: "shin", "gidoppe attin"; (3) Gujjo: "gujjidinne", "hari attoshin"; (4) Dooretho: "woy / woykko".
turns.gofatho_fidel: ቤርትቴ ገሴꬆቲ፦ (1) ገአሶ/ሙሩኡተ፦ "ሄስሰ ጊሾ"፣ "።።።ጊሽሻው"፤ (2) ጳልቅቄ/ቄእሌꬆ፦ "ሺን"፣ "ጊዶፕፔ አትቲን"፤ (3) ጉጅጆ፦ "ጉጅጂዲንኔ"፣ "ሀሪ አትቶሺን"፤ (4) ዶኦሬꬆ፦ "ዎይ / ዎይክኮ"።
turns.amharic: ዋና ዋና አያያዦች፦ (1) የምክንያትና ውጤት፦ «ሄሳ ጊሾ» (ስለዚህ)፣ «...ጊሻው» (ስለ...)፤ (2) የተቃርኖ፦ «ሺን» (ግን)፣ «ጊዶፔ አቲን» (ይሁን እንጂ)፤ (3) የተጨማሪ፦ «ጉጂዲኔ» (በተጨማሪም)፣ «ሃሪ አቶሺን» (ይህም ቀርቶ)፤ (4) የአማራጭ፦ «ዎይ / ዎይኮ» (ወይም) ናቸው።
turns.english: The primary connectors are: (1) Cause/Result: 'hessa gisho' (therefore), '...gishshaw' (because); (2) Contrast: 'shin' (but), 'gidoppe attin' (however); (3) Addition: 'gujjidinne' (furthermore), 'hari attoshin' (moreover/let alone); (4) Alternative: 'woy / woykko' (or).
turns.fst_morpheme_notes: Classification of Gasethota from Gr8 Ch.10 p. 148 & Gr10 Ch.1 p. 11.

turns.gofatho_latin: (1) "Na7iyaa gallassan ubba wode minnada tamaarawsu; hessa gisho, paacciyan koyro keyadasu." (2) "Irathay daro bukkiis; gidoppe attin, tamaareti timirtte keethappe attibookkona."
turns.gofatho_fidel: (1) "ነዒየአ ገልለስሰን ኡብበ ዎዴ ሚንነደ ተመአረውሱ፤ ሄስሰ ጊሾ፣ ፐአጭጪየን ኮይሮ ኬየደሱ።" (2) "ኢረꬃይ ደሮ ቡክኪኢስ፤ ጊዶፕፔ አትቲን፣ ተመአሬቲ ቲሚርትቴ ኬእꬃፕፔ አትቲቦኦክኮነ።"
turns.amharic: (1) «ልጅቷ በየቀኑ ሁልጊዜ ጠንክራ ትማራለች፤ ስለዚህ (ሄሳ ጊሾ)፣ በፈተና አንደኛ ወጣች።» (2) «ዝናብ በብዛት ዘነበ፤ ይሁን እንጂ (ጊዶፔ አቲን)፣ ተማሪዎቹ ከትምህርት ቤት አልቀሩም።»
turns.english: (1) 'The girl studies diligently every day; therefore (hessa gisho), she stood first in the examination.' (2) 'Heavy rain fell; however (gidoppe attin), the students did not stay absent from school.'

turns.gofatho_fidel: ተምመንꬆ ኪፊሌ መጠአፈአ (ፕ። 64) መአረን፦ "አሾ ዶምዕዔ" ጉኡስሰይ ኦደአወይ ሀረ አሰአረ ዎይክኮ ሜꬌተአረ ገሄትቲየአ ዶምዕዔ፤ "ከሀ ዶምዕዔ" ቀስሲ ኦደአወይ በ ዎዘነአ/ቆፈአ ጊድዶን ፐለንꬂየአ ዶምዕዔ!

turns.english: According to the Grade 10 textbook (p. 64): 'asho dom77e' is physical/external conflict between a character ('odaawa') and another person or nature; whereas 'kaha dom77e' is internal/psychological conflict within the character's own mind!

turns.gofatho_latin: Haasginay: (1) "Koyro moode haasgina" ('Taani / Nuuni' gidi paatethiyaagaa, leemisos Ayyala Gabayo xaafido 'Biqqala' maxaafaa), (2) "Wurssi-eraadde haasgina" nne (3) "Xii-eraadde / Sima eraadde haasgina"!

turns.amharic: የትረካ አንጻር (ሃስጊና)፦ (1) «ኮይሮ ሞዴ ሃስጊና» ('ታኒ / ኑኒ' ብሎ የሚተርክ የአንደኛ መደብ አንጻር፣ ለምሳሌ አያሌው ገበየሁ የጻፈው 'ቢቃላ' ረጅም ልቦለድ)፣ (2) «ዉርሲ-ኤራዴ ሃስጊና» (ሁሉን አዋቂ የሦስተኛ መደብ አንጻር) እና (3) «ጢ-ኤራዴ / ሲማ ኤራዴ ሃስጊና» (ውሱን አዋቂ የሦስተኛ መደብ አንጻር) ናቸው!
turns.english: Narrative point of view ('haasgina') includes: (1) First-person POV ('Koyro moode haasgina', narrating as 'Taani / Nuuni', as in Ayyala Gabayo's novel 'Biqqala', pp. 69–70), (2) Omniscient third-person POV ('Wurssi-eraadde haasgina'), and (3) Limited third-person POV ('Xii-eraadde / Sima eraadde haasgina')!
turns.fst_morpheme_notes: Complete literary theory terminology from Gr10 Ch.7 pp. 65–70.

turns.gofatho_latin: Doona ubbaas bertte qoppobay asaa giddon gahetethi medho gididayssappe denddidayssaan, oona doonikka ba deretethaa qofaa, wogaanne hilohaa kumetta qonccissanaw dandda7ees; hessa gisho gita woy guutha dooni baawa!
turns.gofatho_fidel: ዶኦነ ኡብበአስ ቤርትቴ ቆፕፖበይ አሰአ ጊድዶን ገሄቴꬂ ሜꬎ ጊዲደይስሰፕፔ ዴንድዲደይስሰአን፣ ኦኦነ ዶኦኒክከ በ ዴሬቴꬃአ ቆፈአ፣ ዎገአንኔ ሂሎሀአ ኩሜትተ ቆንጭጪስሰነው ደንድደዔእስ፤ ሄስሰ ጊሾ ጊተ ዎይ ጉኡꬃ ዶኦኒ በአወ!
turns.amharic: የሁሉም ቋንቋ ዋና ዓላማ በሰዎች መካከል ግንኙነት መፍጠር ከመሆኑ የተነሣ፣ የማንም ቋንቋ የማኅበረሰቡን ሐሳብ፣ ባህልና ሥልጣኔ ሙሉ በሙሉ መግለጽ ይችላል፤ ስለዚህ ትልቅ ወይም ትንሽ ቋንቋ የለም!
turns.english: Because the primary purpose of every language is creating human communication, any language can fully express its society's thoughts, culture, and civilization ('hiloha'); therefore there is no 'big' or 'small' language!

turns.gofatho_latin: Tammantho kifile Shemppo 2 ("Gade Wogan Eko Gelo", pp. 7-14) giddon Goofa wogan eko gelo maarati koyroppe wurssetha gakkanaw awugeetee?
turns.gofatho_fidel: ተምመንꬆ ኪፊሌ ሼምፕፖ 2 ("ገዴ ዎገን እኮ ጌሎ"፣ ፕፕ። ዕ-14) ጊድዶን ጎኦፈ ዎገን እኮ ጌሎ መአረቲ ኮይሮፕፔ ዉርስሴꬃ ገክከነው አዉጌእቴእ?
turns.amharic: በአሥረኛ ክፍል ምዕራፍ 2 («በባህላዊ ሥርዓት ጋብቻ»፣ ገጽ 7–14) ውስጥ በጎፋ ባህል የጋብቻ ቅደም ተከተሎች ከመጀመሪያ እስከ መጨረሻ የትኞቹ ናቸው?
turns.english: In Grade 10 Chapter 2 ('Traditional Marriage Customs', pp. 7–14), what are the sequential stages of marriage in Gofa tradition from beginning to end?
turns.fst_morpheme_notes: gade woga-n eko gelo maara-ti (cultural custom-LOC marriage procedure-PL.NOM, Gr10 Ch.2 p. 7) + koyro-ppe wurssetha gakk-anaw (first-ABL end reach-UNTIL).

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.gofatho_latin: Orzaamonne Murqqenna haasaya (pp. 13-14) maaran: (1) "Laazanthi" (cima yeddidi oychcho), (2) "Doona pogo", (3) Na7iyaa puutto qolle/gaabe daddonne na7ay keetha keexxidi "cumo" tokkoy, (4) "Soofe", (5) "Yaagano" nne (6) "Githe" (meddati aayee-aawa soo biidi simmoy)!
turns.gofatho_fidel: ኦርዘአሞንኔ ሙርቅቄንነ ሀአሰየ (ፕፕ። 13-14) መአረን፦ (1) "ለአዘንꬂ" (ጪመ ዬድዲዲ ኦይችቾ)፣ (2) "ዶኦነ ፖጎ"፣ (3) ነዒየአ ፑኡትቶ ቆልሌ/ገአቤ ደድዶንኔ ነዓይ ኬእꬃ ኬእጥጢዲ "ጩሞ" ቶክኮይ፣ (4) "ሶኦፌ"፣ (5) "የአገኖ" ንኔ (6) "ጊꬄ" (ሜድደቲ አአዬእ-አአወ ሶኦ ቢኢዲ ሲምሞይ)!
turns.amharic: በኦርዛሞና ሙርቄና ምልልስ (ገጽ 13–14) መሠረት፦ (1) «ላዛንꬂ» (ሽምግልና — ሽማግሌ ልኮ መጠየቅ)፣ (2) «ዶና ፖጎ» (የቃል ማሰሪያ)፣ (3) ልጅቷ ጥጥ መፍተሏና ልጁ ቤት ሠርቶ ተክል መትከሉ («ጩሞ»)፣ (4) «ሶፌ» (የሙሽሪት የገበያ ጉዞ)፣ (5) «ያጋኖ» (ሠርግ) እና (6) «ጊꬄ» (መልስ) ናቸው!
turns.english: According to the dialogue between Orzaamo and Murqqenna (pp. 13–14): (1) 'Laazanthi' (sending matchmaking elders), (2) 'Doona pogo' (betrothal pledge), (3) the bride spinning cotton and the groom building a house and planting 'cumo', (4) 'Soofe' (pre-wedding market outing), (5) 'Yaagano' (wedding feast), and (6) 'Githe' (post-wedding ceremonial visit to the bride's parents)!
turns.fst_morpheme_notes: Complete 6-stage Gofa marriage ethnography from Gr10 Ch.2 pp. 12–14.

turns.speaker: user
turns.gofatho_latin: Yaagano galla meddaawaynne meddaayiyaa ooratha keetha kariyaa gakkiyaa wode aaway "xamaata" oyqqidi waani anjjii?
turns.gofatho_fidel: የአገኖ ገልለ ሜድደአወይንኔ ሜድደአዪየአ ኦኦረꬃ ኬእꬃ ከሪየአ ገክኪየአ ዎዴ አአወይ "ጠመአተ" ኦይቅቂዲ ወአኒ አንጅጂኢ?
turns.amharic: በሠርጉ ቀን ሙሽራውና ሙሽሪት አዲሱ ቤት ደጃፍ ሲደርሱ አባትየው «ጣማታ» (እርጎ) ይዞ እንዴት ይመርቃል?
turns.english: On the wedding day when the groom and bride arrive at the threshold of the new house, how does the father bless them holding curd ('xamaata')?
turns.fst_morpheme_notes: yaagano galla (wedding day) + ooratha keetha kariya-a (new house doorway-ACC, PHR-0194) + xamaata (curd/yogurt, Gr10 Ch.2 p. 14) + waan-i anjj-ii (how-CNV2 bless-PRES.3MS.INTER).

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.gofatho_latin: Kariyan yeechche sa7an hiixxidi, aaway xamaataa meddata gediyan bochchissishe: "Yelite, dichchite, na7a na7a be7ite, xamaataadan irxxite!" gidi anjjees!
turns.gofatho_fidel: ከሪየን ዬእችቼ ሰዓን ሂኢጥጢዲ፣ አአወይ ጠመአተአ ሜድደተ ጌዲየን ቦችቺስሲሼ፦ "ዬሊቴ፣ ዲችቺቴ፣ ነዓ ነዓ ቤዒቴ፣ ጠመአተአደን ኢርጥጢቴ!" ጊዲ አንጅጄእስ!
turns.amharic: በደጃፉ የእንሰት ቅጠል (ዬችቼ) መሬት ላይ አንጥፎ፣ አባትየው እርጎውን በሙሽሮቹ እግር ላይ እያነካካ፦ «ውለዱ፣ አሳድጉ፣ የልጅ ልጅ እዩ፣ እንደ እርጎ ቀዝቅዙ (ሰላም ሁኑ)!» ብሎ ይመርቃል!
turns.english: With fresh enset leaves ('yeechche') spread on the ground at the threshold, the father touches curd ('xamaata') to the newlyweds' feet and blesses them saying: 'Bear children, raise them, see your grandchildren, and be cool and peaceful like curd!'
turns.fst_morpheme_notes: yeechche sa7a-n hiixx-idi (enset.leaf ground-LOC spread-CNV2, PHR-0197) + yel-ite, dichch-ite, na7a na7a be7-ite (bear-IMP.2PL, raise-IMP.2PL, child child see-IMP.2PL, Gr10 Ch.2 p. 14).

turns.speaker: user
turns.gofatho_latin: Tammantho kifile Shemppo 6 ("Bayrata Ooso Gisho", pp. 43-48) giddon "Dubbusha" nne "Gozdda" giyaa Goofa woga sunthati ay qonccissoikonaa?
turns.gofatho_fidel: ተምመንꬆ ኪፊሌ ሼምፕፖ 6 ("በይረተ ኦኦሶ ጊሾ"፣ ፕፕ። 43-48) ጊድዶን "ዱብቡሻ" ንኔ "ጎዝድደ" ጊየአ ጎኦፈ ዎገ ሱንꬃቲ አይ ቆንጭጪስሶኢኮነአ?
turns.amharic: በአሥረኛ ክፍል ምዕራፍ 6 («የሽማግሌዎች ሚና»፣ ገጽ 43–48) ውስጥ «ዱቡሻ» እና «ጎዝዳ» የሚሉት የጎፋ ባህላዊ ስሞች ምን ይገልጻሉ?
turns.english: In Grade 10 Chapter 6 ('The Role of Elders', pp. 43–48), what do the traditional Gofa terms 'Dubbusha' and 'Gozdda' refer to?
turns.fst_morpheme_notes: bayra-ta ooso gisho (elder-PL.GEN work role, Gr10 Ch.6 p. 43) + dubbusha (traditional public assembly ground) + gozdda (council of senior elders).

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.gofatho_latin: "Dubbusha" guussay Goofa deriyan bayratinne deretethay shiiqidi wogaabaa tobbiyaanne ooyettida asata sigethiyaa gita wola mitha garssa bessa; "Gozdda" qassi deriyaa sarotethaa naagiyaanne tumaan sigethiyaa bayra cimata cuga!
turns.gofatho_fidel: "ዱብቡሻ" ጉኡስሰይ ጎኦፈ ዴሪየን በይረቲንኔ ዴሬቴꬃይ ሺኢቂዲ ዎገአበአ ቶብቢየአንኔ ኦኦዬትቲደ አሰተ ሲጌꬂየአ ጊተ ዎለ ሚꬃ ገርስሰ ቤስሰ፤ "ጎዝድደ" ቀስሲ ዴሪየአ ሰሮቴꬃአ ነአጊየአንኔ ቱመአን ሲጌꬂየአ በይረ ጪመተ ጩገ!
turns.amharic: «ዱቡሻ» ማለት በጎፋ ምድር ሽማግሌዎችና ማኅበረሰቡ ተሰብስበው ስለ ባህል የሚወያዩበትና የተጣሉ ሰዎችን የሚያስታርቁበት በትልቅ ዋርካ ዛፍ ስር ያለ አደባባይ ነው፤ «ጎዝዳ» ደግሞ የአካባቢውን ሰላም የሚጠብቁና በእውነት የሚያስታርቁ የታላላቅ ሽማግሌዎች ማዕረግ/ሸንጎ ነው!
turns.english: 'Dubbusha' is the traditional public assembly plaza under a great sycamore tree where Gofa elders and the community gather to deliberate and reconcile disputants; and 'Gozdda' is the respected council of senior peacemaking elders!
turns.fst_morpheme_notes: shiiq-idi (gather-CNV2.ANT) + tobb-iyaa-nne (discuss-PRES.REL-and) + ooy-ett-ida asa-ta (quarrel-RECIP-PAST.REL person-PL.ACC) + sigeth-iyaa (reconcile-PRES.REL, Gr8 Ch.10 p. 140 & Gr10 Ch.6 p. 45).

turns.speaker: user
turns.gofatho_latin: Bayra cimata bonchchuwaanne entta sigetho wolqqaa qonccisiyaa "Dosin ixxin cimi shi7a muzees" giyaa tosse birshshethay aybee?
turns.gofatho_fidel: በይረ ጪመተ ቦንችቹወአንኔ እንትተ ሲጌꬆ ዎልቅቀአ ቆንጭጪሲየአ "ዶሲን ኢጥጢን ጪሚ ሺዓ ሙዜእስ" ጊየአ ቶስሴ ቢርሽሼꬃይ አይቤእ?
turns.amharic: የታላላቅ ሽማግሌዎችን ክብርና የማስታረቅ ኃይላቸውን የሚገልጸው «ዶሲን ኢጢን ጪሚ ሺዓ ሙዜስ» የሚለው ምሳሌ ትርጉሙ ምንድን ነው?
turns.english: What is the meaning of the proverb 'Dosin ixxin cimi shi7a muzees' that expresses the authority and reconciling power of elders?
turns.fst_morpheme_notes: dos-in ixx-in (like-CNV.DS refuse-CNV.DS = whether one likes it or not) + cim-i (elder-NOM.M) + shi7a muz-ees (dung eat.CAUS-PRES.3MS, Gr10 Ch.2 p. 13 & Ch.6 p. 46).

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.gofatho_latin: Ge birshshethay: ayba deexo ooyonne ziggire gidikkokka, bayra cimati giddo gelidi woossiyaanne sigethiyaa wode ooyettida asati cimata qaalaa bonchchidi maarotan sigettoosona guussa!
turns.gofatho_fidel: ጌ ቢርሽሼꬃይ፦ አይበ ዴእጦ ኦኦዮንኔ ዚግጊሬ ጊዲክኮክከ፣ በይረ ጪመቲ ጊድዶ ጌሊዲ ዎኦስሲየአንኔ ሲጌꬂየአ ዎዴ ኦኦዬትቲደ አሰቲ ጪመተ ቀአለአ ቦንችቺዲ መአሮተን ሲጌትቶኦሶነ ጉኡስሰ!
turns.amharic: ውስጠ-ወይራ ፍቺው፦ ምንም ያህል ከባድ ጠብና ቂም ቢሆንም፣ ታላላቅ ሽማግሌዎች በመካከል ገብተው ሲለምኑና ሲያስታርቁ የተጣሉት ሰዎች የሽማግሌዎችን ቃል አክብረው በይቅርታ ይታረቃሉ ማለት ነው!
turns.english: Its figurative meaning is: no matter how bitter a quarrel or grudge may be, when senior elders step in to mediate and appeal for peace, the disputants honor the elders' word and reconcile in forgiveness!
turns.fst_morpheme_notes: deexo ooyo-nne (heavy quarrel-and) + bayra cima-ti giddo gel-idi (senior elder-PL.NOM middle enter-CNV2) + sig-ett-oosona (reconcile-RECIP-PRES.3PL, Gr10 Ch.6 p. 46).

turns.speaker: user
turns.gofatho_latin: Goofa bila-odan "Qan77ishe" giyaa kaassay waani kaa7ettii? Hosppuntho kifile Shemppo 2 (p. 32) wogaa taassi odarkkii?
turns.gofatho_fidel: ጎኦፈ ቢለ-ኦደን "ቀንዕዒሼ" ጊየአ ከአስሰይ ወአኒ ከአዔትቲኢ? ሆስፕፑንꬆ ኪፊሌ ሼምፕፖ 2 (ፕ። 32) ዎገአ ተአስሲ ኦደርክኪኢ?
turns.amharic: በጎፋ ሥነ-ቃል «ቃንጪሼ» የሚባለው የግጥም ምልልስ ጨዋታ እንዴት ይካሄዳል? የስምንተኛ ክፍል ምዕራፍ 2 (ገጽ 32) ደንቡን ትነግረኛለህ?
turns.english: In Gofa oral literature ('bila-oda'), how is the rhyming poetic duel game 'Qan77ishe' played? Could you tell me the rules from Grade 8 Chapter 2 (p. 32)?
turns.fst_morpheme_notes: bila-oda-n (oral.literature-LOC, Gr9 Ch.5 p. 36) + qan77ishe (rhyming poetic duel, ZARA-03 geminate glottal 77=/ʔʔ/) + waan-i kaa7-ett-ii (how-CNV2 play-PASS-PRES.3MS.INTER).

turns.amharic: ጥሩነትን የሚያሞግሰው፦ «ሎዖይ ካዮራ ሎዔስ» (ጥሩ ከቡቃያው ያምራል)፣ የሚተቸው፦ «ሎዖ ዱሌን ሺዒ ዴዔስ» (ከጥሩ ስር እንከን አይጠፋም)፤ ክፉን የሚተቸው፦ «ኢቲ ኢሴስ፤ ጩርቂ ሻሌስ» (ክፋት ያጋጫል)፣ በሌላ አንጻር፦ «ኢቲ ኢታ ዎዴ አሼስ» (ክፉ ለክፉ ቀን ይደርሳል)!
turns.english: Praising the good: 'Lo77oy kayora lo77ees' ('Goodness blossoms from its young shoot') vs. Cautioning: 'Lo77o dullen shi7i de7ees' ('Beneath a fine exterior a flaw may lurk'); Critiquing malice: 'Iiti iissees; curqqi shaallees' ('Malice ruins relationships as mud stains') vs. Counter-perspective: 'Iiti iita wode ashshees' ('Even a harsh person/thing saves you in a time of crisis')!
turns.fst_morpheme_notes: Exact antithetical proverb pairs from Gr10 Ch.5 p. 40.

turns.gofatho_fidel: "ሰበ" ጉኡስሰይ ጎኦፈ ዴሪየን ጠለ፣ ኬሀ ኢመተ ሞክኪየአ፣ ሚኖ ጎሽሻንችቻ ዎይ ዴሬ ከአሌꬂየአ ከዎተ ቦንችቺዲ ዬትꬃአኒንኔ ቀአለን ሰብቢየአ ዎገ!

turns.english: 'Saba' is the traditional panegyric chant in Gofa honoring a brave hero ('xala'), a generous host, a master farmer, or community leaders ('kawo') in rhythmic verse!

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.gofatho_latin: Kawo Gaammonaa Amaado Zaala sabay: "Haathe oychin maathi immiya, mari oychin maathi woytiya!"; Tuuthe Bulqqo sabay qassi: "Atare bangga Tophphiyaas gidisiya!" gees!
turns.gofatho_fidel: ከዎ ገአምሞነአ አመአዶ ዘአለ ሰበይ፦ "ሀአꬄ ኦይቺን መአꬂ ኢምሚየ፣ መሪ ኦይቺን መአꬂ ዎይቲየ!"፤ ቱኡꬄ ቡልቅቆ ሰበይ ቀስሲ፦ "አተሬ በንግገ ቶጵጪየአስ ጊዲሲየ!" ጌእስ!
turns.amharic: የካዎ ጋሞና አማዶ ዛላ ሙገሳ፦ «ሃꬄ ኦይቺን ማꬂ ኢሚያ፣ ማሪ ኦይቺን ማꬂ ዎይቲያ!» (ውኃ ሲጠይቁት ወተት የሚሰጥ ለጋስ!)፤ የቱꬄ ቡልቆ ሙገሳ ደግሞ፦ «አታሬ ባንጋ ቶጵጪያስ ጊዲሲያ!» (አተርና ገብስ ለኢትዮጵያ የሚያበቃ ብርቱ አራሽ!) ይላል!
turns.english: The praise chant for Kawo Gaammona Amaado Zaala goes: 'Haathe oychin maathi immiya!' ('Who gives milk when asked for water!'); and the chant for Tuuthe Bulqqo goes: 'Atare bangga Tophphiyaas gidisiya!' ('Whose harvest of peas and barley suffices for all Ethiopia!')!

turns.gofatho_fidel: ኡድዱፉንꬆ ኪፊሌ ሼምፕፖ 8 ("ዲረአመ"፣ ፕፕ። ዕ2-ዕ5) ጊድዶን ፖለ፣ ዎርቅቀንኔ ጪኢሻይ ከአዒዶ ዲረአመአ አይፌ ቆፈይ አይቤእ?

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.gofatho_latin: He diraamaa giddon Polay "Timirtteappe nne shaloppe awugee aadhdhii?" gidi oycchees; wurssetha ayfe qofaykka timirtteynne eray shaloppe daro aadhdhiyaaogaa qonccissees!
turns.gofatho_fidel: ሄ ዲረአመአ ጊድዶን ፖለይ "ቲሚርትቴአፕፔ ንኔ ሻሎፕፔ አዉጌእ አአꬍꬊኢ?" ጊዲ ኦይጭቼእስ፤ ዉርስሴꬃ አይፌ ቆፈይክከ ቲሚርትቴይንኔ እረይ ሻሎፕፔ ደሮ አአꬍꬊየአኦገአ ቆንጭጪስሴእስ!
turns.amharic: በዚያ ድራማ ውስጥ ፖላ «ከትምህርትና ከገንዘብ (ሻሎ) የቱ ይበልጣል?» ብሎ ይጠይቃል፤ የመጨረሻው ዋና ጭብጥም ትምህርትና ዕውቀት ከገንዘብ በእጅጉ እንደሚበልጡ ያስረዳል!
turns.english: In that drama, Pola asks whether education ('timirtte') or material wealth ('shalo') is greater; and the central conclusion demonstrates that education and knowledge far surpass mere wealth!
turns.fst_morpheme_notes: timirtte-appe-nne shalo-ppe (education-ABL-and wealth-ABL, Gr9 Ch.8 p. 72) + awu-gee aadhdh-ii (which-DEF.M surpass-PRES.3MS.INTER).

turns.gofatho_latin: He diraamaa giddon timirtte bonchchuwaa qonccisiyaa "Shaloy timirtte gindde yedhdhenna" giyaa tosse birshshethay aybee?
turns.gofatho_fidel: ሄ ዲረአመአ ጊድዶን ቲሚርትቴ ቦንችቹወአ ቆንጭጪሲየአ "ሻሎይ ቲሚርትቴ ጊንድዴ ዬꬍꬌንነ" ጊየአ ቶስሴ ቢርሽሼꬃይ አይቤእ?

turns.english: What is the meaning of the proverb 'Shaloy timirtte gindde yedhdhenna' in that drama that highlights the supremacy of education?

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.gofatho_latin: "Shaloy timirtte gindde yedhdhenna" guussay miishshay timirtte gindde yedhdhenna guussa; shaloy wurssanaw dandda7ees, shin eray ubba wode asaa goda!
turns.gofatho_fidel: "ሻሎይ ቲሚርትቴ ጊንድዴ ዬꬍꬌንነ" ጉኡስሰይ ሚኢሽሻይ ቲሚርትቴ ጊንድዴ ዬꬍꬌንነ ጉኡስሰ፤ ሻሎይ ዉርስሰነው ደንድደዔእስ፣ ሺን እረይ ኡብበ ዎዴ አሰአ ጎደ!
turns.amharic: «ሻሎይ ቲሚርቴ ጊንዴ ዬꬌና» ማለት ገንዘብ የትምህርትን ተረከዝ እንኳን አይረግጥም (ከትምህርት ጋር አይወዳደርም) ማለት ነው፤ ገንዘብ ሊያልቅ ይችላል፣ ዕውቀት ግን ሁልጊዜ ከሰው ጋር ይኖራል!
turns.english: 'Shaloy timirtte gindde yedhdhenna' means 'Material wealth cannot even step on the heel of education' (cannot compare to education); money can be lost, whereas knowledge stays with a person forever!
turns.fst_morpheme_notes: Verbatim proverb and moral lesson from Grade 9 Textbook Ch. 8, p. 73.

turns.gofatho_latin: Tammantho kifile maxaafaa (pp. 76-81) maaran: yelagati timirtte wurssidi kawo ooso xalla naagonnaan, guutha miishshaappe doommidi ooratha ooso medhdhiyaanne "tuutummiya" wode manqqotetha kabbashaa koxidi duretethaa demmoosona!
turns.gofatho_fidel: ተምመንꬆ ኪፊሌ መጠአፈአ (ፕፕ። ዕ6-81) መአረን፦ ዬለገቲ ቲሚርትቴ ዉርስሲዲ ከዎ ኦኦሶ ጠልለ ነአጎንነአን፣ ጉኡꬃ ሚኢሽሻአፕፔ ዶኦምሚዲ ኦኦረꬃ ኦኦሶ ሜꬍꬊየአንኔ "ቱኡቱምሚየ" ዎዴ መንቅቆቴꬃ ከብበሻአ ኮጢዲ ዱሬቴꬃአ ዴምሞኦሶነ!
turns.amharic: በአሥረኛ ክፍል መጽሐፍ (ገጽ 76–81) መሠረት፦ ወጣቶች ትምህርት ጨርሰው የመንግሥት ሥራ ብቻ ሳይጠብቁ፣ ከትንሽ ካፒታል ጀምረው አዲስ ሥራ ሲፈጥሩና በጽናት ሲታገሉ («ቱቱሚያ») የድህነትን ቀንበር ሰብረው ብልጽግናን ያገኛሉ!
turns.english: According to the Grade 10 textbook (pp. 76–81): when youth, rather than waiting only for government jobs after graduation, start from small capital, create new enterprises ('ooso medho'), and strive persistently ('tuutummees'), they break the yoke of poverty and achieve prosperity!
turns.fst_morpheme_notes: kawo ooso xalla naag-onnaan (government job only wait-NEG.CNV, Gr10 Ch.9 p. 82) + tuutumm-iya wode (strive-PRES.REL when, Gr10 Ch.9 p. 81) + kox-idi (break-CNV2.ANT).

turns.speaker: user
turns.gofatho_latin: He shemppuwan (p. 82) uttidi wodiyaa mooronnaan qaaxxidi oothanaabaa odiyaa tossey ay gii?
turns.gofatho_fidel: ሄ ሼምፕፑወን (ፕ። 82) ኡትቲዲ ዎዲየአ ሞኦሮንነአን ቀአጥጢዲ ኦኦꬃነአበአ ኦዲየአ ቶስሴይ አይ ጊኢ?
turns.amharic: በዚያ ምዕራፍ ውስጥ (ገጽ 82) ቁጭ ብሎ ጊዜን ሳያባክኑ ተንቀሳቅሶ ስለ መሥራት የሚናገረው ምሳሌ ምን ይላል?
turns.english: What does the proverb in that chapter (p. 82) say about moving and working industriously rather than sitting idle?
turns.fst_morpheme_notes: utt-idi wodiya-a moor-onnaan (sit-CNV2 time-ACC waste-NEG.CNV) + qaaxx-idi ooth-anaa-baa (move/strive-CNV2 work-FUT.NMZ-ABOUT).

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.gofatho_latin: Tammantho kifile Shemppo 9 (p. 82) tossey: "Uttiday dulle pittees, qaaxxiday qanthe pittees" nne "Maahiyaa goynaa oykkopa; oykkiko yeddopa!" gees!
turns.gofatho_fidel: ተምመንꬆ ኪፊሌ ሼምፕፖ 9 (ፕ። 82) ቶስሴይ፦ "ኡትቲደይ ዱልሌ ፒትቴእስ፣ ቀአጥጢደይ ቀንꬄ ፒትቴእስ" ንኔ "መአሂየአ ጎይነአ ኦይክኮፐ፤ ኦይክኪኮ ዬድዶፐ!" ጌእስ!
turns.amharic: የአሥረኛ ክፍል ምዕራፍ 9 (ገጽ 82) ምሳሌ፦ «ኡቲዳይ ዱሌ ፒቴስ፣ ቃጢዳይ ቃንꬄ ፒቴስ» (ቁጭ ያለ መቀመጫውን ያራግፋል፣ የተንቀሳቀሰ ግን ያተርፋል) እና «ማሂያ ጎይና ኦይኮፓ፤ ኦይኪኮ ዬዶፓ!» (የነብር ጭራ አትያዝ፤ ከያዝክም አትልቀቅ — የጀመርከውን ሥራ በጽናት ጨርስ!) ይላል!
turns.english: The Grade 10 Chapter 9 (p. 82) proverbs state: 'Uttiday dulle pittees, qaaxxiday qanthe pittees' ('He who sits idle brushes dust off his seat, while he who moves and works prospers') and 'Maahiyaa goynaa oykkopa; oykkiko yeddopa!' ('Do not grab a leopard by the tail; if you do, do not let go — finish what you start with resolve!')
turns.fst_morpheme_notes: utt-ida-y (sit-PAST.REL-NOM.M) vs. qaaxx-ida-y (move/work-PAST.REL-NOM.M); oykk-opa (grab-PROH.2S), yedd-opa (let.go-PROH.2S, Gr10 Ch.9 p. 82).

dialogues.source_grounding: Grade 10 Goofatho Doona Ch. 8 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/1mKIcfMoMgnZ9Pa657NWmE-OGND2wlveM/view?usp=drivesdk, pp. 68–75: Deriya Gasethiyaa Miisheta / Social Media)
rag_retrieval_anchors: Gr10_Ch8 Vocab: deriya gasethiyaa miisheta (social media), dem-bessa (website), barbaxo/barbbaxetetha (networking), denthi-woso (upload/download)

turns.speaker: user
turns.gofatho_latin: Tammantho kifile Shemppo 8 ("Deriya Gasethiyaa Miisheta", pp. 68-73) giddon Social Media, Website, Networking nne Upload/Download Goofatho doonan ay geetettoikonaa?
turns.gofatho_fidel: ተምመንꬆ ኪፊሌ ሼምፕፖ 8 ("ዴሪየ ገሴꬂየአ ሚኢሼተ"፣ ፕፕ። 68-ዕ3) ጊድዶን ሶጪአል ሜዲአ፣ ዌብሲቴ፣ ኔትዎርኪንግ ንኔ ኡፕሎአድ/ዶውንሎአድ ጎኦፈꬆ ዶኦነን አይ ጌእቴትቶኢኮነአ?
turns.amharic: በአሥረኛ ክፍል ምዕራፍ 8 («ማኅበራዊ ሚዲያ»፣ ገጽ 68–73) ውስጥ Social Media፣ Website፣ Networking እና Upload/Download በጎፋኛ ቋንቋ ምን ይባላሉ?
turns.english: In Grade 10 Chapter 8 ('Social Media', pp. 68–73), what are the Gofatho terms for Social Media, Website, Networking, and Upload/Download?
turns.fst_morpheme_notes: deriya gaseth-iyaa miishe-ta (community connect-PRES.REL tool-PL.ACC = social media, Gr10 Ch.8 p. 68) + ay geet-ett-oikonaa.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.gofatho_latin: Tammantho kifile maxaafaa (p. 73) maaran: Social Media = "Deriya gasethiyaa miisheta"; Website/Web = "Dem-bessa"; Networking = "Barbaxo / Barbbaxetetha"; Upload/Download = "Denthi-woso"!
turns.gofatho_fidel: ተምመንꬆ ኪፊሌ መጠአፈአ (ፕ። ዕ3) መአረን፦ ሶጪአል ሜዲአ = "ዴሪየ ገሴꬂየአ ሚኢሼተ"፤ ዌብሲቴ/ዌብ = "ዴም-ቤስሰ"፤ ኔትዎርኪንግ = "በርበጦ / በርብበጤቴꬃ"፤ ኡፕሎአድ/ዶውንሎአድ = "ዴንꬂ-ዎሶ"!
turns.amharic: በአሥረኛ ክፍል መጽሐፍ (ገጽ 73) መሠረት፦ ማኅበራዊ ሚዲያ = «ዴሪያ ጋሴꬂያ ሚኢሼታ»፤ ድረ-ገጽ (Website) = «ዴም-ቤሳ»፤ ኔትዎርክ (Networking) = «ባርባጦ / ባርባጤቴꬃ»፤ መጫን/ማውረድ (Upload/Download) = «ዴንꬂ-ዎሶ» ይባላሉ!
turns.english: According to the Grade 10 textbook (p. 73): Social Media = 'Deriya gasethiyaa miisheta'; Website = 'Dem-bessa'; Networking = 'Barbaxo / Barbbaxetetha'; and Upload/Download = 'Denthi-woso'!
turns.fst_morpheme_notes: Exact digital technology neologisms coined in the SNNPR Grade 10 Goofatho Doona textbook (p. 73).

turns.speaker: user
turns.gofatho_latin: Deriya gasethiyaa miisheta (Feesbuuke, Teelegiraame, Yuutuube) go77aynne qohoy he shemppuwan waani qonccissettidee?
turns.gofatho_fidel: ዴሪየ ገሴꬂየአ ሚኢሼተ (ፌእስቡኡኬ፣ ቴእሌጊረአሜ፣ ዩኡቱኡቤ) ጎዕዓይንኔ ቆሆይ ሄ ሼምፕፑወን ወአኒ ቆንጭጪስሴትቲዴእ?
turns.amharic: የማኅበራዊ ሚዲያ (ፌስቡክ፣ ቴሌግራም፣ ዩቲዩብ) ጥቅምና ጉዳቱ በዚያ ምዕራፍ ውስጥ እንዴት ተገልጿል?
turns.english: How are the benefits ('go77a') and harms ('qoho') of social media platforms (Facebook, Telegram, YouTube) explained in that chapter?
turns.fst_morpheme_notes: go77a-y-nne qoho-y (benefit-NOM-and harm-NOM) + he shemppuwa-n waan-i qoncc-iss-ett-idee (that chapter-LOC how-CNV2 explain-CAUS-PASS-PAST.3MS.INTER).

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.gofatho_latin: Go77ay: haaho bessan de7iyaa asata eesuwan gasetho, timirtte/pilggethi demmonne zal77e eriso; Qohoy qassi: akeekonna go7ettikko tamaareta tamaaro wodiyaa mooro, worddo odonne xuura qonccisso. Hessa gisho "akeekan go7ettite!" gees.
turns.gofatho_fidel: ጎዕዓይ፦ ሀአሆ ቤስሰን ዴዒየአ አሰተ እእሱወን ገሴꬆ፣ ቲሚርትቴ/ፒልግጌꬂ ዴምሞንኔ ዘልዕዔ እሪሶ፤ ቆሆይ ቀስሲ፦ አኬእኮንነ ጎዔትቲክኮ ተመአሬተ ተመአሮ ዎዲየአ ሞኦሮ፣ ዎርድዶ ኦዶንኔ ጡኡረ ቆንጭጪስሶ። ሄስሰ ጊሾ "አኬእከን ጎዔትቲቴ!" ጌእስ።
turns.amharic: ጥቅሙ፦ በሩቅ ቦታ ያሉ ሰዎችን በፍጥነት ማገናኘት፣ ትምህርትና ምርምር ማግኘትና የንግድ ማስታወቂያ፤ ጉዳቱ ደግሞ፦ ያለ ጥንቃቄ ከተጠቀሙ የተማሪዎችን የጥናት ጊዜ ማባከንና የሐሰት ወሬ ማሰራጨት ነው። ስለዚህ «በማስተዋል ተጠቀሙ!» ይላል።
turns.english: Its benefits: rapidly connecting people across distances, accessing educational research, and promoting business; its harms if used carelessly: wasting students' study time and spreading false rumors. Therefore it advises: 'Use social media with wisdom ('akeekan go7ettite')!'
turns.fst_morpheme_notes: akeeka-n go7ett-ite (wisdom-INST use-IMP.2PL, PHR-097 & Gr10 Ch.8 p. 71).

dialogues.subtopic: Youth Cooperative Coffee & Honey Agribusiness in Sawla
dialogues.source_grounding: Grade 10 Goofatho Doona Ch. 8 & Ch. 9 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/1mKIcfMoMgnZ9Pa657NWmE-OGND2wlveM/view?usp=drivesdk, pp. 68–83)
rag_retrieval_anchors: Gr10_Ch8: Dem-bessa & denthi-woso for digital marketing

turns.speaker: user
turns.gofatho_latin: Nuuni ichchashu yelagati Sawulan cugan hashetidi Goofa bunanne bootha eessa giigissidi bayzziyaa ooso medhanaw koyoos. Waatidi doommoo?
turns.gofatho_fidel: ኑኡኒ ኢችቻሹ ዬለገቲ ሰዉለን ጩገን ሀሼቲዲ ጎኦፈ ቡነንኔ ቦኦꬃ እእስሰ ጊኢጊስሲዲ በይዝዚየአ ኦኦሶ ሜꬋነው ኮዮኦስ። ወአቲዲ ዶኦምሞኦ?
turns.amharic: እኛ አምስት ወጣቶች በሳውላ በቡድን ተደራጅተን የጎፋ ቡናና ነጭ ማር አዘጋጅተን የምንሸጥበት ሥራ መፍጠር እንፈልጋለን። እንዴት እንጀምር?
turns.english: Five of us young people in Sawla want to form a cooperative team and start an enterprise packaging and selling Gofa coffee and white honey. How should we start?
turns.fst_morpheme_notes: cuga-n hashet-idi (group-LOC cooperate-CNV2.ANT, Gr8 Ch.7 p. 103) + giig-iss-idi bayzz-iyaa ooso medh-anaw (prepare-CAUS-CNV2 sell-PRES.REL work create-FUT.PURP) + koy-oos (want-PRES.1PL).

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.gofatho_latin: Koyro, hintte cuga ooso halchchuwaa xaafite; nam77antho, geeshsha eessaanne bunaa goshshanchchatappe sitta shammidi geeshsha qoriyan/bilqqaxxiyan wothite; heedzantho, sunthanne malaata Goofatho, Amaarathoonne Inggilizetho doonan bolla xaafite!
turns.gofatho_fidel: ኮይሮ፣ ሂንትቴ ጩገ ኦኦሶ ሀልችቹወአ ጠአፊቴ፤ ነምዕዓንꬆ፣ ጌእሽሻ እእስሰአንኔ ቡነአ ጎሽሻንችቻተፕፔ ሲትተ ሻምሚዲ ጌእሽሻ ቆሪየን/ቢልቅቀጥጢየን ዎꬂቴ፤ ሄእꬓንꬆ፣ ሱንꬃንኔ መለአተ ጎኦፈꬆ፣ አመአረꬆኦንኔ ኢንግጊሊዜꬆ ዶኦነን ቦልለ ጠአፊቴ!
turns.amharic: በመጀመሪያ፣ የቡድናችሁን የሥራ ዕቅድ (Business Plan) ጻፉ፤ ሁለተኛ፣ ንጹሕ ማርና ቡና ከገበሬዎች በቀጥታ ገዝታችሁ በንጹሕ ዕቃ/ጠርሙስ አሽጉ፤ ሦስተኛ፣ ስምና ምልክት (Brand) በጎፋኛ፣ በአማርኛና በእንግሊዝኛ ቋንቋ ላይ ጻፉ!
turns.english: First, write your team's business plan ('ooso halchcho'); second, source pure honey and coffee directly from farmers and package them in clean jars; third, print a brand label in Gofatho, Amharic, and English!
turns.fst_morpheme_notes: ooso halchchuwa-a (work plan-ACC.M.DEF, MP-10) + goshshanchcha-tappe (farmer-PL.ABL) + sitta shamm-idi (directly buy-CNV2).

turns.speaker: user
turns.gofatho_latin: Addis Ababanne hara katamatan de7iyaa shammanchchati nu oosuwaa erana mala "deriya gasethiyaa miisheta" waatidi go7ettoo?
turns.gofatho_fidel: አድዲስ አበበንኔ ሀረ ከተመተን ዴዒየአ ሻምመንችቻቲ ኑ ኦኦሱወአ እረነ መለ "ዴሪየ ገሴꬂየአ ሚኢሼተ" ወአቲዲ ጎዔትቶኦ?

turns.amharic: ጊዜውን በትክክል አቅዶ የሚጠቀም ሥራ ፈጣሪ የደንበኞችን ቀጠሮ ያከብራል፣ የዕለት ሥራውን ያለ መስነፍ («አሺርቶ») ይጨርሳል እንዲሁም ብዙ ገቢ ያገኛል!
turns.english: An entrepreneur who plans and uses time well honors customer appointments, completes daily work without laziness ('ashirtto', Gr9 p. 83), and earns strong revenue!

dialogues.source_grounding: Grade 10 Goofatho Doona Ch. 6 & Ch. 9 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/1mKIcfMoMgnZ9Pa657NWmE-OGND2wlveM/view?usp=drivesdk, pp. 52–59, 81: Ooso Dabddaabbe)
rag_retrieval_anchors: Gr10_Ch6 Xaafo: Ooso dabddaabbe 6 structural parts (pp. 55–58)

turns.speaker: user
turns.gofatho_latin: Nu yelagata ooso medho cugaas tal77e miishsha oychchanaw Omo Microfinance xifate keethaas "Ooso dabddaabbe" xaafanaw koyoos. Tammantho kifile Shemppo 6 (pp. 55-58) maaraa taassi odarkkii?
turns.gofatho_fidel: ኑ ዬለገተ ኦኦሶ ሜꬎ ጩገአስ ተልዕዔ ሚኢሽሻ ኦይችቻነው ኦሞ ሚጭሮፊነንጬ ጢፈቴ ኬእꬃአስ "ኦኦሶ ደብድደአብቤ" ጠአፈነው ኮዮኦስ። ተምመንꬆ ኪፊሌ ሼምፕፖ 6 (ፕፕ። 55-58) መአረአ ተአስሲ ኦደርክኪኢ?
turns.amharic: ለወጣቶች የሥራ ፈጠራ ቡድናችን የብድር ገንዘብ («ታልዔ ሚኢሻ») ለመጠየቅ ለኦሞ ማይክሮ ፋይናንስ ጽሕፈት ቤት «ኦሶ ዳብዳቤ» (የሥራ ደብዳቤ) መጻፍ እንፈልጋለን። የአሥረኛ ክፍል ምዕራፍ 6 (ገጽ 55–58) ሥርዓቱን ትነግረኛለህ?
turns.english: We want to write an official business letter ('Ooso dabddaabbe') to the microfinance office to request a startup loan ('tal77e miishsha') for our youth enterprise group. Could you tell me the format from Grade 10 Chapter 6 (pp. 55–58)?
turns.fst_morpheme_notes: tal77e miishsha (loan money, ZARA-03 77) + oychch-anaw (request-FUT.PURP) + ooso dabddaabbe xaaf-anaw (official letter write-FUT.PURP, Gr10 Ch.6 p. 55).

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.gofatho_latin: Tammantho kifile maxaafaa (pp. 55-58) maaran Ooso dabddaabbees usuppun kifileti de7oosona: (1) Bolla ushachcha baggan "Gaagla", (2) Bolla haddirssa baggan dabddaabbey biyaa xifate keethaa sunthaa, (3) Giddon "Kaara / Waanna Qofa", (4) Waanna kiitaa giddo daassata, (5) Galata qachchuwaanne (6) Xaafanchchaa sunthaanne kushe-malaataa!
turns.gofatho_fidel: ተምመንꬆ ኪፊሌ መጠአፈአ (ፕፕ። 55-58) መአረን ኦኦሶ ደብድደአብቤእስ ኡሱፕፑን ኪፊሌቲ ዴዖኦሶነ፦ (1) ቦልለ ኡሻችቻ በግገን "ገአግለ"፣ (2) ቦልለ ሀድዲርስሰ በግገን ደብድደአብቤይ ቢየአ ጢፈቴ ኬእꬃአ ሱንꬃአ፣ (3) ጊድዶን "ከአረ / ወአንነ ቆፈ"፣ (4) ወአንነ ኪኢተአ ጊድዶ ደአስሰተ፣ (5) ገለተ ቀችቹወአንኔ (6) ጠአፈንችቻአ ሱንꬃአንኔ ኩሼ-መለአተአ!
turns.amharic: በአሥረኛ ክፍል መጽሐፍ (ገጽ 55–58) መሠረት ለሥራ ደብዳቤ ስድስት ክፍሎች አሉት፦ (1) ከላይ በቀኝ በኩል «ጋግላ» (ቀን)፣ (2) ከላይ በግራ በኩል ደብዳቤው የሚሄድበት ጽሕፈት ቤት ስም፣ (3) በመካከል «ካራ / ዋና ቆፋ» (ጉዳዩ፦)፣ (4) የዋናው መልእክት አንቀጾች፣ (5) የምስጋና መቋጫና (6) የጸሐፊው ስምና ፊርማ («ኩሼ-ማላታ»)!
turns.english: According to the Grade 10 textbook (pp. 55–58), an official letter ('Ooso dabddaabbe') has six parts: (1) the Date ('Gaagla') at top right, (2) the recipient office address at top left, (3) the Subject line ('Kaara / Waanna Qofa') in the center, (4) the body paragraphs, (5) the complimentary close, and (6) the sender's name and signature ('kushe-malaata')!
turns.fst_morpheme_notes: Complete 6-part official letter structure from Grade 10 Textbook Ch. 6, pp. 55–58.

turns.gofatho_latin: Issi kiitaa haratas "denthi-woso" oothanaappe kase, kiitaa pulttoy ammanettiyaa miidiyaakko qoraphpha! Tammantho kifile Shemppo 5 (p. 41) tossey "Yessi be7i yeekkees; missi be7i bookkees" gees; akeekonnaan worddo kiitaa laaloppa!

turns.speaker: user
turns.gofatho_latin: Nu kifile tamaareti Teelegiraame giddon "Goofatho Doona Cuga" medhdhidi paacciyaaw giigettanaw koyoos. Waatidi wogan go7ettoo?
turns.gofatho_fidel: ኑ ኪፊሌ ተመአሬቲ ቴእሌጊረአሜ ጊድዶን "ጎኦፈꬆ ዶኦነ ጩገ" ሜꬍꬊዲ ፐአጭጪየአው ጊኢጌትተነው ኮዮኦስ። ወአቲዲ ዎገን ጎዔትቶኦ?
turns.amharic: የክፍላችን ተማሪዎች በቴሌግራም ውስጥ «የጎፋኛ ቋንቋ ቡድን» መሥርተን ለፈተና መዘጋጀት እንፈልጋለን። እንዴት በሥርዓት እንጠቀምበት?
turns.english: Our classmates want to create a 'Gofatho Language Study Group' on Telegram to prepare for exams. How should we use it effectively?
turns.fst_morpheme_notes: nu kifile tamaare-ti (our class student-PL.NOM) + paacciya-aw giig-ett-anaw (exam-DAT prepare-REFL-FUT.PURP, PHR-072) + waat-idi woga-n go7ett-oo.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.gofatho_latin: Gallassan issi saate dooridi, he saatiyan xalla: (1) Qawosa oyshota, (2) Minniyaanne Leppiya qaalata, (3) Aaqetanne Tosseta woli oychchidinne "xolqqethi" immidi tobbite!
turns.gofatho_fidel: ገልለስሰን ኢስሲ ሰአቴ ዶኦሪዲ፣ ሄ ሰአቲየን ጠልለ፦ (1) ቀዎሰ ኦይሾተ፣ (2) ሚንኒየአንኔ ሌፕፒየ ቀአለተ፣ (3) አአቄተንኔ ቶስሴተ ዎሊ ኦይችቺዲንኔ "ጦልቅቄꬂ" ኢምሚዲ ቶብቢቴ!
turns.amharic: በቀን አንድ የተወሰነ ሰዓት መርጣችሁ፣ በዚያ ሰዓት ብቻ፦ (1) የሰዋስው ጥያቄዎችን፣ (2) የሚጠብቁና የሚላሉ ቃላትን፣ (3) ፈሊጣዊ ንግግሮችንና ምሳሌዎችን እርስ በርስ በመጠያየቅና ግብረ-መልስ («ጦልቄꬂ») በመስጠት ተወያዩ!
turns.english: Set a dedicated one-hour window each day and during that hour quiz one another on: (1) grammar rules ('Qawosa'), (2) geminate vs. singleton minimal pairs, and (3) idioms and proverbs, giving constructive feedback ('xolqqethi', Gr9 Ch.9 p. 77)!
turns.fst_morpheme_notes: woli oychch-idi-nne (each.other ask-CNV2-and) + xolqqethi imm-idi (feedback give-CNV2, Gr9 Ch.9 p. 77) + tobb-ite (discuss-IMP.2PL).

turns.speaker: user
turns.gofatho_latin: Gofatho AI "Meeze Quiz Bank" nne "Audio Bible / TTS" cenggurssaa nu cugan shaakkanaw dandda7oo?
turns.gofatho_fidel: ጎፈꬆ አኢ "ሜእዜ ቁኢዝ በንክ" ንኔ "አኡዲኦ ቢብሌ / ትትስ" ጬንግጉርስሰአ ኑ ጩገን ሻአክከነው ደንድደዖኦ?

turns.english: Can we share items from the Gofatho AI 250-item Meeze Quiz Bank and TTS audio pronunciations in our study group?
turns.fst_morpheme_notes: nu cuga-n shaakk-anaw dandda7-oo (our group-LOC share-FUT.PURP can-1PL.INTER).

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.gofatho_latin: Ee! Hosppuntho, Uddufunthonne Tammantho kifile maxaafatappe giigettida 250 Meeze oyshota cugan shiishshidi, Sherpa-ONNX VITS cenggurssaan suure nabbabuwaa issippe hayzite!
turns.gofatho_fidel: እእ! ሆስፕፑንꬆ፣ ኡድዱፉንꬆንኔ ተምመንꬆ ኪፊሌ መጠአፈተፕፔ ጊኢጌትቲደ 250 ሜእዜ ኦይሾተ ጩገን ሺኢሽሺዲ፣ ሼርፐ-ኦንንጥ Vኢትስ ጬንግጉርስሰአን ሱኡሬ ነብበቡወአ ኢስሲፕፔ ሀይዚቴ!
turns.amharic: አዎ! ከ8ኛ፣ 9ኛ እና 10ኛ ክፍል መጻሕፍት የተዘጋጁትን 250 የመልመጃ ጥያቄዎች በቡድኑ አቅርባችሁ፣ በSherpa-ONNX VITS ድምፅ ትክክለኛውን አነባበብ በጋራ አዳምጡ!
turns.english: Yes! Share the 250 Meeze quiz questions drawn from the Grade 8, 9, and 10 textbooks in your group and listen together to the accurate pronunciation synthesized by Sherpa-ONNX VITS!
turns.fst_morpheme_notes: giig-ett-ida (prepare-PASS-PAST.REL) + cuga-n shiishsh-idi (group-LOC present-CNV2) + issippe hayz-ite (together listen-IMP.2PL).

turns.speaker: user
turns.gofatho_latin: Uddufuntho kifile Shemppo 1 (p. 7) giddon "Dooni hayqqiya gaasoti aybee?" gees. Issi dooni hayqqonna mala dijitaale wodiyan ay oothanaw bessii?
turns.gofatho_fidel: ኡድዱፉንꬆ ኪፊሌ ሼምፕፖ 1 (ፕ። ዕ) ጊድዶን "ዶኦኒ ሀይቅቂየ ገአሶቲ አይቤእ?" ጌእስ። ኢስሲ ዶኦኒ ሀይቅቆንነ መለ ዲጂተአሌ ዎዲየን አይ ኦኦꬃነው ቤስሲኢ?
turns.amharic: በዘጠነኛ ክፍል ምዕራፍ 1 (ገጽ 7) ውስጥ «ቋንቋ የሚሞትባቸው ምክንያቶች ምንድን ናቸው?» ይላል። አንድ ቋንቋ እንዳይሞት በዲጂታል ዘመን ውስጥ ምን ማድረግ ይገባል?
turns.english: In Grade 9 Chapter 1 (p. 7), it asks 'What are the causes of language endangerment/death?' What must be done in the digital era so a language does not die out?
turns.fst_morpheme_notes: doon-i hayqq-iya gaaso-ti ayb-ee (language-NOM die-PRES.REL reason-PL.NOM what-INTER, Gr9 Ch.1 p. 7) + hayqq-onna mala (die-NEG.PURP).

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.gofatho_latin: Uddufuntho kifile maxaafaa (pp. 5-7) maaran: issi dooni ba go7ettiyaa asay aggikko hayqqees; doonay diccana mala timirtte keethan, maxaafan, miidiyaniinne AI/komppiyuutere teknooloojiyan xaafettanawinne haasayettanaw bessees!
turns.gofatho_fidel: ኡድዱፉንꬆ ኪፊሌ መጠአፈአ (ፕፕ። 5-ዕ) መአረን፦ ኢስሲ ዶኦኒ በ ጎዔትቲየአ አሰይ አግጊክኮ ሀይቅቄእስ፤ ዶኦነይ ዲጭጨነ መለ ቲሚርትቴ ኬእꬃን፣ መጠአፈን፣ ሚኢዲየኒኢንኔ አኢ/ኮምፕፒዩኡቴሬ ቴክኖኦሎኦጂየን ጠአፌትተነዊንኔ ሀአሰዬትተነው ቤስሴእስ!
turns.amharic: በዘጠነኛ ክፍል መጽሐፍ (ገጽ 5–7) መሠረት፦ አንድ ቋንቋ ተናጋሪው ሕዝብ መጠቀም ሲተው ይሞታል፤ ቋንቋው እንዲያድግ በትምህርት ቤት፣ በመጽሐፍ፣ በሚዲያና በኤአይ/ኮምፒውተር ቴክኖሎጂ ሊጻፍና ሊነገር ይገባል!
turns.english: According to the Grade 9 textbook (pp. 5–7): a language dies when its speakers stop using it; for a language to flourish, it must be written and spoken in schools, books, media, and AI/computer technology!
turns.fst_morpheme_notes: ba go7ett-iyaa asa-y agg-ikko (3REFL.GEN use-PRES.REL people-NOM leave-COND.REAL) + xaaf-ett-anaw-inne haasay-ett-anaw bess-ees (write-PASS-FUT.PURP-and speak-PASS-FUT.PURP ought-PRES.3MS).

turns.speaker: user
turns.gofatho_latin: Nuuni tamaaretinne asttamaareti Gofatho AI aaplikeshiniyaa giddon ooratha qaalatanne tosse gujjanaw waatidi maaddoo?
turns.gofatho_fidel: ኑኡኒ ተመአሬቲንኔ አስትተመአሬቲ ጎፈꬆ አኢ አአፕሊኬሺኒየአ ጊድዶን ኦኦረꬃ ቀአለተንኔ ቶስሴ ጉጅጀነው ወአቲዲ መአድዶኦ?
turns.amharic: እኛ ተማሪዎችና መምህራን በጎፋꬶ ኤአይ መተግበሪያ ውስጥ አዳዲስ ቃላትንና ምሳሌዎችን ለመጨመር እንዴት እንርዳ?
turns.english: How can we students and teachers contribute new vocabulary and proverbs inside the Gofatho AI application?
turns.fst_morpheme_notes: ooratha qaala-ta-nne tosse gujj-anaw (new word-PL.ACC-and proverb add-FUT.PURP, PHR-119) + waat-idi maadd-oo (how-CNV2 help-1PL.INTER).

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.gofatho_latin: Aaplikeshiniyaa giddon "Feedback & Corpus Contribution" (Xolqqethi) kifiliyaa dooyidi, ooratha qaalata, suure birshshethaanne cenggurssaa yedda! "Goofatho doonay dicconnaan attenna!"
turns.gofatho_fidel: አአፕሊኬሺኒየአ ጊድዶን "ፌእድበጭክ & ጮርፑስ ጮንትሪቡቲኦን" (ጦልቅቄꬂ) ኪፊሊየአ ዶኦዪዲ፣ ኦኦረꬃ ቀአለተ፣ ሱኡሬ ቢርሽሼꬃአንኔ ጬንግጉርስሰአ ዬድደ! "ጎኦፈꬆ ዶኦነይ ዲጭጮንነአን አትቴንነ!"
turns.amharic: በመተግበሪያው ውስጥ «Feedback & Corpus Contribution» («ጦልቄꬂ») የሚለውን ክፍል ከፍታችሁ፣ አዳዲስ ቃላትን፣ ትክክለኛ ትርጉምና ድምፅ ላኩ! «የጎፋኛ ቋንቋ ሳያድግ አይቀርም!»
turns.english: Open the 'Feedback & Corpus Contribution' ('Xolqqethi') screen in the app and submit new words, verified translations, and voice recordings! 'Goofatho doonay dicconnaan attenna!' ('The Gofatho language will surely flourish and grow!')
turns.fst_morpheme_notes: suure birshshetha-a imm-anaw qofa-a gujj-a (PHR-119); Goofatho doona-y dicc-onnaan att-enna (PHR-120).
