turns.speaker: user
turns.gofatho_latin: Hay Gofatho AI, tukke zhabanaa taman wothadis; tamma daqiiqaas saate taaw oyqqa!
turns.gofatho_fidel: ሀይ ጎፈꬆ አኢ፣ ቱክኬ ዣበነአ ተመን ዎꬃዲስ፤ ተምመ ደቂኢቀአስ ሰአቴ ተአው ኦይቅቀ!
turns.amharic: ሄይ ጎፋꬶ ኤአይ፣ የቡና ጀበናውን እሳት ላይ ጥጃለሁ፤ ለአሥር ደቂቃ ሰዓት (ታይመር) ያዝልኝ!
turns.english: Hey Gofatho AI, I have put the coffee pot on the fire; set a timer for ten minutes for me!
turns.fst_morpheme_notes: tukke zhabana-a tama-n woth-adis (coffee pot-ACC fire-LOC put-PAST.1S); tamma daqiiqa-as (ten minute-DAT, Minniyaa mm) + saate taa-w oyqq-a (timer 1S-DAT hold/set-IMP.2S).

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.gofatho_latin: Ee! Tukke katho saatey tamma daqiiqaas (10:00) doommides. Saatey gakkiyaa wode cenggurssaan nena erissana!
turns.gofatho_fidel: እእ! ቱክኬ ከꬆ ሰአቴይ ተምመ ደቂኢቀአስ (10፦00) ዶኦምሚዴስ። ሰአቴይ ገክኪየአ ዎዴ ጬንግጉርስሰአን ኔነ እሪስሰነ!
turns.amharic: እሺ! የቡና ማፍያ ሰዓት መቁጠሪያው ለአሥር ደቂቃ (10:00) ጀምሯል። ሰዓቱ ሲደርስ በድምፅ አሳውቅሃለሁ!
turns.english: Okay! The ten-minute (10:00) coffee timer has started. When the time is up, I will notify you by voice!
turns.fst_morpheme_notes: doomm-ides (start-PAST.3MS.A.DCL); saate-y gakk-iyaa wode (time-NOM arrive-PRES.REL when) + cenggurssaa-n nena er-iss-ana (voice-INST 2S.ACC know-CAUS-FUT.1S).

turns.speaker: user
turns.gofatho_latin: Ha77i aappun daqiiqay attidee, Gofatho AI?
turns.gofatho_fidel: ሀዕዒ አአፕፑን ደቂኢቀይ አትቲዴእ፣ ጎፈꬆ አኢ?
turns.amharic: አሁን ስንት ደቂቃ ቀረው፣ ጎፋꬶ ኤአይ?
turns.english: How many minutes are remaining now, Gofatho AI?
turns.fst_morpheme_notes: ha77i aappun daqiiqa-y (now how.many minute-NOM, ZARA-03 77) + att-idee (remain-PAST.3MS.INTER).

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.gofatho_latin: Heedzu daqiiqaynne tamma-ichchashu sekonddey (03:15) attiis; tukkey loythi buqqana hanees, sineta giigissa!
turns.gofatho_fidel: ሄእꬑ ደቂኢቀይንኔ ተምመ-ኢችቻሹ ሴኮንድዴይ (03፦15) አትቲኢስ፤ ቱክኬይ ሎይꬂ ቡቅቀነ ሀኔእስ፣ ሲኔተ ጊኢጊስሰ!
turns.amharic: ሦስት ደቂቃ ከአሥራ አምስት ሰከንድ (03:15) ቀርቶታል፤ ቡናው በደንብ ሊፈላ ተቃርቧል፣ ሲኒዎቹን አዘጋጅ!
turns.english: Three minutes and fifteen seconds (03:15) remain; the coffee is almost boiling, get the cups ready!
turns.fst_morpheme_notes: heedzu daqiiqa-y-nne (three minute-NOM-and) + att-iis (remain-PAST.3MS); sine-ta giig-iss-a (cup-PL.ACC prepare-CAUS-IMP.2S).

dialogues.domain_name: Voice Assistant Hands-Free Commands (Timers, Weather, Storytelling, Pronunciation Drills)
dialogues.subtopic: Hands-Free Morning Alarm for Sawla Market & School (Maallado Denddo Saate)
dialogues.source_grounding: Phrasebook PHR-077 & PHR-089; Voice Assistant Pipeline (https://drive.google.com/file/d/10sEW32ZgmyVTaNoGNhGJy2KYZlXzDK27/view?usp=drivesdk)

turns.speaker: user
turns.gofatho_latin: Hay Gofatho AI, wontto maallado guuraara tamma-nam77u saaten (6:00 AM) tana denthiyaa alaarmiyaa giigissa!
turns.gofatho_fidel: ሀይ ጎፈꬆ አኢ፣ ዎንትቶ መአልለዶ ጉኡረአረ ተምመ-ነምዕዑ ሰአቴን (6፦00 አም) ተነ ዴንꬂየአ አለአርሚየአ ጊኢጊስሰ!
turns.amharic: ሄይ ጎፋꬶ ኤአይ፣ ነገ ጠዋት በማለዳ አሥራ ሁለት ሰዓት (6:00 AM) ላይ የሚቀሰቅሰኝን አላርም አዘጋጅ!
turns.english: Hey Gofatho AI, set an alarm to wake me up tomorrow early in the morning at 12:00 Ethiopian time (6:00 AM)!
turns.fst_morpheme_notes: wontto maallado guura-ara (tomorrow morning early-COM, PHR-089) + tana denth-iyaa alaarmiya-a (1S.ACC wake/raise-PRES.REL alarm-ACC) + giig-iss-a (prepare-CAUS-IMP.2S).

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.gofatho_latin: Giigettiis! Wontto maallado tamma-nam77u saaten (6:00 AM) Goofa ululle yetthaara nena denthana. Alaarmiyaas suntha wothoo?
turns.gofatho_fidel: ጊኢጌትቲኢስ! ዎንትቶ መአልለዶ ተምመ-ነምዕዑ ሰአቴን (6፦00 አም) ጎኦፈ ኡሉልሌ ዬትꬃአረ ኔነ ዴንꬃነ። አለአርሚየአስ ሱንꬃ ዎꬆኦ?
turns.amharic: ተዘጋጅቷል! ነገ ጠዋት አሥራ ሁለት ሰዓት (6:00 AM) ላይ በጎፋ የዋሽንት ዜማ እቀሰቅስሃለሁ። ለአላርሙ ስም ላውጣለት?
turns.english: It is set! Tomorrow morning at 12:00 Ethiopian time (6:00 AM) I will wake you with a traditional Gofa flute melody. Should I add a label to the alarm?
turns.fst_morpheme_notes: giig-ett-iis (prepare-PASS-PAST.3MS); denth-ana (wake-FUT.1S); suntha woth-oo (name put-1S.INTER.JUSS).

turns.speaker: user
turns.gofatho_latin: Ee, "Sawula Giyaanne Timirtte Giigetho" gada suntha wotha.
turns.gofatho_fidel: እእ፣ "ሰዉለ ጊየአንኔ ቲሚርትቴ ጊኢጌꬆ" ገደ ሱንꬃ ዎꬃ።
turns.amharic: አዎ፣ «የሳውላ ገበያና የትምህርት ዝግጅት» ብለህ ስም አውጣለት።
turns.english: Yes, label it 'Sawla Market and School Preparation'.
turns.fst_morpheme_notes: Sawula giya-a-nne timirtte giigetho (Sawla market-and school preparation) + g-ada suntha woth-a (say-CNV1.ANT.2S name put-IMP.2S).

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.gofatho_latin: "Sawula Giyaanne Timirtte Giigetho" giyaa sunthaan xaafettiis! Saro pe7a, wontto maallado guuraara gahettana.
turns.gofatho_fidel: "ሰዉለ ጊየአንኔ ቲሚርትቴ ጊኢጌꬆ" ጊየአ ሱንꬃአን ጠአፌትቲኢስ! ሰሮ ፔዓ፣ ዎንትቶ መአልለዶ ጉኡረአረ ገሄትተነ።
turns.amharic: «የሳውላ ገበያና የትምህርት ዝግጅት» በሚል ስም ተመዝግቧል! ደህና እደር፣ ነገ ጠዋት በማለዳ እንገናኛለን።
turns.english: Saved under the label 'Sawla Market and School Preparation'! Sleep in peace, we will meet early tomorrow morning.
turns.fst_morpheme_notes: xaaf-ett-iis (write-PASS-PAST.3MS); saro pe7-a (peace spend.night-IMP.2S, ZARA-03 7); gah-ett-ana (meet-RECIP-FUT.1PL).

dialogues.domain_name: Voice Assistant Hands-Free Commands (Timers, Weather, Storytelling, Pronunciation Drills)
dialogues.subtopic: Hands-Free Weather Check for Sawla, Bulqi & Laha (Ayyere Haaro Oychcho)
dialogues.source_grounding: Grade 8 Goofatho Doona Ch. 9 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/160NHNy-4orPcAIk-L5t6tOEtZoWemz_-/view?usp=drivesdk, pp. 121–128: Ayyere Haaro); Phrasebook PHR-047 & PHR-058

turns.speaker: user
turns.gofatho_latin: Hay Gofatho AI, hachchi Sawulaninne Bulqi gezzen ayyere haaroy ay milatii? Irathay bukkanee?
turns.gofatho_fidel: ሀይ ጎፈꬆ አኢ፣ ሀችቺ ሰዉለኒንኔ ቡልቂ ጌዝዜን አይዬሬ ሀአሮይ አይ ሚለቲኢ? ኢረꬃይ ቡክከኔእ?
turns.amharic: ሄይ ጎፋꬶ ኤአይ፣ ዛሬ በሳውላና በቡልቂ ደጋ የአየር ሁኔታው ምን ይመስላል? ዝናብ ይዘንባል?
turns.english: Hey Gofatho AI, what is the weather like today in Sawla and the Bulqi highlands? Will it rain?
turns.fst_morpheme_notes: hachchi Sawula-n-inne Bulqi gezze-n (today Sawla-LOC-and Bulqi highland-LOC) + ayyere haaro-y ay milat-ii (weather-NOM what look.like-PRES.3MS.INTER); iratha-y bukk-anee (rain-NOM fall-FUT.3MS.INTER).

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.gofatho_latin: Hachchi maallado Sawulan keyay ho77ees (27 C); gallassaappe guyye qassi Bulqi gezzen (18 C) shaareynne guutha irathay bukkanaw dandda7ees.
turns.gofatho_fidel: ሀችቺ መአልለዶ ሰዉለን ኬየይ ሆዕዔእስ (2ዕ ጭ)፤ ገልለስሰአፕፔ ጉይዬ ቀስሲ ቡልቂ ጌዝዜን (18 ጭ) ሻአሬይንኔ ጉኡꬃ ኢረꬃይ ቡክከነው ደንድደዔእስ።
turns.amharic: ዛሬ ጠዋት በሳውላ ፀሐይ ይሞቃል (27°C)፤ ከቀትር በኋላ ደግሞ በቡልቂ ደጋ (18°C) ደመናና መጠነኛ ዝናብ ሊዘንብ ይችላል።
turns.english: This morning in Sawla the sun is warm (27°C); in the afternoon in the Bulqi highlands (18°C), clouds and light rain are expected.
turns.fst_morpheme_notes: keya-y ho77-ees (sun-NOM be.hot-PRES.3MS, PHR-058); gallassaa-ppe guyye (midday-ABL after) + shaare-y-nne guutha iratha-y bukk-anaw dandda7-ees.

turns.speaker: user
turns.gofatho_latin: Buna awan melissanaw kariyaan hiixxoo, woykko irathaappe naagoo?
turns.gofatho_fidel: ቡነ አወን ሜሊስሰነው ከሪየአን ሂኢጥጦኦ፣ ዎይክኮ ኢረꬃአፕፔ ነአጎኦ?
turns.amharic: ቡና በፀሐይ ለማድረቅ በደጃፍ ልዘርጋ፣ ወይስ ከዝናብ ልጠብቅ?
turns.english: Should I spread out the coffee beans in the courtyard to dry in the sun, or guard against rain?
turns.fst_morpheme_notes: buna awa-n mel-iss-anaw (coffee sun-LOC dry-CAUS-FUT.PURP) + kariya-n hiixx-oo (courtyard-LOC spread-1S.INTER.JUSS).

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.gofatho_latin: Sawulan maallado saate hosppuna gakkanaw awan melissa; hosppun saateppe guyye shaarey shiiqiyaa gishshaw bunaa kammidi soo gelissa!
turns.gofatho_fidel: ሰዉለን መአልለዶ ሰአቴ ሆስፕፑነ ገክከነው አወን ሜሊስሰ፤ ሆስፕፑን ሰአቴፕፔ ጉይዬ ሻአሬይ ሺኢቂየአ ጊሽሻው ቡነአ ከምሚዲ ሶኦ ጌሊስሰ!
turns.amharic: በሳውላ እስከ ቀኑ ስምንት ሰዓት ድረስ በፀሐይ አድርቅ፤ ከስምንት ሰዓት በኋላ ደመና ስለሚሰበሰብ ቡናውን ሰብስበህ ወደ ቤት አስገባ!
turns.english: In Sawla, dry the coffee in the sun until 2:00 PM (8:00 local time); after that, as clouds gather, cover and bring the coffee indoors!
turns.fst_morpheme_notes: awa-n mel-iss-a (sun-LOC dry-CAUS-IMP.2S); shaare-y shiiq-iyaa gishshaw (cloud-NOM gather-PRES.REL because) + soo gel-iss-a (home enter-CAUS-IMP.2S).

dialogues.domain_name: Voice Assistant Hands-Free Commands (Timers, Weather, Storytelling, Pronunciation Drills)
dialogues.subtopic: Hands-Free Minniyaa vs. Leppiya Gemination Pronunciation Drill (Tama/Tamma, Gita/Gitta, Lo7o/Lo77o)
dialogues.source_grounding: Sellassie Cheru (2015, Ch. 2, pp. 31–36); Phase 6 Gemination 75 Minimal Pairs (https://drive.google.com/file/d/10sEW32ZgmyVTaNoGNhGJy2KYZlXzDK27/view?usp=drivesdk)

turns.speaker: user
turns.gofatho_latin: Hay Gofatho AI, "Minniyaa" nne "Leppiya" cenggurssa meezeta taara issippe ootha!
turns.gofatho_fidel: ሀይ ጎፈꬆ አኢ፣ "ሚንኒየአ" ንኔ "ሌፕፒየ" ጬንግጉርስሰ ሜእዜተ ተአረ ኢስሲፕፔ ኦኦꬃ!
turns.amharic: ሄይ ጎፋꬶ ኤአይ፣ የ«ሚንኒያ» (የሚጠብቅ) እና የ«ሌፕፒያ» (የሚላላ) የድምፅ አጠራር ልምምድ ከእኔ ጋር አብረህ ሥራ!
turns.english: Hey Gofatho AI, practice a 'Minniyaa' (geminate) vs. 'Leppiya' (singleton) pronunciation drill with me!
turns.fst_morpheme_notes: minn-iyaa-nne lepp-iya cenggurssa meeze-ta (geminate-and singleton sound exercise-PL.ACC) + taa-ra issippe ooth-a (1S-COM together do-IMP.2S).

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.gofatho_latin: Ufayssan! Taani koyro Leppiya (1.0x) kaallidi Minniyaa (1.85x) nabbabays, neeni taappe kaallada zaara: (1) "tama" - "tamma"; (2) "gita" - "gitta"; (3) "caro" - "carro"!
turns.gofatho_fidel: ኡፈይስሰን! ተአኒ ኮይሮ ሌፕፒየ (1።0ጥ) ከአልሊዲ ሚንኒየአ (1።85ጥ) ነብበበይስ፣ ኔእኒ ተአፕፔ ከአልለደ ዘአረ፦ (1) "ተመ" - "ተምመ"፤ (2) "ጊተ" - "ጊትተ"፤ (3) "ጨሮ" - "ጨርሮ"!
turns.amharic: በደስታ! እኔ መጀመሪያ የላላውን (1.0x) ቀጥሎም የጠበቀውን (1.85x) አነባለሁ፣ አንተ ከእኔ ተከትለህ ድገም፦ (1) «ታማ» (እሳት) — «ታምማ» (አሥር)፤ (2) «ጊታ» (ትልቅ) — «ጊትታ» (እኩል)፤ (3) «ጫሮ» — «ጫርሮ»!
turns.english: Gladly! I will first pronounce the singleton ('Leppiya', 1.0x) followed by the geminate ('Minniyaa', 1.85x), and you repeat after me: (1) 'tama' (fire) — 'tamma' (ten); (2) 'gita' (big) — 'gitta' (equal); (3) 'caro' — 'carro'!
turns.fst_morpheme_notes: Contrastive minimal pairs GEM-001 (tama/tamma), GEM-002 (gita/gitta), GEM-008 (caro/carro) from Sellassie Cheru (2015).

turns.speaker: user
turns.gofatho_latin: "Tama - tamma, gita - gitta, caro - carro!" Ta cenggurssay suuree?
turns.gofatho_fidel: "ተመ - ተምመ፣ ጊተ - ጊትተ፣ ጨሮ - ጨርሮ!" ተ ጬንግጉርስሰይ ሱኡሬእ?
turns.amharic: «ታማ — ታምማ፣ ጊታ — ጊትታ፣ ጫሮ — ጫርሮ!» የእኔ አጠራር ትክክል ነው?
turns.english: 'Tama — tamma, gita — gitta, caro — carro!' Is my pronunciation accurate?
turns.fst_morpheme_notes: ta cenggurssa-y suur-ee (my voice/pronunciation-NOM accurate-INTER).

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.gofatho_latin: Daro lo77o! "Tamma", "gitta" nne "carro" bolla minniyaa guttumaa 1.85x keenan loythi oyqqadasa. Ha77i qassi glottal '7' meezeta: "be7ees" nne "lo77o"!
turns.gofatho_fidel: ደሮ ሎዕዖ! "ተምመ"፣ "ጊትተ" ንኔ "ጨርሮ" ቦልለ ሚንኒየአ ጉትቱመአ 1።85ጥ ኬእነን ሎይꬂ ኦይቅቀደሰ። ሀዕዒ ቀስሲ ግሎትተል 'ዕ' ሜእዜተ፦ "ቤዔእስ" ንኔ "ሎዕዖ"!
turns.amharic: በጣም ጥሩ! በ«ታምማ»፣ «ጊትታ» እና «ጫርሮ» ላይ የሚጠብቀውን ተነባቢ በ1.85x መጠን በደንብ ይዘሃል። አሁን ደግሞ የግሎታል '7' (/ʔ/) ልምምድ፦ «ቤዔስ» (ያያል) እና «ሎዖ» (ጥሩ)!
turns.english: Excellent! On 'tamma', 'gitta', and 'carro' you held the geminate closure at 1.85x duration accurately. Now practice the glottal stop '7' (/ʔ/): 'be7ees' (he sees) and 'lo77o' (good)!
turns.fst_morpheme_notes: oyqq-adasa (hold-PAST.2S.A.DCL); glottal stop contrast: singleton 7 in be7ees /beʔees/ vs. geminate 77 in lo77o /loʔʔo/.

dialogues.source_grounding: Grade 9 Ch. 7 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/1uvGaBT4-O_Jn7oQbuNl1W88lFBFiHULU/view?usp=drivesdk, pp. 62–65: Gilootaley 7); Sellassie Cheru (2015, Ch. 2 Phonemic Inventory)
rag_retrieval_anchors: Sellassie Cheru (2015): Ejectives q /k'/, x /t'/, c /tʃ'/, ph /p'/, implosive dh /ɗ/

turns.speaker: user
turns.gofatho_latin: Hay Gofatho AI, Goofatho doonan "7" nne "q, x, c, ph, dh" cenggurssata suuren haasayanaw meezeta taassi imma!
turns.gofatho_fidel: ሀይ ጎፈꬆ አኢ፣ ጎኦፈꬆ ዶኦነን "ዕ" ንኔ "ቅ፣ ጥ፣ ጭ፣ ጵ፣ ꬍ" ጬንግጉርስሰተ ሱኡሬን ሀአሰየነው ሜእዜተ ተአስሲ ኢምመ!
turns.amharic: ሄይ ጎፋꬶ ኤአይ፣ በጎፋኛ ቋንቋ «7» (/ʔ/) እና «q, x, c, ph, dh» ድምፆችን በትክክል ለመጥራት ልምምድ ስጠኝ!
turns.english: Hey Gofatho AI, give me a pronunciation drill to accurately articulate the Gofatho glottal stop '7' (/ʔ/) and the ejectives/implosives 'q, x, c, ph, dh'!
turns.fst_morpheme_notes: suure-n haasay-anaw (accurately-LOC speak-FUT.PURP) + meeze-ta taa-ssi imm-a (exercise-PL.ACC 1S-DAT give-IMP.2S).

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.gofatho_latin: Hayzaada taappe kaallada haasaya: (1) "7": 'sa7aa', 'na7a', 'pe7adii'; (2) "q": 'qaala'; (3) "x": 'xaafe'; (4) "c": 'cincca'; (5) "ph": 'phanqqe'; (6) "dh": 'dhiille'!
turns.gofatho_fidel: ሀይዘአደ ተአፕፔ ከአልለደ ሀአሰየ፦ (1) "ዕ"፦ 'ሰዓአ'፣ 'ነዓ'፣ 'ፔዓዲኢ'፤ (2) "ቅ"፦ 'ቀአለ'፤ (3) "ጥ"፦ 'ጠአፌ'፤ (4) "ጭ"፦ 'ጪንጭጨ'፤ (5) "ጵ"፦ 'ጳንቅቄ'፤ (6) "ꬍ"፦ 'ꬊኢልሌ'!
turns.amharic: አዳምጠህ ከእኔ ተከትለህ ተናገር፦ (1) «7» (/ʔ/)፦ 'ሳዓ' (ምድር)፣ 'ናዓ' (ልጅ)፣ 'ፔዓዲ' (አደርክ)፤ (2) «q» (ቀ)፦ 'ቃላ' (ቃል)፤ (3) «x» (ጠ)፦ 'ጣፌ' (ጤፍ)፤ (4) «c» (ጨ)፦ 'ጪንጫ' (ብልህ)፤ (5) «ph» (ጰ)፦ 'ጳንቄ' (ጀበና)፤ (6) «dh» (ꬍ)፦ 'ꬊኢሌ' (ዱቄት)!
turns.english: Listen and repeat after me: (1) '7' (/ʔ/): 'sa7aa' (earth), 'na7a' (child), 'pe7adii' (did you spend the night); (2) 'q' (/k'/): 'qaala' (word); (3) 'x' (/t'/): 'xaafe' (teff); (4) 'c' (/tʃ'/): 'cincca' (wise); (5) 'ph' (/p'/): 'phanqqe' (coffee pot); (6) 'dh' (/ɗ/): 'dhiille' (flour)!
turns.fst_morpheme_notes: Complete Gofatho glottalic consonant inventory drill (Sellassie Cheru 2015, p. 24).

turns.speaker: user
turns.gofatho_latin: "Sa7aa, na7a, pe7adii; qaala, xaafe, cincca, phanqqe, dhiille!" "Th" cenggurssaakka issi meega qofan meezetissoo?
turns.gofatho_fidel: "ሰዓአ፣ ነዓ፣ ፔዓዲኢ፤ ቀአለ፣ ጠአፌ፣ ጪንጭጨ፣ ጳንቅቄ፣ ꬊኢልሌ!" "ꬅ" ጬንግጉርስሰአክከ ኢስሲ ሜእገ ቆፈን ሜእዜቲስሶኦ?
turns.amharic: «ሳዓ፣ ናዓ፣ ፔዓዲ፤ ቃላ፣ ጣፌ፣ ጪንጫ፣ ጳንቄ፣ ꬊኢሌ!» የ«th» (ꬅ = /θ/) ድምፅንም በአንድ ዓረፍተ ነገር ታለማምደኛለህ?
turns.english: 'Sa7aa, na7a, pe7adii; qaala, xaafe, cincca, phanqqe, dhiille!' Could you also drill the dental fricative 'th' (ꬅ = /θ/) in a sentence?
turns.fst_morpheme_notes: th (/θ/, Ethiopic Extended-A ꬁ-ꬆ) + issi meega qofa-n meezet-iss-oo (one sentence-LOC practice-CAUS-2S.INTER).

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.gofatho_latin: Ha meega qofaa haasaya: "Goofatho keethan geeshsha haathaaninne maathaan payyatethaa naagoos!" - 'Goofatho', 'keethan', 'haathaan', 'maathaan', 'payyatethaa' ichchashukka 'th' oyqqidosona!
turns.gofatho_fidel: ሀ ሜእገ ቆፈአ ሀአሰየ፦ "ጎኦፈꬆ ኬእꬃን ጌእሽሻ ሀአꬃአኒንኔ መአꬃአን ፐይየቴꬃአ ነአጎኦስ!" - 'ጎኦፈꬆ'፣ 'ኬእꬃን'፣ 'ሀአꬃአን'፣ 'መአꬃአን'፣ 'ፐይየቴꬃአ' ኢችቻሹክከ 'ꬅ' ኦይቅቂዶሶነ!
turns.amharic: ይህንን ዓረፍተ ነገር ተናገር፦ «ጎፋꬶ ኬꬃን ጌሻ ሃꬃኒኔ ማꬃን ፓያቴꬃ ናጎስ!» (በጎፋ ቤት በንጹሕ ውኃና በወተት ጤንነትን እንጠብቃለን!) — አምስቱም ቃላት የ«th» (ꬅ) ድምፅ ይዘዋል!
turns.english: Speak this sentence: 'Goofatho keethan geeshsha haathaaninne maathaan payyatethaa naagoos!' ('In a Gofa home we guard health with clean water and milk!') — all five key words contain the dental fricative 'th' (ꬅ)!
turns.fst_morpheme_notes: Targeted dental fricative /θ/ ('th' / ꬅ) articulation drill across 5 high-frequency lexemes.

turns.speaker: user
turns.gofatho_latin: Hay Gofatho AI, naytas Goofatho "hayse" cenggurssaan odarkkii? "Haysee haysee!"
turns.gofatho_fidel: ሀይ ጎፈꬆ አኢ፣ ነይተስ ጎኦፈꬆ "ሀይሴ" ጬንግጉርስሰአን ኦደርክኪኢ? "ሀይሴእ ሀይሴእ!"
turns.amharic: ሄይ ጎፋꬶ ኤአይ፣ ለልጆቹ የጎፋኛ «ሃይሴ» (ተረት) በድምፅ ትነግርልኛለህ? «ሃይሴ ሃይሴ!»
turns.english: Hey Gofatho AI, could you tell a Gofatho folktale ('hayse') aloud for the children? 'Haysee haysee!'
turns.fst_morpheme_notes: nay-tas Goofatho hayse (child-PL.DAT Gofatho folktale, Gr9 Ch.5 p. 36) + cenggurssaa-n od-arkkii (voice-INST tell-2S.POT.INTER).

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.gofatho_latin: "Yaareti yaareti!" Beni wode issi woran gaammoy, godareynne bawakkey issippe daggo goshshidosona. Katthay cakettiyaa wode, gaammoy wolqqaan ubbaa oyqqanaw koyis, shin cincca bawakkey suuren shaakkidi woraa sarotethaa naagiis!
turns.gofatho_fidel: "የአሬቲ የአሬቲ!" ቤኒ ዎዴ ኢስሲ ዎረን ገአምሞይ፣ ጎደሬይንኔ በወክኬይ ኢስሲፕፔ ደግጎ ጎሽሺዶሶነ። ከትꬃይ ጨኬትቲየአ ዎዴ፣ ገአምሞይ ዎልቅቀአን ኡብበአ ኦይቅቀነው ኮዪስ፣ ሺን ጪንጭጨ በወክኬይ ሱኡሬን ሻአክኪዲ ዎረአ ሰሮቴꬃአ ነአጊኢስ!
turns.amharic: «ያሬቲ ያሬቲ!» በድሮ ዘመን በአንድ ደን ውስጥ አንበሳ፣ ጅብና ጥንቸል/ቀበሮ በጋራ እርሻ አረሱ። እህሉ በሚታጨድበት ጊዜ አንበሳው በጉልበት ሁሉንም ለመውሰድ ፈለገ፣ ነገር ግን ብልኋ ጥንቸል በጥበብ አካፍላ የደኑን ሰላም ጠበቀች!
turns.english: 'Yaareti yaareti!' Long ago in a forest, the lion ('gaammo'), the hyena ('godare'), and the clever hare ('bawakke') farmed a field together. At harvest time, the lion wanted to seize everything by force, but the wise hare divided the harvest fairly and preserved peace in the forest!
turns.fst_morpheme_notes: Traditional Gelo ('Beni wode...'), Giddo (conflict), and Wurssetha (resolution) folktale structure (Gr9 Ch.5 p. 43).

turns.speaker: user
turns.gofatho_latin: Ha haysey naytas ayba timirtte (ayfe qofa) tamaarissii?
turns.gofatho_fidel: ሀ ሀይሴይ ነይተስ አይበ ቲሚርትቴ (አይፌ ቆፈ) ተመአሪስሲኢ?
turns.amharic: ይህ ተረት ለልጆቹ ምን ትምህርት (ዋና ጭብጥ) ያስተምራል?
turns.english: What moral lesson ('ayfe qofa') does this folktale teach the children?
turns.fst_morpheme_notes: ha hayse-y nay-tas ayba timirtte tamaar-iss-ii (this folktale-NOM child-PL.DAT what lesson teach-CAUS-PRES.3MS.INTER).

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.gofatho_latin: Haysee ayfe qofay: "Wolqqaappe cinccatethaynne suureatethay aadhdhees; issippe oothida oosuwaa ubbay suuren shaakkidi maanaw bessees!" giyaagaa.
turns.gofatho_fidel: ሀይሴእ አይፌ ቆፈይ፦ "ዎልቅቀአፕፔ ጪንጭጨቴꬃይንኔ ሱኡሬአቴꬃይ አአꬍꬌእስ፤ ኢስሲፕፔ ኦኦꬂደ ኦኦሱወአ ኡብበይ ሱኡሬን ሻአክኪዲ መአነው ቤስሴእስ!" ጊየአገአ።
turns.amharic: የተረቱ ዋና ጭብጥ፦ «ከጉልበት ጥበብና ፍትሐዊነት ይበልጣል፤ በጋራ የሠሩትን ሥራ ሁሉም በትክክል ተካፍሎ መብላት ይገባል!» የሚል ነው።
turns.english: The moral of the tale is: 'Wisdom ('cinccatetha') and fairness ('suureatetha') surpass brute force; what is worked for together should be shared fairly!'
turns.fst_morpheme_notes: wolqqaa-ppe cinccatetha-y-nne suureatetha-y aadhdh-ees (force-ABL wisdom-NOM-and fairness-NOM surpass-PRES.3MS).

assistant_response.english: I spent the day in peace, thank you! I am glad because you arrived home safely. Should you not rest for a short time now?

user_prompt.gofatho_latin: Goofatho doonan so asaa sunthata taassi qonccisarkkii? Aawa, aayee, ishaanne michchiyaappe harati oonee?
user_prompt.gofatho_fidel: ጎኦፈꬆ ዶኦነን ሶ አሰአ ሱንꬃተ ተአስሲ ቆንጭጪሰርክኪኢ? አአወ፣ አአዬእ፣ ኢሻአንኔ ሚችቺየአፕፔ ሀረቲ ኦኦኔእ?
user_prompt.amharic: በጎፋኛ ቋንቋ የቤተሰብ መጠሪያ ስሞችን ታብራራልኛለህ? ከአባት፣ እናት፣ ወንድምና እኅት ሌላ እነማን ናቸው?
user_prompt.english: Could you explain family kinship terms to me in Gofatho? Besides father, mother, brother, and sister, who are the others?
user_prompt.fst_morpheme_notes: so asa-a (family-GEN) + suntha-ta (noun/name-PL.ACC) + taa-ssi (1S-DAT) + qoncc-is-arkkii (explain-CAUS-2S.POT.INTER); michch-iyaa-ppe (sister-F.DEF-ABL) + hara-ti (other-PL.NOM) + oon-ee (who-COP.INTER).

rag_context_anchors: PHR-091: Ta aawaynne ta aayee Sawulan de7oosona

assistant_response.gofatho_latin: Ufayssan! Goofatho doonan: aawa aaway woy aayee aaway 'maayza' geetettees; aawa ishay 'gutha aawa', aayee ishay 'vooce', qassi aawa michchiyaa 'aayee gutha' geetettawsu.
assistant_response.gofatho_fidel: ኡፈይስሰን! ጎኦፈꬆ ዶኦነን፦ አአወ አአወይ ዎይ አአዬእ አአወይ 'መአይዘ' ጌእቴትቴእስ፤ አአወ ኢሻይ 'ጉꬃ አአወ'፣ አአዬእ ኢሻይ 'vኦኦጬ'፣ ቀስሲ አአወ ሚችቺየአ 'አአዬእ ጉꬃ' ጌእቴትተውሱ።
assistant_response.amharic: በደስታ! በጎፋኛ ቋንቋ፦ የአባት አባት ወይም የእናት አባት «ማይዛ» (አያት) ይባላል፤ የአባት ወንድም «ጉꬃ አዋ» (አጎት)፣ የእናት ወንድም «ቮቼ» (የእናት ወንድም)፣ ደግሞ የአባት እኅት «አዬ ጉꬃ» (አክስት) ትባላለች።
assistant_response.english: Gladly! In Gofatho: a paternal or maternal grandfather is called 'maayza'; a paternal uncle is 'gutha aawa', a maternal uncle is 'vooce', and an aunt is called 'aayee gutha'.
assistant_response.fst_morpheme_notes: geet-ett-ees (call-PASS-PRES.3MS.A.DCL < g- 'say' + -ett- passive); geet-ett-awsu (call-PASS-PRES.3FS.A.DCL); demonstrates gender agreement between 3MS (-ees) and 3FS (-awsu).

assistant_response.gofatho_latin: Bayrata oychchoynne bonchchoy Goofa dere gita woga. Enttako gakkiya wode "Saro de7idetii, ta maayzatoo?" gada sarotha!

user_prompt.gofatho_latin: Iza ha77i tamma laytha kumadasu. Goofatho doonan 'tamma' giyaa qaalan 'mm' minniyaa gidoogaa waatada hassayissoo?

assistant_response.gofatho_latin: Miicissishe hagaada ga: "Ne laythay 'tamma' gidiis; 'tama' gidenna! Tamma laythan cincca tamaare gida!"

assistant_response.english: Playfully tell her: 'Your age has become tamma (ten — geminated minniyaa), not tama (fire — singleton leppiya)! At age ten, be a bright student!'

assistant_response.gofatho_fidel: እእ! "ዪዖ" ጉኡስሰይ አአወይንኔ አአዪየአ በይንነ ነዓ፤ "ከዮ" ጉኡስሰይ አዝዘኖ፤ "ሀጵጪዲ" ጉኡስሰይ ቆኦምሚዲ ኦይቅቆ። ሌእሚሶስ፦ "ሾኦሮቲ ዪዖ ነዓአ ሀጵጪዲ ከዮ ዘርብቢስሲዶሶነ።"
assistant_response.amharic: አዎ! «ዪዖ» ማለት አባትና እናት የሌለው ልጅ፤ «ካዮ» ማለት ሐዘን፤ «ሃጵጪዲ» ማለት አቅፎ መያዝ ነው። ለምሳሌ፦ «ጎረቤቶቹ ወላጅ አልባውን ልጅ አቅፈው ሐዘኑን አበረዱ።»
assistant_response.english: Yes! 'Yi7o' means an orphan child without parents; 'kayo' means grief; 'haphphidi' means embracing closely. For example: 'The neighbors embraced the orphan child and comforted his grief.'
assistant_response.fst_morpheme_notes: yi7o na7a-a (orphan child-ACC) + haphph-idi (embrace-CNV2.ANT) + kayo (grief.ACC) + zarbb-iss-idosona (calm-CAUS-PAST.3PL.A.DCL).

assistant_response.gofatho_latin: Issi uraas "Saro pe7a!" geetettees; daro asatas woy bonchchoos qassi "Saro pe7ite!" geetettees.
assistant_response.gofatho_fidel: ኢስሲ ኡረአስ "ሰሮ ፔዓ!" ጌእቴትቴእስ፤ ደሮ አሰተስ ዎይ ቦንችቾኦስ ቀስሲ "ሰሮ ፔዒቴ!" ጌእቴትቴእስ።
assistant_response.amharic: ለአንድ ሰው «ሳሮ ፔዓ!» (ደህና እደር/እደሪ!) ይባላል፤ ለብዙ ሰዎች ወይም ለአክብሮት ደግሞ «ሳሮ ፔዒቴ!» (ደህና እደሩ!) ይባላል።
assistant_response.english: To one person we say 'Saro pe7a!' ('Spend the night in peace!'), and to multiple people or politely we say 'Saro pe7ite!'
assistant_response.fst_morpheme_notes: pe7-a (spend.night-IMP.2S, ZARA-03 7=/ʔ/) vs. pe7-ite (spend.night-IMP.2PL/HON).

conversation_history.gofatho_latin: Puutto ma7o giyaan, dadanchchati kushen daddida lo77o gaabey, deexo bullukkoynne zo7o-kareetha-boorappe daddettida Goofa dungguzay bayzzettees.
conversation_history.gofatho_fidel: ፑኡትቶ መዖ ጊየአን፣ ደደንችቻቲ ኩሼን ደድዲደ ሎዕዖ ገአቤይ፣ ዴእጦ ቡልሉክኮይንኔ ዞዖ-ከሬእꬃ-ቦኦረፕፔ ደድዴትቲደ ጎኦፈ ዱንግጉዘይ በይዝዜትቴእስ።

user_prompt.gofatho_latin: Ta aawaas yaagano bonchchos ma7ana gaabe shammanaw waagay aappunee?
user_prompt.gofatho_fidel: ተ አአወአስ የአገኖ ቦንችቾስ መዓነ ገአቤ ሻምመነው ወአገይ አአፕፑኔእ?
user_prompt.amharic: ለአባቴ ለሠርግ ክብር የሚለብሰው ጋቢ ለመግዛት ዋጋው ስንት ነው?
user_prompt.english: How much is the price to buy a ceremonial gaabe for my father to wear for a wedding celebration?
user_prompt.fst_morpheme_notes: ta aawa-as (my father-DAT) + yaagano bonchcho-s (wedding honor-DAT, Gr10 Ch.2 p. 12) + ma7-ana (wear-FUT.REL) + gaabe shamm-anaw (gaabi buy-FUT.PURP).

rag_context_anchors: Gr10_Ch2: Na7iyaa puutto oykkada dakko, gaabe, laxana daddawus

assistant_response.gofatho_latin: Kushen puuttora loythi daddettida gaabee issi sha7anne ichchashu xeeta birappe na77u sha7a bira gakkees; nam77u issippe shammikko zal77anchchay waagaa oxxees.
assistant_response.gofatho_fidel: ኩሼን ፑኡትቶረ ሎይꬂ ደድዴትቲደ ገአቤእ ኢስሲ ሻዓንኔ ኢችቻሹ ጤእተ ቢረፕፔ ነዕዑ ሻዓ ቢረ ገክኬእስ፤ ነምዕዑ ኢስሲፕፔ ሻምሚክኮ ዘልዕዓንችቻይ ወአገአ ኦጥጤእስ።
assistant_response.amharic: በእጅ ከጥጥ በደንብ የተሸመነ ጋቢ ከአንድ ሺህ አምስት መቶ ብር እስከ ሁለት ሺህ ብር ይደርሳል፤ ሁለት አንድ ላይ ከገዛህ ነጋዴው ዋጋ ይቀንሳል።
assistant_response.english: A gaabe finely handwoven from pure cotton costs from 1,500 to 2,000 birr; if you buy two together, the seller reduces the price.
assistant_response.fst_morpheme_notes: puutto-ra (cotton-INST) + dadd-ett-ida (weave-PASS-PAST.REL) + sha7a-nne (thousand-and, ZARA-03 7) + shamm-ikko (buy-COND.REAL) + oxx-ees (reduce-PRES.3MS).

user_prompt.gofatho_latin: Ha muzeynne maangoy daro lo77o! "Ha muzey daro mal77ees, kiloy aappunee?" gada oychchoo?
user_prompt.gofatho_fidel: ሀ ሙዜይንኔ መአንጎይ ደሮ ሎዕዖ! "ሀ ሙዜይ ደሮ መልዕዔእስ፣ ኪሎይ አአፕፑኔእ?" ገደ ኦይችቾኦ?
user_prompt.amharic: ይህ ሙዝና ማንጎ በጣም ያምራል! «ይህ ሙዝ በጣም ይጣፍጣል፣ ኪሎው ስንት ነው?» ብዬ ልጠይቅ?
user_prompt.english: These bananas and mangoes look very nice! Should I ask, 'This banana is very sweet, how much is a kilo?'
user_prompt.fst_morpheme_notes: ha muze-y-nne (this banana-NOM-COORD) + maango-y (mango-NOM) + mal77-ees (be.sweet-PRES.3MS, ZARA-03 77=/ʔʔ/, PHR-025); kilo-y aappun-ee (kilo-NOM how.much-INTER).

assistant_response.gofatho_latin: Ee! Qassi awppe yiidaakko eranaw, "Ha muzey Oomo shafaa gadhappe yiidaysee?" gada oychchanaw dandda7aasa.
assistant_response.gofatho_fidel: እእ! ቀስሲ አውፕፔ ዪኢደአክኮ እረነው፣ "ሀ ሙዜይ ኦኦሞ ሻፈአ ገꬋፕፔ ዪኢደይሴእ?" ገደ ኦይችቻነው ደንድደዓአሰ።
assistant_response.amharic: አዎ! ደግሞም ከየት እንደመጣ ለማወቅ፣ «ይህ ሙዝ ከኦሞ ወንዝ ቆላ የመጣ ነው?» ብለህ መጠየቅ ትችላለህ።
assistant_response.english: Yes! And to know where it came from, you can ask, 'Is this banana from the Omo River lowlands?'
assistant_response.fst_morpheme_notes: Oomo shafa-a gadha-ppe (Omo river-GEN lowland-ABL, Gr8 Ch.5 p. 76 gadha vs. gezze) + y-iida-ysee (come-PAST.REL-NMZ.INTER).

user_prompt.gofatho_fidel: ጤእተ ቢረ ኢምመደ ዘአረአ ኦይችቻነው ጎኦፈꬆ ዶኦነን አይ ጎኦ?
user_prompt.amharic: መቶ ብር ሰጥቼ መልስ (ቀሪ ገንዘብ) ለመጠየቅ በጎፋኛ ምን ልበል?
user_prompt.english: After giving a hundred-birr note, what do I say in Gofatho to ask for my change?
user_prompt.fst_morpheme_notes: xeeta bira (hundred birr) + imm-ada (give-CNV1.ANT.1S) + zaara-a (change/return-ACC, PHR-021) + oychch-anaw (ask-FUT.PURP).

assistant_response.gofatho_latin: "Hayyanaa, miishshaa zaaraa taaw imma" gada oychcha; qoodada ekkakka!
assistant_response.gofatho_fidel: "ሀይየነአ፣ ሚኢሽሻአ ዘአረአ ተአው ኢምመ" ገደ ኦይችቻ፤ ቆኦደደ እክከክከ!
assistant_response.amharic: «ሃይያና፣ ሚኢሻ ዛራ ታው ኢማ» (እባክህ፣ የገንዘቡን መልስ ስጠኝ) ብለህ ጠይቅ፤ ቆጥረህም ተቀበል!
assistant_response.english: Say, 'Hayyanaa, miishshaa zaaraa taaw imma' ('Please, give me back the change'); and count it as you receive it!
assistant_response.fst_morpheme_notes: miishsha-a zaara-a (money-GEN change-ACC) + taa-w (1S-DAT) + imm-a (give-IMP.2S, PHR-021); qood-ada (count-CNV1.ANT.2S) + ekk-a-kka (take-IMP.2S-ADD).

user_prompt.gofatho_latin: Ta aaway goshsha-boorinne dorssa shammanaw mehe giyaa biis. Mehe giyan booraa payyatethaa waatidi qoraphphoo?
user_prompt.gofatho_fidel: ተ አአወይ ጎሽሻ-ቦኦሪንኔ ዶርስሰ ሻምመነው ሜሄ ጊየአ ቢኢስ። ሜሄ ጊየን ቦኦረአ ፐይየቴꬃአ ወአቲዲ ቆረጵፆኦ?
user_prompt.amharic: አባቴ የእርሻ በሬና በግ ለመግዛት ወደ ከብት ገበያ ሄደ። በከብት ገበያ የበሬውን ጤንነት እንዴት እንመርምር?
user_prompt.english: My father went to the livestock market to buy a plow ox (goshsha-boori) and a sheep (dorssa). How do we inspect the ox's health at the market?
user_prompt.fst_morpheme_notes: goshsha-boori-nne (compound: plow-ox-COORD, Gr8 Ch.3 p. 53) + dorssa (sheep, Gr8 Ch.5 p. 76) + mehe giya-a (cattle/livestock market-DIR) + b-iis (go-PAST.3MS.A.DCL).

assistant_response.gofatho_latin: Goshshaanchchati booraa shammiyaa wode: achchiyaa, gediyaa minotethaa, zokkuwaanne kabbasha tookkiyaa qodhdhiyaa loythi xeelloosona.
assistant_response.gofatho_fidel: ጎሽሻአንችቻቲ ቦኦረአ ሻምሚየአ ዎዴ፦ አችቺየአ፣ ጌዲየአ ሚኖቴꬃአ፣ ዞክኩወአንኔ ከብበሻ ቶኦክኪየአ ቆꬍꬊየአ ሎይꬂ ጤእልሎኦሶነ።
assistant_response.amharic: ገበሬዎች በሬ ሲገዙ፦ ጥርሱን (ዕድሜውን ለማወቅ)፣ የእግሩን ጥንካሬ፣ ጀርባውንና ቀንበር የሚሸከመውን ማጅራቱን በደንብ ያያሉ።
assistant_response.english: When farmers buy an ox, they carefully inspect its teeth (to know its age), the strength of its legs, its back, and its neck that carries the yoke (kabbasha).
assistant_response.fst_morpheme_notes: goshshanchcha-ti (farmer-PL.NOM) + achchiya-a (tooth-ACC.M.DEF) + gediya-a minotetha-a (leg strength-ACC) + kabbasha (yoke, Gr10 Ch.9 p. 81) + tookk-iyaa (carry-PRES.REL) + xeell-oosona (inspect-PRES.3PL).

conversation_history.gofatho_fidel: ጊየአ ዩኡየደ ነምዕዔትተዲስ። ቁኡመአ መአነው ሆቴእሊየአ ጌለደ አይበ ቁመ ኦይችቾኦ?

conversation_history.gofatho_latin: Hoteeliyan: "Saro! Ho77o soollo, zo7o-asho woxe, dono-oto woykko eesanne santhi de7ii? Qassi geeshsha haathaa taaw eha" gada oychcha.
conversation_history.gofatho_fidel: ሆቴእሊየን፦ "ሰሮ! ሆዕዖ ሶኦልሎ፣ ዞዖ-አሾ ዎጤ፣ ዶኖ-ኦቶ ዎይክኮ እእሰንኔ ሰንꬂ ዴዒኢ? ቀስሲ ጌእሽሻ ሀአꬃአ ተአው እሀ" ገደ ኦይችቻ።

user_prompt.gofatho_latin: Quumaa mi wurssidaappe guyye, qanxxuwaa oychchanaw ay goo?
user_prompt.gofatho_fidel: ቁኡመአ ሚ ዉርስሲደአፕፔ ጉይዬ፣ ቀንጥጡወአ ኦይችቻነው አይ ጎኦ?
user_prompt.amharic: ምግቡን በልቼ ከጨረስኩ በኋላ፣ ሂሳቡን ለመጠየቅ ምን ልበል?
user_prompt.english: After I finish eating the meal, what do I say to ask for the bill?
user_prompt.fst_morpheme_notes: quuma-a m-i wurss-idaa-ppe guyye (food-ACC eat-CNV2 finish-PAST.REL-ABL after) + qanxxuwa-a (payment/bill-ACC.M.DEF, MP-10) + oychch-anaw (ask-FUT.PURP).

assistant_response.gofatho_latin: "Quumay daro mal77ees, kushey anjjetto! Waagay ubbay aappunee?" gada oychcha.
assistant_response.gofatho_fidel: "ቁኡመይ ደሮ መልዕዔእስ፣ ኩሼይ አንጅጄትቶ! ወአገይ ኡብበይ አአፕፑኔእ?" ገደ ኦይችቻ።
assistant_response.amharic: «ምግቡ በጣም ይጣፍጣል፣ እጅ ይባረክ! ዋጋው ሁሉ ስንት ነው?» ብለህ ጠይቅ።
assistant_response.english: Ask: 'The food is very delicious, may the hand that cooked it be blessed! How much is the total price?'
assistant_response.fst_morpheme_notes: quuma-y daro mal77-ees (food-NOM very be.delicious-PRES.3MS); kushe-y anjj-etto (hand-NOM bless-PASS.JUSS.3MS); waaga-y ubba-y aappun-ee (price-NOM all-NOM how.much-INTER).

user_prompt.gofatho_latin: Oto kathanaw suunqqota - thuumo, yenjjeelo, maxinenne berbbere - giyaappe shammanaw koyays.
user_prompt.gofatho_fidel: ኦቶ ከꬃነው ሱኡንቅቆተ - ꬁኡሞ፣ ዬንጅጄእሎ፣ መጢኔንኔ ቤርብቤሬ - ጊየአፕፔ ሻምመነው ኮየይስ።
user_prompt.amharic: ወጥ ለማብሰል ቅመማ ቅመሞችን—ነጭ ሽንኩርት (ꬁሞ)፣ ዝንጅብል (ዬንጄሎ)፣ ጨው (ማጢኔ) እና በርበሬ—ከገበያ መግዛት እፈልጋለሁ።
user_prompt.english: To cook stew, I want to buy spices—garlic (thuumo), ginger (yenjjeelo), salt (maxine), and chili pepper (berbbere)—from the market.
user_prompt.fst_morpheme_notes: oto kath-anaw (stew cook-FUT.PURP) + suunqqo-ta (spice-PL.ACC) + thuumo (garlic, dental fricative th /θ/) + yenjjeelo (ginger) + maxine (salt, ejective x /t'/) + berbbere (pepper).

rag_context_anchors: Sellassie Cheru (2015): thuumo (garlic), yenjjeelo (ginger), maxine (salt), berbbere (chili pepper)

assistant_response.gofatho_latin: Suunqqo giyan maccati thuumuwaa, yenjjeeluwaanne xadduwaa qoriyan bayzzoosona. "Issi qoriya thuumonne na77u qoriya maxine taaw imma" ga.
assistant_response.gofatho_fidel: ሱኡንቅቆ ጊየን መጭጨቲ ꬁኡሙወአ፣ ዬንጅጄእሉወአንኔ ጠድዱወአ ቆሪየን በይዝዞኦሶነ። "ኢስሲ ቆሪየ ꬁኡሞንኔ ነዕዑ ቆሪየ መጢኔ ተአው ኢምመ" ገ።
assistant_response.amharic: በቅመም ገበያ ሴቶቹ ነጭ ሽንኩርቱን፣ ዝንጅብሉንና ጤና አዳሙን በመስፈሪያ (ቆሪያ) ይሸጣሉ። «አንድ መስፈሪያ ነጭ ሽንኩርትና ሁለት መስፈሪያ ጨው ስጪኝ» በል።
assistant_response.english: In the spice market, women sell garlic, ginger, and rue by the measuring cup (qoriya). Say, 'Give me one cup of garlic and two cups of salt.'
assistant_response.fst_morpheme_notes: thuumuwa-a (garlic-ACC.M.DEF, MP-10) + yenjjeeluwa-a-nne (ginger-ACC.M.DEF-COORD) + qoriya-n (measuring.cup-INST) + bayzz-oosona (sell-PRES.3PL).

user_prompt.gofatho_latin: Goofa oysaas gujjettiyaa sawuwaa lo77o suunqqoti awugeetee?
user_prompt.gofatho_fidel: ጎኦፈ ኦይሰአስ ጉጅጄትቲየአ ሰዉወአ ሎዕዖ ሱኡንቅቆቲ አዉጌእቴእ?
user_prompt.amharic: ለጎፋ ቅቤ ማጣፈጫ የሚጨመሩ ጥሩ መዓዛ ያላቸው ቅመሞች የትኞቹ ናቸው?
user_prompt.english: Which are the fragrant spices added when clarifying Gofa butter (oysa)?
user_prompt.fst_morpheme_notes: Goofa oysa-as (Gofa butter-DAT) + gujj-ett-iyaa (add-PASS-PRES.REL) + sawuwa-a lo77o (aroma-ACC good) + suunqqo-ti (spice-PL.NOM) + awu-geet-ee (which-PL.DEF-INTER).

rag_context_anchors: Sellassie Cheru (2015): thuumo (garlic), yenjjeelo (ginger), maxine (salt), berbbere (chili pepper)

assistant_response.gofatho_latin: Oysa kathanaw kasho, xaddo, korariimanne yenjjeelo issippe gujjiyaa wode oysaa sawuwaynne mal77oy daro aadhdhees!
assistant_response.gofatho_fidel: ኦይሰ ከꬃነው ከሾ፣ ጠድዶ፣ ኮረሪኢመንኔ ዬንጅጄእሎ ኢስሲፕፔ ጉጅጂየአ ዎዴ ኦይሰአ ሰዉወይንኔ መልዕዖይ ደሮ አአꬍꬌእስ!
assistant_response.amharic: ቅቤ ለማንጠር ኮሰረት (ካሾ)፣ ጤና አዳም (ጣዶ)፣ ኮረሪማና ዝንጅብል አንድ ላይ ሲጨመሩ የቅቤው መዓዛና ጣዕም እጅግ ይበልጣል!
assistant_response.english: When koseret herb (kasho), rue (xaddo), korarima cardamom, and ginger are added together to clarify butter, its aroma and flavor become extraordinary!
assistant_response.fst_morpheme_notes: oysa kath-anaw (butter clarify/boil-FUT.PURP) + gujj-iyaa wode (add-PRES.REL when) + sawuwa-y-nne mal77o-y (aroma-NOM-and taste-NOM) + aadhdh-ees (surpass-PRES.3MS, geminate implosive dhdh).

user_prompt.gofatho_latin: Hosppuntho kifile Shemppo 7 giddon "hirayssi" nne "al77o" giyaa phalqqe qaalati de7oosona. Giya haasayan enttana waatada go7ettoo?
user_prompt.gofatho_fidel: ሆስፕፑንꬆ ኪፊሌ ሼምፕፖ ዕ ጊድዶን "ሂረይስሲ" ንኔ "አልዕዖ" ጊየአ ጳልቅቄ ቀአለቲ ዴዖኦሶነ። ጊየ ሀአሰየን እንትተነ ወአተደ ጎዔትቶኦ?
user_prompt.amharic: በስምንተኛ ክፍል ምዕራፍ 7 ውስጥ «ሂራይሲ» (ርካሽ) እና «አልዕዖ» (ውድ) የሚሉ ተቃራኒ ቃላት አሉ። በገበያ ንግግር ውስጥ እንዴት ልጠቀምባቸው?
user_prompt.english: In Grade 8 Chapter 7 there are the antonym words 'hirayssi' (cheap) and 'al77o' (expensive/precious). How do I use them in market conversation?
user_prompt.fst_morpheme_notes: hirayssi (cheap/inexpensive, Gr8 Ch.7 p. 103) vs. al77o (expensive/precious, ZARA-03 geminate glottal 77=/ʔʔ/); phalqqe qaala-ti (antonym word-PL.NOM, Gr8 Ch.7 p. 111) + go7ett-oo (use-1S.INTER.JUSS).

assistant_response.gofatho_latin: Issi miishshi waagay xoqqa gidikko "Ha miishshay daro al77o" gaasa; waagay guutha gidikko qassi "Ha miishshay hirayssi" gaasa.
assistant_response.gofatho_fidel: ኢስሲ ሚኢሽሺ ወአገይ ጦቅቀ ጊዲክኮ "ሀ ሚኢሽሻይ ደሮ አልዕዖ" ገአሰ፤ ወአገይ ጉኡꬃ ጊዲክኮ ቀስሲ "ሀ ሚኢሽሻይ ሂረይስሲ" ገአሰ።
assistant_response.amharic: የአንድ ዕቃ ዋጋ ከፍተኛ ከሆነ «ሃ ሚኢሻይ ዳሮ አልዕዖ» (ይህ ዕቃ በጣም ውድ ነው) ትላለህ፤ ዋጋው አነስተኛ ከሆነ ደግሞ «ሃ ሚኢሻይ ሂራይሲ» (ይህ ዕቃ ርካሽ ነው) ትላለህ።
assistant_response.english: If an item's price is high, you say 'Ha miishshay daro al77o' ('This item is very expensive'); and if the price is low, you say 'Ha miishshay hirayssi' ('This item is inexpensive').
assistant_response.fst_morpheme_notes: xoqqa gid-ikko (high be-COND.REAL) -> al77o; guutha gid-ikko (low/small be-COND.REAL) -> hirayssi; g-aasa (say-PRES.2S.A.DCL).

user_prompt.gofatho_latin: Kathi cakettiyaa boniyaa wode giyan katthaa waagay hirayssee woykko al77oo?
user_prompt.gofatho_fidel: ከꬂ ጨኬትቲየአ ቦኒየአ ዎዴ ጊየን ከትꬃአ ወአገይ ሂረይስሴእ ዎይክኮ አልዕዖኦ?
user_prompt.amharic: እህል በሚታጨድበት የበጋ ወቅት በገበያ የእህል ዋጋ ርካሽ ነው ወይስ ውድ?
user_prompt.english: During the dry harvest season (boniya), is the price of grain in the market cheap or expensive?
user_prompt.fst_morpheme_notes: kath-i cak-ett-iyaa boniya-a wode (grain-NOM harvest-PASS-PRES.REL dry.season-GEN time) + kattha-a waaga-y (grain-GEN price-NOM) + hirayss-ee woykko al77-oo (cheap-INTER or expensive-INTER).

assistant_response.gofatho_latin: Kathi cakettiyaa wode giyan katthay daro shiiqiyaa gishshaw waagay hirayssi gidees; zerethi zerettiyaa balgguwan qassi al77o gidees.
assistant_response.gofatho_fidel: ከꬂ ጨኬትቲየአ ዎዴ ጊየን ከትꬃይ ደሮ ሺኢቂየአ ጊሽሻው ወአገይ ሂረይስሲ ጊዴእስ፤ ዜሬꬂ ዜሬትቲየአ በልግጉወን ቀስሲ አልዕዖ ጊዴእስ።
assistant_response.amharic: እህል በሚታጨድበት ወቅት በገበያ እህል በብዛት ስለሚቀርብ ዋጋው ርካሽ ይሆናል፤ ዘር በሚዘራበት ክረምት ደግሞ ውድ ይሆናል።
assistant_response.english: During harvest time, because grain is abundant in the market, the price becomes inexpensive (hirayssi); whereas during the rainy planting season (balgguwa), it becomes expensive (al77o).
assistant_response.fst_morpheme_notes: daro shiiq-iyaa gishshaw (abundantly gather/supply-PRES.REL because) + hirayssi gid-ees (cheap become-PRES.3MS); balgguwa-n (rainy.season-LOC, MP-10) + al77o gid-ees.

conversation_history.gofatho_latin: Hachchi giyan daabbuwaa, maathaanne eessaa bayzzada wurssadis. Gallassa demishaanne tirfiyaa Goofatho doonan waatada qoodoo?
conversation_history.gofatho_fidel: ሀችቺ ጊየን ደአብቡወአ፣ መአꬃአንኔ እእስሰአ በይዝዘደ ዉርስሰዲስ። ገልለስሰ ዴሚሻአንኔ ቲርፊየአ ጎኦፈꬆ ዶኦነን ወአተደ ቆኦዶኦ?

conversation_history.gofatho_latin: Koyro hachchi gelida "qaye bira" ubbaa qooda; hessaappe koyro baasida waagaa kessiyaa wode geeshsha tirfey beettees.
conversation_history.gofatho_fidel: ኮይሮ ሀችቺ ጌሊደ "ቀዬ ቢረ" ኡብበአ ቆኦደ፤ ሄስሰአፕፔ ኮይሮ በአሲደ ወአገአ ኬስሲየአ ዎዴ ጌእሽሻ ቲርፌይ ቤእትቴእስ።

user_prompt.gofatho_latin: Demishaappe baggaa baankkiyan dagayada baggaara wontto giyaas miishsha shammanaw qoppays.
user_prompt.gofatho_fidel: ዴሚሻአፕፔ በግገአ በአንክኪየን ደገየደ በግገአረ ዎንትቶ ጊየአስ ሚኢሽሻ ሻምመነው ቆፕፐይስ።
user_prompt.amharic: ከገቢው ግማሹን በባንክ ቆጥቤ በግማሹ ነገ ለገበያ ዕቃ ለመግዛት አስባለሁ።
user_prompt.english: I plan to save half of the income in the bank and buy goods for tomorrow's market with the other half.
user_prompt.fst_morpheme_notes: demishaa-ppe bagga-a (income-ABL half-ACC) + baankkiya-n (bank-LOC) + dagay-ada (save/store-CNV1.ANT.1S, PHR-051) + baggaa-ra (half-INST) + shamm-anaw (buy-FUT.PURP) + qopp-ays (think/plan-PRES.1S).

rag_context_anchors: Gr9_Ch2 Vocab: qaye bira (liquid cash), demisha (income/revenue)

assistant_response.gofatho_latin: Hegee cincca zal77anchcha qofa! Miishsha dagayoynne dabtteren xaafidi oyqqoy ne zal77iyaa eesuwan dichchees.
assistant_response.gofatho_fidel: ሄጌእ ጪንጭጨ ዘልዕዓንችቻ ቆፈ! ሚኢሽሻ ደገዮይንኔ ደብትቴሬን ጠአፊዲ ኦይቅቆይ ኔ ዘልዕዒየአ እእሱወን ዲችቼእስ።
assistant_response.amharic: ይህ የብልህ ነጋዴ ሐሳብ ነው! ገንዘብ መቆጠብና በደብተር ጽፎ መያዝ ንግድህን በፍጥነት ያሳድገዋል።
assistant_response.english: That is the thought of a wise merchant! Saving money and keeping written records in a notebook will rapidly grow your business.
assistant_response.fst_morpheme_notes: cincca zal77anchcha qofa (wise merchant thought); miishsha dagayo-y-nne (money saving-NOM-and) + xaaf-idi oyqqo-y (write-CNV2 keeping-NOM) + dichch-ees (grow.CAUS-PRES.3MS).

user_prompt.gofatho_latin: Saro! Zine omarssappe doommidi ta huuphey daro sakkees, bollaykka mishuxan ho77ees.
user_prompt.gofatho_fidel: ሰሮ! ዚኔ ኦመርስሰፕፔ ዶኦምሚዲ ተ ሁኡጴይ ደሮ ሰክኬእስ፣ ቦልለይክከ ሚሹጠን ሆዕዔእስ።
user_prompt.amharic: ሰላም! ከትናንት ማታ ጀምሮ ራሴን በጣም ያመኛል፣ ሰውነቴም በትኩሳት ይሞቃል።
user_prompt.english: Hello! Since yesterday evening my head hurts very much, and my body is hot with fever.
user_prompt.fst_morpheme_notes: zine omarssa-ppe doomm-idi (yesterday evening-ABL start-CNV2.ANT) + ta huuphe-y (my head-NOM) + daro sakk-ees (very ache-PRES.3MS, PHR-032); bolla-y-kka (body-NOM-ADD) + mishuxa-n (fever-INST, PHR-038) + ho77-ees (be.hot-PRES.3MS, ZARA-03 77).

rag_context_anchors: PHR-031: Taani aakime keethi baanaw koyays

assistant_response.gofatho_latin: Saro! Mishuxaynne huuphe sakkoy shekkeere woykko gunfana gidanaw dandda7ees. Suuthaa qoraphiyanaw eesuwan aakime keethi ba; cenggurssaykka qaxettii?
assistant_response.gofatho_fidel: ሰሮ! ሚሹጠይንኔ ሁኡጴ ሰክኮይ ሼክኬእሬ ዎይክኮ ጉንፈነ ጊደነው ደንድደዔእስ። ሱኡꬃአ ቆረጪየነው እእሱወን አአኪሜ ኬእꬂ በ፤ ጬንግጉርስሰይክከ ቀጤትቲኢ?
assistant_response.amharic: ሰላም! ትኩሳትና የራስ ምታት የወባ ወይም የጉንፋን ምልክት ሊሆን ይችላል። ደም ለመመርመር በፍጥነት ወደ ሐኪም ቤት ሂድ፤ ጉሮሮህንም ይቆርጥሃል?
assistant_response.english: Hello! Fever and headache can be signs of malaria (shekkeere) or flu. Go quickly to the clinic to have your blood tested; does your throat also ache?
assistant_response.fst_morpheme_notes: mishuxa-y-nne huuphe sakko-y (fever-NOM-and head ache-NOM) + suutha-a qoraph-iyanaw (blood-ACC examine-FUT.PURP, PHR-041) + aakime keethi ba (clinic go.IMP.2S).

user_prompt.gofatho_latin: Ta guutha na7aa uloy sakkeesinne haathaa gussees. Aakime keethi gakkanaashin soon ay oothoo?
user_prompt.gofatho_fidel: ተ ጉኡꬃ ነዓአ ኡሎይ ሰክኬእሲንኔ ሀአꬃአ ጉስሴእስ። አአኪሜ ኬእꬂ ገክከነአሺን ሶኦን አይ ኦኦꬆኦ?

user_prompt.english: My young child has a stomachache and diarrhea. Until I reach the clinic, what should I do at home?
user_prompt.fst_morpheme_notes: ta guutha na7a-a ulo-y (my young child-GEN stomach-NOM, ZARA-03 7) + sakk-ees-inne (ache-PRES.3MS-and, PHR-033); aakime keethi gakk-anaashin (clinic reach-UNTIL) + soo-n ay ooth-oo (home-LOC what do-1S.INTER.JUSS).

assistant_response.gofatho_latin: Na7aa bollan haathay dhayonna mala, ORS kathidi qoraphphan qoraphphan ushsha; aayee dhanththaakka aggonnaan dhanththissa!
assistant_response.gofatho_fidel: ነዓአ ቦልለን ሀአꬃይ ꬋዮንነ መለ፣ ኦርስ ከꬂዲ ቆረጵጳን ቆረጵጳን ኡሽሻ፤ አአዬእ ꬋንꬅꬃአክከ አግጎንነአን ꬋንꬅꬂስሰ!

assistant_response.english: So that the child does not become dehydrated, mix ORS (oral rehydration salts) with clean water and give sips frequently; also continue breastfeeding without stopping!
assistant_response.fst_morpheme_notes: na7a-a bolla-n (child-GEN body-LOC) + haatha-y dhay-onna mala (water-NOM disappear-NEG.PURP) + ushsh-a (drink.CAUS-IMP.2S, MP-04/05 < uy- + -iss-); dhanthth-iss-a (suckle-CAUS-IMP.2S).

user_prompt.gofatho_fidel: አአኪሜይ ጠሊየአ ጠአፊዲ ተአው ኢምሚኢስ። ጠሌ ኬእꬃን ጠሊየአ ወአኒ ኡየነአክኮ ወአተደ ኦይችቾኦ?
user_prompt.amharic: ሐኪሙ መድኃኒት ጽፎ ሰጠኝ። በፋርማሲ (መድኃኒት ቤት) መድኃኒቱን እንዴት እንደምውጥ እንዴት ልጠይቅ?
user_prompt.english: The doctor wrote a prescription and gave it to me. At the pharmacy, how do I ask how to take the medicine?
user_prompt.fst_morpheme_notes: aakime-y xaliya-a xaaf-idi (doctor-NOM medicine-ACC write-CNV2.ANT) + taa-w imm-iis (1S-DAT give-PAST.3MS, PHR-034); waan-i uy-ana-akko (how-CNV2 drink/take-FUT-COMP) + oychch-oo (ask-1S.INTER.JUSS).

rag_context_anchors: PHR-035: Ha xaliyaa gallassan heedzu toho uya

assistant_response.gofatho_latin: Xale oosanchchaakko: "Hayyanaa, ha xaliyaa gallassan aappun toho uyoo? Quumaappe kaseeye quumaappe guyye uyoo?" gada oychcha.
assistant_response.gofatho_fidel: ጠሌ ኦኦሰንችቻአክኮ፦ "ሀይየነአ፣ ሀ ጠሊየአ ገልለስሰን አአፕፑን ቶሆ ኡዮኦ? ቁኡመአፕፔ ከሴእዬ ቁኡመአፕፔ ጉይዬ ኡዮኦ?" ገደ ኦይችቻ።
assistant_response.amharic: የፋርማሲ ባለሙያውን፦ «እባክህ፣ ይህን መድኃኒት በቀን ስንት ጊዜ ልዋጥ? ከምግብ በፊት ነው ወይስ ከምግብ በኋላ የምውጠው?» ብለህ ጠይቅ።
assistant_response.english: Ask the pharmacist: 'Please, how many times a day should I take this medicine? Should I take it before food or after food?'
assistant_response.fst_morpheme_notes: gallassa-n aappun toho (day-LOC how.many times, PHR-035) + uy-oo (take-1S.INTER.JUSS); quumaa-ppe kase-eye quumaa-ppe guyye (food-ABL before-INTER.OR food-ABL after).

assistant_response.gofatho_fidel: አአኪሜይ አዘዚዶኦገአደን ጠሊየአ ዉርስሰነ ገክከነው ኡየ! ፐጢደ ሚለቲክኮክከ ጠሊየአ ጊድዶን አግጎፕፐ።

user_prompt.gofatho_latin: Ta maayzaa ayfey haahuwaa loythi xeellenna, qassi afuxees. Ayfe aakimeekko efaanaw ay goo?
user_prompt.gofatho_fidel: ተ መአይዘአ አይፌይ ሀአሁወአ ሎይꬂ ጤእልሌንነ፣ ቀስሲ አፉጤእስ። አይፌ አአኪሜእክኮ እፈአነው አይ ጎኦ?
user_prompt.amharic: የአያቴ ዓይን ሩቅ በደንብ አያይም፣ ደግሞም እንባ ይፈሰዋል። ወደ ዓይን ሐኪም ለመውሰድ ምን ልበል?
user_prompt.english: My grandfather's eyes do not see far distances well, and they water. What should I say when taking him to the eye doctor?
user_prompt.fst_morpheme_notes: ta maayza-a ayfe-y (my grandfather-GEN eye-NOM) + haahuwa-a (far.distance-ACC.M.DEF) + loythi xeell-enna (well see-PRES.3MS.NEG, PHR-044); ayfe aakimee-kko (eye doctor-DIR) + ef-aanaw (take-FUT.PURP).

rag_context_anchors: Gr8_Ch10 Proverb: Ayfe caddana mithi ayfes beetenna

assistant_response.gofatho_latin: Ayfe aakimeekko: "Ta maayzaa ayfey loythi xeellenna; puuray de7iyaakko hayyanaa qoraphpharkkii?" gada oychcha.
assistant_response.gofatho_fidel: አይፌ አአኪሜእክኮ፦ "ተ መአይዘአ አይፌይ ሎይꬂ ጤእልሌንነ፤ ፑኡረይ ዴዒየአክኮ ሀይየነአ ቆረጵጳርክኪኢ?" ገደ ኦይችቻ።
assistant_response.amharic: ለዓይን ሐኪሙ፦ «የአያቴ ዓይን በደንብ አያይም፤ የዓይን ሞራ እንዳለበት እባክህ ትመረምርልኛለህ?» ብለህ ጠይቅ።
assistant_response.english: Say to the eye specialist: 'My grandfather's eyes do not see clearly; please could you examine whether he has a cataract?'
assistant_response.fst_morpheme_notes: loythi xeell-enna (well see-PRES.3MS.NEG) + de7-iyaa-kko (exist-PRES.REL-COMP) + qoraphph-arkkii (examine-2S.POT.INTER).

assistant_response.gofatho_latin: Hosppuntho kifile Shemppo 10 (p. 145) tossey: "Ayfe caddana mithi ayfes beetenna" gees; hessa gisho ayfe payyatethaa kasetidi naaganaw bessees.
assistant_response.gofatho_fidel: ሆስፕፑንꬆ ኪፊሌ ሼምፕፖ 10 (ፕ። 145) ቶስሴይ፦ "አይፌ ጨድደነ ሚꬂ አይፌስ ቤእቴንነ" ጌእስ፤ ሄስሰ ጊሾ አይፌ ፐይየቴꬃአ ከሴቲዲ ነአገነው ቤስሴእስ።
assistant_response.amharic: የስምንተኛ ክፍል ምዕራፍ 10 (ገጽ 145) ምሳሌ፦ «አይፌ ጫዳና ሚꬂ አይፌስ ቤቴና» (ዓይንን የሚወጋ እንጨት ለዓይን አይታይም) ይላል፤ ስለዚህ የዓይንን ጤንነት አስቀድሞ መጠበቅ ይገባል።
assistant_response.english: The Grade 8 Chapter 10 (p. 145) proverb says: 'Ayfe caddana mithi ayfes beetenna' ('The twig that will poke the eye is not visible to the eye'); therefore one must protect eye health proactively.
assistant_response.fst_morpheme_notes: ayfe cadd-ana mithi (eye poke/stab-FUT.REL wood/twig) + ayfe-s (eye-DAT) + beet-enna (be.seen-PRES.3MS.NEG < be7- + -ett- + -enna, MP-06).

user_prompt.gofatho_latin: Hosppuntho kifile Shemppo 1 ("Ooso Woga") giddon aakime keethan oothiyaa aakimeta ooso wogaabaa ay gii?
user_prompt.gofatho_fidel: ሆስፕፑንꬆ ኪፊሌ ሼምፕፖ 1 ("ኦኦሶ ዎገ") ጊድዶን አአኪሜ ኬእꬃን ኦኦꬂየአ አአኪሜተ ኦኦሶ ዎገአበአ አይ ጊኢ?

rag_context_anchors: Gr8_Ch1 Meeze 1 p. 11: Aakime keethan oothiya aakimeti hargganchcha xuura naaganaas bessees

assistant_response.gofatho_latin: Hosppuntho kifile maxaafaa (p. 4 & p. 11) maaran: aakimeti hargganchchata ubbaa issi gina bonchchon mokkidi akkamoosonanne hargganchcha xuura loythi naagoosona.
assistant_response.gofatho_fidel: ሆስፕፑንꬆ ኪፊሌ መጠአፈአ (ፕ። 4 & ፕ። 11) መአረን፦ አአኪሜቲ ሀርግገንችቻተ ኡብበአ ኢስሲ ጊነ ቦንችቾን ሞክኪዲ አክከሞኦሶነንኔ ሀርግገንችቻ ጡኡረ ሎይꬂ ነአጎኦሶነ።
assistant_response.amharic: በስምንተኛ ክፍል መጽሐፍ (ገጽ 4 እና 11) መሠረት፦ ሐኪሞች ታካሚዎችን ሁሉ በእኩል አክብሮት ተቀብለው ያክማሉ እንዲሁም የታካሚውን ምሥጢር (ጡኡራ) በጥብቅ ይጠብቃሉ።

conversation_history.gofatho_latin: Hosppuntho kifile maxaafaa (p. 4 & p. 11) maaran: aakimeti hargganchchata ubbaa issi gina bonchchon mokkidi akkamoosonanne hargganchcha xuura loythi naagoosona.
conversation_history.gofatho_fidel: ሆስፕፑንꬆ ኪፊሌ መጠአፈአ (ፕ። 4 & ፕ። 11) መአረን፦ አአኪሜቲ ሀርግገንችቻተ ኡብበአ ኢስሲ ጊነ ቦንችቾን ሞክኪዲ አክከሞኦሶነንኔ ሀርግገንችቻ ጡኡረ ሎይꬂ ነአጎኦሶነ።

user_prompt.gofatho_latin: Hargganchchaykka aakime keethan ba harggiyaabaa qonccissiyaa wode ay oothanaw bessii?
user_prompt.gofatho_fidel: ሀርግገንችቻይክከ አአኪሜ ኬእꬃን በ ሀርግጊየአበአ ቆንጭጪስሲየአ ዎዴ አይ ኦኦꬃነው ቤስሲኢ?
user_prompt.amharic: ታካሚውም በሐኪም ቤት ስለ ሕመሙ ሲገልጽ ምን ማድረግ ይገባዋል?
user_prompt.english: And when the patient explains his illness at the clinic, what should he do?
user_prompt.fst_morpheme_notes: hargganchcha-y-kka (patient-NOM-ADD) + ba harggiyaa-baa (3REFL.GEN illness-ABOUT) + qoncc-iss-iyaa wode (explain-CAUS-PRES.REL when) + ay ooth-anaw bess-ii (what do-FUT.PURP ought-PRES.3MS.INTER).

rag_context_anchors: Gr8_Ch1 Meeze 1 p. 11: Aakime keethan oothiya aakimeti hargganchcha xuura naaganaas bessees

assistant_response.gofatho_latin: Aakimey hargganchcha xuura naagiyaa gishshaw, hargganchchay yayyonnaaninne qottanabaa aggonnaan ba sakkoy awannne awde doommidaakko suure odanaw bessees.
assistant_response.gofatho_fidel: አአኪሜይ ሀርግገንችቻ ጡኡረ ነአጊየአ ጊሽሻው፣ ሀርግገንችቻይ የይዮንነአኒንኔ ቆትተነበአ አግጎንነአን በ ሰክኮይ አወንንኔ አውዴ ዶኦምሚደአክኮ ሱኡሬ ኦደነው ቤስሴእስ።
assistant_response.amharic: ሐኪሙ የታካሚውን ምሥጢር ስለሚጠብቅ፣ ታካሚው ሳይፈራና ምንም ሳይደብቅ ሕመሙ የትና መቼ እንደጀመረ በትክክል መናገር ይገባዋል።
assistant_response.english: Because the doctor protects patient confidentiality, the patient should speak honestly without fear or hiding anything about where and when his pain started.
assistant_response.fst_morpheme_notes: yayy-onnaan-inne (fear-NEG.CNV-and) + ba sakko-y (3REFL.GEN pain-NOM) + awde doomm-ida-akko (when start-PAST.REL-COMP) + suure od-anaw bess-ees (honestly tell-FUT.PURP ought-PRES.3MS).

user_prompt.gofatho_latin: Goshshan oothishe waley goshshanchcha kushiyaa qanxxiis; suuthay daro gukkees. Koyro maaduwaa ay oothoo?
user_prompt.gofatho_fidel: ጎሽሻን ኦኦꬂሼ ወሌይ ጎሽሻንችቻ ኩሺየአ ቀንጥጢኢስ፤ ሱኡꬃይ ደሮ ጉክኬእስ። ኮይሮ መአዱወአ አይ ኦኦꬆኦ?
user_prompt.amharic: በእርሻ ላይ እየሠራ ሳለ ማጭዱ የገበሬውን እጅ ቆረጠው፤ ደም በብዛት ይፈሳል። የመጀመሪያ እርዳታ ምን እናድርግ?
user_prompt.english: While working on the farm, a sickle cut a farmer's hand and it is bleeding heavily. What first aid should we perform?
user_prompt.fst_morpheme_notes: goshsha-n ooth-ishe (farm-LOC work-CNV.SIM) + wale-y (sickle-NOM, Gr10 Ch.5 p. 39) + kushiya-a qanxx-iis (hand-ACC cut-PAST.3MS); suutha-y daro gukk-ees (blood-NOM much pour/bleed-PRES.3MS).

assistant_response.gofatho_latin: Shemppuwaa ashshiyaa koyro maaduwaas: geeshsha haathaara madhdhaa meecada, geeshsha puutto ma7on minnada qachchidi suuthaa essa! Biitta woy qita madhdhaa bolla wothoppa.
assistant_response.gofatho_fidel: ሼምፕፑወአ አሽሺየአ ኮይሮ መአዱወአስ፦ ጌእሽሻ ሀአꬃአረ መꬍꬋአ ሜእጨደ፣ ጌእሽሻ ፑኡትቶ መዖን ሚንነደ ቀችቺዲ ሱኡꬃአ እስሰ! ቢኢትተ ዎይ ቂተ መꬍꬋአ ቦልለ ዎꬆፕፐ።
assistant_response.amharic: ሕይወት አድን የመጀመሪያ እርዳታ ለመስጠት፦ ቁስሉን በንጹሕ ውኃ አጥበህ፣ በንጹሕ የጥጥ ጨርቅ አጥብቀህ በማሰር ደሙን አቁም! አፈር ወይም ቆሻሻ ቁስሉ ላይ አታድርግ።
assistant_response.english: For life-saving first aid: wash the wound with clean water, bind it firmly with a clean cotton cloth, and stop the bleeding! Do not put soil or dirt on the wound.
assistant_response.fst_morpheme_notes: shemppuwa-a ashsh-iyaa (life-ACC save-PRES.REL, PHR-042) + madhdha-a (wound-ACC) + meec-ada (wash-CNV1.ANT.2S) + qachch-idi (bind/tie-CNV2.ANT) + suutha-a ess-a (blood-ACC stop.CAUS-IMP.2S, MP-05 < eqq- + -iss-); woth-oppa (put-PROH.2S).

user_prompt.gofatho_latin: Madhdhay ciimma gidikko, teetanasi marppiyaa cadettanaw aakime keethi efoo?

assistant_response.gofatho_fidel: እእ! ቢረተ ሚኢሽሻን ቀንጥጤትቲደ ጪኢምመ መꬍꬋአስ አአኪሜ ኬእꬃን ሲክኮንኔ ቴእተነሲ ነአጎ መርፕፔይ ደሮ ኮሽሼእስ፤ ሀዕዒ እፊቴ!
assistant_response.amharic: አዎ! በብረት መሣሪያ ለተቆረጠ ጥልቅ ቁስል በሐኪም ቤት መሰፋትና የቴታነስ መከላከያ መርፌ በጣም ያስፈልጋል፤ አሁኑኑ ውሰዱት!

user_prompt.gofatho_latin: Ooratha yelettida guutha na7aas hargge naago kittibaate awde doommii?

user_prompt.fst_morpheme_notes: ooratha yel-ett-ida (newly bear-PASS-PAST.REL) + guutha na7a-as (small child-DAT, ZARA-03 7) + hargge naago (disease protection) + awde doomm-ii (when start-PRES.3MS.INTER).

assistant_response.gofatho_latin: Kittibaatey na7ay yelettido gallassan doommidi, usuppun saaminttan, tamma saaminttan, tamma-oyddu saaminttaninne uddufun aginan xenaa keethan imettees.
assistant_response.gofatho_fidel: ኪትቲበአቴይ ነዓይ ዬሌትቲዶ ገልለስሰን ዶኦምሚዲ፣ ኡሱፕፑን ሰአሚንትተን፣ ተምመ ሰአሚንትተን፣ ተምመ-ኦይድዱ ሰአሚንትተኒንኔ ኡድዱፉን አጊነን ጤነአ ኬእꬃን ኢሜትቴእስ።
assistant_response.amharic: ክትባቱ ሕፃኑ በተወለደበት ቀን ጀምሮ፣ በስድስት ሳምንት፣ በአሥር ሳምንት፣ በአሥራ አራት ሳምንትና በዘጠኝ ወር በጤና ጣቢያ ይሰጣል።
assistant_response.english: Vaccination starts on the day the baby is born, and continues at six weeks, ten weeks, fourteen weeks, and nine months at the health center.
assistant_response.fst_morpheme_notes: yel-ett-ido gallassa-n (bear-PASS-PAST.REL day-LOC) + doomm-idi (start-CNV2.ANT) + uddufun agina-n (nine month-LOC) + im-ett-ees (give-PASS-PRES.3MS, MP-06).

user_prompt.gofatho_fidel: ኡድዱፉንꬆ ኪፊሌ ሼምፕፖ 4 ("ደሮተ"፣ ፕ። 30) ጊድዶን "ሀርግጌ መችቾ ጊዲስ" ንኔ "ቦልለይ ለይቲ ኡትቲስ" ጊየአ አአቄ ኦደቲ ዴዖኦሶነ። እንትተ ቢርሽሼꬃይ አይቤእ?
user_prompt.amharic: በዘጠነኛ ክፍል ምዕራፍ 4 («ዳሮታ»፣ ገጽ 30) ውስጥ «ሃርጌ ማቾ ጊዲስ» እና «ቦላይ ላይቲ ኡቲስ» የሚሉ ፈሊጣዊ ንግግሮች አሉ። ትርጉማቸው ምንድን ነው?
user_prompt.english: In Grade 9 Chapter 4 ('Darota', p. 30), there are the idioms 'Hargge machcho gidis' and 'Bollay layti uttis'. What do they mean?
user_prompt.fst_morpheme_notes: hargge machcho gid-is (illness spouse become-PAST.3MS, Gr9 Ch.4 p. 30) + bolla-y layt-i utt-is (body-NOM waste.away-CNV2 sit-PAST.3MS, Gr9 Ch.4 p. 30).

rag_context_anchors: Gr9_Ch4 Idioms: Hargge machcho gidis; Bollay layti uttis

assistant_response.gofatho_latin: "Hargge machcho gidis" guussay adussa wode harggiyaan oyqqettidi de7iis guussa; "Bollay layti uttis" guussay qassi harggeppe denddidayssaan asatethay laafidi daaburiis guussa.
assistant_response.gofatho_fidel: "ሀርግጌ መችቾ ጊዲስ" ጉኡስሰይ አዱስሰ ዎዴ ሀርግጊየአን ኦይቅቄትቲዲ ዴዒኢስ ጉኡስሰ፤ "ቦልለይ ለይቲ ኡትቲስ" ጉኡስሰይ ቀስሲ ሀርግጌፕፔ ዴንድዲደይስሰአን አሰቴꬃይ ለአፊዲ ደአቡሪኢስ ጉኡስሰ።
assistant_response.amharic: «ሃርጌ ማቾ ጊዲስ» ማለት ለረጅም ጊዜ በበሽታ ተይዞ ቆየ (የበሽታ ጓደኛ ሆነ) ማለት ነው፤ «ቦላይ ላይቲ ኡቲስ» ማለት ደግሞ ከሕመሙ የተነሣ ሰውነቱ ከስቶ ደከመ ማለት ነው።
assistant_response.english: 'Hargge machcho gidis' (lit. 'became a spouse of illness') means suffering from a prolonged chronic illness; and 'Bollay layti uttis' means the body became frail and weakened from illness.
assistant_response.fst_morpheme_notes: adussa wode (long time) + harggiya-an oyqq-ett-idi (illness-INST seize-PASS-CNV2.ANT); hargge-ppe dendd-idayssaa-n (illness-ABL arise-PAST.REL.NMZ-LOC) + daabur-iis (tire/weaken-PAST.3MS).

conversation_history.gofatho_fidel: ኡድዱፉንꬆ ኪፊሌ ሼምፕፖ 4 ("ደሮተ"፣ ፕ። 30) ጊድዶን "ሀርግጌ መችቾ ጊዲስ" ንኔ "ቦልለይ ለይቲ ኡትቲስ" ጊየአ አአቄ ኦደቲ ዴዖኦሶነ። እንትተ ቢርሽሼꬃይ አይቤእ?

conversation_history.gofatho_latin: "Hargge machcho gidis" guussay adussa wode harggiyaan oyqqettidi de7iis guussa; "Bollay layti uttis" guussay qassi harggeppe denddidayssaan asatethay laafidi daaburiis guussa.
conversation_history.gofatho_fidel: "ሀርግጌ መችቾ ጊዲስ" ጉኡስሰይ አዱስሰ ዎዴ ሀርግጊየአን ኦይቅቄትቲዲ ዴዒኢስ ጉኡስሰ፤ "ቦልለይ ለይቲ ኡትቲስ" ጉኡስሰይ ቀስሲ ሀርግጌፕፔ ዴንድዲደይስሰአን አሰቴꬃይ ለአፊዲ ደአቡሪኢስ ጉኡስሰ።

user_prompt.gofatho_latin: Adussa harggeppe paxiyaa uraas ("Hargganchchay ha77i paxees") asatethaa minthanaw ay koshshii?
user_prompt.gofatho_fidel: አዱስሰ ሀርግጌፕፔ ፐጢየአ ኡረአስ ("ሀርግገንችቻይ ሀዕዒ ፐጤእስ") አሰቴꬃአ ሚንꬃነው አይ ኮሽሺኢ?
user_prompt.amharic: ከረጅም ሕመም እያገገመ ላለ ሰው («በሽተኛው አሁን እየዳነ ነው») ሰውነቱን ለማጠንከር ምን ያስፈልጋል?
user_prompt.english: For a person recovering from a long illness ('Hargganchchay ha77i paxees'), what is needed to rebuild bodily strength?
user_prompt.fst_morpheme_notes: hargganchcha-y ha77i pax-ees (patient-NOM now recover-PRES.3MS, PHR-040) + asatetha-a minth-anaw (body-ACC strengthen-FUT.PURP, PHR-043).

rag_context_anchors: Gr9_Ch4 Idioms: Hargge machcho gidis; Bollay layti uttis

assistant_response.gofatho_latin: Geeshsha quumaa - asho suuphe, maatha, itima ukkenne gommane - maanaw, guutha wode shemppanawinne aakime kaalluwaa naaganaw bessees.
assistant_response.gofatho_fidel: ጌእሽሻ ቁኡመአ - አሾ ሱኡጴ፣ መአꬃ፣ ኢቲመ ኡክኬንኔ ጎምመኔ - መአነው፣ ጉኡꬃ ዎዴ ሼምፕፐነዊንኔ አአኪሜ ከአልሉወአ ነአገነው ቤስሴእስ።
assistant_response.amharic: ንጹሕና ገንቢ ምግብ—የሥጋ መረቅ፣ ወተት፣ የቡላ ገንፎና ጎመን—መመገብ፣ ለትንሽ ጊዜ ማረፍና የሐኪም ክትትልን መጠበቅ ይገባል።
assistant_response.english: He should eat nourishing food—meat broth, milk, bulla porridge, and greens—rest adequately, and keep up with medical follow-ups.
assistant_response.fst_morpheme_notes: geeshsha quuma-a ma-anaw (nutritious food-ACC eat-FUT.PURP, PHR-043) + shempp-anaw-inne (rest-FUT.PURP-and, PHR-045) + naag-anaw bess-ees (keep-FUT.PURP ought-PRES.3MS).

user_prompt.gofatho_latin: Qamma ta achchey daro sakkidi zin77ibekke. Achche aakimeekko baada ay gada qonccissoo?
user_prompt.gofatho_fidel: ቀምመ ተ አችቼይ ደሮ ሰክኪዲ ዚንዕዒቤክኬ። አችቼ አአኪሜእክኮ በአደ አይ ገደ ቆንጭጪስሶኦ?
user_prompt.amharic: ማታ ጥርሴ በጣም አሞኝ አልተኛሁም። ወደ ጥርስ ሐኪም ሄጄ ምን ብዬ ላስረዳ?
user_prompt.english: Last night my tooth hurt badly and I did not sleep. When I go to the dentist, how should I explain it?
user_prompt.fst_morpheme_notes: qamma ta achche-y (night my tooth-NOM, geminate chch) + daro sakk-idi (very ache-CNV2.ANT) + zin77-ibekke (sleep-PAST.1S.NEG.DCL); achche aakimee-kko (tooth doctor-DIR) + qoncc-iss-oo (explain-CAUS-1S.INTER).

rag_context_anchors: PHR-031: Taani aakime keethi baanaw koyays

assistant_response.gofatho_latin: Achche aakimeekko: "Haddirssa bagga gaxa achchey daro sakkees; irxxa haatha uyiyaa wodekka qanxxees" gada qonccissa.
assistant_response.gofatho_fidel: አችቼ አአኪሜእክኮ፦ "ሀድዲርስሰ በግገ ገጠ አችቼይ ደሮ ሰክኬእስ፤ ኢርጥጠ ሀአꬃ ኡዪየአ ዎዴክከ ቀንጥጤእስ" ገደ ቆንጭጪስሰ።
assistant_response.amharic: ለጥርስ ሐኪሙ፦ «በግራ በኩል ያለው የመንጋጋ ጥርሴ በጣም ያመኛል፤ ቀዝቃዛ ውኃ ስጠጣም ይሰቀጥጠኛል» ብለህ አስረዳ።
assistant_response.english: Explain to the dentist: 'My left back molar hurts very much; and when I drink cold water, it gives a sharp pain.'
assistant_response.fst_morpheme_notes: haddirssa bagga (left side, PHR-083) + gaxa achche-y (molar tooth-NOM) + irxxa haatha uy-iyaa wode-kka (cold water drink-PRES.REL when-ADD) + qanxx-ees (cut/sting-PRES.3MS).

assistant_response.gofatho_latin: "Quumaappe guyye achchiyaa haathaaranne achche miishshan loythi meeccite; sukkaarey daridabaa daro mooppite!" gada zora.
assistant_response.gofatho_fidel: "ቁኡመአፕፔ ጉይዬ አችቺየአ ሀአꬃአረንኔ አችቼ ሚኢሽሻን ሎይꬂ ሜእጭጪቴ፤ ሱክከአሬይ ደሪደበአ ደሮ ሞኦፕፒቴ!" ገደ ዞረ።

user_prompt.gofatho_latin: Ta gutha aaway Sawula Hospitaaliyan zin77idi akkamettees. Iya oychchanaw biyaa wode Goofa wogan ay gada anjjoo?
user_prompt.gofatho_fidel: ተ ጉꬃ አአወይ ሰዉለ ሆስፒተአሊየን ዚንዕዒዲ አክከሜትቴእስ። ኢየ ኦይችቻነው ቢየአ ዎዴ ጎኦፈ ዎገን አይ ገደ አንጅጆኦ?
user_prompt.amharic: አጎቴ በሳውላ ሆስፒታል ተኝቶ እየታከመ ነው። እርሱን ለመጠየቅ ስሄድ በጎፋ ባህል ምን ብዬ ልመርቀው?
user_prompt.english: My paternal uncle is admitted and receiving treatment at Sawla Hospital. When I go to visit him, how should I bless and encourage him in Gofa custom?
user_prompt.fst_morpheme_notes: ta gutha aawa-y (my paternal.uncle-NOM) + Sawula Hospitaaliya-n zin77-idi (Sawla Hospital-LOC lie/sleep-CNV2.ANT) + akkam-ett-ees (treat-PASS-PRES.3MS); iya oychch-anaw (3MS.ACC visit-FUT.PURP).

assistant_response.gofatho_latin: Iyaakko gelada: "Saro! Ha77i waanay? Xoossi neessi kumetta payyatethaa immo, eesuwan paxada ne soo simma!" gada minthitha.
assistant_response.gofatho_fidel: ኢየአክኮ ጌለደ፦ "ሰሮ! ሀዕዒ ወአነይ? ጦኦስሲ ኔእስሲ ኩሜትተ ፐይየቴꬃአ ኢምሞ፣ እእሱወን ፐጠደ ኔ ሶኦ ሲምመ!" ገደ ሚንꬂꬃ።
assistant_response.amharic: ወደ እርሱ ገብተህ፦ «ሰላም! አሁን እንዴት ነህ? እግዚአብሔር ሙሉ ጤንነትን ይስጥህ፣ በፍጥነት ድነህ ወደ ቤትህ ተመለስ!» ብለህ አበረታታው።
assistant_response.english: When you enter to see him, encourage him saying: 'Peace! How are you feeling now? May God grant you full health, recover quickly and return to your home!'
assistant_response.fst_morpheme_notes: iyaa-kko gel-ada (3MS-DIR enter-CNV1.ANT.2S); ha77i waan-ay (now how.be-PRES.2S.INTER); kumetta payyatetha-a (full health-ACC) + imm-o (give-JUSS.3MS); pax-ada (heal-CNV1.ANT.2S) + simm-a (return-IMP.2S).

user_prompt.english: As the rain begins, I am getting ready to plow the field. Before sowing the seed, how should I prepare the soil?
user_prompt.fst_morpheme_notes: iratha-y doomm-ishin (rain-NOM start-CNV.SIM.DS) + gadiya-a goshsh-anaw (field-ACC.M.DEF plow-FUT.PURP, PHR-046); zariya-a zer-anaa-ppe kase (seed-ACC sow-FUT.NMZ-ABL before, PHR-056) + biitta-a (soil-ACC) + giig-iss-oo (prepare-CAUS-1S.INTER).

assistant_response.gofatho_latin: Zariyaa zeranaappe kase booratan biittaa na77u woy heedzu toho loythi goshsha; qassi gadiyaa maaddiyaa woga marqqaa biittan walakka!
assistant_response.gofatho_fidel: ዘሪየአ ዜረነአፕፔ ከሴ ቦኦረተን ቢኢትተአ ነዕዑ ዎይ ሄእꬑ ቶሆ ሎይꬂ ጎሽሻ፤ ቀስሲ ገዲየአ መአድዲየአ ዎገ መርቅቀአ ቢኢትተን ወለክከ!
assistant_response.amharic: ዘር ከመዝራትህ በፊት በበሬዎች መሬቱን ሁለት ወይም ሦስት ጊዜ በደንብ እረስ፤ ደግሞም መሬቱን የሚያዳብር የተፈጥሮ ማዳበሪያ (ማርቃ) ከአፈሩ ጋር ቀላቅል!
assistant_response.english: Before sowing the seed, plow the soil well two or three times with oxen; and mix natural compost/manure ('marqqa', PHR-055) into the soil!

user_prompt.english: In the rainy season when heavy rain falls, the river floods. Before crossing the river, what precautions must we take?
user_prompt.fst_morpheme_notes: balgguwa-n iratha-y daro bukk-iyaa wode (rainy.season-LOC rain-NOM much fall-PRES.REL when) + shaafa-y kum-ees (river-NOM fill/flood-PRES.3MS); pinn-anaa-ppe kase (cross-FUT.NMZ-ABL before, PHR-084).

rag_context_anchors: Gr8_Ch2 Riddle 3: Gede bishin de7ees, haa yishin de7onaba -> Shaafa haatha

assistant_response.gofatho_latin: Shaafay di7on kumida wode gediyan woy mehen pinnoppa! Zooziyaa go7ettada pinna, woykko haathay hirqqanaashin naaga.
assistant_response.gofatho_fidel: ሻአፈይ ዲዖን ኩሚደ ዎዴ ጌዲየን ዎይ ሜሄን ፒንኖፕፐ! ዞኦዚየአ ጎዔትተደ ፒንነ፣ ዎይክኮ ሀአꬃይ ሂርቅቀነአሺን ነአገ።
assistant_response.amharic: ወንዙ በጎርፍ በሞላ ጊዜ በእግር ወይም በከብት አትሻገር! ድልድዩን («ዞዜ») ተጠቅመህ ተሻገር፣ ወይም ውኃው እስኪጎድል ድረስ ጠብቅ።
assistant_response.english: When the river is swollen with floodwater, do not cross on foot or with livestock! Cross using the bridge ('zooze', Gr9 Ch.9 p. 77), or wait until the water subsides.
assistant_response.fst_morpheme_notes: di7o-n kum-ida wode (flood-INST fill-PAST.REL when) + pinn-oppa (cross-PROH.2S); zooziya-a (bridge-ACC.M.DEF, Gr9 Ch.9 p. 77) + go7ett-ada pinn-a (use-CNV1.ANT.2S cross-IMP.2S).

user_prompt.english: In Grade 9 Chapter 5 (p. 41), what is the meaning of the proverb 'Kalisana kathay keren erettees'?
user_prompt.fst_morpheme_notes: kalis-ana katha-y (satisfy-FUT.REL grain/food-NOM, < kall- 'be full' + -is- CAUS) + kere-n (grinding.stone-LOC) + er-ett-ees (know-PASS-PRES.3MS, Gr9 Ch.5 p. 41).

rag_context_anchors: Gr9_Ch5 Proverb: Kalisana kathay keren erettees
Gr10_Ch5 Riddle 1: Tuutenne udula (pestle & mortar); Riddle 2: Difo daabbo

assistant_response.gofatho_latin: Za birshshethay "kalisana kathay keren erettees" guussa; ge birshshethay qassi go77iyaa oosoy woy cincca na7ay koyro doomman erettees guussa.
assistant_response.gofatho_fidel: ዘ ቢርሽሼꬃይ "ከሊሰነ ከꬃይ ኬሬን እሬትቴእስ" ጉኡስሰ፤ ጌ ቢርሽሼꬃይ ቀስሲ ጎዕዒየአ ኦኦሶይ ዎይ ጪንጭጨ ነዓይ ኮይሮ ዶኦምመን እሬትቴእስ ጉኡስሰ።
assistant_response.amharic: ቀጥተኛ ፍቺው «የሚያጠግብ እህል በወፍጮ ላይ ይታወቃል» ማለት ሲሆን፣ አገባባዊ (ውስጠ-ወይራ) ፍቺው ደግሞ ውጤታማ ሥራ ወይም ጎበዝ ልጅ ከጅምሩ ይታወቃል ማለት ነው።
assistant_response.english: Its literal meaning ('za birshshethi') is 'Grain that will satisfy is known right on the grinding stone'; and its figurative meaning ('ge birshshethi', Gr9 Ch.1 p. 6) is that fruitful work or a promising person shows quality right from the start.
assistant_response.fst_morpheme_notes: za birshshetha-y (literal meaning-NOM, Gr9 Ch.1 p. 6) vs. ge birshshetha-y (figurative/contextual meaning-NOM, Gr9 Ch.1 p. 6); koyro doomma-n er-ett-ees (first beginning-LOC know-PASS-PRES.3MS).

assistant_response.english: According to the Grade 10 textbook (p. 64): 'asho dom77e' is physical/external conflict between a character ('odaawa') and another person or nature; whereas 'kaha dom77e' is internal/psychological conflict within the character's own mind!

user_prompt.fst_morpheme_notes: nay-tas Goofatho hayse (child-PL.DAT Gofatho folktale, Gr9 Ch.5 p. 36) + cenggurssaa-n od-arkkii (voice-INST tell-2S.POT.INTER).

assistant_response.gofatho_latin: "Yaareti yaareti!" Beni wode issi woran gaammoy, godareynne bawakkey issippe daggo goshshidosona. Katthay cakettiyaa wode, gaammoy wolqqaan ubbaa oyqqanaw koyis, shin cincca bawakkey suuren shaakkidi woraa sarotethaa naagiis!
assistant_response.gofatho_fidel: "የአሬቲ የአሬቲ!" ቤኒ ዎዴ ኢስሲ ዎረን ገአምሞይ፣ ጎደሬይንኔ በወክኬይ ኢስሲፕፔ ደግጎ ጎሽሺዶሶነ። ከትꬃይ ጨኬትቲየአ ዎዴ፣ ገአምሞይ ዎልቅቀአን ኡብበአ ኦይቅቀነው ኮዪስ፣ ሺን ጪንጭጨ በወክኬይ ሱኡሬን ሻአክኪዲ ዎረአ ሰሮቴꬃአ ነአጊኢስ!
assistant_response.amharic: «ያሬቲ ያሬቲ!» በድሮ ዘመን በአንድ ደን ውስጥ አንበሳ፣ ጅብና ጥንቸል/ቀበሮ በጋራ እርሻ አረሱ። እህሉ በሚታጨድበት ጊዜ አንበሳው በጉልበት ሁሉንም ለመውሰድ ፈለገ፣ ነገር ግን ብልኋ ጥንቸል በጥበብ አካፍላ የደኑን ሰላም ጠበቀች!
assistant_response.english: 'Yaareti yaareti!' Long ago in a forest, the lion ('gaammo'), the hyena ('godare'), and the clever hare ('bawakke') farmed a field together. At harvest time, the lion wanted to seize everything by force, but the wise hare divided the harvest fairly and preserved peace in the forest!
assistant_response.fst_morpheme_notes: Traditional Gelo ('Beni wode...'), Giddo (conflict), and Wurssetha (resolution) folktale structure (Gr9 Ch.5 p. 43).

user_prompt.gofatho_latin: Qassi "bayzettis" nne "uukettis" giyaa peeshotan MP-06 higgey waani oothii?

assistant_response.gofatho_latin: Rule MP-06 (Pre-Suffixal Root Degemination): minniyaa xaphuwan ('bayzz-', 'uukk-', 'shamm-') "-ett-" woy "-iss-" gujjettiyaa wode, xaphuwaa wurssetha guttumay leppiya gidees: bayzz- + -ett- + -is -> "bayzettis"; uukk- + -ett- + -is -> "uukettis"!

assistant_response.amharic: የMP-06 ሕግ (ከቅጥያ በፊት የሥር ተነባቢ መላላት)፦ በሚጠብቅ የግስ ሥር ('bayzz-'፣ 'uukk-'፣ 'shamm-') ላይ «-ett-» ወይም «-iss-» ሲጨመር የሥሩ የመጨረሻ ተነባቢ ይላላል፦ bayzz- + -ett- + -is -> «bayzettis» (ተሸጠ)፤ uukk- + -ett- + -is -> «uukettis» (ተጋገረ)!
assistant_response.english: Rule MP-06 (Pre-Suffixal Root Degemination): when derivational suffixes like '-ett-' (passive) or '-iss-' (causative) attach to a geminate-final root ('bayzz-', 'uukk-', 'shamm-'), the root-final geminate degeminates: bayzz- + -ett- + -is -> 'bayzettis'; uukk- + -ett- + -is -> 'uukettis'!

assistant_response.gofatho_latin: "Akeeka-a" = akeeka (abstract noun root) + "-a" (Kaalodde some / Masculine Definite Accusative); "gujj-ees" = gujj- (verb root with geminate jj) + "-ees" (Ha7ode 3MS)!
assistant_response.gofatho_fidel: "አኬእከ-አ" = አኬእከ (አብስትረጭት ኖኡን ሮኦት) + "-አ" (ከአሎድዴ ሶሜ / መስጩሊኔ ዴፊኒቴ አጭጩሰቲvእ)፤ "ጉጅጅ-እእስ" = ጉጅጅ- (vእርብ ሮኦት ዊꬅ ጌሚነቴ ጅጅ) + "-እእስ" (ሀዖዴ 3ምስ)!
assistant_response.amharic: «አኬካ-አ» = akeeka (ግንዛቤ / ረቂቅ ስም) + «-a» (የተሳቢ ቅጥያ)፤ «ጉጅ-ኤስ» = gujj- (መጨመር / የግስ ሥር) + «-ees» (የአሁን ጊዜ 3ኛ መደብ ነጠላ ወንድ ቅጥያ) ነው!
assistant_response.english: 'Akeeka-a' = 'akeeka' (comprehension, abstract noun root) + '-a' (masculine definite accusative object suffix); 'gujj-ees' = 'gujj-' (add/increase, geminate verb root) + '-ees' (3MS present declarative suffix)!

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Ufayssan! Goofatho doonan: aawa aaway woy aayee aaway 'maayza' geetettees; aawa ishay 'gutha aawa', aayee ishay 'vooce', qassi aawa michchiyaa 'aayee gutha' geetettawsu.
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ኡፈይስሰን! ጎኦፈꬆ ዶኦነን፦ አአወ አአወይ ዎይ አአዬእ አአወይ 'መአይዘ' ጌእቴትቴእስ፤ አአወ ኢሻይ 'ጉꬃ አአወ'፣ አአዬእ ኢሻይ 'vኦኦጬ'፣ ቀስሲ አአወ ሚችቺየአ 'አአዬእ ጉꬃ' ጌእቴትተውሱ።
flat_utterances.amharic: በደስታ! በጎፋኛ ቋንቋ፦ የአባት አባት ወይም የእናት አባት «ማይዛ» (አያት) ይባላል፤ የአባት ወንድም «ጉꬃ አዋ» (አጎት)፣ የእናት ወንድም «ቮቼ» (የእናት ወንድም)፣ ደግሞ የአባት እኅት «አዬ ጉꬃ» (አክስት) ትባላለች።
flat_utterances.english: Gladly! In Gofatho: a paternal or maternal grandfather is called 'maayza'; a paternal uncle is 'gutha aawa', a maternal uncle is 'vooce', and an aunt is called 'aayee gutha'.
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: geet-ett-ees (call-PASS-PRES.3MS.A.DCL < g- 'say' + -ett- passive); geet-ett-awsu (call-PASS-PRES.3FS.A.DCL); demonstrates gender agreement between 3MS (-ees) and 3FS (-awsu).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Grade 8 Goofatho Doona Ch. 3 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/160NHNy-4orPcAIk-L5t6tOEtZoWemz_-/view?usp=drivesdk); Sellassie Cheru (2015, Appendix D Kinship Lexicon)

flat_utterances.domain_name: Daily Greetings & Family Life (So Asaa)
flat_utterances.subtopic: Extended Kinship Terms & Grandparents in Sawula
flat_utterances.speaker: user
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Daro lo77o! Ta maayzaynne ta aayee aayiyaa Sawula kataman de7oosona. Wontto enttana oychchanaw baana.
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ደሮ ሎዕዖ! ተ መአይዘይንኔ ተ አአዬእ አአዪየአ ሰዉለ ከተመን ዴዖኦሶነ። ዎንትቶ እንትተነ ኦይችቻነው በአነ።
flat_utterances.amharic: በጣም ጥሩ! አያቴ (ወንድ) እና ሴት አያቴ በሳውላ ከተማ ይኖራሉ። ነገ እነርሱን ለመጠየቅ እሄዳለሁ።
flat_utterances.english: Very good! My grandfather and my grandmother live in Sawula town. Tomorrow I will go to visit them.
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: ta maayza-y-nne (my grandfather-NOM.M-COORD) + ta aayee aay-iyaa (my grandmother-NOM.F.DEF) + Sawula katama-n (Sawula town-LOC) + de7-oosona (live-PRES.3PL); wontto (tomorrow) + entta-na (3PL-ACC) + oychch-anaw (visit/ask-FUT.PURP) + ba-ana (go-FUT.DCL).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Grade 8 Goofatho Doona Ch. 3 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/160NHNy-4orPcAIk-L5t6tOEtZoWemz_-/view?usp=drivesdk); Sellassie Cheru (2015, Appendix D Kinship Lexicon)

flat_utterances.domain_name: Daily Greetings & Family Life (So Asaa)
flat_utterances.subtopic: Extended Kinship Terms & Grandparents in Sawula
flat_utterances.speaker: assistant
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Bayrata oychchoynne bonchchoy Goofa dere gita woga. Enttako gakkiya wode "Saro de7idetii, ta maayzatoo?" gada sarotha!
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: በይረተ ኦይችቾይንኔ ቦንችቾይ ጎኦፈ ዴሬ ጊተ ዎገ። እንትተኮ ገክኪየ ዎዴ "ሰሮ ዴዒዴቲኢ፣ ተ መአይዘቶኦ?" ገደ ሰሮꬃ!
flat_utterances.amharic: ታላላቆችን መጠየቅና ማክበር የጎፋ ሕዝብ ትልቅ ባህል ነው። እነርሱ ጋር ስትደርስ «በሰላም አላችሁ፣ አያቶቼ?» ብለህ ሰላምታ አቅርብ!
flat_utterances.english: Visiting and respecting elders is a great custom of the Gofa people. When you arrive at their place, greet them saying, 'Are you well, my grandparents?'
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: bayra-ta (elder-PL.ACC) + oychcho-y-nne (visiting-NOM-COORD) + bonchcho-y (respecting-NOM); entta-kko (3PL-DIR) + gakk-iya wode (arrive-PRES.REL time) + g-ada (say-CNV1.ANT.2S) + saroth-a (greet-IMP.2S).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Grade 8 Goofatho Doona Ch. 3 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/160NHNy-4orPcAIk-L5t6tOEtZoWemz_-/view?usp=drivesdk); Sellassie Cheru (2015, Appendix D Kinship Lexicon)

flat_utterances.domain_name: Daily Greetings & Family Life (So Asaa)
flat_utterances.subtopic: Traditional Gofa Coffee Ceremony (Tukke Katho Maara)
flat_utterances.speaker: user
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Imatati nu soo yidosona. Goofa wogan tukke katho maaraa koyroppe doomada taassi odarkkii?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ኢመተቲ ኑ ሶኦ ዪዶሶነ። ጎኦፈ ዎገን ቱክኬ ከꬆ መአረአ ኮይሮፕፔ ዶኦመደ ተአስሲ ኦደርክኪኢ?
flat_utterances.amharic: እንግዶች ወደ ቤታችን መጥተዋል። በጎፋ ባህል የቡና አፈላል ቅደም ተከተልን ከመጀመሪያው ጀምረህ ትነግረኛለህ?
flat_utterances.english: Guests have come to our home. Could you tell me the step-by-step procedure for making coffee in Gofa tradition from the beginning?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: imata-ti (guest-PL.NOM) + nu soo (our home.DIR) + y-idosona (come-PAST.3PL.A.DCL); tukke katho maara-a (coffee brewing procedure-ACC, Gr8 Ch.4 pp. 57–58) + koyro-ppe (first-ABL) + doomm-ada (begin-CNV1.ANT.2S) + od-arkkii (tell-2S.POT.INTER).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Grade 8 Goofatho Doona Ch. 3 & Ch. 4 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/160NHNy-4orPcAIk-L5t6tOEtZoWemz_-/view?usp=drivesdk, pp. 53, 57–58: Tukke katho maara)

flat_utterances.domain_name: Daily Greetings & Family Life (So Asaa)
flat_utterances.subtopic: Traditional Gofa Coffee Ceremony (Tukke Katho Maara)
flat_utterances.speaker: assistant
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Ee! Hosppuntho kifile maxaafaa maaran: koyro, tukkiyaa geeshshidi meecettes; nam77antho, beshen shahettidi udulan idzettees; heedzantho, phanqqiyan bolla haathaara kathettees; wurssethan, sinen wothidi imatatas imettees.
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: እእ! ሆስፕፑንꬆ ኪፊሌ መጠአፈአ መአረን፦ ኮይሮ፣ ቱክኪየአ ጌእሽሺዲ ሜእጬትቴስ፤ ነምዕዓንꬆ፣ ቤሼን ሻሄትቲዲ ኡዱለን ኢꬔትቴእስ፤ ሄእꬓንꬆ፣ ጳንቅቂየን ቦልለ ሀአꬃአረ ከꬄትቴእስ፤ ዉርስሴꬃን፣ ሲኔን ዎꬂዲ ኢመተተስ ኢሜትቴእስ።
flat_utterances.amharic: አዎ! በስምንተኛ ክፍል መጽሐፍ መሠረት፦ በመጀመሪያ ቡናው በንጽሕና ይታጠባል፤ በሁለተኛ ደረጃ በምጣድ ተቆልቶ በሙቀጫ ይወቀጣል፤ በሦስተኛ ደረጃ በጀበና ውኃ ተጨምሮ ይፈላል፤ በመጨረሻም በሲኒ ተቀድቶ ለእንግዶች ይሰጣል።
flat_utterances.english: Yes! According to the Grade 8 textbook procedure: first, the coffee is washed cleanly; second, it is roasted on the pan and pounded in the mortar; third, it is boiled with water in the clay coffee pot; finally, it is poured into cups and served to the guests.
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: Procedural discourse markers (Gr8 Ch.4 p. 57): koyro (first), nam77antho (second, MP-04 ordinal), heedzantho (third), wurssethan (finally); passive chain: meec-ett-ees (wash-PASS), shah-ett-idi (roast-PASS-CNV2), idz-ett-ees (pound-PASS), kath-ett-ees (boil-PASS), im-ett-ees (give-PASS, MP-06 < imm- + -ett-).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Grade 8 Goofatho Doona Ch. 3 & Ch. 4 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/160NHNy-4orPcAIk-L5t6tOEtZoWemz_-/view?usp=drivesdk, pp. 53, 57–58: Tukke katho maara)

flat_utterances.domain_name: Daily Greetings & Family Life (So Asaa)

flat_utterances.speaker: user
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Goofa heeran ayfe tukke xalla gidonnashin tukke-haythikka kathettee?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ጎኦፈ ሄእረን አይፌ ቱክኬ ጠልለ ጊዶንነሺን ቱክኬ-ሀይꬂክከ ከꬄትቴእ?
flat_utterances.amharic: በጎፋ አካባቢ የፍሬ ቡና ብቻ ሳይሆን የቡና ቅጠልም (ሻይ/ቅጠል ቡና) ይፈላል?
flat_utterances.english: In the Gofa area, is not only coffee bean brewed, but also coffee-leaf infusion (tukke-haythi)?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: ayfe tukke (coffee berry/bean) + xalla (only) + gid-onnashin (be-NEG.CNV.SIM) + tukke-haythi-kka (compound noun: coffee-leaf-NOM-ADD, Gr8 Ch.3 p. 53) + kath-ett-ee (brew-PASS-PRES.3MS.INTER).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Grade 8 Goofatho Doona Ch. 3 & Ch. 4 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/160NHNy-4orPcAIk-L5t6tOEtZoWemz_-/view?usp=drivesdk, pp. 53, 57–58: Tukke katho maara)

flat_utterances.domain_name: Daily Greetings & Family Life (So Asaa)
flat_utterances.subtopic: Traditional Gofa Coffee Ceremony (Tukke Katho Maara)
flat_utterances.speaker: assistant
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Ee, tuma! "Tukke-haythi" Goofa so asaa giddon daro dosettiyaa woga ushsha; suunqqo, xaddonne kasho gujjidi kathiyaa wode daro mal77ees.
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: እእ፣ ቱመ! "ቱክኬ-ሀይꬂ" ጎኦፈ ሶ አሰአ ጊድዶን ደሮ ዶሴትቲየአ ዎገ ኡሽሻ፤ ሱኡንቅቆ፣ ጠድዶንኔ ከሾ ጉጅጂዲ ከꬂየአ ዎዴ ደሮ መልዕዔእስ።
flat_utterances.amharic: አዎ፣ እውነት ነው! «ቱኬ-ሃይꬂ» (የቡና ቅጠል) በጎፋ ቤተሰብ ውስጥ በጣም የሚወደድ ባህላዊ መጠጥ ነው፤ ቅመማ ቅመምና ጤና አዳም ጨምረው ሲያፈሉት በጣም ይጣፍጣል።
flat_utterances.english: Yes, indeed! 'Tukke-haythi' (coffee-leaf tea) is a much-loved traditional beverage among Gofa families; when brewed with aromatic spices and rue, it is very delicious.
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: dos-ett-iyaa (love-PASS-PRES.REL) + woga ushsha (traditional drink); gujj-idi (add-CNV2.ANT) + kath-iyaa wode (brew-PRES.REL when) + daro mal77-ees (very be.sweet/delicious-PRES.3MS.A.DCL).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Grade 8 Goofatho Doona Ch. 3 & Ch. 4 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/160NHNy-4orPcAIk-L5t6tOEtZoWemz_-/view?usp=drivesdk, pp. 53, 57–58: Tukke katho maara)

flat_utterances.domain_name: Daily Greetings & Family Life (So Asaa)
flat_utterances.subtopic: Household Chores & Cooperative Family Responsibilities
flat_utterances.speaker: user
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Nu keethan attuma naytinne macca nayti keetha-ooso issippe shaakkidi oothoosona. Tammantho kifile maxaafay hayssaabaa ay gii?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ኑ ኬእꬃን አትቱመ ነይቲንኔ መጭጨ ነይቲ ኬእꬃ-ኦኦሶ ኢስሲፕፔ ሻአክኪዲ ኦኦꬆኦሶነ። ተምመንꬆ ኪፊሌ መጠአፈይ ሀይስሰአበአ አይ ጊኢ?
flat_utterances.amharic: በቤታችን ወንድ ልጆችና ሴት ልጆች የቤት ሥራን በጋራ ተከፋፍለው ይሠራሉ። የአሥረኛ ክፍል መጽሐፍ ስለዚህ ምን ይላል?
flat_utterances.english: In our home, boys and girls share and do housework together. What does the Grade 10 textbook say about this?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: attuma nay-ti-nne (male child-PL.NOM-COORD) + macca nay-ti (female child-PL.NOM) + keetha-ooso (housework) + issippe (together) + shaakk-idi (divide/share-CNV2.ANT) + ooth-oosona (do/work-PRES.3PL.A.DCL); ay g-ii (what say-PRES.3MS.INTER).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Grade 10 Goofatho Doona Ch. 3 & Ch. 8 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/1mKIcfMoMgnZ9Pa657NWmE-OGND2wlveM/view?usp=drivesdk, pp. 19–25, 79)

flat_utterances.domain_name: Daily Greetings & Family Life (So Asaa)
flat_utterances.subtopic: Household Chores & Cooperative Family Responsibilities
flat_utterances.speaker: assistant
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Tammantho kifile Shemppo 3 ("Maccatanne Dichaa", p. 20) giddon, keetha oosuwaa macca nayta xallaas aggonnaan attuma naytikka quma katho, keetha geeshshatethaanne haatha duuqo issippe oothanaw bessiis gees.
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ተምመንꬆ ኪፊሌ ሼምፕፖ 3 ("መጭጨተንኔ ዲቻአ"፣ ፕ። 20) ጊድዶን፣ ኬእꬃ ኦኦሱወአ መጭጨ ነይተ ጠልለአስ አግጎንነአን አትቱመ ነይቲክከ ቁመ ከꬆ፣ ኬእꬃ ጌእሽሻቴꬃአንኔ ሀአꬃ ዱኡቆ ኢስሲፕፔ ኦኦꬃነው ቤስሲኢስ ጌእስ።
flat_utterances.amharic: በአሥረኛ ክፍል ምዕራፍ 3 («ሴቶችና ልማት»፣ ገጽ 20) ውስጥ የቤት ሥራን ለሴት ልጆች ብቻ ሳይተዉ ወንድ ልጆችም ምግብ ማብሰልን፣ የቤት ጽዳትንና ውኃ መቅዳትን በጋራ መሥራት እንደሚገባቸው ይገልጻል።
flat_utterances.english: In Grade 10 Chapter 3 ('Women and Development', p. 20), it states that rather than leaving housework only to girls, boys too should share cooking, house cleaning, and fetching water together.
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: macca nay-ta xalla-as (female child-PL.ACC only-DAT) + agg-onnaan (leave-NEG.CNV) + attuma nay-ti-kka (male child-PL.NOM-ADD) + ooth-anaw (work-FUT.PURP.INF) + bess-iis (ought-PAST/GNOMIC.3MS) + g-ees (say-PRES.3MS).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Grade 10 Goofatho Doona Ch. 3 & Ch. 8 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/1mKIcfMoMgnZ9Pa657NWmE-OGND2wlveM/view?usp=drivesdk, pp. 19–25, 79)

flat_utterances.domain_name: Daily Greetings & Family Life (So Asaa)
flat_utterances.subtopic: Household Chores & Cooperative Family Responsibilities
flat_utterances.speaker: user
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Tuma! Ta ishay keetha pitteesinne haatha ehaas; ta michchiyaa quma kathawsu; taanikka saaniyaa meeccays.
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ቱመ! ተ ኢሻይ ኬእꬃ ፒትቴእሲንኔ ሀአꬃ እሀአስ፤ ተ ሚችቺየአ ቁመ ከꬃውሱ፤ ተአኒክከ ሰአኒየአ ሜእጭጨይስ።
flat_utterances.amharic: እውነት ነው! ወንድሜ ቤት ይጠርጋልና ውኃ ያመጣል፤ እኅቴ ምግብ ታበስላለች፤ እኔም ሳህን አጥባለሁ።
flat_utterances.english: True! My brother sweeps the house and brings water; my sister cooks the food; and I wash the dishes.
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: ta isha-y (my brother-NOM) + pitt-ees-inne (sweep-PRES.3MS-COORD) + eh-ees (bring-PRES.3MS); ta michch-iyaa (my sister-NOM.F) + kath-awsu (cook-PRES.3FS); taani-kka (1S.NOM-ADD) + saaniya-a (dish-ACC.M.DEF) + meecc-ays (wash-PRES.1S.A.DCL).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Grade 10 Goofatho Doona Ch. 3 & Ch. 8 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/1mKIcfMoMgnZ9Pa657NWmE-OGND2wlveM/view?usp=drivesdk, pp. 19–25, 79)

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Intte so asaa hashetethay daro galatissiyaabaa! So giddon woli maaddiyaa nayti timirtte keethankka zalbudda tamaareta gidoosona.
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ኢንትቴ ሶ አሰአ ሀሼቴꬃይ ደሮ ገለቲስሲየአበአ! ሶ ጊድዶን ዎሊ መአድዲየአ ነይቲ ቲሚርትቴ ኬእꬃንክከ ዘልቡድደ ተመአሬተ ጊዶኦሶነ።
flat_utterances.amharic: የቤተሰባችሁ ትብብር በጣም የሚያስመሰግን ነው! በቤት ውስጥ እርስ በርስ የሚረዳዱ ልጆች በትምህርት ቤትም ታታሪ ተማሪዎች ይሆናሉ።
flat_utterances.english: Your family's cooperation is very commendable! Children who help one another at home also become diligent students at school.
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: hashetetha-y (cooperation-NOM < hashet- + -tetha ABSTR.NMZ) + galat-iss-iyaa-baa (praise-CAUS-PRES.REL-NMZ); woli maadd-iyaa (RECIP help-PRES.REL) + zalbudda (diligent/industrious, Gr10 Ch.3 p. 21) + gid-oosona (become-PRES.3PL).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Grade 10 Goofatho Doona Ch. 3 & Ch. 8 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/1mKIcfMoMgnZ9Pa657NWmE-OGND2wlveM/view?usp=drivesdk, pp. 19–25, 79)

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Nu dabboti Bulqi katamaappe ha77i nu soo gakkidosona. Goofa wogan imata waatidi mokko?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ኑ ደብቦቲ ቡልቂ ከተመአፕፔ ሀዕዒ ኑ ሶኦ ገክኪዶሶነ። ጎኦፈ ዎገን ኢመተ ወአቲዲ ሞክኮ?
flat_utterances.amharic: ዘመዶቻችን ከቡልቂ ከተማ አሁን ወደ ቤታችን ደረሱ። በጎፋ ባህል እንግዳን እንዴት እንቀበል?
flat_utterances.english: Our relatives have just arrived at our home from Bulqi town. How should we welcome guests in Gofa custom?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: nu dabbo-ti (our relative-PL.NOM) + Bulqi katamaa-ppe (Bulqi town-ABL) + gakk-idosona (arrive-PAST.3PL.A.DCL); imata (guest.ACC) + waat-idi (do.how-CNV2.ANT) + mokk-o (welcome-1PL.INTER.JUSS).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Grade 8 Goofatho Doona Ch. 3 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/160NHNy-4orPcAIk-L5t6tOEtZoWemz_-/view?usp=drivesdk); Sellassie Cheru (2015, p. 112)

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Koyro ufayssan "Ufayssan mokkoos! Saro gakkidetii?" gidi mokkite; kaallidi kushe meeciyaa haathaa immidinne uttiyaa oydiyaa giigissite.
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ኮይሮ ኡፈይስሰን "ኡፈይስሰን ሞክኮኦስ! ሰሮ ገክኪዴቲኢ?" ጊዲ ሞክኪቴ፤ ከአልሊዲ ኩሼ ሜእጪየአ ሀአꬃአ ኢምሚዲንኔ ኡትቲየአ ኦይዲየአ ጊኢጊስሲቴ።
flat_utterances.amharic: በመጀመሪያ በደስታ «በደስታ እንቀበላለን! በሰላም ደረሳችሁ?» ብላችሁ ተቀበሉ፤ ቀጥሎም የእጅ መታጠቢያ ውኃ ሰጥታችሁ መቀመጫ ወንበር አዘጋጁ።
flat_utterances.english: First welcome them joyfully saying, 'We welcome you with joy! Did you arrive safely?'; next, offer water for hand-washing and prepare seats.
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: ufayssa-n (joy-INST) + mokk-oos (welcome-PRES.1PL); gakk-idetii (arrive-PAST.2PL.INTER); kushe meec-iyaa haatha-a (hand wash-REL water-ACC) + imm-idi-nne (give-CNV2-COORD) + oydiya-a (seat/chair-ACC.M.DEF) + giig-iss-ite (prepare-CAUS-IMP.2PL).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Grade 8 Goofatho Doona Ch. 3 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/160NHNy-4orPcAIk-L5t6tOEtZoWemz_-/view?usp=drivesdk); Sellassie Cheru (2015, p. 112)

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Kushe meecissidaappe guyye ayba quma kathi shiishshoo?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ኩሼ ሜእጪስሲደአፕፔ ጉይዬ አይበ ቁመ ከꬂ ሺኢሽሾኦ?
flat_utterances.amharic: እጃቸውን ካስታጠብን በኋላ ምን ዓይነት ምግብ አብስለን እናቅርብ?
flat_utterances.english: After helping them wash their hands, what kind of food should we cook and serve?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: meec-iss-idaa-ppe guyye (wash-CAUS-PAST.REL-ABL after, MP-06) + ayba quma (what food) + kath-i (cook-CNV2) + shiishsh-oo (serve/present-1PL.JUSS.INTER < shiiq- + -iss- coalesced).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Grade 8 Goofatho Doona Ch. 3 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/160NHNy-4orPcAIk-L5t6tOEtZoWemz_-/view?usp=drivesdk); Sellassie Cheru (2015, p. 112)

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Goofa wogan imataas ho77o eesaa, oysaa, dono-otuwaanne ho77o tukkiyaa shiishshoy daro bonchcho besses.
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ጎኦፈ ዎገን ኢመተአስ ሆዕዖ እእሰአ፣ ኦይሰአ፣ ዶኖ-ኦቱወአንኔ ሆዕዖ ቱክኪየአ ሺኢሽሾይ ደሮ ቦንችቾ ቤስሴስ።
flat_utterances.amharic: በጎፋ ባህል ለእንግዳ ትኩስ ቆጮ (ኤሳ)፣ ቅቤ፣ የድንች ወጥና ትኩስ ቡና ማቅረብ ትልቅ አክብሮትን ያሳያል።
flat_utterances.english: In Gofa tradition, serving warm kocho (eesaa), butter (oysaa), potato stew (dono-oto), and hot coffee to a guest shows great respect.
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: imata-as (guest-DAT) + ho77o eesa-a (hot kocho-ACC, ZARA-03 geminate glottal 77) + oysa-a (butter-ACC) + dono-otuwa-a-nne (potato-stew-ACC-COORD, Gr8 Ch.3 p. 53) + shiishsho-y (serving-NOM) + bonchcho (respect) + bess-ees (show-PRES.3MS < be7- + -iss- MP-05).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Grade 8 Goofatho Doona Ch. 3 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/160NHNy-4orPcAIk-L5t6tOEtZoWemz_-/view?usp=drivesdk); Sellassie Cheru (2015, p. 112)

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Omarssi kahuwaa mi wurssidaappe guyye, nu maayzay naytas hayse odees. Goofatho hayse odoy waani doommii?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ኦመርስሲ ከሁወአ ሚ ዉርስሲደአፕፔ ጉይዬ፣ ኑ መአይዘይ ነይተስ ሀይሴ ኦዴእስ። ጎኦፈꬆ ሀይሴ ኦዶይ ወአኒ ዶኦምሚኢ?
flat_utterances.amharic: ማታ እራት በልተን ከጨረስን በኋላ፣ አያታችን ለልጆቹ ተረት ይነግራል። በጎፋኛ ተረት መንገር እንዴት ይጀምራል?
flat_utterances.english: In the evening after we finish eating dinner, our grandfather tells folktales to the children. How does telling a folktale begin in Gofatho?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: omarssi kahuwa-a (evening dinner-ACC.M.DEF) + m-i wurss-idaa-ppe guyye (eat-CNV2 finish-PAST.REL-ABL after); hayse (folktale, Gr9 Ch.5 p. 36) + od-ees (tell-PRES.3MS); waan-i doomm-ii (how-CNV2 begin-PRES.3MS.INTER).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Grade 9 Goofatho Doona Ch. 5 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/1uvGaBT4-O_Jn7oQbuNl1W88lFBFiHULU/view?usp=drivesdk, pp. 32–46: Bila-Oda & Hayse)
