flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Uddufuntho kifile Shemppo 5 (p. 37) giddon xaafettidaogaadan, hayse odiyaa uray "Haysee haysee!" giyaa wode, hayziyaa nayti "Yaareti yaareti!" gidi zaaroosona.
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ኡድዱፉንꬆ ኪፊሌ ሼምፕፖ 5 (ፕ። 3ዕ) ጊድዶን ጠአፌትቲደኦገአደን፣ ሀይሴ ኦዲየአ ኡረይ "ሀይሴእ ሀይሴእ!" ጊየአ ዎዴ፣ ሀይዚየአ ነይቲ "የአሬቲ የአሬቲ!" ጊዲ ዘአሮኦሶነ።
flat_utterances.amharic: በዘጠነኛ ክፍል ምዕራፍ 5 (ገጽ 37) ላይ እንደተጻፈው፣ ተረት ነጋሪው «ሃይሴ ሃይሴ!» (ተረት ተረት!) ሲል፣ አድማጭ ልጆቹ «ያሬቲ ያሬቲ!» ብለው ይመልሳሉ።
flat_utterances.english: As written in Grade 9 Chapter 5 (p. 37), when the storyteller calls out 'Haysee haysee!', the listening children reply 'Yaareti yaareti!'
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: xaaf-ett-ida-ogaa-dan (write-PASS-PAST.REL-NMZ-EQU); od-iyaa ura-y (tell-PRES.REL person-NOM.M) + hayz-iyaa nay-ti (listen-PRES.REL child-PL.NOM) + zaar-oosona (answer-PRES.3PL.A.DCL).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Grade 9 Goofatho Doona Ch. 5 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/1uvGaBT4-O_Jn7oQbuNl1W88lFBFiHULU/view?usp=drivesdk, pp. 32–46: Bila-Oda & Hayse)

flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ሀይሴይ ነይተ ከንድዱወአንኔ ቆፈአ ዲችቻአስ አይበ ጎዕዓ ኢምሚኢ?
flat_utterances.amharic: ተረቱ የልጆችን ሥነ-ምግባርና አስተሳሰብ ለማሳደግ ምን ጥቅም ይሰጣል?
flat_utterances.english: What benefit does the folktale provide for developing children's character and thinking?

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Haysey nayti iitaanne lo77uwaa shaakkidi erana mala, doona hiillaa dichchana malanne bantta dere wogaa naagana mala daro maaddees.
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ሀይሴይ ነይቲ ኢኢተአንኔ ሎዕዑወአ ሻአክኪዲ እረነ መለ፣ ዶኦነ ሂኢልለአ ዲችቻነ መለንኔ በንትተ ዴሬ ዎገአ ነአገነ መለ ደሮ መአድዴእስ።
flat_utterances.amharic: ተረት ልጆች ክፉውንና ደጉን ለይተው እንዲያውቁ፣ የቋንቋ ክህሎታቸውን እንዲያሳድጉና የአካባቢያቸውን ባህል እንዲጠብቁ በእጅጉ ይረዳል።
flat_utterances.english: Folktales greatly help children distinguish between bad and good, develop language skills, and preserve their community's cultural heritage.
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: iita-a-nne (bad-ACC-COORD) + lo77uwa-a (good-ACC.M.DEF, MP-10) + shaakk-idi (distinguish-CNV2.ANT) + er-ana mala (know-FUT.PURP) + maadd-ees (help-PRES.3MS.A.DCL).

flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ሆስፕፑንꬆ ኪፊሌ ሼምፕፖ ዕ ጊድዶን "ዮኦገ ነይተ ዎልቅቀ ኦኦሶን ቆሆ" ጊየአ ቲሚርትቴይ ሶ አሰአ አይ ዞሪ?
flat_utterances.amharic: በስምንተኛ ክፍል ምዕራፍ 7 ውስጥ «የታዳጊ ልጆች የጉልበት ብዝበዛ ጉዳት» የሚለው ትምህርት ቤተሰብን ምን ይመክራል?

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: He shemppoy yooga nayta entta wolqqaappe aadhdhiyaa deexo ooson toorchchonnaan, timirtte keethi yeddidi tamaarissanaw bessiis gidi minththidi zorees.
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ሄ ሼምፕፖይ ዮኦገ ነይተ እንትተ ዎልቅቀአፕፔ አአꬍꬊየአ ዴእጦ ኦኦሶን ቶኦርችቾንነአን፣ ቲሚርትቴ ኬእꬂ ዬድዲዲ ተመአሪስሰነው ቤስሲኢስ ጊዲ ሚንꬅꬂዲ ዞሬእስ።
flat_utterances.amharic: ያ ምዕራፍ ታዳጊ ልጆችን ከአቅማቸው በላይ በሆነ ከባድ ሥራ ሳይጫኑ፣ ወደ ትምህርት ቤት ልኮ ማስተማር እንደሚገባ አጥብቆ ይመክራል።
flat_utterances.english: That chapter strongly advises that rather than burdening young children with heavy labor beyond their strength, families must send them to school and educate them.
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: wolqqaa-ppe aadhdh-iyaa (strength-ABL surpass-PRES.REL) + deexo ooso-n (heavy work-INST) + toorchch-onnaan (exploit/burden-NEG.CNV) + yedd-idi (send-CNV2.ANT) + tamaar-iss-anaw (learn-CAUS-FUT.PURP) + zor-ees (advise-PRES.3MS).

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: "Tamaarida asi issi gade dichchaas zokko meqethi" giyaa aaqe oday Hosppuntho kifile maxaafa sinthe 104 bolla de7ees.
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: "ተመአሪደ አሲ ኢስሲ ገዴ ዲችቻአስ ዞክኮ ሜቄꬂ" ጊየአ አአቄ ኦደይ ሆስፕፑንꬆ ኪፊሌ መጠአፈ ሲንꬄ 104 ቦልለ ዴዔእስ።
flat_utterances.amharic: «ተማሪዳ አሲ ኢሲ ጋዴ ዲቻስ ዞኮ ሜቄꬂ» (የተማረ ሰው ለአንድ አገር ልማት የጀርባ አጥንት ነው) የሚለው ፈሊጣዊ አነጋገር በስምንተኛ ክፍል መጽሐፍ ገጽ 104 ላይ ይገኛል።
flat_utterances.english: The idiom 'Tamaarida asi issi gade dichchaas zokko meqethi' ('An educated person is the backbone of a nation's development') is found on page 104 of the Grade 8 textbook.
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: tamaar-ida as-i (learn-PAST.REL person-NOM.M) + gade dichcha-as (country development-DAT) + zokko meqethi (backbone: back + bone, Gr8 Ch.7 p. 104) + de7-ees (exist-PRES.3MS).

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Ta ishaara guutha qofan ooyettida. Goofatho doonan keha qaalara maarota waatada oychchoo?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ተ ኢሻአረ ጉኡꬃ ቆፈን ኦኦዬትቲደ። ጎኦፈꬆ ዶኦነን ኬሀ ቀአለረ መአሮተ ወአተደ ኦይችቾኦ?
flat_utterances.amharic: ከወንድሜ ጋር በትንሽ ሐሳብ ተጋጨን። በጎፋኛ ቋንቋ በትሕትና ቃል ይቅርታ እንዴት ልጠይቅ?
flat_utterances.english: My brother and I had a small disagreement. How can I politely ask for forgiveness in Gofatho?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: ta ishaa-ra (my brother-COM) + guutha qofa-n (small idea-LOC) + ooy-ett-ida (quarrel-RECIP-PAST.1PL); keha qaala-ra (gentle/kind word-COM) + maarot-a (forgiveness-ACC) + waat-ada (how-CNV1.ANT.1S) + oychch-oo (ask-1S.INTER.JUSS).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Grade 8 Goofatho Doona Ch. 8 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/160NHNy-4orPcAIk-L5t6tOEtZoWemz_-/view?usp=drivesdk, pp. 107–120: Sarotethi)

flat_utterances.domain_name: Daily Greetings & Family Life (So Asaa)

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Ne ishaakko shiiqada, "Ta ishaw, ta balaa akeekadis; hayyanaa maarota oychchays, nu giddon sarotethaynne siiqotethay de7o" gada haasaya.
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ኔ ኢሻአክኮ ሺኢቀደ፣ "ተ ኢሻው፣ ተ በለአ አኬእከዲስ፤ ሀይየነአ መአሮተ ኦይችቻይስ፣ ኑ ጊድዶን ሰሮቴꬃይንኔ ሲኢቆቴꬃይ ዴዖ" ገደ ሀአሰየ።
flat_utterances.amharic: ወደ ወንድምህ ቀርበህ፣ «ወንድሜ ሆይ፣ ጥፋቴን ተገንዝቤአለሁ፤ እባክህ ይቅርታ እጠይቃለሁ፣ በመካከላችን ሰላምና ፍቅር ይኑር» ብለህ ተናገር።
flat_utterances.english: Approach your brother and say, 'My brother, I have realized my mistake; please I ask for forgiveness, may peace and mutual love remain between us.'
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: ne ishaa-kko (your brother-DIR) + shiiq-ada (approach-CNV1.ANT.2S); ta isha-w (my brother-VOC.M) + ta bala-a (my mistake-ACC, Gr8 Ch.1 p. 15) + akeek-adis (realize-PAST.1S); sarotetha-y-nne siiqotetha-y (peace-NOM-and love-NOM, Gr8 Ch.8 p. 108) + de7-o (exist-JUSS.3MS).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Grade 8 Goofatho Doona Ch. 8 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/160NHNy-4orPcAIk-L5t6tOEtZoWemz_-/view?usp=drivesdk, pp. 107–120: Sarotethi)

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Iikka maarota ekko gikko, ay gada galatoo?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ኢኢክከ መአሮተ እክኮ ጊክኮ፣ አይ ገደ ገለቶኦ?
flat_utterances.amharic: እርሱም ይቅርታውን ቢቀበል፣ ምን ብዬ ላመስግነው?
flat_utterances.english: And if he accepts the apology, what should I say to thank him?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: ii-kka (3MS.NOM-ADD) + maarot-a (forgiveness-ACC) + ekk-o g-ikko (take/accept-COND.REAL), ay g-ada (what say-CNV1.ANT.1S) + galat-oo (thank-1S.INTER.JUSS).

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: "Daro galatays, ta ishaw! Siiqotethaynne zarbbey nu keethan ubba wode minni de7o!" gada galata.
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: "ደሮ ገለተይስ፣ ተ ኢሻው! ሲኢቆቴꬃይንኔ ዘርብቤይ ኑ ኬእꬃን ኡብበ ዎዴ ሚንኒ ዴዖ!" ገደ ገለተ።
flat_utterances.amharic: «በጣም አመሰግናለሁ፣ ወንድሜ ሆይ! ፍቅርና መረጋጋት በቤታችን ሁልጊዜ ጸንቶ ይኑር!» ብለህ አመስግን።
flat_utterances.english: Thank him by saying, 'Thank you very much, my brother! May love and calm stability always remain strong in our home!'
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: daro galat-ays (very thank-PRES.1S); siiqotetha-y-nne zarbbe-y (mutual.love-NOM-and calm-NOM, Gr10 Ch.4 p. 31) + minni (strongly) + de7-o (remain-JUSS.3MS).

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Hachchi ta gutha michchee yeletaa gallassa. Goofatho doonan lo77o anjjo qaalata iziw xaafanaw koyays.
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ሀችቺ ተ ጉꬃ ሚችቼእ ዬሌተአ ገልለስሰ። ጎኦፈꬆ ዶኦነን ሎዕዖ አንጅጆ ቀአለተ ኢዚው ጠአፈነው ኮየይስ።
flat_utterances.amharic: ዛሬ የታናሽ እኅቴ የልደት ቀን ነው። በጎፋኛ ቋንቋ መልካም የምርቃት ቃላትን ለእርሷ መጻፍ እፈልጋለሁ።
flat_utterances.english: Today is my younger sister's birthday. I want to write kind words of blessing to her in Gofatho.
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: hachchi (today) + ta gutha michch-ee (my younger sister-GEN.F) + yeleta-a gallassa (birth-GEN day); lo77o anjjo qaala-ta (good blessing word-PL.ACC) + izi-w (3FS-DAT) + xaaf-anaw (write-FUT.PURP) + koy-ays (want-PRES.1S).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Grade 8 Goofatho Doona Ch. 5 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/160NHNy-4orPcAIk-L5t6tOEtZoWemz_-/view?usp=drivesdk, p. 76: Yeleta); Phrasebook PHR-009 & PHR-102

flat_utterances.domain_name: Daily Greetings & Family Life (So Asaa)
flat_utterances.subtopic: Celebrating a Birthday & Blessing Children (Yeletaa Gallassaa)
flat_utterances.speaker: assistant
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Hagaa xaafarkkii: "Ufayssaa yeletaa gallassaa, ta siiqo michchiw! Xoossi ne laythaa adusso, payyatethaanne cinccatethaa neessi immo!"
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ሀገአ ጠአፈርክኪኢ፦ "ኡፈይስሰአ ዬሌተአ ገልለስሰአ፣ ተ ሲኢቆ ሚችቺው! ጦኦስሲ ኔ ለይꬃአ አዱስሶ፣ ፐይየቴꬃአንኔ ጪንጭጨቴꬃአ ኔእስሲ ኢምሞ!"
flat_utterances.amharic: ይህንን ልትጽፍላት ትችላለህ፦ «መልካም የልደት ቀን ደስታ፣ ለውድ እኅቴ! እግዚአብሔር ዕድሜሽን ያርዝም፣ ጤንነትንና ጥበብን ይስጥሽ!»
flat_utterances.english: You can write this: 'Happy birthday, to my beloved sister! May God lengthen your years and grant you health and wisdom!'
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: ta siiqo michch-iw (my beloved sister-DAT.F, MP-09/10); ne laytha-a (your year/age-ACC) + aduss-o (lengthen-JUSS.3MS < aduqq- + -iss-); cinccatetha-a (wisdom-ACC < cincca + -tetha ABSTR.NMZ) + nee-ssi (2S-DAT) + imm-o (give-JUSS.3MS).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Grade 8 Goofatho Doona Ch. 5 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/160NHNy-4orPcAIk-L5t6tOEtZoWemz_-/view?usp=drivesdk, p. 76: Yeleta); Phrasebook PHR-009 & PHR-102

flat_utterances.domain_name: Daily Greetings & Family Life (So Asaa)
flat_utterances.subtopic: Celebrating a Birthday & Blessing Children (Yeletaa Gallassaa)
flat_utterances.speaker: user
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Iza ha77i tamma laytha kumadasu. Goofatho doonan 'tamma' giyaa qaalan 'mm' minniyaa gidoogaa waatada hassayissoo?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ኢዘ ሀዕዒ ተምመ ለይꬃ ኩመደሱ። ጎኦፈꬆ ዶኦነን 'ተምመ' ጊየአ ቀአለን 'ምም' ሚንኒየአ ጊዶኦገአ ወአተደ ሀስሰዪስሶኦ?
flat_utterances.amharic: እርሷ አሁን አሥር ዓመት ሞላት። በጎፋኛ «tamma» (አሥር) በሚለው ቃል ውስጥ «mm» ጠብቆ የሚነበብ (Minniyaa) መሆኑን እንዴት ላስታውሳት?
flat_utterances.english: She has now turned ten years old. How can I remind her that in the Gofatho word 'tamma' (ten), the 'mm' is geminated (minniyaa)?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: iza (3FS.NOM) + tamma (ten, geminate mm) + laytha (year) + kum-adasu (fill/complete-PAST.3FS.A.DCL); minn-iyaa (geminated-REL) + gid-oogaa (be-NMZ.ACC) + hassay-iss-oo (remember-CAUS-1S.INTER).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Grade 8 Goofatho Doona Ch. 5 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/160NHNy-4orPcAIk-L5t6tOEtZoWemz_-/view?usp=drivesdk, p. 76: Yeleta); Phrasebook PHR-009 & PHR-102

flat_utterances.domain_name: Daily Greetings & Family Life (So Asaa)
flat_utterances.subtopic: Celebrating a Birthday & Blessing Children (Yeletaa Gallassaa)
flat_utterances.speaker: assistant
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Miicissishe hagaada ga: "Ne laythay 'tamma' gidiis; 'tama' gidenna! Tamma laythan cincca tamaare gida!"
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ሚኢጪስሲሼ ሀገአደ ገ፦ "ኔ ለይꬃይ 'ተምመ' ጊዲኢስ፤ 'ተመ' ጊዴንነ! ተምመ ለይꬃን ጪንጭጨ ተመአሬ ጊደ!"
flat_utterances.amharic: እያጫወትካት እንዲህ በላት፦ «ዕድሜሽ 'ታምማ' (አሥር - የጠበቀ) ሆኗል፤ 'ታማ' (እሳት - የላላ) አይደለም! በአሥር ዓመትሽ ጎበዝ ተማሪ ሁኚ!»
flat_utterances.english: Playfully tell her: 'Your age has become tamma (ten — geminated minniyaa), not tama (fire — singleton leppiya)! At age ten, be a bright student!'
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: Contrastive minimal pair GEM-001 (Sellassie Cheru 2015, p. 31): tama /tama/ ('fire', Leppiya singleton) vs. tamma /tamma/ ('ten', Minniyaa geminate).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Grade 8 Goofatho Doona Ch. 5 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/160NHNy-4orPcAIk-L5t6tOEtZoWemz_-/view?usp=drivesdk, p. 76: Yeleta); Phrasebook PHR-009 & PHR-102

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Goofa gaxare heeran woga maata-keethi keexxiyo wode bertte kifileti ayba aybee?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ጎኦፈ ገጠሬ ሄእረን ዎገ መአተ-ኬእꬂ ኬእጥጢዮ ዎዴ ቤርትቴ ኪፊሌቲ አይበ አይቤእ?
flat_utterances.amharic: በጎፋ ገጠር አካባቢ ባህላዊ የሣር ቤት (ጎጆ) ሲሠራ ዋና ዋና ክፍሎቹ ምን ምን ናቸው?
flat_utterances.english: When building a traditional thatched house (maata-keethi) in rural Gofa, what are its main structural parts?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: Goofa gaxare heera-n (Gofa rural area-LOC, Gr8 Ch.5 p. 76) + maata-keethi (compound: grass-house, Gr8 Ch.3 p. 53) + keexx-iyo wode (build-PRES.REL when) + bertte kifile-ti (main part-PL.NOM) + ayba ayb-ee (what what-COP.INTER).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Grade 8 Goofatho Doona Ch. 2 & Ch. 3 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/160NHNy-4orPcAIk-L5t6tOEtZoWemz_-/view?usp=drivesdk, pp. 34, 53: keetha tuussa, maata-keethi)

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Woga keethaas giddon eqqiyaa mino "keetha tuussa", yuushuwan "goda", bollara "kaara" nne geliyaa "pengge sanqa" de7oosona.
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ዎገ ኬእꬃአስ ጊድዶን እቅቂየአ ሚኖ "ኬእꬃ ቱኡስሰ"፣ ዩኡሹወን "ጎደ"፣ ቦልለረ "ከአረ" ንኔ ጌሊየአ "ፔንግጌ ሰንቀ" ዴዖኦሶነ።
flat_utterances.amharic: ለባህላዊ ቤት በመካከል የሚቆም ጠንካራ «ኬꬃ ቱኡሳ» (ምሶሶ)፣ በዙሪያው «ጎዳ» (ግድግዳ)፣ ከላይ «ካራ» (ጣሪያ) እና መግቢያ «ፔንጌ ሳንቃ» (የበር መዝጊያ) አሉት።
flat_utterances.english: A traditional house has a strong center pole ('keetha tuussa') standing in the middle, walls ('goda') around it, a roof ('kaara') above, and a door bar ('pengge sanqa') at the entrance.
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: keetha tuussa (center house pole, Gr8 Ch.2 p. 34 Riddle 2) + goda (wall) + kaara (roof/ceiling) + pengge sanqa (door bar, Gr8 Ch.2 p. 35 Riddle 8) + de7-oosona (exist-PRES.3PL).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Grade 8 Goofatho Doona Ch. 2 & Ch. 3 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/160NHNy-4orPcAIk-L5t6tOEtZoWemz_-/view?usp=drivesdk, pp. 34, 53: keetha tuussa, maata-keethi)

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Keetha tuussaabaa Hosppuntho kifile maxaafan de7iyaa sedhemenkkey ay gii?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ኬእꬃ ቱኡስሰአበአ ሆስፕፑንꬆ ኪፊሌ መጠአፈን ዴዒየአ ሴꬌሜንክኬይ አይ ጊኢ?
flat_utterances.amharic: ስለ ቤት ምሶሶ (ኬꬃ ቱኡሳ) በስምንተኛ ክፍል መጽሐፍ ውስጥ ያለው እንቆቅልሽ ምን ይላል?
flat_utterances.english: What does the riddle in the Grade 8 textbook say about the center house pole (keetha tuussa)?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: keetha tuussaa-baa (house center.pole-ABOUT) + sedhemenkke-y (riddle-NOM.M, Gr8 Ch.2 p. 34) + ay g-ii (what say-PRES.3MS.INTER).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Grade 8 Goofatho Doona Ch. 2 & Ch. 3 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/160NHNy-4orPcAIk-L5t6tOEtZoWemz_-/view?usp=drivesdk, pp. 34, 53: keetha tuussa, maata-keethi)

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Sedhemenkkey: "Dulley tama kayees, xeeray awa kayees" gees; zaaroykka "Keetha tuussa"!
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ሴꬌሜንክኬይ፦ "ዱልሌይ ተመ ከዬእስ፣ ጤእረይ አወ ከዬእስ" ጌእስ፤ ዘአሮይክከ "ኬእꬃ ቱኡስሰ"!
flat_utterances.amharic: እንቆቅልሹ፦ «ዱሌይ ታማ ካዬስ፣ ጤራይ አዋ ካዬስ» (ሥሩ እሳት ይሞቃል፣ ጫፉ ፀሐይ ይሞቃል) ይላል፤ መልሱም «ኬꬃ ቱኡሳ» (የቤት ምሶሶ) ነው!
flat_utterances.english: The riddle says: 'Dulley tama kayees, xeeray awa kayees' ('Its base warms itself by the hearth fire, its tip warms itself in the sun'); and the answer is 'Keetha tuussa' (the center house pole)!
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: dulle-y (base/bottom-NOM.M) + tama (fire, Leppiya) + kay-ees (warm-PRES.3MS); xeera-y (tip/top-NOM.M) + awa (sun) + kay-ees; zaaro-y-kka (answer-NOM.M-ADD) = keetha tuussa (Gr8 Ch.2 p. 34).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Grade 8 Goofatho Doona Ch. 2 & Ch. 3 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/160NHNy-4orPcAIk-L5t6tOEtZoWemz_-/view?usp=drivesdk, pp. 34, 53: keetha tuussa, maata-keethi)

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Wontto maallado guuraara denddada Bulqippe Sawula baanaw koyays. Ogey aappun saate ekkii?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ዎንትቶ መአልለዶ ጉኡረአረ ዴንድደደ ቡልቂፕፔ ሰዉለ በአነው ኮየይስ። ኦጌይ አአፕፑን ሰአቴ እክኪኢ?
flat_utterances.amharic: ነገ ጠዋት በማለዳ ተነሥቼ ከቡልቂ ወደ ሳውላ መሄድ እፈልጋለሁ። መንገዱ ስንት ሰዓት ይወስዳል?
flat_utterances.english: Tomorrow early in the morning I want to wake up and travel from Bulqi to Sawula. How many hours does the journey take?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: wontto (tomorrow) + maallado guura-ara (early.morning-COM) + dendd-ada (wake.up-CNV1.ANT.1S) + Bulqi-ppe (Bulqi-ABL) + Sawula ba-anaw (go-FUT.PURP.INF); aappun saate (how.many hour) + ekk-ii (take-PRES.3MS.INTER).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Phrasebook PHR-076 to PHR-090; Grade 8 Ch. 1 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/160NHNy-4orPcAIk-L5t6tOEtZoWemz_-/view?usp=drivesdk)

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Bulqippe Sawula kaamen baanaw na77u saate heera ekkees. Maallado usuppun saaten kaamee denddiyaa gishshaw, guuraara giigetta!
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ቡልቂፕፔ ሰዉለ ከአሜን በአነው ነዕዑ ሰአቴ ሄእረ እክኬእስ። መአልለዶ ኡሱፕፑን ሰአቴን ከአሜእ ዴንድዲየአ ጊሽሻው፣ ጉኡረአረ ጊኢጌትተ!
flat_utterances.amharic: ከቡልቂ ወደ ሳውላ በመኪና ለመሄድ ሁለት ሰዓት አካባቢ ይወስዳል። ጠዋት አሥራ ሁለት ሰዓት ላይ መኪናው ስለሚነሣ፣ በማለዳ ተዘጋጅ!
flat_utterances.english: Traveling by bus from Bulqi to Sawula takes around two hours. Because the bus departs early in the morning, get ready early!
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: kaame-n (bus/car-INST) + ba-anaw (go-FUT.PURP) + na77u saate (two hours, ZARA-03 77) + ekk-ees (take-PRES.3MS); dendd-iyaa gishshaw (depart-PRES.REL because) + giig-ett-a (prepare-REFL-IMP.2S).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Phrasebook PHR-076 to PHR-090; Grade 8 Ch. 1 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/160NHNy-4orPcAIk-L5t6tOEtZoWemz_-/view?usp=drivesdk)

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Ta aayees ehaana uutha dhiilliyaanne eessaa shanxan wothadis. Kaamiyaa bolla wothanaassi oona oychchoo?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ተ አአዬእስ እሀአነ ኡኡꬃ ꬊኢልሊየአንኔ እእስሰአ ሻንጠን ዎꬃዲስ። ከአሚየአ ቦልለ ዎꬃነአስሲ ኦኦነ ኦይችቾኦ?
flat_utterances.amharic: ለእናቴ የምወስደውን የእንሰት ዱቄትና ማር በሻንጣ አድርጌአለሁ። መኪናው ላይ ለማስጫን ማንን ልጠይቅ?
flat_utterances.english: I have packed the enset flour and honey to bring to my mother in a bag. Whom should I ask to load it onto the bus?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: ta aayee-s (my mother-DAT) + eh-aana (bring-FUT.REL) + uutha dhiilliya-a-nne (enset flour-ACC-COORD) + eessa-a (honey-ACC, Minniyaa ss) + shanxa-n (bag-LOC) + woth-adis (put-PAST.1S); oona (whom.ACC) + oychch-oo (ask-1S.INTER.JUSS).

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Kaame maaddanchchaa "Hayyanaa, ta shanxaa kaamiyaa bolla wothada taana maaddarkkii?" gada oychcha. Ogey saro gido!
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ከአሜ መአድደንችቻአ "ሀይየነአ፣ ተ ሻንጠአ ከአሚየአ ቦልለ ዎꬃደ ተአነ መአድደርክኪኢ?" ገደ ኦይችቻ። ኦጌይ ሰሮ ጊዶ!
flat_utterances.amharic: የመኪናውን ረዳት «እባክህ፣ ሻንጣዬን መኪናው ላይ አድርገህ ትረዳኛለህ?» ብለህ ጠይቀው። መንገዱ የሰላም ይሁንልህ!
flat_utterances.english: Ask the bus assistant, 'Please, could you help me by putting my bag on top of the bus?' May your journey be safe!
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: kaame maaddanchcha-a (bus assistant-ACC < maadd- + -anchcha agentive) + woth-ada (put-CNV1.ANT.2S) + maadd-arkkii (help-2S.POT.INTER); oge-y saro gid-o (road-NOM peace be-JUSS.3MS).

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Nu shooroti miizziyaa yuuyidi ooratha maathaanne oysaa nuussi yedidosona. Goofa shoorotetha wogan waatidi galatoo?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ኑ ሾኦሮቲ ሚኢዝዚየአ ዩኡዪዲ ኦኦረꬃ መአꬃአንኔ ኦይሰአ ኑኡስሲ ዬዲዶሶነ። ጎኦፈ ሾኦሮቴꬃ ዎገን ወአቲዲ ገለቶኦ?
flat_utterances.amharic: ጎረቤቶቻችን ላሟን አልበው ትኩስ ወተትና ቅቤ ለእኛ ላኩልን። በጎፋ የጉርብትና ባህል እንዴት እናመስግን?
flat_utterances.english: Our neighbors milked their cow and sent fresh milk and butter to us. In Gofa neighborly tradition, how should we thank them?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: nu shooro-ti (our neighbor-PL.NOM) + miizziya-a (cow-ACC.F.DEF) + ooratha maatha-a-nne (fresh milk-ACC-COORD) + oysa-a (butter-ACC) + nuu-ssi (1PL-DAT) + yed-idosona (send-PAST.3PL.A.DCL).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Grade 9 Goofatho Doona Ch. 5 & Grade 10 Ch. 4 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/1uvGaBT4-O_Jn7oQbuNl1W88lFBFiHULU/view?usp=drivesdk, p. 41; https://drive.google.com/file/d/1mKIcfMoMgnZ9Pa657NWmE-OGND2wlveM/view?usp=drivesdk, p. 30)

flat_utterances.domain_name: Daily Greetings & Family Life (So Asaa)
flat_utterances.subtopic: Neighborly Mutual Support & Sharing Dairy and Greens
flat_utterances.speaker: assistant
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Goofa wogan maatha miishshay mela simmenna; miishshaa meeccidi giddon xaddo woy bangga dhiille guutha wothidi, "Hintte miizziyaa aacco, daro galatoos!" gidi zaarite.
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ጎኦፈ ዎገን መአꬃ ሚኢሽሻይ ሜለ ሲምሜንነ፤ ሚኢሽሻአ ሜእጭጪዲ ጊድዶን ጠድዶ ዎይ በንግገ ꬊኢልሌ ጉኡꬃ ዎꬂዲ፣ "ሂንትቴ ሚኢዝዚየአ አአጭጮ፣ ደሮ ገለቶኦስ!" ጊዲ ዘአሪቴ።
flat_utterances.amharic: በጎፋ ባህል የወተት ዕቃ ባዶውን አይመለስም፤ ዕቃውን አጥባችሁ በውስጡ ጤና አዳም ወይም ጥቂት የገብስ ዱቄት አድርጋችሁ፣ «ላማችሁ ትርባ (ትብዛ)፣ በጣም እናመሰግናለን!» ብላችሁ መልሱ።
flat_utterances.english: In Gofa custom, a milk vessel is never returned empty; wash the container, place a sprig of rue or a little barley flour inside, and return it saying, 'May your cow multiply, thank you very much!'
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: maatha miishsha-y (milk vessel-NOM) + mela (empty) + simm-enna (return-PRES.3MS.NEG); aacc-o (multiply-JUSS.3FS, Gr10 Aaqeta p. 88) + zaar-ite (return-IMP.2PL).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Grade 9 Goofatho Doona Ch. 5 & Grade 10 Ch. 4 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/1uvGaBT4-O_Jn7oQbuNl1W88lFBFiHULU/view?usp=drivesdk, p. 41; https://drive.google.com/file/d/1mKIcfMoMgnZ9Pa657NWmE-OGND2wlveM/view?usp=drivesdk, p. 30)

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Shoorotetha siiqonne woli maaddo qonccisiyaa Goofatho tosse taassi odarkkii?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ሾኦሮቴꬃ ሲኢቆንኔ ዎሊ መአድዶ ቆንጭጪሲየአ ጎኦፈꬆ ቶስሴ ተአስሲ ኦደርክኪኢ?
flat_utterances.amharic: የጉርብትና ፍቅርንና መረዳዳትን የሚገልጽ የጎፋኛ ምሳሌያዊ ንግግር ትነግረኛለህ?
flat_utterances.english: Could you tell me a Gofatho proverb that expresses neighborly love and mutual sharing?

flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ተምመንꬆ ኪፊሌ ሼምፕፖ 4 (ፕ። 30) ጊድዶን፦ "ደረነ ዴሪየን ሄእꬓይ ደግጊ ኡዬእስ" ንኔ ኡድዱፉንꬆ ኪፊሌ ሼምፕፖ 5 (ፕ። 41) ጊድዶን፦ "ኬእꬃን ኬእሂን ከሬን ሰንꬂ አአꬄእስ" ጊየአ ቶስሴቲ ዴዖኦሶነ።
flat_utterances.amharic: በአሥረኛ ክፍል ምዕራፍ 4 (ገጽ 30) ውስጥ፦ «ዳራና ዴሪያን ሄꬓይ ዳጊ ኡዬስ» (በሚያድግ አገር ሦስት ሰው ተጋግዞ ይጠጣል) እና በዘጠነኛ ክፍል ምዕራፍ 5 (ገጽ 41) ውስጥ፦ «ኬꬃን ኬሂን ካሬን ሳንꬂ አꬄስ» የሚሉ ምሳሌዎች አሉ።
flat_utterances.english: In Grade 10 Chapter 4 (p. 30) there is 'Darana deriyan heedzay daggi uyees' ('In a community destined to prosper, three people share and drink together'), and in Grade 9 Chapter 5 (p. 41) 'Keethan keehin karen santhi aathees' ('Generosity inside the home shares greens across the fence').
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: dar-ana deriya-n (prosper-FUT.REL community-LOC) + heedza-y (three-NOM) + dagg-i (share-CNV2) + uy-ees (drink-PRES.3MS); santhi (cabbage/greens) + aath-ees (pass.over-PRES.3MS).

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Hosppuntho kifile Shemppo 4 giddon "yi7o", "kayo" nne "haphphidi" giyaa qaalati de7oosona. Entta birshshethaa meega qofan bessarkkii?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ሆስፕፑንꬆ ኪፊሌ ሼምፕፖ 4 ጊድዶን "ዪዖ"፣ "ከዮ" ንኔ "ሀጵጪዲ" ጊየአ ቀአለቲ ዴዖኦሶነ። እንትተ ቢርሽሼꬃአ ሜእገ ቆፈን ቤስሰርክኪኢ?
flat_utterances.amharic: በስምንተኛ ክፍል ምዕራፍ 4 ውስጥ «ዪዖ» (ወላጅ አልባ)፣ «ካዮ» (ሐዘን) እና «ሃጵጪዲ» (አቅፎ) የሚሉ ቃላት አሉ። ፍቺአቸውን በዓረፍተ ነገር ታሳየኛለህ?
flat_utterances.english: In Grade 8 Chapter 4 there are the words 'yi7o' (orphan), 'kayo' (grief), and 'haphphidi' (embracing). Could you show their meanings in sentences?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: yi7o (orphan, ZARA-03 glottal 7=/ʔ/, Gr8 Ch.4 p. 59) + kayo (grief/sorrow) + haphph-idi (embrace-CNV2.ANT, geminate bilabial ejective phph); meega qofa-n (sentence-LOC) + bess-arkkii (show-2S.POT.INTER, MP-05 < be7- + -iss-).

flat_utterances.domain_name: Daily Greetings & Family Life (So Asaa)
flat_utterances.subtopic: Comforting an Orphan or Grieving Neighbor with Compassion
flat_utterances.speaker: assistant
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Ee! "Yi7o" guussay aawaynne aayiyaa baynna na7a; "kayo" guussay azzano; "haphphidi" guussay qoommidi oyqqo. Leemisos: "Shooroti yi7o na7aa haphphidi kayo zarbbissidosona."
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: እእ! "ዪዖ" ጉኡስሰይ አአወይንኔ አአዪየአ በይንነ ነዓ፤ "ከዮ" ጉኡስሰይ አዝዘኖ፤ "ሀጵጪዲ" ጉኡስሰይ ቆኦምሚዲ ኦይቅቆ። ሌእሚሶስ፦ "ሾኦሮቲ ዪዖ ነዓአ ሀጵጪዲ ከዮ ዘርብቢስሲዶሶነ።"
flat_utterances.amharic: አዎ! «ዪዖ» ማለት አባትና እናት የሌለው ልጅ፤ «ካዮ» ማለት ሐዘን፤ «ሃጵጪዲ» ማለት አቅፎ መያዝ ነው። ለምሳሌ፦ «ጎረቤቶቹ ወላጅ አልባውን ልጅ አቅፈው ሐዘኑን አበረዱ።»
flat_utterances.english: Yes! 'Yi7o' means an orphan child without parents; 'kayo' means grief; 'haphphidi' means embracing closely. For example: 'The neighbors embraced the orphan child and comforted his grief.'
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: yi7o na7a-a (orphan child-ACC) + haphph-idi (embrace-CNV2.ANT) + kayo (grief.ACC) + zarbb-iss-idosona (calm-CAUS-PAST.3PL.A.DCL).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Grade 8 Goofatho Doona Ch. 4 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/160NHNy-4orPcAIk-L5t6tOEtZoWemz_-/view?usp=drivesdk, pp. 50–66: Qantha Medh-Darsso & Yi7o vocabulary)

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: He shemppuwan "Ache saxxada dichchasu" giyaa aaqe oda birshshethay aybee?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ሄ ሼምፕፑወን "አቼ ሰጥጠደ ዲችቻሱ" ጊየአ አአቄ ኦደ ቢርሽሼꬃይ አይቤእ?
flat_utterances.amharic: በዚያው ምዕራፍ ውስጥ «አቼ ሳጣዳ ዲቻሱ» የሚለው ፈሊጣዊ ንግግር ትርጉሙ ምንድን ነው?
flat_utterances.english: In that same chapter, what is the meaning of the idiom 'Ache saxxada dichchasu'?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: ache (tooth) + saxx-ada (bite/grit-CNV1.ANT.3FS) + dichch-asu (raise/grow.CAUS-PAST.3FS.A.DCL, Gr8 Ch.4 p. 60).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Grade 8 Goofatho Doona Ch. 4 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/160NHNy-4orPcAIk-L5t6tOEtZoWemz_-/view?usp=drivesdk, pp. 50–66: Qantha Medh-Darsso & Yi7o vocabulary)

flat_utterances.domain_name: Daily Greetings & Family Life (So Asaa)
flat_utterances.subtopic: Comforting an Orphan or Grieving Neighbor with Compassion
flat_utterances.speaker: assistant
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: "Ache saxxada dichchasu" guussay daro metuwaanne yeemothaa dandda7ada, minnada na7aa dichchasu guussa.
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: "አቼ ሰጥጠደ ዲችቻሱ" ጉኡስሰይ ደሮ ሜቱወአንኔ ዬእሞꬃአ ደንድደዓደ፣ ሚንነደ ነዓአ ዲችቻሱ ጉኡስሰ።
flat_utterances.amharic: «አቼ ሳጣዳ ዲቻሱ» ማለት ብዙ ችግርንና መከራን ችላ፣ ጠንክራ ልጁን አሳደገችው (ጥርሷን ነክሳ አሳደገችው) ማለት ነው።
flat_utterances.english: 'Ache saxxada dichchasu' (lit. 'she gritted her teeth and raised him') means she endured great hardship with perseverance and raised the child.
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: metuwa-a-nne (hardship-ACC.M.DEF-COORD) + yeemotha-a (suffering-ACC, Gr8 Ch.4 p. 59) + dandda7-ada (endure-CNV1.ANT.3FS, ZARA-03 7) + minn-ada (be.strong-CNV1.ANT.3FS) + dichch-asu (raise-PAST.3FS).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Grade 8 Goofatho Doona Ch. 4 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/160NHNy-4orPcAIk-L5t6tOEtZoWemz_-/view?usp=drivesdk, pp. 50–66: Qantha Medh-Darsso & Yi7o vocabulary)

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Qammay gakkiis, Gofatho AI. Ha77i zin77anaw baana; qamma sarothoy Goofatho doonan ay geetettii?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ቀምመይ ገክኪኢስ፣ ጎፈꬆ አኢ። ሀዕዒ ዚንዕዓነው በአነ፤ ቀምመ ሰሮꬆይ ጎኦፈꬆ ዶኦነን አይ ጌእቴትቲኢ?
flat_utterances.amharic: ምሽቱ ደርሷል፣ ጎፋꬶ ኤአይ። አሁን ልተኛ ልሄድ ነው፤ የምሽት (የመኝታ) ሰላምታ በጎፋኛ ምን ይባላል?
flat_utterances.english: Night has arrived, Gofatho AI. I am going to sleep now; how do we say goodnight in Gofatho?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: qamma-y (night-NOM.M) + gakk-iis (arrive-PAST.3MS); zin77-anaw (sleep-FUT.PURP.INF, ZARA-03 geminate glottal 77=/ʔʔ/) + ba-ana (go-FUT.1S); qamma sarotho-y (night greeting-NOM) + ay geet-ett-ii (what call-PASS-PRES.3MS.INTER).

flat_utterances.domain_name: Daily Greetings & Family Life (So Asaa)

flat_utterances.speaker: assistant
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Issi uraas "Saro pe7a!" geetettees; daro asatas woy bonchchoos qassi "Saro pe7ite!" geetettees.
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ኢስሲ ኡረአስ "ሰሮ ፔዓ!" ጌእቴትቴእስ፤ ደሮ አሰተስ ዎይ ቦንችቾኦስ ቀስሲ "ሰሮ ፔዒቴ!" ጌእቴትቴእስ።
flat_utterances.amharic: ለአንድ ሰው «ሳሮ ፔዓ!» (ደህና እደር/እደሪ!) ይባላል፤ ለብዙ ሰዎች ወይም ለአክብሮት ደግሞ «ሳሮ ፔዒቴ!» (ደህና እደሩ!) ይባላል።
flat_utterances.english: To one person we say 'Saro pe7a!' ('Spend the night in peace!'), and to multiple people or politely we say 'Saro pe7ite!'
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: pe7-a (spend.night-IMP.2S, ZARA-03 7=/ʔ/) vs. pe7-ite (spend.night-IMP.2PL/HON).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Grade 8 Goofatho Doona Ch. 8 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/160NHNy-4orPcAIk-L5t6tOEtZoWemz_-/view?usp=drivesdk); Grade 10 Ch. 5 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/1mKIcfMoMgnZ9Pa657NWmE-OGND2wlveM/view?usp=drivesdk, p. 40)

flat_utterances.amharic: ትክክለኛ ሥራ ሠርቶ በንጹሕ ልብ ስለ መተኛት የጎፋኛ ምሳሌ ምን ይላል?
flat_utterances.english: What does the Gofatho proverb say about doing upright work and sleeping with a clear conscience?

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Tammantho kifile Shemppo 5 (p. 40) tossey: "Iitabay zin77i qakkees" gees; hessa gisho lo77o ooso oothida asi sirphatethan zin77ees. Saro pe7a!
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ተምመንꬆ ኪፊሌ ሼምፕፖ 5 (ፕ። 40) ቶስሴይ፦ "ኢኢተበይ ዚንዕዒ ቀክኬእስ" ጌእስ፤ ሄስሰ ጊሾ ሎዕዖ ኦኦሶ ኦኦꬂደ አሲ ሲርጳቴꬃን ዚንዕዔእስ። ሰሮ ፔዓ!
flat_utterances.amharic: የአሥረኛ ክፍል ምዕራፍ 5 (ገጽ 40) ምሳሌ፦ «ኢታባይ ዚንዒ ቃኬስ» (ክፉ ሥራ እንቅልፍ ይነሣል) ይላል፤ ስለዚህ መልካም ሥራ የሠራ ሰው በጸጥታና በእርጋታ ይተኛል። ደህና እደር!
flat_utterances.english: The Grade 10 Chapter 5 (p. 40) proverb says: 'Iitabay zin77i qakkees' ('Evil deeds disturb one's sleep'); therefore a person who has done good work sleeps in tranquility. Goodnight!

flat_utterances.speaker: user
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Hachchi Sawula gita giyaa baanaw koyays. Issi kilo geeshsha Goofa bunaa shammanaw waagay aappunee?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ሀችቺ ሰዉለ ጊተ ጊየአ በአነው ኮየይስ። ኢስሲ ኪሎ ጌእሽሻ ጎኦፈ ቡነአ ሻምመነው ወአገይ አአፕፑኔእ?
flat_utterances.amharic: ዛሬ ወደ ሳውላ ትልቁ ገበያ መሄድ እፈልጋለሁ። አንድ ኪሎ ንጹሕ የጎፋ ቡና ለመግዛት ዋጋው ስንት ነው?
flat_utterances.english: Today I want to go to the main Sawla market. How much is the price to buy one kilo of clean Gofa coffee?

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Sawula giyan loythi mela geeshsha bunaa waagay kiluwan xeetanne usuppun tamma birappe na77u xeeta bira gakkees. Zal77anchchaakko "Waagaa guutha oxxarkkii?" gada oychchanaw dandda7aasa.
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ሰዉለ ጊየን ሎይꬂ ሜለ ጌእሽሻ ቡነአ ወአገይ ኪሉወን ጤእተንኔ ኡሱፕፑን ተምመ ቢረፕፔ ነዕዑ ጤእተ ቢረ ገክኬእስ። ዘልዕዓንችቻአክኮ "ወአገአ ጉኡꬃ ኦጥጠርክኪኢ?" ገደ ኦይችቻነው ደንድደዓአሰ።
flat_utterances.amharic: በሳውላ ገበያ በደንብ የደረቀ ንጹሕ ቡና ዋጋው በኪሎ ከመቶ ስድሳ ብር እስከ ሁለት መቶ ብር ይደርሳል። ነጋዴውን «ዋጋውን ትንሽ ትቀንሳለህ?» ብለህ መጠየቅ ትችላለህ።
flat_utterances.english: In Sawla market, the price of well-dried clean coffee ranges from 160 to 200 birr per kilo. You can ask the merchant, 'Could you reduce the price a little?'
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: kiluwa-n (kilo-LOC, MP-10) + xeeta-nne usuppun tamma (160) + bira-ppe (birr-ABL) + gakk-ees (reach-PRES.3MS); zal77anchchaa-kko (merchant-DIR, ZARA-03 77) + oxx-arkkii (reduce-2S.POT.INTER) + dandda7-aasa (can-PRES.2S.A.DCL).

flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ቡነአ ሻምሚየአ ዎዴ ሱኡሬ ሚኢዘአነን ሻሜትቲዶኦገአ ወአተደ እሮኦ?
flat_utterances.amharic: ቡናውን ስገዛ በትክክለኛ ሚዛን መገዛቱን እንዴት ላውቅ እችላለሁ?
flat_utterances.english: When buying coffee, how can I know that it is weighed on an honest scale?

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Hosppuntho kifile Shemppo 1 ("Ooso Woga") giddon, ammanettiyaa zal77anchchati suure miizaanan bayzzoosona gees; miizaanaa ayfiyan xeellada kiluwaa qoraphpha!
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ሆስፕፑንꬆ ኪፊሌ ሼምፕፖ 1 ("ኦኦሶ ዎገ") ጊድዶን፣ አምመኔትቲየአ ዘልዕዓንችቻቲ ሱኡሬ ሚኢዘአነን በይዝዞኦሶነ ጌእስ፤ ሚኢዘአነአ አይፊየን ጤእልለደ ኪሉወአ ቆረጵጳ!
flat_utterances.amharic: በስምንተኛ ክፍል ምዕራፍ 1 («የሥራ ሥነ-ምግባር») ውስጥ፣ ታማኝ ነጋዴዎች በትክክለኛ ሚዛን ይሸጣሉ ይላል፤ ሚዛኑን በዓይንህ አይተህ ኪሎውን አረጋግጥ!
flat_utterances.english: In Grade 8 Chapter 1 ('Work Ethics'), it states that trustworthy merchants sell with an honest scale; check the scale with your own eyes and verify the weight!
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: amman-ett-iyaa zal77anchcha-ti (trust-PASS-REL merchant-PL.NOM) + bayzz-oosona (sell-PRES.3PL); ayfiya-n (eye-INST) + xeell-ada (look-CNV1.ANT.2S) + qoraphph-a (verify/examine-IMP.2S).

flat_utterances.speaker: user
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Bulqi giyan gezze bootha eessa shammanaw koyays. Zal77anchchaara waatada waagaa haasayoo?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ቡልቂ ጊየን ጌዝዜ ቦኦꬃ እእስሰ ሻምመነው ኮየይስ። ዘልዕዓንችቻአረ ወአተደ ወአገአ ሀአሰዮኦ?
flat_utterances.amharic: በቡልቂ ገበያ የደጋ ነጭ ማር መግዛት እፈልጋለሁ። ከነጋዴው ጋር እንዴት ዋጋ ልደራደር?
flat_utterances.english: In Bulqi market I want to buy highland white honey (gezze bootha eessa). How should I bargain over the price with the seller?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: Bulqi giya-n (Bulqi market-LOC) + gezze (highland, Gr8 Ch.5 p. 76) + bootha eessa (white honey, Minniyaa ss) + shamm-anaw (buy-FUT.PURP); zal77anchchaa-ra (merchant-COM) + waaga-a haasay-oo (bargain-1S.INTER.JUSS).

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Hagaada ga: "Saro ooladii! Ha gezze eessaa kiloy aappunee? Taani na77u kilo shammanaw koyays; waagaa guutha oxxarkkii?"
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ሀገአደ ገ፦ "ሰሮ ኦኦለዲኢ! ሀ ጌዝዜ እእስሰአ ኪሎይ አአፕፑኔእ? ተአኒ ነዕዑ ኪሎ ሻምመነው ኮየይስ፤ ወአገአ ጉኡꬃ ኦጥጠርክኪኢ?"
flat_utterances.amharic: እንዲህ በል፦ «ሰላም ዋልክ! ይህ የደጋ ማር ኪሎው ስንት ነው? እኔ ሁለት ኪሎ መግዛት እፈልጋለሁ፤ ዋጋውን ትንሽ ትቀንሳለህ?»
flat_utterances.english: Say this: 'Good afternoon! How much is a kilo of this highland honey? I want to buy two kilos; could you lower the price a little?'

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Eessay haathi walakkettonna geeshsha eessa gididoogaa Goofatho doonan waatada oychchoo?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: እእስሰይ ሀአꬂ ወለክኬትቶንነ ጌእሽሻ እእስሰ ጊዲዶኦገአ ጎኦፈꬆ ዶኦነን ወአተደ ኦይችቾኦ?
flat_utterances.amharic: ማሩ ውኃ ያልተቀላቀለበት ንጹሕ ማር መሆኑን በጎፋኛ እንዴት ልጠይቅ?
flat_utterances.english: How do I ask in Gofatho whether the honey is pure honey unmixed with water?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: eessa-y (honey-NOM.M) + haath-i (water-NOM) + walakk-ett-onna (mix-PASS-NEG.REL) + geeshsha (pure/clean) + gid-idoogaa (be-PAST.REL.NMZ.ACC) + oychch-oo (ask-1S.INTER.JUSS).

flat_utterances.subtopic: Bulqi Highland Market: Bargaining for Pure White Honey (Bootha Eessa)
flat_utterances.speaker: assistant
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: "Ha eessay sukkaare woy haathi bu7ettonna geeshsha mathi eessee?" gada oychcha. Zal77anchchay "Ee, ha77i gezzeeppe kessida geeshsha eessa!" gidi zaarees.
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: "ሀ እእስሰይ ሱክከአሬ ዎይ ሀአꬂ ቡዔትቶንነ ጌእሽሻ መꬂ እእስሴእ?" ገደ ኦይችቻ። ዘልዕዓንችቻይ "እእ፣ ሀዕዒ ጌዝዜእፕፔ ኬስሲደ ጌእሽሻ እእስሰ!" ጊዲ ዘአሬእስ።
flat_utterances.amharic: «ይህ ማር ስኳር ወይም ውኃ ያልተቀላቀለበት ንጹሕ የንብ ማር ነው?» ብለህ ጠይቅ። ነጋዴውም «አዎ፣ አሁን ከደጋ የቆረጥነው ንጹሕ ማር ነው!» ብሎ ይመልሳል።
flat_utterances.english: Ask: 'Is this pure bee honey unmixed with sugar or water?' The seller will reply: 'Yes, it is pure honey freshly harvested from the highlands!'
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: bu7-ett-onna (blend/mix-PASS-NEG.REL, Gr8 Ch.8 p. 114 bu7ettis) + mathi eess-ee (honeybee honey-INTER, Gr8 Ch.5 p. 76); gezzee-ppe (highland-ABL) + kess-ida (take.out-PAST.REL).

flat_utterances.subtopic: Laha Market: Buying Teff (Xaafe), Maize (Badalla) & Barley (Bangga)
flat_utterances.speaker: assistant
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Giya karan eqqiyaa baajaaje woy kaame derabbiyaa "Ha kunttaale xaafiyaa ta soo gatharkkii? Gatay aappunee?" gada oychchada caana.
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ጊየ ከረን እቅቂየአ በአጀአጄ ዎይ ከአሜ ዴረብቢየአ "ሀ ኩንትተአሌ ጠአፊየአ ተ ሶኦ ገꬃርክኪኢ? ገተይ አአፕፑኔእ?" ገደ ኦይችቻደ ጨአነ።
flat_utterances.amharic: በገበያው በር ላይ የሚቆመውን ባጃጅ ወይም የመኪና ሹፌር «ይህንን ኩንታል ጤፍ ወደ ቤቴ ታደርስልኛለህ? ዋጋው (ክፍያው) ስንት ነው?» ብለህ ጠይቀህ ጫን።
flat_utterances.english: Ask a bajaj or truck driver standing at the market gate, 'Could you deliver this quintal of teff to my home? How much is the fare?' and load it.
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: giya kara-n (market gate-LOC) + eqq-iyaa (stand-PRES.REL) + gath-arkkii (make.arrive-2S.POT.INTER < gakk- + -iss-) + gata-y (fare/wage-NOM) + caan-a (load-IMP.2S).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Phrasebook PHR-020 & PHR-080; Grade 9 Ch. 5 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/1uvGaBT4-O_Jn7oQbuNl1W88lFBFiHULU/view?usp=drivesdk, p. 39: badalla, bangga)

flat_utterances.domain_name: Sawla, Bulqi & Laha Market Bargaining (Giya)
flat_utterances.subtopic: Buying Kocho (Eesa), Bulla (Itima) & Enset Products
flat_utterances.speaker: user
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Giyaappe bootha itimanne lo77o eesa shammanaw koyays. Maccati bayzziyaa bessay awan de7ii?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ጊየአፕፔ ቦኦꬃ ኢቲመንኔ ሎዕዖ እእሰ ሻምመነው ኮየይስ። መጭጨቲ በይዝዚየአ ቤስሰይ አወን ዴዒኢ?
flat_utterances.amharic: ከገበያ ነጭ ቡላ (ኢቲማ) እና ጥሩ ቆጮ (ኤሳ) መግዛት እፈልጋለሁ። ሴቶቹ የሚሸጡበት ቦታ የት ነው ያለው?
flat_utterances.english: I want to buy white bulla (itima) and fine kocho (eesa) from the market. Where is the section where the women sell them?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: giyaa-ppe (market-ABL) + bootha itima (white enset starch/bulla) + lo77o eesa (good kocho, PHR-060); macca-ti (woman-PL.NOM) + bayzz-iyaa bessa-y (sell-PRES.REL place-NOM.M) + awa-n de7-ii (where-LOC exist-PRES.3MS.INTER).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Phrasebook PHR-048 & PHR-060; Sellassie Cheru (2015, p. 381: uutha, eesa, itima)

flat_utterances.domain_name: Sawla, Bulqi & Laha Market Bargaining (Giya)
flat_utterances.subtopic: Buying Kocho (Eesa), Bulla (Itima) & Enset Products
flat_utterances.speaker: assistant
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Uutha oosota bayzziyaa bessay giyaa giddo baggan, yeechche hiixxettida bessan de7ees. Bootha itimay ukke kathanaw daro mal77ees.
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ኡኡꬃ ኦኦሶተ በይዝዚየአ ቤስሰይ ጊየአ ጊድዶ በግገን፣ ዬእችቼ ሂኢጥጤትቲደ ቤስሰን ዴዔእስ። ቦኦꬃ ኢቲመይ ኡክኬ ከꬃነው ደሮ መልዕዔእስ።
flat_utterances.amharic: የእንሰት ውጤቶች የሚሸጡበት ቦታ በገበያው መካከል፣ የእንሰት ቅጠል (ዬችቼ) በተነጠፈበት ቦታ ይገኛል። ነጩ ቡላ (ኢቲማ) ገንፎ ለማብሰል በጣም ይጣፍጣል።
flat_utterances.english: The section selling enset products is in the middle of the market, where fresh enset leaves (yeechche) are spread out. White itima is very delicious for cooking porridge.
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: yeechche (enset leaf, PHR-0197) + hiixx-ett-ida bessa-n (spread-PASS-PAST.REL place-LOC); bootha itima-y (white bulla-NOM) + kath-anaw (cook-FUT.PURP) + mal77-ees (be.delicious-PRES.3MS).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Phrasebook PHR-048 & PHR-060; Sellassie Cheru (2015, p. 381: uutha, eesa, itima)

flat_utterances.domain_name: Sawla, Bulqi & Laha Market Bargaining (Giya)
flat_utterances.subtopic: Buying Kocho (Eesa), Bulla (Itima) & Enset Products
flat_utterances.speaker: user
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Eesay loythi gam77idi mal77ida eesa gididoogaa waatada eroo?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: እእሰይ ሎይꬂ ገምዕዒዲ መልዕዒደ እእሰ ጊዲዶኦገአ ወአተደ እሮኦ?
flat_utterances.amharic: ቆጮው በደንብ ሰንብቶ የቦካና የሚጣፍጥ ቆጮ መሆኑን እንዴት አውቃለሁ?
flat_utterances.english: How do I know whether the kocho is well-fermented and tasty kocho?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: eesa-y (kocho-NOM) + loythi gam77-idi (well stay/ferment-CNV2.ANT, ZARA-03 77) + mal77-ida (become.sweet-PAST.REL) + er-oo (know-1S.INTER.JUSS).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Phrasebook PHR-048 & PHR-060; Sellassie Cheru (2015, p. 381: uutha, eesa, itima)

flat_utterances.domain_name: Sawla, Bulqi & Laha Market Bargaining (Giya)
flat_utterances.subtopic: Buying Kocho (Eesa), Bulla (Itima) & Enset Products
flat_utterances.speaker: assistant
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Bootha melay de7iyaanne sawuway mal77iyaa eesaa doora; bayzziyaa aayeekko "Ha eessay loythi cenggurssidi gam77ida eessee?" gada oychcha.
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ቦኦꬃ ሜለይ ዴዒየአንኔ ሰዉወይ መልዕዒየአ እእሰአ ዶኦረ፤ በይዝዚየአ አአዬእክኮ "ሀ እእስሰይ ሎይꬂ ጬንግጉርስሲዲ ገምዕዒደ እእስሴእ?" ገደ ኦይችቻ።
flat_utterances.amharic: ነጭ መልክ ያለውንና ሽታው የሚጣፍጠውን ቆጮ ምረጥ፤ ሻጯን እናትም «ይህ ቆጮ በደንብ የቦካና የሰነበተ ቆጮ ነው?» ብለህ ጠይቃት።
flat_utterances.english: Choose kocho that has a clean white color and a pleasant aroma; ask the seller, 'Is this well-fermented, aged kocho?'
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: sawuwa-y (aroma/smell-NOM.M, MP-10) + mal77-iyaa (be.sweet-PRES.REL) + door-a (choose-IMP.2S); bayzz-iyaa aayee-kko (sell-PRES.REL mother-DIR) + oychch-a (ask-IMP.2S).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Phrasebook PHR-048 & PHR-060; Sellassie Cheru (2015, p. 381: uutha, eesa, itima)

flat_utterances.domain_name: Sawla, Bulqi & Laha Market Bargaining (Giya)
flat_utterances.subtopic: Buying Traditional Handwoven Cotton Garments (Gaabe, Bullukko, Dungguza)
flat_utterances.speaker: user
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Sawula giyan Goofa woga ma7o - gaabiya, bullukkuwaanne dungguzaa - shammanaw koyays. Awan bayzzettii?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ሰዉለ ጊየን ጎኦፈ ዎገ መዖ - ገአቢየ፣ ቡልሉክኩወአንኔ ዱንግጉዘአ - ሻምመነው ኮየይስ። አወን በይዝዜትቲኢ?
flat_utterances.amharic: በሳውላ ገበያ የጎፋ ባህላዊ ልብስ—ጋቢ፣ ቡልኮና ዱንጉዛ—መግዛት እፈልጋለሁ። የት ነው የሚሸጠው?
flat_utterances.english: In Sawla market I want to buy traditional Gofa clothing—gaabe, bullukko, and dungguza. Where are they sold?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: Goofa woga ma7o (Gofa traditional clothing, ZARA-03 7) + gaabiya (gaabi.ACC.M) + bullukkuwa-a-nne (bullukko-ACC.M.DEF-COORD, MP-10) + dungguza-a (patterned.cloth-ACC); awa-n bayzz-ett-ii (where-LOC sell-PASS-PRES.3MS.INTER).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Grade 9 Ch. 9 & Grade 10 Ch. 2 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/1uvGaBT4-O_Jn7oQbuNl1W88lFBFiHULU/view?usp=drivesdk, p. 78; https://drive.google.com/file/d/1mKIcfMoMgnZ9Pa657NWmE-OGND2wlveM/view?usp=drivesdk, pp. 13–14: gaabe, bullukko, laxana)

flat_utterances.domain_name: Sawla, Bulqi & Laha Market Bargaining (Giya)
flat_utterances.subtopic: Buying Traditional Handwoven Cotton Garments (Gaabe, Bullukko, Dungguza)
flat_utterances.speaker: assistant
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Puutto ma7o giyaan, dadanchchati kushen daddida lo77o gaabey, deexo bullukkoynne zo7o-kareetha-boorappe daddettida Goofa dungguzay bayzzettees.
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ፑኡትቶ መዖ ጊየአን፣ ደደንችቻቲ ኩሼን ደድዲደ ሎዕዖ ገአቤይ፣ ዴእጦ ቡልሉክኮይንኔ ዞዖ-ከሬእꬃ-ቦኦረፕፔ ደድዴትቲደ ጎኦፈ ዱንግጉዘይ በይዝዜትቴእስ።
flat_utterances.amharic: በጥጥ ልብስ ገበያ ውስጥ፣ ሸማኔዎች በእጃቸው የሸመኑት ጥሩ ጋቢ፣ ወፍራም ቡልኮና ከቀይ፣ ጥቁርና ቢጫ ክር የተሸመነ የጎፋ ዱንጉዛ ይሸጣል።
flat_utterances.english: In the cotton garment section of the market, fine handwoven gaabe, heavy bullukko, and Gofa dungguza woven from red, black, and yellow threads by weavers (dadanchchati) are sold.
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: puutto ma7o (cotton garment, Gr10 Ch.2 p. 13) + dadanchcha-ti (weaver-PL.NOM < dadd- 'weave' + -anchcha agentive) + kushe-n (hand-INST) + dadd-ida (weave-PAST.REL) + bayzz-ett-ees (sell-PASS-PRES.3MS).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Grade 9 Ch. 9 & Grade 10 Ch. 2 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/1uvGaBT4-O_Jn7oQbuNl1W88lFBFiHULU/view?usp=drivesdk, p. 78; https://drive.google.com/file/d/1mKIcfMoMgnZ9Pa657NWmE-OGND2wlveM/view?usp=drivesdk, pp. 13–14: gaabe, bullukko, laxana)

flat_utterances.domain_name: Sawla, Bulqi & Laha Market Bargaining (Giya)
flat_utterances.subtopic: Buying Traditional Handwoven Cotton Garments (Gaabe, Bullukko, Dungguza)
flat_utterances.speaker: user
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Ta aawaas yaagano bonchchos ma7ana gaabe shammanaw waagay aappunee?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ተ አአወአስ የአገኖ ቦንችቾስ መዓነ ገአቤ ሻምመነው ወአገይ አአፕፑኔእ?
flat_utterances.amharic: ለአባቴ ለሠርግ ክብር የሚለብሰው ጋቢ ለመግዛት ዋጋው ስንት ነው?
flat_utterances.english: How much is the price to buy a ceremonial gaabe for my father to wear for a wedding celebration?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: ta aawa-as (my father-DAT) + yaagano bonchcho-s (wedding honor-DAT, Gr10 Ch.2 p. 12) + ma7-ana (wear-FUT.REL) + gaabe shamm-anaw (gaabi buy-FUT.PURP).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Grade 9 Ch. 9 & Grade 10 Ch. 2 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/1uvGaBT4-O_Jn7oQbuNl1W88lFBFiHULU/view?usp=drivesdk, p. 78; https://drive.google.com/file/d/1mKIcfMoMgnZ9Pa657NWmE-OGND2wlveM/view?usp=drivesdk, pp. 13–14: gaabe, bullukko, laxana)

flat_utterances.domain_name: Sawla, Bulqi & Laha Market Bargaining (Giya)
flat_utterances.subtopic: Buying Traditional Handwoven Cotton Garments (Gaabe, Bullukko, Dungguza)
flat_utterances.speaker: assistant
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Kushen puuttora loythi daddettida gaabee issi sha7anne ichchashu xeeta birappe na77u sha7a bira gakkees; nam77u issippe shammikko zal77anchchay waagaa oxxees.
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ኩሼን ፑኡትቶረ ሎይꬂ ደድዴትቲደ ገአቤእ ኢስሲ ሻዓንኔ ኢችቻሹ ጤእተ ቢረፕፔ ነዕዑ ሻዓ ቢረ ገክኬእስ፤ ነምዕዑ ኢስሲፕፔ ሻምሚክኮ ዘልዕዓንችቻይ ወአገአ ኦጥጤእስ።
flat_utterances.amharic: በእጅ ከጥጥ በደንብ የተሸመነ ጋቢ ከአንድ ሺህ አምስት መቶ ብር እስከ ሁለት ሺህ ብር ይደርሳል፤ ሁለት አንድ ላይ ከገዛህ ነጋዴው ዋጋ ይቀንሳል።
flat_utterances.english: A gaabe finely handwoven from pure cotton costs from 1,500 to 2,000 birr; if you buy two together, the seller reduces the price.
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: puutto-ra (cotton-INST) + dadd-ett-ida (weave-PASS-PAST.REL) + sha7a-nne (thousand-and, ZARA-03 7) + shamm-ikko (buy-COND.REAL) + oxx-ees (reduce-PRES.3MS).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Grade 9 Ch. 9 & Grade 10 Ch. 2 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/1uvGaBT4-O_Jn7oQbuNl1W88lFBFiHULU/view?usp=drivesdk, p. 78; https://drive.google.com/file/d/1mKIcfMoMgnZ9Pa657NWmE-OGND2wlveM/view?usp=drivesdk, pp. 13–14: gaabe, bullukko, laxana)

flat_utterances.domain_name: Sawla, Bulqi & Laha Market Bargaining (Giya)
flat_utterances.subtopic: Buying Sweet Bananas (Muze), Mangoes & Highland Fruits
flat_utterances.speaker: user
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Ha muzeynne maangoy daro lo77o! "Ha muzey daro mal77ees, kiloy aappunee?" gada oychchoo?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ሀ ሙዜይንኔ መአንጎይ ደሮ ሎዕዖ! "ሀ ሙዜይ ደሮ መልዕዔእስ፣ ኪሎይ አአፕፑኔእ?" ገደ ኦይችቾኦ?
flat_utterances.amharic: ይህ ሙዝና ማንጎ በጣም ያምራል! «ይህ ሙዝ በጣም ይጣፍጣል፣ ኪሎው ስንት ነው?» ብዬ ልጠይቅ?
flat_utterances.english: These bananas and mangoes look very nice! Should I ask, 'This banana is very sweet, how much is a kilo?'
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: ha muze-y-nne (this banana-NOM-COORD) + maango-y (mango-NOM) + mal77-ees (be.sweet-PRES.3MS, ZARA-03 77=/ʔʔ/, PHR-025); kilo-y aappun-ee (kilo-NOM how.much-INTER).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Phrasebook PHR-021 & PHR-025; Sellassie Cheru (2015, p. 386)

flat_utterances.domain_name: Sawla, Bulqi & Laha Market Bargaining (Giya)
flat_utterances.subtopic: Buying Sweet Bananas (Muze), Mangoes & Highland Fruits
flat_utterances.speaker: assistant
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Ee! Qassi awppe yiidaakko eranaw, "Ha muzey Oomo shafaa gadhappe yiidaysee?" gada oychchanaw dandda7aasa.
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: እእ! ቀስሲ አውፕፔ ዪኢደአክኮ እረነው፣ "ሀ ሙዜይ ኦኦሞ ሻፈአ ገꬋፕፔ ዪኢደይሴእ?" ገደ ኦይችቻነው ደንድደዓአሰ።
flat_utterances.amharic: አዎ! ደግሞም ከየት እንደመጣ ለማወቅ፣ «ይህ ሙዝ ከኦሞ ወንዝ ቆላ የመጣ ነው?» ብለህ መጠየቅ ትችላለህ።
flat_utterances.english: Yes! And to know where it came from, you can ask, 'Is this banana from the Omo River lowlands?'
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: Oomo shafa-a gadha-ppe (Omo river-GEN lowland-ABL, Gr8 Ch.5 p. 76 gadha vs. gezze) + y-iida-ysee (come-PAST.REL-NMZ.INTER).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Phrasebook PHR-021 & PHR-025; Sellassie Cheru (2015, p. 386)

flat_utterances.domain_name: Sawla, Bulqi & Laha Market Bargaining (Giya)
flat_utterances.subtopic: Buying Sweet Bananas (Muze), Mangoes & Highland Fruits
flat_utterances.speaker: user
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Xeeta bira immada zaaraa oychchanaw Goofatho doonan ay goo?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ጤእተ ቢረ ኢምመደ ዘአረአ ኦይችቻነው ጎኦፈꬆ ዶኦነን አይ ጎኦ?
flat_utterances.amharic: መቶ ብር ሰጥቼ መልስ (ቀሪ ገንዘብ) ለመጠየቅ በጎፋኛ ምን ልበል?
flat_utterances.english: After giving a hundred-birr note, what do I say in Gofatho to ask for my change?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: xeeta bira (hundred birr) + imm-ada (give-CNV1.ANT.1S) + zaara-a (change/return-ACC, PHR-021) + oychch-anaw (ask-FUT.PURP).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Phrasebook PHR-021 & PHR-025; Sellassie Cheru (2015, p. 386)

flat_utterances.domain_name: Sawla, Bulqi & Laha Market Bargaining (Giya)
flat_utterances.subtopic: Buying Sweet Bananas (Muze), Mangoes & Highland Fruits
flat_utterances.speaker: assistant
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: "Hayyanaa, miishshaa zaaraa taaw imma" gada oychcha; qoodada ekkakka!
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: "ሀይየነአ፣ ሚኢሽሻአ ዘአረአ ተአው ኢምመ" ገደ ኦይችቻ፤ ቆኦደደ እክከክከ!
flat_utterances.amharic: «ሃይያና፣ ሚኢሻ ዛራ ታው ኢማ» (እባክህ፣ የገንዘቡን መልስ ስጠኝ) ብለህ ጠይቅ፤ ቆጥረህም ተቀበል!
flat_utterances.english: Say, 'Hayyanaa, miishshaa zaaraa taaw imma' ('Please, give me back the change'); and count it as you receive it!
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: miishsha-a zaara-a (money-GEN change-ACC) + taa-w (1S-DAT) + imm-a (give-IMP.2S, PHR-021); qood-ada (count-CNV1.ANT.2S) + ekk-a-kka (take-IMP.2S-ADD).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Phrasebook PHR-021 & PHR-025; Sellassie Cheru (2015, p. 386)

flat_utterances.domain_name: Sawla, Bulqi & Laha Market Bargaining (Giya)
flat_utterances.subtopic: Livestock Market: Buying a Plow Ox (Goshsha-Boori) & Sheep (Dorssa)
flat_utterances.speaker: user
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Ta aaway goshsha-boorinne dorssa shammanaw mehe giyaa biis. Mehe giyan booraa payyatethaa waatidi qoraphphoo?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ተ አአወይ ጎሽሻ-ቦኦሪንኔ ዶርስሰ ሻምመነው ሜሄ ጊየአ ቢኢስ። ሜሄ ጊየን ቦኦረአ ፐይየቴꬃአ ወአቲዲ ቆረጵፆኦ?
flat_utterances.amharic: አባቴ የእርሻ በሬና በግ ለመግዛት ወደ ከብት ገበያ ሄደ። በከብት ገበያ የበሬውን ጤንነት እንዴት እንመርምር?
flat_utterances.english: My father went to the livestock market to buy a plow ox (goshsha-boori) and a sheep (dorssa). How do we inspect the ox's health at the market?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: goshsha-boori-nne (compound: plow-ox-COORD, Gr8 Ch.3 p. 53) + dorssa (sheep, Gr8 Ch.5 p. 76) + mehe giya-a (cattle/livestock market-DIR) + b-iis (go-PAST.3MS.A.DCL).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Grade 8 Goofatho Doona Ch. 3 & Ch. 5 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/160NHNy-4orPcAIk-L5t6tOEtZoWemz_-/view?usp=drivesdk, pp. 53, 76: goshsha-boori, dorssa)

flat_utterances.domain_name: Sawla, Bulqi & Laha Market Bargaining (Giya)
flat_utterances.subtopic: Livestock Market: Buying a Plow Ox (Goshsha-Boori) & Sheep (Dorssa)
flat_utterances.speaker: assistant
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Goshshaanchchati booraa shammiyaa wode: achchiyaa, gediyaa minotethaa, zokkuwaanne kabbasha tookkiyaa qodhdhiyaa loythi xeelloosona.
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ጎሽሻአንችቻቲ ቦኦረአ ሻምሚየአ ዎዴ፦ አችቺየአ፣ ጌዲየአ ሚኖቴꬃአ፣ ዞክኩወአንኔ ከብበሻ ቶኦክኪየአ ቆꬍꬊየአ ሎይꬂ ጤእልሎኦሶነ።
flat_utterances.amharic: ገበሬዎች በሬ ሲገዙ፦ ጥርሱን (ዕድሜውን ለማወቅ)፣ የእግሩን ጥንካሬ፣ ጀርባውንና ቀንበር የሚሸከመውን ማጅራቱን በደንብ ያያሉ።
flat_utterances.english: When farmers buy an ox, they carefully inspect its teeth (to know its age), the strength of its legs, its back, and its neck that carries the yoke (kabbasha).
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: goshshanchcha-ti (farmer-PL.NOM) + achchiya-a (tooth-ACC.M.DEF) + gediya-a minotetha-a (leg strength-ACC) + kabbasha (yoke, Gr10 Ch.9 p. 81) + tookk-iyaa (carry-PRES.REL) + xeell-oosona (inspect-PRES.3PL).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Grade 8 Goofatho Doona Ch. 3 & Ch. 5 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/160NHNy-4orPcAIk-L5t6tOEtZoWemz_-/view?usp=drivesdk, pp. 53, 76: goshsha-boori, dorssa)

flat_utterances.domain_name: Sawla, Bulqi & Laha Market Bargaining (Giya)
flat_utterances.subtopic: Livestock Market: Buying a Plow Ox (Goshsha-Boori) & Sheep (Dorssa)
flat_utterances.speaker: user
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Booraa godaakko "Ha booray kabbasha meezetida goshsha-booree?" gada oychchanaw dandda7oo?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ቦኦረአ ጎደአክኮ "ሀ ቦኦረይ ከብበሻ ሜእዜቲደ ጎሽሻ-ቦኦሬእ?" ገደ ኦይችቻነው ደንድደዖኦ?
flat_utterances.amharic: የበሬውን ባለቤት «ይህ በሬ ቀንበር የለመደ የእርሻ በሬ ነው?» ብዬ መጠየቅ እችላለሁ?
flat_utterances.english: Can I ask the owner of the ox, 'Is this ox a plow-ox accustomed to the yoke?'
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: boora-a godaa-kko (ox-GEN owner-DIR) + kabbasha meezet-ida (yoke practice/accustom-PAST.REL) + goshsha-boor-ee (plow-ox-COP.INTER).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Grade 8 Goofatho Doona Ch. 3 & Ch. 5 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/160NHNy-4orPcAIk-L5t6tOEtZoWemz_-/view?usp=drivesdk, pp. 53, 76: goshsha-boori, dorssa)

flat_utterances.subtopic: Livestock Market: Buying a Plow Ox (Goshsha-Boori) & Sheep (Dorssa)
flat_utterances.speaker: assistant
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Ee, hegee koshshiyaa oysho! Qassi "Harggeppe geeshshee? Maataa loythi mii?" gadakka oychcha.
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: እእ፣ ሄጌእ ኮሽሺየአ ኦይሾ! ቀስሲ "ሀርግጌፕፔ ጌእሽሼእ? መአተአ ሎይꬂ ሚኢ?" ገደክከ ኦይችቻ።
flat_utterances.amharic: አዎ፣ ይህ አስፈላጊ ጥያቄ ነው! ደግሞም «ከበሽታ ንጹሕ ነው? ሣር በደንብ ይበላል?» ብለህም ጠይቅ።
flat_utterances.english: Yes, that is an essential question! Also ask, 'Is it free from disease? Does it eat grass well?'
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: hargge-ppe (disease-ABL) + geeshsh-ee (clean-INTER); maata-a (grass-ACC) + loythi m-ii (well eat-PRES.3MS.INTER).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Grade 8 Goofatho Doona Ch. 3 & Ch. 5 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/160NHNy-4orPcAIk-L5t6tOEtZoWemz_-/view?usp=drivesdk, pp. 53, 76: goshsha-boori, dorssa)

flat_utterances.domain_name: Sawla, Bulqi & Laha Market Bargaining (Giya)
flat_utterances.subtopic: Buying Traditional Iron Farming Tools (Wale, Kaltta, Beexe)
flat_utterances.speaker: user
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Tammantho kifile Shemppo 5 giddon de7iyaa "wale", "kaltta" nne "beexe" giyaa goshsha miisheta giyaappe shammanaw koyays. Entta dummatethay aybee?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ተምመንꬆ ኪፊሌ ሼምፕፖ 5 ጊድዶን ዴዒየአ "ወሌ"፣ "ከልትተ" ንኔ "ቤእጤ" ጊየአ ጎሽሻ ሚኢሼተ ጊየአፕፔ ሻምመነው ኮየይስ። እንትተ ዱምመቴꬃይ አይቤእ?
flat_utterances.amharic: በአሥረኛ ክፍል ምዕራፍ 5 ውስጥ ያሉትን «ዋሌ»፣ «ካልታ» እና «ቤጤ» የሚባሉ የእርሻ መሣሪያዎችን ከገበያ መግዛት እፈልጋለሁ። ልዩነታቸው ምንድን ነው?
flat_utterances.english: I want to buy the farming tools 'wale', 'kaltta', and 'beexe' mentioned in Grade 10 Chapter 5 from the market. What is the difference between them?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: wale (sickle/bush-knife), kaltta (axe), beexe (digging hoe) — traditional iron farming tools in Gr10 Ch.5 p. 39; entta dummatetha-y (their difference-NOM) + ayb-ee (what-INTER).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Grade 10 Goofatho Doona Ch. 5 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/1mKIcfMoMgnZ9Pa657NWmE-OGND2wlveM/view?usp=drivesdk, p. 39: wale, kaltta, beexe)

flat_utterances.domain_name: Sawla, Bulqi & Laha Market Bargaining (Giya)
flat_utterances.subtopic: Buying Traditional Iron Farming Tools (Wale, Kaltta, Beexe)
flat_utterances.speaker: assistant
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Tammantho kifile maxaafaa (p. 39) maaran: "wale" maataanne woraa qanxxiyaa miishsha; "kaltta" mitha phalqqiyanne qanxxiyaa miishsha; "beexe" qassi biittaa bookkiyaa miishsha.
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ተምመንꬆ ኪፊሌ መጠአፈአ (ፕ። 39) መአረን፦ "ወሌ" መአተአንኔ ዎረአ ቀንጥጢየአ ሚኢሽሻ፤ "ከልትተ" ሚꬃ ጳልቅቂየንኔ ቀንጥጢየአ ሚኢሽሻ፤ "ቤእጤ" ቀስሲ ቢኢትተአ ቦኦክኪየአ ሚኢሽሻ።
flat_utterances.amharic: በአሥረኛ ክፍል መጽሐፍ (ገጽ 39) መሠረት፦ «ዋሌ» ሣርና ቁጥቋጦ የሚቆርጥ ማጭድ/ቆንጨራ፤ «ካልታ» እንጨት የሚፈልጥና የሚቆርጥ መጥረቢያ፤ «ቤጤ» ደግሞ መሬት የሚቆፍር ዶማ ነው።
flat_utterances.english: According to the Grade 10 textbook (p. 39): 'wale' is a bush-knife/sickle for cutting grass and brush; 'kaltta' is an axe for splitting and chopping wood; and 'beexe' is a hoe for digging soil.
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: maata-a-nne wora-a (grass-ACC-and brush-ACC) + qanxx-iyaa (cut-PRES.REL); mitha phalqq-iyaa (wood split-PRES.REL); biitta-a bookk-iyaa (soil-ACC dig-PRES.REL).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Grade 10 Goofatho Doona Ch. 5 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/1mKIcfMoMgnZ9Pa657NWmE-OGND2wlveM/view?usp=drivesdk, p. 39: wale, kaltta, beexe)

flat_utterances.domain_name: Sawla, Bulqi & Laha Market Bargaining (Giya)
flat_utterances.subtopic: Buying Traditional Iron Farming Tools (Wale, Kaltta, Beexe)
flat_utterances.speaker: user
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Birata oothiyaa oosanchchaakko "Mino biratappe oothettida beexonne wale taaw bessa" gada oychchoo?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ቢረተ ኦኦꬂየአ ኦኦሰንችቻአክኮ "ሚኖ ቢረተፕፔ ኦኦꬄትቲደ ቤእጦንኔ ወሌ ተአው ቤስሰ" ገደ ኦይችቾኦ?
flat_utterances.amharic: ብረት የሚሠራውን ባለሙያ «ከጠንካራ ብረት የተሠራ ዶማና ማጭድ አሳየኝ» ብዬ ልጠይቀው?
flat_utterances.english: Should I ask the blacksmith, 'Show me a hoe and sickle forged from strong iron'?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: mino birata-ppe (strong iron-ABL) + ooth-ett-ida (make-PASS-PAST.REL) + taa-w bess-a (1S-DAT show-IMP.2S, MP-05 < be7- + -iss-).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Grade 10 Goofatho Doona Ch. 5 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/1mKIcfMoMgnZ9Pa657NWmE-OGND2wlveM/view?usp=drivesdk, p. 39: wale, kaltta, beexe)

flat_utterances.domain_name: Sawla, Bulqi & Laha Market Bargaining (Giya)
flat_utterances.subtopic: Buying Traditional Iron Farming Tools (Wale, Kaltta, Beexe)
flat_utterances.speaker: assistant
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Ee! Qassi mitha oyqqoy loythi giigettidaakko xeellada, "Oyqqoykka mino mithappe oothettidee?" gada oychcha.
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: እእ! ቀስሲ ሚꬃ ኦይቅቆይ ሎይꬂ ጊኢጌትቲደአክኮ ጤእልለደ፣ "ኦይቅቆይክከ ሚኖ ሚꬃፕፔ ኦኦꬄትቲዴእ?" ገደ ኦይችቻ።
flat_utterances.amharic: አዎ! ደግሞም የእንጨት እጀታው በደንብ መዘጋጀቱን አይተህ፣ «እጀታውም ከጠንካራ እንጨት የተሠራ ነው?» ብለህ ጠይቅ።
flat_utterances.english: Yes! Also check whether the wooden handle is well fitted, and ask, 'Is the handle also made from strong wood?'
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: oyqqo-y-kka (handle-NOM-ADD < oyqq- 'hold') + mino mitha-ppe (strong wood-ABL) + ooth-ett-idee (make-PASS-PAST.3MS.INTER).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Grade 10 Goofatho Doona Ch. 5 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/1mKIcfMoMgnZ9Pa657NWmE-OGND2wlveM/view?usp=drivesdk, p. 39: wale, kaltta, beexe)

flat_utterances.subtopic: Buying Clay Pottery: Coffee Pots (Phanqqe/Zhabana), Cooking Pots (Oto) & Griddles (Beshe)
flat_utterances.speaker: user
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Ta aayee kiitan giyaappe urqqa miisheta - eesa uukkiyaa beshe, dono-otonne tukke zhabana - shammanaw koyays.
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ተ አአዬእ ኪኢተን ጊየአፕፔ ኡርቅቀ ሚኢሼተ - እእሰ ኡኡክኪየአ ቤሼ፣ ዶኖ-ኦቶንኔ ቱክኬ ዣበነ - ሻምመነው ኮየይስ።
flat_utterances.amharic: በእናቴ መልእክት ከገበያ የሸክላ ዕቃዎችን—ቆጮ መጋገሪያ ምጣድ (ቤሼ)፣ የወጥ ምንቸት (ኦቶ) እና የቡና ጀበና—መግዛት እፈልጋለሁ።
flat_utterances.english: On my mother's errand, I want to buy clay pottery from the market—a griddle (beshe) for baking kocho, a stew pot (oto), and a coffee pot (zhabana).
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: ta aayee kiita-n (my mother message/errand-INST) + urqqa miishe-ta (clay vessel-PL.ACC) + eesa uukk-iyaa beshe (kocho bake-REL griddle, Gr8 Ch.2 p. 34) + shamm-anaw (buy-FUT.PURP).

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Urqqa miishe giyan beshiyaanne zhabanaa shammiyaa wode, kushen qoccada cenggurssaa si7a; baqay baynnaanne taman loythi xuugettida miishshaa doora.
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ኡርቅቀ ሚኢሼ ጊየን ቤሺየአንኔ ዣበነአ ሻምሚየአ ዎዴ፣ ኩሼን ቆጭጨደ ጬንግጉርስሰአ ሲዓ፤ በቀይ በይንነአንኔ ተመን ሎይꬂ ጡኡጌትቲደ ሚኢሽሻአ ዶኦረ።
flat_utterances.amharic: በሸክላ ዕቃ ገበያ ምጣዱንና ጀበናውን ስትገዛ፣ በእጅህ አንኳኩተህ ድምፁን አዳምጥ፤ ስንጥቅ የሌለውንና በእሳት በደንብ የተተኮሰውን ዕቃ ምረጥ።
flat_utterances.english: When buying a griddle and coffee pot in the pottery market, tap them lightly with your hand and listen to the sound; choose a vessel without cracks that has been well fired.
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: kushe-n qocc-ada (hand-INST tap-CNV1.ANT.2S) + cenggurssa-a si7-a (sound-ACC listen-IMP.2S, ZARA-03 7); baqa-y baynna-a-nne (crack-NOM without-ACC-and) + tama-n xuug-ett-ida (fire-LOC burn/fire-PASS-PAST.REL).

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Tammantho kifile Shemppo 5 giddon zhabanaanne sineebaa odiyaa sedhemenkkey ay gii?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ተምመንꬆ ኪፊሌ ሼምፕፖ 5 ጊድዶን ዣበነአንኔ ሲኔእበአ ኦዲየአ ሴꬌሜንክኬይ አይ ጊኢ?
flat_utterances.amharic: በአሥረኛ ክፍል ምዕራፍ 5 ውስጥ ስለ ጀበናና ሲኒ የሚናገረው እንቆቅልሽ ምን ይላል?
flat_utterances.english: What does the riddle in Grade 10 Chapter 5 say about the coffee pot and cups?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: zhabana-a-nne sinee-baa (coffee.pot-ACC-and cup-ABOUT) + od-iyaa sedhemenkke-y (tell-PRES.REL riddle-NOM, Gr10 Ch.5 p. 45).

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Sedhemenkkey: "Kareetha miiziya bootha marata kaalethawus" gees; zaaroykka "Ayfe tukke sinenne zhabana"!
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ሴꬌሜንክኬይ፦ "ከሬእꬃ ሚኢዚየ ቦኦꬃ መረተ ከአሌꬃዉስ" ጌእስ፤ ዘአሮይክከ "አይፌ ቱክኬ ሲኔንኔ ዣበነ"!
flat_utterances.amharic: እንቆቅልሹ፦ «ካሬꬃ ሚኢዚያ ቦꬃ ማራታ ካሌꬃዉስ» (ጥቁር ላም ነጭ ጥጃዎችን ትመራለች) ይላል፤ መልሱም «የቡና ጀበናና ነጭ ሲኒዎች» ነው!
flat_utterances.english: The riddle says: 'Kareetha miiziya bootha marata kaalethawus' ('A black cow leads white calves'); and the answer is 'A black clay coffee pot and white coffee cups'!
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: kareetha miiz-iya (black cow-NOM.F.DEF, MP-09/10) + bootha mara-ta (white calf-PL.ACC) + kaaleth-awus (lead-PRES.3FS.A.DCL, Gr10 Ch.5 p. 45).

flat_utterances.speaker: user
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Giyaa yuuyada nam77ettadis. Quumaa maanaw hoteeliyaa gelada ayba quma oychchoo?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ጊየአ ዩኡየደ ነምዕዔትተዲስ። ቁኡመአ መአነው ሆቴእሊየአ ጌለደ አይበ ቁመ ኦይችቾኦ?
flat_utterances.amharic: ገበያውን ዞሬ ራበኝ። ምግብ ለመብላት ወደ ምግብ ቤት ገብቼ ምን ዓይነት ምግብ ልጠይቅ?
flat_utterances.english: After walking around the market, I have become hungry. Entering a restaurant to eat food, what should I order?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: giya-a yuuy-ada (market-ACC walk.around-CNV1.ANT.1S) + nam77-ett-adis (hunger-PASS-PAST.1S, ZARA-03 77); quuma-a ma-anaw (food-ACC eat-FUT.PURP, PHR-029) + gel-ada (enter-CNV1.ANT.1S).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Phrasebook PHR-023, PHR-029 & PHR-030; Grade 8 Ch. 10 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/160NHNy-4orPcAIk-L5t6tOEtZoWemz_-/view?usp=drivesdk, p. 145: soollo)

flat_utterances.domain_name: Sawla, Bulqi & Laha Market Bargaining (Giya)
flat_utterances.subtopic: Ordering Traditional Food & Clean Water at a Sawla Restaurant (Hoteeliya)
flat_utterances.speaker: assistant
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Hoteeliyan: "Saro! Ho77o soollo, zo7o-asho woxe, dono-oto woykko eesanne santhi de7ii? Qassi geeshsha haathaa taaw eha" gada oychcha.
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ሆቴእሊየን፦ "ሰሮ! ሆዕዖ ሶኦልሎ፣ ዞዖ-አሾ ዎጤ፣ ዶኖ-ኦቶ ዎይክኮ እእሰንኔ ሰንꬂ ዴዒኢ? ቀስሲ ጌእሽሻ ሀአꬃአ ተአው እሀ" ገደ ኦይችቻ።
flat_utterances.amharic: በምግብ ቤቱ፦ «ሰላም! ትኩስ እንጀራ (ሶሎ)፣ የቀይ ሥጋ ወጥ፣ የድንች ወጥ ወይስ ቆጮና ጎመን አለ? ደግሞም ንጹሕ ውኃ አምጣልኝ» ብለህ ጠይቅ።
flat_utterances.english: At the restaurant, ask: 'Hello! Do you have warm injera/flatbread (soollo), lean meat stew (zo7o-asho), potato stew (dono-oto), or kocho and greens (santhi)? And bring me clean water.'
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: soollo (injera/flatbread, Gr8 Ch.10 p. 145) + zo7o-asho (lean red meat, Gr8 Ch.3 p. 53) + dono-oto (potato stew, Gr8 Ch.3 p. 53) + geeshsha haatha-a taa-w eh-a (PHR-030).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Phrasebook PHR-023, PHR-029 & PHR-030; Grade 8 Ch. 10 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/160NHNy-4orPcAIk-L5t6tOEtZoWemz_-/view?usp=drivesdk, p. 145: soollo)

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Quumaa mi wurssidaappe guyye, qanxxuwaa oychchanaw ay goo?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ቁኡመአ ሚ ዉርስሲደአፕፔ ጉይዬ፣ ቀንጥጡወአ ኦይችቻነው አይ ጎኦ?
flat_utterances.amharic: ምግቡን በልቼ ከጨረስኩ በኋላ፣ ሂሳቡን ለመጠየቅ ምን ልበል?
flat_utterances.english: After I finish eating the meal, what do I say to ask for the bill?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: quuma-a m-i wurss-idaa-ppe guyye (food-ACC eat-CNV2 finish-PAST.REL-ABL after) + qanxxuwa-a (payment/bill-ACC.M.DEF, MP-10) + oychch-anaw (ask-FUT.PURP).

flat_utterances.subtopic: Ordering Traditional Food & Clean Water at a Sawla Restaurant (Hoteeliya)
flat_utterances.speaker: assistant
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: "Quumay daro mal77ees, kushey anjjetto! Waagay ubbay aappunee?" gada oychcha.
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: "ቁኡመይ ደሮ መልዕዔእስ፣ ኩሼይ አንጅጄትቶ! ወአገይ ኡብበይ አአፕፑኔእ?" ገደ ኦይችቻ።
flat_utterances.amharic: «ምግቡ በጣም ይጣፍጣል፣ እጅ ይባረክ! ዋጋው ሁሉ ስንት ነው?» ብለህ ጠይቅ።
flat_utterances.english: Ask: 'The food is very delicious, may the hand that cooked it be blessed! How much is the total price?'
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: quuma-y daro mal77-ees (food-NOM very be.delicious-PRES.3MS); kushe-y anjj-etto (hand-NOM bless-PASS.JUSS.3MS); waaga-y ubba-y aappun-ee (price-NOM all-NOM how.much-INTER).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Phrasebook PHR-023, PHR-029 & PHR-030; Grade 8 Ch. 10 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/160NHNy-4orPcAIk-L5t6tOEtZoWemz_-/view?usp=drivesdk, p. 145: soollo)

flat_utterances.domain_name: Sawla, Bulqi & Laha Market Bargaining (Giya)
flat_utterances.subtopic: Buying Spices, Garlic (Thuumo), Ginger (Yenjjeelo) & Salt (Maxine)
flat_utterances.speaker: user
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Oto kathanaw suunqqota - thuumo, yenjjeelo, maxinenne berbbere - giyaappe shammanaw koyays.
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ኦቶ ከꬃነው ሱኡንቅቆተ - ꬁኡሞ፣ ዬንጅጄእሎ፣ መጢኔንኔ ቤርብቤሬ - ጊየአፕፔ ሻምመነው ኮየይስ።
flat_utterances.amharic: ወጥ ለማብሰል ቅመማ ቅመሞችን—ነጭ ሽንኩርት (ꬁሞ)፣ ዝንጅብል (ዬንጄሎ)፣ ጨው (ማጢኔ) እና በርበሬ—ከገበያ መግዛት እፈልጋለሁ።
flat_utterances.english: To cook stew, I want to buy spices—garlic (thuumo), ginger (yenjjeelo), salt (maxine), and chili pepper (berbbere)—from the market.
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: oto kath-anaw (stew cook-FUT.PURP) + suunqqo-ta (spice-PL.ACC) + thuumo (garlic, dental fricative th /θ/) + yenjjeelo (ginger) + maxine (salt, ejective x /t'/) + berbbere (pepper).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Sellassie Cheru (2015, Appendix D Lexicon, pp. 375–395); Grade 8 Ch. 3 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/160NHNy-4orPcAIk-L5t6tOEtZoWemz_-/view?usp=drivesdk)

flat_utterances.domain_name: Sawla, Bulqi & Laha Market Bargaining (Giya)
flat_utterances.subtopic: Buying Spices, Garlic (Thuumo), Ginger (Yenjjeelo) & Salt (Maxine)
flat_utterances.speaker: assistant
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Suunqqo giyan maccati thuumuwaa, yenjjeeluwaanne xadduwaa qoriyan bayzzoosona. "Issi qoriya thuumonne na77u qoriya maxine taaw imma" ga.
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ሱኡንቅቆ ጊየን መጭጨቲ ꬁኡሙወአ፣ ዬንጅጄእሉወአንኔ ጠድዱወአ ቆሪየን በይዝዞኦሶነ። "ኢስሲ ቆሪየ ꬁኡሞንኔ ነዕዑ ቆሪየ መጢኔ ተአው ኢምመ" ገ።
flat_utterances.amharic: በቅመም ገበያ ሴቶቹ ነጭ ሽንኩርቱን፣ ዝንጅብሉንና ጤና አዳሙን በመስፈሪያ (ቆሪያ) ይሸጣሉ። «አንድ መስፈሪያ ነጭ ሽንኩርትና ሁለት መስፈሪያ ጨው ስጪኝ» በል።
flat_utterances.english: In the spice market, women sell garlic, ginger, and rue by the measuring cup (qoriya). Say, 'Give me one cup of garlic and two cups of salt.'
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: thuumuwa-a (garlic-ACC.M.DEF, MP-10) + yenjjeeluwa-a-nne (ginger-ACC.M.DEF-COORD) + qoriya-n (measuring.cup-INST) + bayzz-oosona (sell-PRES.3PL).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Sellassie Cheru (2015, Appendix D Lexicon, pp. 375–395); Grade 8 Ch. 3 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/160NHNy-4orPcAIk-L5t6tOEtZoWemz_-/view?usp=drivesdk)

flat_utterances.subtopic: Buying Spices, Garlic (Thuumo), Ginger (Yenjjeelo) & Salt (Maxine)
flat_utterances.speaker: user
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Goofa oysaas gujjettiyaa sawuwaa lo77o suunqqoti awugeetee?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ጎኦፈ ኦይሰአስ ጉጅጄትቲየአ ሰዉወአ ሎዕዖ ሱኡንቅቆቲ አዉጌእቴእ?
flat_utterances.amharic: ለጎፋ ቅቤ ማጣፈጫ የሚጨመሩ ጥሩ መዓዛ ያላቸው ቅመሞች የትኞቹ ናቸው?
flat_utterances.english: Which are the fragrant spices added when clarifying Gofa butter (oysa)?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: Goofa oysa-as (Gofa butter-DAT) + gujj-ett-iyaa (add-PASS-PRES.REL) + sawuwa-a lo77o (aroma-ACC good) + suunqqo-ti (spice-PL.NOM) + awu-geet-ee (which-PL.DEF-INTER).

flat_utterances.domain_name: Sawla, Bulqi & Laha Market Bargaining (Giya)
flat_utterances.subtopic: Buying Spices, Garlic (Thuumo), Ginger (Yenjjeelo) & Salt (Maxine)
flat_utterances.speaker: assistant
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Oysa kathanaw kasho, xaddo, korariimanne yenjjeelo issippe gujjiyaa wode oysaa sawuwaynne mal77oy daro aadhdhees!
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ኦይሰ ከꬃነው ከሾ፣ ጠድዶ፣ ኮረሪኢመንኔ ዬንጅጄእሎ ኢስሲፕፔ ጉጅጂየአ ዎዴ ኦይሰአ ሰዉወይንኔ መልዕዖይ ደሮ አአꬍꬌእስ!
flat_utterances.amharic: ቅቤ ለማንጠር ኮሰረት (ካሾ)፣ ጤና አዳም (ጣዶ)፣ ኮረሪማና ዝንጅብል አንድ ላይ ሲጨመሩ የቅቤው መዓዛና ጣዕም እጅግ ይበልጣል!
flat_utterances.english: When koseret herb (kasho), rue (xaddo), korarima cardamom, and ginger are added together to clarify butter, its aroma and flavor become extraordinary!
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: oysa kath-anaw (butter clarify/boil-FUT.PURP) + gujj-iyaa wode (add-PRES.REL when) + sawuwa-y-nne mal77o-y (aroma-NOM-and taste-NOM) + aadhdh-ees (surpass-PRES.3MS, geminate implosive dhdh).

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Hosppuntho kifile Shemppo 7 giddon "hirayssi" nne "al77o" giyaa phalqqe qaalati de7oosona. Giya haasayan enttana waatada go7ettoo?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ሆስፕፑንꬆ ኪፊሌ ሼምፕፖ ዕ ጊድዶን "ሂረይስሲ" ንኔ "አልዕዖ" ጊየአ ጳልቅቄ ቀአለቲ ዴዖኦሶነ። ጊየ ሀአሰየን እንትተነ ወአተደ ጎዔትቶኦ?
flat_utterances.amharic: በስምንተኛ ክፍል ምዕራፍ 7 ውስጥ «ሂራይሲ» (ርካሽ) እና «አልዕዖ» (ውድ) የሚሉ ተቃራኒ ቃላት አሉ። በገበያ ንግግር ውስጥ እንዴት ልጠቀምባቸው?
flat_utterances.english: In Grade 8 Chapter 7 there are the antonym words 'hirayssi' (cheap) and 'al77o' (expensive/precious). How do I use them in market conversation?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: hirayssi (cheap/inexpensive, Gr8 Ch.7 p. 103) vs. al77o (expensive/precious, ZARA-03 geminate glottal 77=/ʔʔ/); phalqqe qaala-ti (antonym word-PL.NOM, Gr8 Ch.7 p. 111) + go7ett-oo (use-1S.INTER.JUSS).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Grade 8 Goofatho Doona Ch. 7 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/160NHNy-4orPcAIk-L5t6tOEtZoWemz_-/view?usp=drivesdk, p. 111: hirayssi vs. al77o antonyms)

flat_utterances.domain_name: Sawla, Bulqi & Laha Market Bargaining (Giya)
flat_utterances.subtopic: Comparing Cheap (Hirayssi) vs. Expensive (Al77o) Goods in the Market
flat_utterances.speaker: assistant
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Issi miishshi waagay xoqqa gidikko "Ha miishshay daro al77o" gaasa; waagay guutha gidikko qassi "Ha miishshay hirayssi" gaasa.
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ኢስሲ ሚኢሽሺ ወአገይ ጦቅቀ ጊዲክኮ "ሀ ሚኢሽሻይ ደሮ አልዕዖ" ገአሰ፤ ወአገይ ጉኡꬃ ጊዲክኮ ቀስሲ "ሀ ሚኢሽሻይ ሂረይስሲ" ገአሰ።
flat_utterances.amharic: የአንድ ዕቃ ዋጋ ከፍተኛ ከሆነ «ሃ ሚኢሻይ ዳሮ አልዕዖ» (ይህ ዕቃ በጣም ውድ ነው) ትላለህ፤ ዋጋው አነስተኛ ከሆነ ደግሞ «ሃ ሚኢሻይ ሂራይሲ» (ይህ ዕቃ ርካሽ ነው) ትላለህ።
flat_utterances.english: If an item's price is high, you say 'Ha miishshay daro al77o' ('This item is very expensive'); and if the price is low, you say 'Ha miishshay hirayssi' ('This item is inexpensive').
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: xoqqa gid-ikko (high be-COND.REAL) -> al77o; guutha gid-ikko (low/small be-COND.REAL) -> hirayssi; g-aasa (say-PRES.2S.A.DCL).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Grade 8 Goofatho Doona Ch. 7 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/160NHNy-4orPcAIk-L5t6tOEtZoWemz_-/view?usp=drivesdk, p. 111: hirayssi vs. al77o antonyms)

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Kathi cakettiyaa boniyaa wode giyan katthaa waagay hirayssee woykko al77oo?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ከꬂ ጨኬትቲየአ ቦኒየአ ዎዴ ጊየን ከትꬃአ ወአገይ ሂረይስሴእ ዎይክኮ አልዕዖኦ?
flat_utterances.amharic: እህል በሚታጨድበት የበጋ ወቅት በገበያ የእህል ዋጋ ርካሽ ነው ወይስ ውድ?
flat_utterances.english: During the dry harvest season (boniya), is the price of grain in the market cheap or expensive?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: kath-i cak-ett-iyaa boniya-a wode (grain-NOM harvest-PASS-PRES.REL dry.season-GEN time) + kattha-a waaga-y (grain-GEN price-NOM) + hirayss-ee woykko al77-oo (cheap-INTER or expensive-INTER).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Grade 8 Goofatho Doona Ch. 7 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/160NHNy-4orPcAIk-L5t6tOEtZoWemz_-/view?usp=drivesdk, p. 111: hirayssi vs. al77o antonyms)

flat_utterances.domain_name: Sawla, Bulqi & Laha Market Bargaining (Giya)
flat_utterances.subtopic: Comparing Cheap (Hirayssi) vs. Expensive (Al77o) Goods in the Market
flat_utterances.speaker: assistant
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Kathi cakettiyaa wode giyan katthay daro shiiqiyaa gishshaw waagay hirayssi gidees; zerethi zerettiyaa balgguwan qassi al77o gidees.
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ከꬂ ጨኬትቲየአ ዎዴ ጊየን ከትꬃይ ደሮ ሺኢቂየአ ጊሽሻው ወአገይ ሂረይስሲ ጊዴእስ፤ ዜሬꬂ ዜሬትቲየአ በልግጉወን ቀስሲ አልዕዖ ጊዴእስ።
flat_utterances.amharic: እህል በሚታጨድበት ወቅት በገበያ እህል በብዛት ስለሚቀርብ ዋጋው ርካሽ ይሆናል፤ ዘር በሚዘራበት ክረምት ደግሞ ውድ ይሆናል።
flat_utterances.english: During harvest time, because grain is abundant in the market, the price becomes inexpensive (hirayssi); whereas during the rainy planting season (balgguwa), it becomes expensive (al77o).
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: daro shiiq-iyaa gishshaw (abundantly gather/supply-PRES.REL because) + hirayssi gid-ees (cheap become-PRES.3MS); balgguwa-n (rainy.season-LOC, MP-10) + al77o gid-ees.
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Grade 8 Goofatho Doona Ch. 7 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/160NHNy-4orPcAIk-L5t6tOEtZoWemz_-/view?usp=drivesdk, p. 111: hirayssi vs. al77o antonyms)

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Tammantho kifile Shemppo 2nne Sellassie Cheru (2015) giddon "meddaawaynne meddaayiya soofe bidosona" geetettees. "Soofe" giyay aybee?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ተምመንꬆ ኪፊሌ ሼምፕፖ 2ንኔ ሴልለስሲእ ቼሩ (2015) ጊድዶን "ሜድደአወይንኔ ሜድደአዪየ ሶኦፌ ቢዶሶነ" ጌእቴትቴእስ። "ሶኦፌ" ጊየይ አይቤእ?
flat_utterances.amharic: በአሥረኛ ክፍል ምዕራፍ 2 እና በSellassie Cheru (2015) ውስጥ «ሜዳዋይኔ ሜዳዪያ ሶፌ ቢዶሶና» ይባላል። «ሶፌ» ገበያ ምንድን ነው?
flat_utterances.english: In Grade 10 Chapter 2 and Sellassie Cheru (2015), it says 'meddaawaynne meddaayiya soofe bidosona'. What is the 'soofe' market outing?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: meddaawa-y-nne (groom-NOM.M.DEF-COORD) + meddaay-iya (bride-NOM.F.DEF < meddaayo + -e-j-a, MP-09/10) + soofe (pre-wedding market festival) + b-idosona (go-PAST.3PL.A.DCL, IGT-04).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Grade 10 Goofatho Doona Ch. 2 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/1mKIcfMoMgnZ9Pa657NWmE-OGND2wlveM/view?usp=drivesdk, pp. 12–14: Soofe market outing); Sellassie Cheru (2015, p. 116 IGT-04)

flat_utterances.subtopic: Pre-Wedding Celebratory Market Outing (Soofe Giya)
flat_utterances.speaker: assistant
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Tammantho kifile maxaafaa (p. 12) maaran, "soofe" guussay yaaganoppe issi saaminttaappe kase geela7iyaa ba laggetara lo77o ma7o ma77ada giyaa keyidi yuuyiyaa ufayssa woga.
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ተምመንꬆ ኪፊሌ መጠአፈአ (ፕ። 12) መአረን፣ "ሶኦፌ" ጉኡስሰይ የአገኖፕፔ ኢስሲ ሰአሚንትተአፕፔ ከሴ ጌእለዒየአ በ ለግጌተረ ሎዕዖ መዖ መዕዓደ ጊየአ ኬዪዲ ዩኡዪየአ ኡፈይስሰ ዎገ።
flat_utterances.amharic: በአሥረኛ ክፍል መጽሐፍ (ገጽ 12) መሠረት፣ «ሶፌ» ማለት ከሠርግ አንድ ሳምንት በፊት ሙሽሪት ከጓደኞቿ ጋር ያማረ ልብስ ለብሳ ወደ ገበያ ወጥታ የምትዞርበት የደስታ ባህላዊ ሥርዓት ነው።
flat_utterances.english: According to the Grade 10 textbook (p. 12), 'soofe' is the joyous custom one week before the wedding (yaagano) where the bride-to-be dresses in fine attire and processes through the market with her friends.
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: yaagano-ppe (wedding-ABL) + issi saaminttaa-ppe kase (one week-ABL before) + geela7-iyaa (maiden/bride-NOM.F.DEF, ZARA-03 7) + ma77-ada (wear-CNV1.ANT.3FS) + giya-a key-idi (market-ACC go.out-CNV2.ANT).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Grade 10 Goofatho Doona Ch. 2 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/1mKIcfMoMgnZ9Pa657NWmE-OGND2wlveM/view?usp=drivesdk, pp. 12–14: Soofe market outing); Sellassie Cheru (2015, p. 116 IGT-04)

flat_utterances.amharic: በሶፌ ገበያ ቀን የሙሽሪት ጓደኞች በገበያ ውስጥ ምን ያደርጋሉ?
flat_utterances.english: On the day of the soofe market outing, what do the bride's friends do in the market?

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Entti woga yetthaa yexxishe, suunqqonne alleeqo shammishe, giyaa asaara ufayssan sarotettishe ooloosona.
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: እንትቲ ዎገ ዬትꬃአ ዬጥጢሼ፣ ሱኡንቅቆንኔ አልሌእቆ ሻምሚሼ፣ ጊየአ አሰአረ ኡፈይስሰን ሰሮቴትቲሼ ኦኦሎኦሶነ።
flat_utterances.amharic: እነርሱም ባህላዊ ዘፈን እየዘፈኑ፣ ቅመማ ቅመምና ጌጣጌጥ እየገዙ፣ ከገበያው ሕዝብ ጋር በደስታ ሰላምታ እየተለዋወጡ ይውላሉ።
flat_utterances.english: They spend the day singing traditional songs, buying spices and ornaments (alleeqo), and joyfully exchanging greetings with the market people.
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: woga yettha-a yexx-ishe (traditional song-ACC sing-CNV.SIM) + shamm-ishe (buy-CNV.SIM) + sarot-ett-ishe (greet-RECIP-CNV.SIM) + ool-oosona (spend.day-PRES.3PL.A.DCL).

flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ሰዉለን ዎገ መዖ ሲክኪየአ ኬእꬃን ኦኦረꬃ ጎኦፈ ቀሚኢሴ ሲክኪስሰነው ኮየይስ። ወአተደ ሀአሰዮኦ?

flat_utterances.english: At a traditional tailoring shop in Sawla, I want to have a new Gofa dress sewn. How should I speak with the tailor?

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Sikkanchchaakko: "Saro! Dungguzaara gahettida Goofa woga qamiise taassi sikkarkkii? Awde wurssanee?" gada oychcha.
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ሲክከንችቻአክኮ፦ "ሰሮ! ዱንግጉዘአረ ገሄትቲደ ጎኦፈ ዎገ ቀሚኢሴ ተአስሲ ሲክከርክኪኢ? አውዴ ዉርስሰኔእ?" ገደ ኦይችቻ።
flat_utterances.amharic: ልብስ ሰፊውን፦ «ሰላም! ከዱንጉዛ ጋር የተዋሐደ የጎፋ ባህላዊ ቀሚስ ትሰፋልኛለህ? መቼ ትጨርሳለህ?» ብለህ ጠይቅ።
flat_utterances.english: Ask the tailor: 'Hello! Could you sew a traditional Gofa dress trimmed with dungguza border for me? When will you finish it?'
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: sikkanchchaa-kko (tailor-DIR < sikk- 'sew' + -anchcha) + gah-ett-ida (join-PASS-PAST.REL) + sikk-arkkii (sew-2S.POT.INTER); awde wurss-anee (when finish-FUT.2S.INTER).

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Ta bolla keenaa ekkidi, saaminttan giigissana giikko waagaa baggaa ha77i qanxxoo?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ተ ቦልለ ኬእነአ እክኪዲ፣ ሰአሚንትተን ጊኢጊስሰነ ጊኢክኮ ወአገአ በግገአ ሀዕዒ ቀንጥጦኦ?
flat_utterances.amharic: የሰውነቴን ልክ ወስዶ በሳምንት አዘጋጃለሁ ካለ፣ የዋጋውን ግማሽ አሁን ልክፈል?
flat_utterances.english: Once he takes my measurements and says he will have it ready in a week, should I pay half the price now?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: ta bolla keena-a (my body measure-ACC) + ekk-idi (take-CNV2.ANT) + giig-iss-ana g-ikko (prepare-CAUS-FUT say-COND.REAL) + waagaa bagga-a (price half-ACC) + qanxx-oo (pay-1S.INTER.JUSS).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Grade 9 Goofatho Doona Ch. 9 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/1uvGaBT4-O_Jn7oQbuNl1W88lFBFiHULU/view?usp=drivesdk, p. 78: woga ma7o sikkiyaa keetha)

flat_utterances.domain_name: Sawla, Bulqi & Laha Market Bargaining (Giya)
flat_utterances.subtopic: Tailor & Seamstress Shop: Ordering Custom Traditional Dress (Sikkiyaa Keetha)
flat_utterances.speaker: assistant
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Ee! "Ha77i qabduwaa baggaa qanxxays; ma7uwaa ekkiyaa galla attidaagaa qanxxana" gada wogara giigetta.
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: እእ! "ሀዕዒ ቀብዱወአ በግገአ ቀንጥጠይስ፤ መዑወአ እክኪየአ ገልለ አትቲደአገአ ቀንጥጠነ" ገደ ዎገረ ጊኢጌትተ።
flat_utterances.amharic: አዎ! «አሁን ቀብዱን ግማሹን እከፍላለሁ፤ ልብሱን በምወስድበት ቀን ቀሪውን እከፍላለሁ» ብለህ በሥርዓት ተስማማ።
flat_utterances.english: Yes! Agree properly by saying, 'I am paying half as a deposit now; on the day I pick up the garment, I will pay the remainder.'
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: bagga-a qanxx-ays (half-ACC pay-PRES.1S); ma7uwa-a ekk-iyaa galla (garment-ACC.M.DEF take-PRES.REL day) + att-ida-agaa (remain-PAST.REL-NMZ.ACC) + qanxx-ana (pay-FUT.1S).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Grade 9 Goofatho Doona Ch. 9 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/1uvGaBT4-O_Jn7oQbuNl1W88lFBFiHULU/view?usp=drivesdk, p. 78: woga ma7o sikkiyaa keetha)

flat_utterances.subtopic: Evening Market Wrap-Up & Accounting Daily Sales (Zal77e Qoodo)
flat_utterances.speaker: user
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Hachchi giyan daabbuwaa, maathaanne eessaa bayzzada wurssadis. Gallassa demishaanne tirfiyaa Goofatho doonan waatada qoodoo?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ሀችቺ ጊየን ደአብቡወአ፣ መአꬃአንኔ እእስሰአ በይዝዘደ ዉርስሰዲስ። ገልለስሰ ዴሚሻአንኔ ቲርፊየአ ጎኦፈꬆ ዶኦነን ወአተደ ቆኦዶኦ?
flat_utterances.amharic: ዛሬ በገበያ ዳቦ፣ ወተትና ማር ሸጬ ጨረስኩ። የቀኑን ገቢና ትርፍ በጎፋኛ እንዴት ልቁጠር?
flat_utterances.english: Today at the market I finished selling bread, milk, and honey. How do I calculate the day's revenue (demisha) and profit in Gofatho?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: daabbuwa-a (bread-ACC.M.DEF), maatha-a-nne (milk-ACC-and), eessa-a (honey-ACC) + bayzz-ada (sell-CNV1.ANT.1S) + wurss-adis (finish-PAST.1S); gallassa demisha-a-nne (daily income-ACC-and, Gr9 Ch.2 p. 12) + qood-oo (count-1S.INTER.JUSS).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Grade 9 Goofatho Doona Ch. 2 & Grade 10 Ch. 9 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/1uvGaBT4-O_Jn7oQbuNl1W88lFBFiHULU/view?usp=drivesdk, p. 12: qaye bira, demisha; https://drive.google.com/file/d/1mKIcfMoMgnZ9Pa657NWmE-OGND2wlveM/view?usp=drivesdk, p. 81)

flat_utterances.speaker: assistant
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Koyro hachchi gelida "qaye bira" ubbaa qooda; hessaappe koyro baasida waagaa kessiyaa wode geeshsha tirfey beettees.
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ኮይሮ ሀችቺ ጌሊደ "ቀዬ ቢረ" ኡብበአ ቆኦደ፤ ሄስሰአፕፔ ኮይሮ በአሲደ ወአገአ ኬስሲየአ ዎዴ ጌእሽሻ ቲርፌይ ቤእትቴእስ።
flat_utterances.amharic: በመጀመሪያ ዛሬ የገባውን «ቃዬ ቢራ» (ጥሬ ገንዘብ / ጠቅላላ ገቢ) ሁሉ ቁጠር፤ ከዚያ ላይ መጀመሪያ ያወጣኸውን ወጪ ስትቀንስ የተጣራ ትርፍ ይገኛል።
flat_utterances.english: First count all the liquid cash ('qaye bira' / revenue, Gr9 Ch.2 p. 12) received today; when you subtract the initial cost from that, the net profit is found.
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: qaye bira (liquid cash/currency, Gr9 Ch.2 p. 12) + ubba-a qood-a (all-ACC count-IMP.2S); hessaa-ppe (that-ABL) + kess-iyaa wode (subtract/take.out-PRES.REL when) + beett-ees (be.found-PRES.3MS < be7- + -ett-).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Grade 9 Goofatho Doona Ch. 2 & Grade 10 Ch. 9 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/1uvGaBT4-O_Jn7oQbuNl1W88lFBFiHULU/view?usp=drivesdk, p. 12: qaye bira, demisha; https://drive.google.com/file/d/1mKIcfMoMgnZ9Pa657NWmE-OGND2wlveM/view?usp=drivesdk, p. 81)

flat_utterances.speaker: user
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Demishaappe baggaa baankkiyan dagayada baggaara wontto giyaas miishsha shammanaw qoppays.
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ዴሚሻአፕፔ በግገአ በአንክኪየን ደገየደ በግገአረ ዎንትቶ ጊየአስ ሚኢሽሻ ሻምመነው ቆፕፐይስ።
flat_utterances.amharic: ከገቢው ግማሹን በባንክ ቆጥቤ በግማሹ ነገ ለገበያ ዕቃ ለመግዛት አስባለሁ።
flat_utterances.english: I plan to save half of the income in the bank and buy goods for tomorrow's market with the other half.
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: demishaa-ppe bagga-a (income-ABL half-ACC) + baankkiya-n (bank-LOC) + dagay-ada (save/store-CNV1.ANT.1S, PHR-051) + baggaa-ra (half-INST) + shamm-anaw (buy-FUT.PURP) + qopp-ays (think/plan-PRES.1S).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Grade 9 Goofatho Doona Ch. 2 & Grade 10 Ch. 9 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/1uvGaBT4-O_Jn7oQbuNl1W88lFBFiHULU/view?usp=drivesdk, p. 12: qaye bira, demisha; https://drive.google.com/file/d/1mKIcfMoMgnZ9Pa657NWmE-OGND2wlveM/view?usp=drivesdk, p. 81)
