flat_utterances.speaker: assistant
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Hegee cincca zal77anchcha qofa! Miishsha dagayoynne dabtteren xaafidi oyqqoy ne zal77iyaa eesuwan dichchees.
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ሄጌእ ጪንጭጨ ዘልዕዓንችቻ ቆፈ! ሚኢሽሻ ደገዮይንኔ ደብትቴሬን ጠአፊዲ ኦይቅቆይ ኔ ዘልዕዒየአ እእሱወን ዲችቼእስ።
flat_utterances.amharic: ይህ የብልህ ነጋዴ ሐሳብ ነው! ገንዘብ መቆጠብና በደብተር ጽፎ መያዝ ንግድህን በፍጥነት ያሳድገዋል።
flat_utterances.english: That is the thought of a wise merchant! Saving money and keeping written records in a notebook will rapidly grow your business.
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: cincca zal77anchcha qofa (wise merchant thought); miishsha dagayo-y-nne (money saving-NOM-and) + xaaf-idi oyqqo-y (write-CNV2 keeping-NOM) + dichch-ees (grow.CAUS-PRES.3MS).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Grade 9 Goofatho Doona Ch. 2 & Grade 10 Ch. 9 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/1uvGaBT4-O_Jn7oQbuNl1W88lFBFiHULU/view?usp=drivesdk, p. 12: qaye bira, demisha; https://drive.google.com/file/d/1mKIcfMoMgnZ9Pa657NWmE-OGND2wlveM/view?usp=drivesdk, p. 81)

flat_utterances.domain_name: Primary Healthcare & Maternal/Clinic Triage (Aakime Keethi)
flat_utterances.subtopic: Outpatient Clinic Registration & Headache/Fever Triage
flat_utterances.speaker: user
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Saro! Zine omarssappe doommidi ta huuphey daro sakkees, bollaykka mishuxan ho77ees.
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ሰሮ! ዚኔ ኦመርስሰፕፔ ዶኦምሚዲ ተ ሁኡጴይ ደሮ ሰክኬእስ፣ ቦልለይክከ ሚሹጠን ሆዕዔእስ።
flat_utterances.amharic: ሰላም! ከትናንት ማታ ጀምሮ ራሴን በጣም ያመኛል፣ ሰውነቴም በትኩሳት ይሞቃል።
flat_utterances.english: Hello! Since yesterday evening my head hurts very much, and my body is hot with fever.
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: zine omarssa-ppe doomm-idi (yesterday evening-ABL start-CNV2.ANT) + ta huuphe-y (my head-NOM) + daro sakk-ees (very ache-PRES.3MS, PHR-032); bolla-y-kka (body-NOM-ADD) + mishuxa-n (fever-INST, PHR-038) + ho77-ees (be.hot-PRES.3MS, ZARA-03 77).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Phrasebook PHR-031 to PHR-041; Grade 8 Ch. 1 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/160NHNy-4orPcAIk-L5t6tOEtZoWemz_-/view?usp=drivesdk, p. 11: Aakime keethi)

flat_utterances.domain_name: Primary Healthcare & Maternal/Clinic Triage (Aakime Keethi)
flat_utterances.subtopic: Outpatient Clinic Registration & Headache/Fever Triage
flat_utterances.speaker: assistant
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Saro! Mishuxaynne huuphe sakkoy shekkeere woykko gunfana gidanaw dandda7ees. Suuthaa qoraphiyanaw eesuwan aakime keethi ba; cenggurssaykka qaxettii?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ሰሮ! ሚሹጠይንኔ ሁኡጴ ሰክኮይ ሼክኬእሬ ዎይክኮ ጉንፈነ ጊደነው ደንድደዔእስ። ሱኡꬃአ ቆረጪየነው እእሱወን አአኪሜ ኬእꬂ በ፤ ጬንግጉርስሰይክከ ቀጤትቲኢ?
flat_utterances.amharic: ሰላም! ትኩሳትና የራስ ምታት የወባ ወይም የጉንፋን ምልክት ሊሆን ይችላል። ደም ለመመርመር በፍጥነት ወደ ሐኪም ቤት ሂድ፤ ጉሮሮህንም ይቆርጥሃል?
flat_utterances.english: Hello! Fever and headache can be signs of malaria (shekkeere) or flu. Go quickly to the clinic to have your blood tested; does your throat also ache?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: mishuxa-y-nne huuphe sakko-y (fever-NOM-and head ache-NOM) + suutha-a qoraph-iyanaw (blood-ACC examine-FUT.PURP, PHR-041) + aakime keethi ba (clinic go.IMP.2S).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Phrasebook PHR-031 to PHR-041; Grade 8 Ch. 1 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/160NHNy-4orPcAIk-L5t6tOEtZoWemz_-/view?usp=drivesdk, p. 11: Aakime keethi)

flat_utterances.domain_name: Primary Healthcare & Maternal/Clinic Triage (Aakime Keethi)
flat_utterances.subtopic: Outpatient Clinic Registration & Headache/Fever Triage
flat_utterances.speaker: user
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Cenggurssay sakkenna, shin dadaay tana oykkees. Sawula aakime keethan suuthaa qoraphoy de7ii?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ጬንግጉርስሰይ ሰክኬንነ፣ ሺን ደደአይ ተነ ኦይክኬእስ። ሰዉለ አአኪሜ ኬእꬃን ሱኡꬃአ ቆረፆይ ዴዒኢ?
flat_utterances.amharic: ጉሮሮዬን አያመኝም፣ ግን ብርድ ብርድ ይለኛል። በሳውላ ሐኪም ቤት የደም ምርመራ አለ?
flat_utterances.english: My throat does not hurt, but chills have seized me. Is blood testing available at the Sawla clinic?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: sakk-enna (ache-PRES.3MS.NEG) + shin (but) + dadaa-y (chills/shivering-NOM) + tana oykk-ees (1S.ACC seize-PRES.3MS); suuthaa qorapho-y de7-ii (blood test-NOM exist-PRES.3MS.INTER).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Phrasebook PHR-031 to PHR-041; Grade 8 Ch. 1 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/160NHNy-4orPcAIk-L5t6tOEtZoWemz_-/view?usp=drivesdk, p. 11: Aakime keethi)

flat_utterances.domain_name: Primary Healthcare & Maternal/Clinic Triage (Aakime Keethi)
flat_utterances.subtopic: Outpatient Clinic Registration & Headache/Fever Triage
flat_utterances.speaker: assistant
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Ee, Sawula Hospitaaliyaninne xenaa xaabiyan eesuwaa suuthaa qoraphoy de7ees. Aakimey immiyaa xaliyaa saate naagada uya, haathaakka daro uya!
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: እእ፣ ሰዉለ ሆስፒተአሊየኒንኔ ጤነአ ጠአቢየን እእሱወአ ሱኡꬃአ ቆረፆይ ዴዔእስ። አአኪሜይ ኢምሚየአ ጠሊየአ ሰአቴ ነአገደ ኡየ፣ ሀአꬃአክከ ደሮ ኡየ!
flat_utterances.amharic: አዎ፣ በሳውላ ሆስፒታልና በጤና ጣቢያው ፈጣን የደም ምርመራ አለ። ሐኪሙ የሚሰጥህን መድኃኒት ሰዓት ጠብቀህ ዋጥ፣ ውኃም በብዛት ጠጣ!
flat_utterances.english: Yes, rapid blood testing is available at Sawla Hospital and the health center. Take the medicine prescribed by the doctor on time, and drink plenty of water!
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: aakime-y imm-iyaa xaliya-a (doctor-NOM give-PRES.REL medicine-ACC, PHR-034) + saate naag-ada (hour keep-CNV1.ANT.2S) + uy-a (drink/take-IMP.2S, PHR-035).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Phrasebook PHR-031 to PHR-041; Grade 8 Ch. 1 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/160NHNy-4orPcAIk-L5t6tOEtZoWemz_-/view?usp=drivesdk, p. 11: Aakime keethi)

flat_utterances.domain_name: Primary Healthcare & Maternal/Clinic Triage (Aakime Keethi)
flat_utterances.subtopic: Pediatric Fever, Diarrhea & Oral Rehydration (Na7a Payyatetha)
flat_utterances.speaker: user
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Ta guutha na7aa uloy sakkeesinne haathaa gussees. Aakime keethi gakkanaashin soon ay oothoo?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ተ ጉኡꬃ ነዓአ ኡሎይ ሰክኬእሲንኔ ሀአꬃአ ጉስሴእስ። አአኪሜ ኬእꬂ ገክከነአሺን ሶኦን አይ ኦኦꬆኦ?
flat_utterances.amharic: የትንሽ ልጄ ሆድ ያመዋል እንዲሁም ተቅማጥ አለው። ሐኪም ቤት እስክደርስ በቤት ውስጥ ምን ላድርግ?
flat_utterances.english: My young child has a stomachache and diarrhea. Until I reach the clinic, what should I do at home?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: ta guutha na7a-a ulo-y (my young child-GEN stomach-NOM, ZARA-03 7) + sakk-ees-inne (ache-PRES.3MS-and, PHR-033); aakime keethi gakk-anaashin (clinic reach-UNTIL) + soo-n ay ooth-oo (home-LOC what do-1S.INTER.JUSS).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Phrasebook PHR-033, PHR-038 & PHR-042; Grade 8 Ch. 10 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/160NHNy-4orPcAIk-L5t6tOEtZoWemz_-/view?usp=drivesdk, p. 145)

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Na7aa bollan haathay dhayonna mala, ORS kathidi qoraphphan qoraphphan ushsha; aayee dhanththaakka aggonnaan dhanththissa!
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ነዓአ ቦልለን ሀአꬃይ ꬋዮንነ መለ፣ ኦርስ ከꬂዲ ቆረጵጳን ቆረጵጳን ኡሽሻ፤ አአዬእ ꬋንꬅꬃአክከ አግጎንነአን ꬋንꬅꬂስሰ!
flat_utterances.amharic: ከልጁ ሰውነት ውኃ እንዳያልቅ፣ ኦአርኤስ (የሕይወት አድን ጨው) በጥብጠህ ጥቂት በጥቂቱ አጠጣው፤ የእናት ጡትም ሳታቋርጪ አጥቢው!
flat_utterances.english: So that the child does not become dehydrated, mix ORS (oral rehydration salts) with clean water and give sips frequently; also continue breastfeeding without stopping!
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: na7a-a bolla-n (child-GEN body-LOC) + haatha-y dhay-onna mala (water-NOM disappear-NEG.PURP) + ushsh-a (drink.CAUS-IMP.2S, MP-04/05 < uy- + -iss-); dhanthth-iss-a (suckle-CAUS-IMP.2S).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Phrasebook PHR-033, PHR-038 & PHR-042; Grade 8 Ch. 10 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/160NHNy-4orPcAIk-L5t6tOEtZoWemz_-/view?usp=drivesdk, p. 145)

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Hargganchcha na7aa geday "kana siidhe gidis"; hegee wolqqaama malaatee?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ሀርግገንችቻ ነዓአ ጌደይ "ከነ ሲኢꬌ ጊዲስ"፤ ሄጌእ ዎልቅቀአመ መለአቴእ?
flat_utterances.amharic: የታመመው ልጅ እግር «ካና ሲኢꬌ ጊዲስ» (እንደ ውሻ አፍንጫ በጣም ቀዘቀዘ)፤ ይህ የከባድ ሕመም ምልክት ነው?
flat_utterances.english: The sick child's foot has become ice-cold ('kana siidhe gidis'); is that a danger sign?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: hargganchcha na7a-a geda-y (sick child-GEN foot-NOM) + kana siidhe gid-is (idiom: became a dog's nose = ice-cold, Gr8 Ch.10 p. 145) + wolqqaama malaat-ee (serious sign-INTER).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Phrasebook PHR-033, PHR-038 & PHR-042; Grade 8 Ch. 10 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/160NHNy-4orPcAIk-L5t6tOEtZoWemz_-/view?usp=drivesdk, p. 145)

flat_utterances.domain_name: Primary Healthcare & Maternal/Clinic Triage (Aakime Keethi)
flat_utterances.subtopic: Pediatric Fever, Diarrhea & Oral Rehydration (Na7a Payyatetha)
flat_utterances.speaker: assistant
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Ee! Geday irxxoynne ayfey xuummoy wolqqaama haatha dhayo malaata. Na7aa ho77o ma7on xaaxada ha77i eesuwan aakime keethi efa!
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: እእ! ጌደይ ኢርጥጦይንኔ አይፌይ ጡኡምሞይ ዎልቅቀአመ ሀአꬃ ꬋዮ መለአተ። ነዓአ ሆዕዖ መዖን ጠአጠደ ሀዕዒ እእሱወን አአኪሜ ኬእꬂ እፈ!
flat_utterances.amharic: አዎ! የእግር መቀዝቀዝና የዓይን መሰርጎድ የከፍተኛ ውኃ ማነስ ምልክት ነው። ልጁን በሙቅ ልብስ ጠቅልለህ አሁኑኑ በፍጥነት ወደ ሐኪም ቤት ውሰደው!
flat_utterances.english: Yes! Cold extremities and sunken eyes are signs of severe dehydration. Wrap the child in a warm cloth and take him to the clinic immediately!
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: geda-y irxxo-y-nne (foot-NOM coldness-NOM-and) + ho77o ma7o-n (warm cloth-INST) + xaax-ada (wrap-CNV1.ANT.2S) + eesuwa-n (quickly-INST) + ef-a (take-IMP.2S).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Phrasebook PHR-033, PHR-038 & PHR-042; Grade 8 Ch. 10 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/160NHNy-4orPcAIk-L5t6tOEtZoWemz_-/view?usp=drivesdk, p. 145)

flat_utterances.speaker: user
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Ta machchiyaa shahaara gidadasu. Aakime keethan shahaara aayee kaalluwaa awde doommanaw bessii?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ተ መችቺየአ ሻሀአረ ጊደደሱ። አአኪሜ ኬእꬃን ሻሀአረ አአዬእ ከአልሉወአ አውዴ ዶኦምመነው ቤስሲኢ?
flat_utterances.amharic: ባለቤቴ ነፍሰ ጡር ሆናለች። በሐኪም ቤት የነፍሰ ጡር እናቶች ክትትል መቼ መጀመር ይገባል?
flat_utterances.english: My wife is pregnant. When should antenatal care follow-up begin at the clinic?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: ta machch-iyaa (my wife-NOM.F.DEF, MP-09/10) + shahaara (pregnant) + gid-adasu (become-PAST.3FS.A.DCL); shahaara aayee kaalluwa-a (pregnant mother follow.up-ACC.M.DEF) + awde doomm-anaw bess-ii (when start-FUT.PURP ought-PRES.3MS.INTER).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Phrasebook PHR-039, PHR-041 & PHR-043; Grade 10 Ch. 3 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/1mKIcfMoMgnZ9Pa657NWmE-OGND2wlveM/view?usp=drivesdk, p. 20)

flat_utterances.domain_name: Primary Healthcare & Maternal/Clinic Triage (Aakime Keethi)
flat_utterances.subtopic: Maternal Antenatal Care (ANC) & Nutrition for Expectant Mothers
flat_utterances.speaker: assistant
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Shahaara gididoogaa eridoogaara koyro aginaappe doommidi aakime keethi baanaw bessees. Aakimey suuthaa, suutha sugiyaanne na7aa dichchaa qoraphphees.
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ሻሀአረ ጊዲዶኦገአ እሪዶኦገአረ ኮይሮ አጊነአፕፔ ዶኦምሚዲ አአኪሜ ኬእꬂ በአነው ቤስሴእስ። አአኪሜይ ሱኡꬃአ፣ ሱኡꬃ ሱጊየአንኔ ነዓአ ዲችቻአ ቆረጵጴእስ።
flat_utterances.amharic: ነፍሰ ጡር መሆኗ እንደታወቀ ከመጀመሪያው ወር ጀምሮ ወደ ሐኪም ቤት መሄድ ይገባል። ሐኪሙ ደም፣ የደም ግፊትና የጽንሱን ዕድገት ይመረምራል።
flat_utterances.english: As soon as pregnancy is known, she should go to the clinic starting from the first month. The doctor examines blood levels, blood pressure, and the baby's growth.
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: koyro aginaa-ppe doomm-idi (first month-ABL start-CNV2.ANT) + ba-anaw bess-ees (go-FUT.PURP ought-PRES.3MS); suutha-a (blood-ACC) + na7a-a dichcha-a (child-GEN growth-ACC) + qoraphph-ees (examine-PRES.3MS).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Phrasebook PHR-039, PHR-041 & PHR-043; Grade 10 Ch. 3 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/1mKIcfMoMgnZ9Pa657NWmE-OGND2wlveM/view?usp=drivesdk, p. 20)

flat_utterances.domain_name: Primary Healthcare & Maternal/Clinic Triage (Aakime Keethi)
flat_utterances.subtopic: Maternal Antenatal Care (ANC) & Nutrition for Expectant Mothers
flat_utterances.speaker: user
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Shahaara aayiyaa soon ayba quma maanawanne ayba oosoppe naagettanaw bessii?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ሻሀአረ አአዪየአ ሶኦን አይበ ቁመ መአነወንኔ አይበ ኦኦሶፕፔ ነአጌትተነው ቤስሲኢ?
flat_utterances.amharic: ነፍሰ ጡር እናት በቤት ውስጥ ምን ዓይነት ምግብ መመገብና ከምን ዓይነት ሥራ መጠንቀቅ ይገባታል?
flat_utterances.english: What kind of nutritious food should an expectant mother eat at home, and what kind of work should she avoid?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: shahaara aay-iyaa (pregnant mother-NOM.F.DEF) + ayba quma ma-anaw-anne (what food eat-FUT.PURP-and) + ayba ooso-ppe naag-ett-anaw (what work-ABL guard-REFL-FUT.PURP) + bess-ii (ought-PRES.3MS.INTER).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Phrasebook PHR-039, PHR-041 & PHR-043; Grade 10 Ch. 3 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/1mKIcfMoMgnZ9Pa657NWmE-OGND2wlveM/view?usp=drivesdk, p. 20)

flat_utterances.domain_name: Primary Healthcare & Maternal/Clinic Triage (Aakime Keethi)
flat_utterances.subtopic: Maternal Antenatal Care (ANC) & Nutrition for Expectant Mothers
flat_utterances.speaker: assistant
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Santhi, uphpha, maatha, atare, muzenne geeshsha haatha daro maanaw bessees; qassi deexo tooho tookkoppa, aakimey immiyaa birata xaliyaa ubba galla uya!
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ሰንꬂ፣ ኡጵጳ፣ መአꬃ፣ አተሬ፣ ሙዜንኔ ጌእሽሻ ሀአꬃ ደሮ መአነው ቤስሴእስ፤ ቀስሲ ዴእጦ ቶኦሆ ቶኦክኮፕፐ፣ አአኪሜይ ኢምሚየአ ቢረተ ጠሊየአ ኡብበ ገልለ ኡየ!
flat_utterances.amharic: ጎመን፣ እንቁላል፣ ወተት፣ አተር፣ ሙዝና ንጹሕ ውኃ በብዛት መመገብ ይገባል፤ ደግሞም ከባድ ሸክም አትሸከም፣ ሐኪሙ የሚሰጣትን የደም ማነስ መድኃኒት (አይረን) በየቀኑ ትዋጥ!
flat_utterances.english: She should eat plenty of greens, eggs, milk, peas, bananas, and clean water; she should not carry heavy loads, and should take the iron/folate tablets given by the clinic every day!
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: deexo tooho (heavy load) + tookk-oppa (carry-PROH.2S); aakime-y imm-iyaa birata xaliya-a (doctor-NOM give-PRES.REL iron medicine-ACC) + ubba galla uy-a (every day take-IMP.2S).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Phrasebook PHR-039, PHR-041 & PHR-043; Grade 10 Ch. 3 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/1mKIcfMoMgnZ9Pa657NWmE-OGND2wlveM/view?usp=drivesdk, p. 20)

flat_utterances.subtopic: Respiratory Illness, Lung Health (Goofina) & COVID-19/Flu Prevention
flat_utterances.speaker: user
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Uddufuntho kifile Shemppo 7 giddon "goofina", "kilaho" nne "doona gultte" giyaa payyatetha qaalati de7oosona. Entta birshshethay aybee?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ኡድዱፉንꬆ ኪፊሌ ሼምፕፖ ዕ ጊድዶን "ጎኦፊነ"፣ "ኪለሆ" ንኔ "ዶኦነ ጉልትቴ" ጊየአ ፐይየቴꬃ ቀአለቲ ዴዖኦሶነ። እንትተ ቢርሽሼꬃይ አይቤእ?
flat_utterances.amharic: በዘጠነኛ ክፍል ምዕራፍ 7 ውስጥ «ጎፊና»፣ «ኪላሆ» እና «ዶና ጉልቴ» የሚሉ የጤና ቃላት አሉ። ትርጉማቸው ምንድን ነው?
flat_utterances.english: In Grade 9 Chapter 7 there are the medical terms 'goofina', 'kilaho', and 'doona gultte'. What are their meanings?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: goofina (lung, Gr9 Ch.7 p. 59), kilaho (kidney, Gr9 Ch.7 p. 59), doona gultte (face mask: mouth cover, Gr9 Ch.7 p. 60); entta birshshetha-y ayb-ee (their meaning-NOM what-INTER).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Grade 9 Goofatho Doona Ch. 7 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/1uvGaBT4-O_Jn7oQbuNl1W88lFBFiHULU/view?usp=drivesdk, pp. 54–64: Kovide-19, goofina, kilaho, doona gultte)

flat_utterances.domain_name: Primary Healthcare & Maternal/Clinic Triage (Aakime Keethi)
flat_utterances.subtopic: Respiratory Illness, Lung Health (Goofina) & COVID-19/Flu Prevention
flat_utterances.speaker: assistant
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Uddufuntho kifile maxaafaa (p. 59-60) maaran: "goofina" guussay shemppo ekkiyaa kifile; "kilaho" guussay bolla geeshshiyaa kifile; "doona gultte" qassi doonaanne siidhiyaa kammiyaa ma7o.
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ኡድዱፉንꬆ ኪፊሌ መጠአፈአ (ፕ። 59-60) መአረን፦ "ጎኦፊነ" ጉኡስሰይ ሼምፕፖ እክኪየአ ኪፊሌ፤ "ኪለሆ" ጉኡስሰይ ቦልለ ጌእሽሺየአ ኪፊሌ፤ "ዶኦነ ጉልትቴ" ቀስሲ ዶኦነአንኔ ሲኢꬊየአ ከምሚየአ መዖ።
flat_utterances.amharic: በዘጠነኛ ክፍል መጽሐፍ (ገጽ 59–60) መሠረት፦ «ጎፊና» ማለት ትንፋሽ የሚወስድ ሳምባ፤ «ኪላሆ» ማለት ኩላሊት፤ «ዶና ጉልቴ» ደግሞ አፍና አፍንጫን የሚሸፍን ጭምብል (ማስክ) ነው።
flat_utterances.english: According to the Grade 9 textbook (pp. 59–60): 'goofina' means the lungs that breathe air; 'kilaho' means kidney; and 'doona gultte' means a face mask covering the mouth and nose.
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: shemppo ekk-iyaa (breath take-PRES.REL) + doona-a-nne siidhiya-a (mouth-ACC-and nose-ACC.M.DEF) + kamm-iyaa (cover-PRES.REL).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Grade 9 Goofatho Doona Ch. 7 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/1uvGaBT4-O_Jn7oQbuNl1W88lFBFiHULU/view?usp=drivesdk, pp. 54–64: Kovide-19, goofina, kilaho, doona gultte)

flat_utterances.domain_name: Primary Healthcare & Maternal/Clinic Triage (Aakime Keethi)
flat_utterances.subtopic: Respiratory Illness, Lung Health (Goofina) & COVID-19/Flu Prevention
flat_utterances.speaker: user
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Shemppuwaara aathiyaa qufanne goofina harggetappe naagettanaw ayba maara kaalloo?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ሼምፕፑወአረ አአꬂየአ ቁፈንኔ ጎኦፊነ ሀርግጌተፕፔ ነአጌትተነው አይበ መአረ ከአልሎኦ?
flat_utterances.amharic: በትንፋሽ ከሚተላለፉ የሳልና የሳምባ በሽታዎች ለመጠበቅ ምን ዓይነት መመሪያ እንከተል?
flat_utterances.english: What guidelines should we follow to protect ourselves from airborne cough and respiratory diseases?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: shemppuwaa-ra (breath-INST, MP-10) + aath-iyaa (pass-PRES.REL) + qufa-nne goofina hargge-tappe (cough-and lung disease-PL.ABL) + naag-ett-anaw (guard-REFL-FUT.PURP).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Grade 9 Goofatho Doona Ch. 7 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/1uvGaBT4-O_Jn7oQbuNl1W88lFBFiHULU/view?usp=drivesdk, pp. 54–64: Kovide-19, goofina, kilaho, doona gultte)

flat_utterances.domain_name: Primary Healthcare & Maternal/Clinic Triage (Aakime Keethi)
flat_utterances.subtopic: Respiratory Illness, Lung Health (Goofina) & COVID-19/Flu Prevention
flat_utterances.speaker: assistant
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Kushe geeshshatethaa saamunaaranne haathaara naagite, daro asay shiiqiyaa bessan doona gultte ma77ite, qassi qufay gam77ikko aakime keethi biidi qoraphphite!
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ኩሼ ጌእሽሻቴꬃአ ሰአሙነአረንኔ ሀአꬃአረ ነአጊቴ፣ ደሮ አሰይ ሺኢቂየአ ቤስሰን ዶኦነ ጉልትቴ መዕዒቴ፣ ቀስሲ ቁፈይ ገምዕዒክኮ አአኪሜ ኬእꬂ ቢኢዲ ቆረጵጪቴ!
flat_utterances.amharic: የእጅ ንጽሕናን በሳሙናና በውኃ ጠብቁ፣ ብዙ ሰው በሚሰበሰብበት ቦታ የአፍና አፍንጫ ጭምብል (ዶና ጉልቴ) አድርጉ፣ ደግሞም ሳሉ ከቆየ ወደ ሐኪም ቤት ሄዳችሁ ተመርመሩ!
flat_utterances.english: Maintain hand hygiene with soap and water, wear a face mask (doona gultte) in crowded places, and if a cough persists, go to the clinic and get examined!
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: kushe geeshshatetha-a (hand cleanliness-ACC, PHR-036) + saamunaa-ra-nne haathaa-ra (soap-INST-and water-INST) + naag-ite (guard-IMP.2PL); gam77-ikko (persist/stay-COND.REAL) + qoraphph-ite (examine-IMP.2PL).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Grade 9 Goofatho Doona Ch. 7 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/1uvGaBT4-O_Jn7oQbuNl1W88lFBFiHULU/view?usp=drivesdk, pp. 54–64: Kovide-19, goofina, kilaho, doona gultte)

flat_utterances.domain_name: Primary Healthcare & Maternal/Clinic Triage (Aakime Keethi)
flat_utterances.subtopic: Pharmacy Prescription Instructions & Dosage Schedule
flat_utterances.speaker: user
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Aakimey xaliyaa xaafidi taaw immiis. Xale keethan xaliyaa waani uyanaakko waatada oychchoo?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: አአኪሜይ ጠሊየአ ጠአፊዲ ተአው ኢምሚኢስ። ጠሌ ኬእꬃን ጠሊየአ ወአኒ ኡየነአክኮ ወአተደ ኦይችቾኦ?
flat_utterances.amharic: ሐኪሙ መድኃኒት ጽፎ ሰጠኝ። በፋርማሲ (መድኃኒት ቤት) መድኃኒቱን እንዴት እንደምውጥ እንዴት ልጠይቅ?
flat_utterances.english: The doctor wrote a prescription and gave it to me. At the pharmacy, how do I ask how to take the medicine?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: aakime-y xaliya-a xaaf-idi (doctor-NOM medicine-ACC write-CNV2.ANT) + taa-w imm-iis (1S-DAT give-PAST.3MS, PHR-034); waan-i uy-ana-akko (how-CNV2 drink/take-FUT-COMP) + oychch-oo (ask-1S.INTER.JUSS).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Phrasebook PHR-034, PHR-035 & PHR-040; Sellassie Cheru (2015, p. 142)

flat_utterances.domain_name: Primary Healthcare & Maternal/Clinic Triage (Aakime Keethi)
flat_utterances.subtopic: Pharmacy Prescription Instructions & Dosage Schedule
flat_utterances.speaker: assistant
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Xale oosanchchaakko: "Hayyanaa, ha xaliyaa gallassan aappun toho uyoo? Quumaappe kaseeye quumaappe guyye uyoo?" gada oychcha.
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ጠሌ ኦኦሰንችቻአክኮ፦ "ሀይየነአ፣ ሀ ጠሊየአ ገልለስሰን አአፕፑን ቶሆ ኡዮኦ? ቁኡመአፕፔ ከሴእዬ ቁኡመአፕፔ ጉይዬ ኡዮኦ?" ገደ ኦይችቻ።
flat_utterances.amharic: የፋርማሲ ባለሙያውን፦ «እባክህ፣ ይህን መድኃኒት በቀን ስንት ጊዜ ልዋጥ? ከምግብ በፊት ነው ወይስ ከምግብ በኋላ የምውጠው?» ብለህ ጠይቅ።
flat_utterances.english: Ask the pharmacist: 'Please, how many times a day should I take this medicine? Should I take it before food or after food?'
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: gallassa-n aappun toho (day-LOC how.many times, PHR-035) + uy-oo (take-1S.INTER.JUSS); quumaa-ppe kase-eye quumaa-ppe guyye (food-ABL before-INTER.OR food-ABL after).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Phrasebook PHR-034, PHR-035 & PHR-040; Sellassie Cheru (2015, p. 142)

flat_utterances.domain_name: Primary Healthcare & Maternal/Clinic Triage (Aakime Keethi)
flat_utterances.subtopic: Pharmacy Prescription Instructions & Dosage Schedule
flat_utterances.speaker: user
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Iikka "Ha xaliyaa quumaappe guyye gallassan heedzu toho - maallado, gallassanne omarssi - ichchashu gallassa gakkanaw uya" giis.
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ኢኢክከ "ሀ ጠሊየአ ቁኡመአፕፔ ጉይዬ ገልለስሰን ሄእꬑ ቶሆ - መአልለዶ፣ ገልለስሰንኔ ኦመርስሲ - ኢችቻሹ ገልለስሰ ገክከነው ኡየ" ጊኢስ።
flat_utterances.amharic: እርሱም «ይህን መድኃኒት ከምግብ በኋላ በቀን ሦስት ጊዜ—ጠዋት፣ ቀንና ማታ—እስከ አምስት ቀን ድረስ ዋጥ» አለኝ።
flat_utterances.english: And he said, 'Take this medicine after meals three times a day—morning, midday, and evening—for five days.'
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: quumaa-ppe guyye (food-ABL after) + gallassa-n heedzu toho (day-LOC three times, PHR-035) + ichchashu gallassa gakk-anaw (five days reach-UNTIL) + uy-a (take-IMP.2S).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Phrasebook PHR-034, PHR-035 & PHR-040; Sellassie Cheru (2015, p. 142)

flat_utterances.domain_name: Primary Healthcare & Maternal/Clinic Triage (Aakime Keethi)
flat_utterances.subtopic: Pharmacy Prescription Instructions & Dosage Schedule
flat_utterances.speaker: assistant
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Aakimey azazidoogaadan xaliyaa wurssana gakkanaw uya! Paxida milatikkokka xaliyaa giddon aggoppa.
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: አአኪሜይ አዘዚዶኦገአደን ጠሊየአ ዉርስሰነ ገክከነው ኡየ! ፐጢደ ሚለቲክኮክከ ጠሊየአ ጊድዶን አግጎፕፐ።
flat_utterances.amharic: ሐኪሙ እንዳዘዘው መድኃኒቱን እስኪያልቅ ድረስ ዋጥ! የዳንክ ቢመስልህም መድኃኒቱን በመካከል አታቋርጥ።
flat_utterances.english: Take the medicine until you finish the full course just as the doctor ordered! Even if you feel better, do not stop the medicine midway.
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: azaz-idoogaa-dan (order-PAST.REL-EQU) + wurss-ana gakk-anaw (finish-FUT reach-UNTIL); pax-ida milat-ikko-kka (heal-PAST.REL seem-COND-EVEN) + agg-oppa (leave/stop-PROH.2S).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Phrasebook PHR-034, PHR-035 & PHR-040; Sellassie Cheru (2015, p. 142)

flat_utterances.domain_name: Primary Healthcare & Maternal/Clinic Triage (Aakime Keethi)
flat_utterances.subtopic: Eye Care & Vision Examination (Ayfe Qorapho)
flat_utterances.speaker: user
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Ta maayzaa ayfey haahuwaa loythi xeellenna, qassi afuxees. Ayfe aakimeekko efaanaw ay goo?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ተ መአይዘአ አይፌይ ሀአሁወአ ሎይꬂ ጤእልሌንነ፣ ቀስሲ አፉጤእስ። አይፌ አአኪሜእክኮ እፈአነው አይ ጎኦ?
flat_utterances.amharic: የአያቴ ዓይን ሩቅ በደንብ አያይም፣ ደግሞም እንባ ይፈሰዋል። ወደ ዓይን ሐኪም ለመውሰድ ምን ልበል?
flat_utterances.english: My grandfather's eyes do not see far distances well, and they water. What should I say when taking him to the eye doctor?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: ta maayza-a ayfe-y (my grandfather-GEN eye-NOM) + haahuwa-a (far.distance-ACC.M.DEF) + loythi xeell-enna (well see-PRES.3MS.NEG, PHR-044); ayfe aakimee-kko (eye doctor-DIR) + ef-aanaw (take-FUT.PURP).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Phrasebook PHR-044; Grade 8 Ch. 10 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/160NHNy-4orPcAIk-L5t6tOEtZoWemz_-/view?usp=drivesdk, p. 145: Ayfe caddana mithi ayfes beetenna)

flat_utterances.domain_name: Primary Healthcare & Maternal/Clinic Triage (Aakime Keethi)
flat_utterances.subtopic: Eye Care & Vision Examination (Ayfe Qorapho)
flat_utterances.speaker: assistant
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Ayfe aakimeekko: "Ta maayzaa ayfey loythi xeellenna; puuray de7iyaakko hayyanaa qoraphpharkkii?" gada oychcha.
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: አይፌ አአኪሜእክኮ፦ "ተ መአይዘአ አይፌይ ሎይꬂ ጤእልሌንነ፤ ፑኡረይ ዴዒየአክኮ ሀይየነአ ቆረጵጳርክኪኢ?" ገደ ኦይችቻ።
flat_utterances.amharic: ለዓይን ሐኪሙ፦ «የአያቴ ዓይን በደንብ አያይም፤ የዓይን ሞራ እንዳለበት እባክህ ትመረምርልኛለህ?» ብለህ ጠይቅ።
flat_utterances.english: Say to the eye specialist: 'My grandfather's eyes do not see clearly; please could you examine whether he has a cataract?'
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: loythi xeell-enna (well see-PRES.3MS.NEG) + de7-iyaa-kko (exist-PRES.REL-COMP) + qoraphph-arkkii (examine-2S.POT.INTER).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Phrasebook PHR-044; Grade 8 Ch. 10 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/160NHNy-4orPcAIk-L5t6tOEtZoWemz_-/view?usp=drivesdk, p. 145: Ayfe caddana mithi ayfes beetenna)

flat_utterances.domain_name: Primary Healthcare & Maternal/Clinic Triage (Aakime Keethi)
flat_utterances.subtopic: Eye Care & Vision Examination (Ayfe Qorapho)
flat_utterances.speaker: user
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Ayfiyaa qohoppe naagettanaabaa Hosppuntho kifile Shemppo 10 giddon de7iyaa tossey ay gii?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: አይፊየአ ቆሆፕፔ ነአጌትተነአበአ ሆስፕፑንꬆ ኪፊሌ ሼምፕፖ 10 ጊድዶን ዴዒየአ ቶስሴይ አይ ጊኢ?
flat_utterances.amharic: ዓይንን ከጉዳት ስለ መጠበቅ በስምንተኛ ክፍል ምዕራፍ 10 ውስጥ ያለው ምሳሌያዊ ንግግር ምን ይላል?
flat_utterances.english: What does the proverb in Grade 8 Chapter 10 say about guarding the eye from unexpected harm?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: ayfiya-a qoho-ppe (eye-ACC.M.DEF harm-ABL) + naag-ett-anaa-baa (guard-REFL-FUT.NMZ-ABOUT).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Phrasebook PHR-044; Grade 8 Ch. 10 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/160NHNy-4orPcAIk-L5t6tOEtZoWemz_-/view?usp=drivesdk, p. 145: Ayfe caddana mithi ayfes beetenna)

flat_utterances.domain_name: Primary Healthcare & Maternal/Clinic Triage (Aakime Keethi)
flat_utterances.subtopic: Eye Care & Vision Examination (Ayfe Qorapho)
flat_utterances.speaker: assistant
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Hosppuntho kifile Shemppo 10 (p. 145) tossey: "Ayfe caddana mithi ayfes beetenna" gees; hessa gisho ayfe payyatethaa kasetidi naaganaw bessees.
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ሆስፕፑንꬆ ኪፊሌ ሼምፕፖ 10 (ፕ። 145) ቶስሴይ፦ "አይፌ ጨድደነ ሚꬂ አይፌስ ቤእቴንነ" ጌእስ፤ ሄስሰ ጊሾ አይፌ ፐይየቴꬃአ ከሴቲዲ ነአገነው ቤስሴእስ።
flat_utterances.amharic: የስምንተኛ ክፍል ምዕራፍ 10 (ገጽ 145) ምሳሌ፦ «አይፌ ጫዳና ሚꬂ አይፌስ ቤቴና» (ዓይንን የሚወጋ እንጨት ለዓይን አይታይም) ይላል፤ ስለዚህ የዓይንን ጤንነት አስቀድሞ መጠበቅ ይገባል።
flat_utterances.english: The Grade 8 Chapter 10 (p. 145) proverb says: 'Ayfe caddana mithi ayfes beetenna' ('The twig that will poke the eye is not visible to the eye'); therefore one must protect eye health proactively.
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: ayfe cadd-ana mithi (eye poke/stab-FUT.REL wood/twig) + ayfe-s (eye-DAT) + beet-enna (be.seen-PRES.3MS.NEG < be7- + -ett- + -enna, MP-06).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Phrasebook PHR-044; Grade 8 Ch. 10 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/160NHNy-4orPcAIk-L5t6tOEtZoWemz_-/view?usp=drivesdk, p. 145: Ayfe caddana mithi ayfes beetenna)

flat_utterances.domain_name: Primary Healthcare & Maternal/Clinic Triage (Aakime Keethi)
flat_utterances.subtopic: Medical Confidentiality & Professional Healthcare Ethics (Aakime Ooso Woga)
flat_utterances.speaker: user
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Hosppuntho kifile Shemppo 1 ("Ooso Woga") giddon aakime keethan oothiyaa aakimeta ooso wogaabaa ay gii?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ሆስፕፑንꬆ ኪፊሌ ሼምፕፖ 1 ("ኦኦሶ ዎገ") ጊድዶን አአኪሜ ኬእꬃን ኦኦꬂየአ አአኪሜተ ኦኦሶ ዎገአበአ አይ ጊኢ?
flat_utterances.amharic: በስምንተኛ ክፍል ምዕራፍ 1 («የሥራ ሥነ-ምግባር») ውስጥ በሕክምና ተቋም ስለሚሠሩ ሐኪሞች የሥራ ሥነ-ምግባር ምን ይላል?
flat_utterances.english: In Grade 8 Chapter 1 ('Work Ethics'), what does it say about the professional ethics of doctors working in a healthcare facility?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: aakime keetha-n ooth-iyaa aakime-ta (clinic-LOC work-PRES.REL doctor-PL.GEN) + ooso wogaa-baa (work ethics-ABOUT, Gr8 Ch.1 pp. 3–5).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Grade 8 Goofatho Doona Ch. 1 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/160NHNy-4orPcAIk-L5t6tOEtZoWemz_-/view?usp=drivesdk, pp. 3–5, 11: Aakime keethan oothiya aakimeti hargganchcha xuura naaganaas bessees)

flat_utterances.domain_name: Primary Healthcare & Maternal/Clinic Triage (Aakime Keethi)
flat_utterances.subtopic: Medical Confidentiality & Professional Healthcare Ethics (Aakime Ooso Woga)
flat_utterances.speaker: assistant
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Hosppuntho kifile maxaafaa (p. 4 & p. 11) maaran: aakimeti hargganchchata ubbaa issi gina bonchchon mokkidi akkamoosonanne hargganchcha xuura loythi naagoosona.
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ሆስፕፑንꬆ ኪፊሌ መጠአፈአ (ፕ። 4 & ፕ። 11) መአረን፦ አአኪሜቲ ሀርግገንችቻተ ኡብበአ ኢስሲ ጊነ ቦንችቾን ሞክኪዲ አክከሞኦሶነንኔ ሀርግገንችቻ ጡኡረ ሎይꬂ ነአጎኦሶነ።
flat_utterances.amharic: በስምንተኛ ክፍል መጽሐፍ (ገጽ 4 እና 11) መሠረት፦ ሐኪሞች ታካሚዎችን ሁሉ በእኩል አክብሮት ተቀብለው ያክማሉ እንዲሁም የታካሚውን ምሥጢር (ጡኡራ) በጥብቅ ይጠብቃሉ።
flat_utterances.english: According to the Grade 8 textbook (pp. 4 & 11): doctors welcome and treat all patients with equal respect and strictly safeguard patient confidentiality ('hargganchcha xuura').
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: hargganchcha-ta ubba-a (patient-PL.ACC all-ACC) + issi gina bonchcho-n (equal respect-INST) + mokk-idi (welcome-CNV2.ANT) + hargganchcha xuura (patient secret/confidentiality, Gr8 Ch.1 p. 11) + naag-oosona (keep-PRES.3PL).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Grade 8 Goofatho Doona Ch. 1 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/160NHNy-4orPcAIk-L5t6tOEtZoWemz_-/view?usp=drivesdk, pp. 3–5, 11: Aakime keethan oothiya aakimeti hargganchcha xuura naaganaas bessees)

flat_utterances.domain_name: Primary Healthcare & Maternal/Clinic Triage (Aakime Keethi)
flat_utterances.subtopic: Medical Confidentiality & Professional Healthcare Ethics (Aakime Ooso Woga)
flat_utterances.speaker: user
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Hargganchchaykka aakime keethan ba harggiyaabaa qonccissiyaa wode ay oothanaw bessii?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ሀርግገንችቻይክከ አአኪሜ ኬእꬃን በ ሀርግጊየአበአ ቆንጭጪስሲየአ ዎዴ አይ ኦኦꬃነው ቤስሲኢ?
flat_utterances.amharic: ታካሚውም በሐኪም ቤት ስለ ሕመሙ ሲገልጽ ምን ማድረግ ይገባዋል?
flat_utterances.english: And when the patient explains his illness at the clinic, what should he do?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: hargganchcha-y-kka (patient-NOM-ADD) + ba harggiyaa-baa (3REFL.GEN illness-ABOUT) + qoncc-iss-iyaa wode (explain-CAUS-PRES.REL when) + ay ooth-anaw bess-ii (what do-FUT.PURP ought-PRES.3MS.INTER).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Grade 8 Goofatho Doona Ch. 1 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/160NHNy-4orPcAIk-L5t6tOEtZoWemz_-/view?usp=drivesdk, pp. 3–5, 11: Aakime keethan oothiya aakimeti hargganchcha xuura naaganaas bessees)

flat_utterances.domain_name: Primary Healthcare & Maternal/Clinic Triage (Aakime Keethi)
flat_utterances.subtopic: Medical Confidentiality & Professional Healthcare Ethics (Aakime Ooso Woga)
flat_utterances.speaker: assistant
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Aakimey hargganchcha xuura naagiyaa gishshaw, hargganchchay yayyonnaaninne qottanabaa aggonnaan ba sakkoy awannne awde doommidaakko suure odanaw bessees.
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: አአኪሜይ ሀርግገንችቻ ጡኡረ ነአጊየአ ጊሽሻው፣ ሀርግገንችቻይ የይዮንነአኒንኔ ቆትተነበአ አግጎንነአን በ ሰክኮይ አወንንኔ አውዴ ዶኦምሚደአክኮ ሱኡሬ ኦደነው ቤስሴእስ።
flat_utterances.amharic: ሐኪሙ የታካሚውን ምሥጢር ስለሚጠብቅ፣ ታካሚው ሳይፈራና ምንም ሳይደብቅ ሕመሙ የትና መቼ እንደጀመረ በትክክል መናገር ይገባዋል።
flat_utterances.english: Because the doctor protects patient confidentiality, the patient should speak honestly without fear or hiding anything about where and when his pain started.
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: yayy-onnaan-inne (fear-NEG.CNV-and) + ba sakko-y (3REFL.GEN pain-NOM) + awde doomm-ida-akko (when start-PAST.REL-COMP) + suure od-anaw bess-ees (honestly tell-FUT.PURP ought-PRES.3MS).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Grade 8 Goofatho Doona Ch. 1 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/160NHNy-4orPcAIk-L5t6tOEtZoWemz_-/view?usp=drivesdk, pp. 3–5, 11: Aakime keethan oothiya aakimeti hargganchcha xuura naaganaas bessees)

flat_utterances.speaker: user
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Goshshan oothishe waley goshshanchcha kushiyaa qanxxiis; suuthay daro gukkees. Koyro maaduwaa ay oothoo?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ጎሽሻን ኦኦꬂሼ ወሌይ ጎሽሻንችቻ ኩሺየአ ቀንጥጢኢስ፤ ሱኡꬃይ ደሮ ጉክኬእስ። ኮይሮ መአዱወአ አይ ኦኦꬆኦ?
flat_utterances.amharic: በእርሻ ላይ እየሠራ ሳለ ማጭዱ የገበሬውን እጅ ቆረጠው፤ ደም በብዛት ይፈሳል። የመጀመሪያ እርዳታ ምን እናድርግ?
flat_utterances.english: While working on the farm, a sickle cut a farmer's hand and it is bleeding heavily. What first aid should we perform?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: goshsha-n ooth-ishe (farm-LOC work-CNV.SIM) + wale-y (sickle-NOM, Gr10 Ch.5 p. 39) + kushiya-a qanxx-iis (hand-ACC cut-PAST.3MS); suutha-y daro gukk-ees (blood-NOM much pour/bleed-PRES.3MS).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Phrasebook PHR-042; Grade 8 Ch. 1 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/160NHNy-4orPcAIk-L5t6tOEtZoWemz_-/view?usp=drivesdk, p. 15: dano)

flat_utterances.domain_name: Primary Healthcare & Maternal/Clinic Triage (Aakime Keethi)
flat_utterances.subtopic: First Aid for Farm Cuts & Snake/Insect Bite Emergency (Shemppuwaa Ashshiyaa Maaduwaa)
flat_utterances.speaker: assistant
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Shemppuwaa ashshiyaa koyro maaduwaas: geeshsha haathaara madhdhaa meecada, geeshsha puutto ma7on minnada qachchidi suuthaa essa! Biitta woy qita madhdhaa bolla wothoppa.
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ሼምፕፑወአ አሽሺየአ ኮይሮ መአዱወአስ፦ ጌእሽሻ ሀአꬃአረ መꬍꬋአ ሜእጨደ፣ ጌእሽሻ ፑኡትቶ መዖን ሚንነደ ቀችቺዲ ሱኡꬃአ እስሰ! ቢኢትተ ዎይ ቂተ መꬍꬋአ ቦልለ ዎꬆፕፐ።
flat_utterances.amharic: ሕይወት አድን የመጀመሪያ እርዳታ ለመስጠት፦ ቁስሉን በንጹሕ ውኃ አጥበህ፣ በንጹሕ የጥጥ ጨርቅ አጥብቀህ በማሰር ደሙን አቁም! አፈር ወይም ቆሻሻ ቁስሉ ላይ አታድርግ።
flat_utterances.english: For life-saving first aid: wash the wound with clean water, bind it firmly with a clean cotton cloth, and stop the bleeding! Do not put soil or dirt on the wound.
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: shemppuwa-a ashsh-iyaa (life-ACC save-PRES.REL, PHR-042) + madhdha-a (wound-ACC) + meec-ada (wash-CNV1.ANT.2S) + qachch-idi (bind/tie-CNV2.ANT) + suutha-a ess-a (blood-ACC stop.CAUS-IMP.2S, MP-05 < eqq- + -iss-); woth-oppa (put-PROH.2S).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Phrasebook PHR-042; Grade 8 Ch. 1 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/160NHNy-4orPcAIk-L5t6tOEtZoWemz_-/view?usp=drivesdk, p. 15: dano)

flat_utterances.domain_name: Primary Healthcare & Maternal/Clinic Triage (Aakime Keethi)
flat_utterances.subtopic: First Aid for Farm Cuts & Snake/Insect Bite Emergency (Shemppuwaa Ashshiyaa Maaduwaa)
flat_utterances.speaker: user
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Madhdhay ciimma gidikko, teetanasi marppiyaa cadettanaw aakime keethi efoo?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: መꬍꬋይ ጪኢምመ ጊዲክኮ፣ ቴእተነሲ መርፕፒየአ ጨዴትተነው አአኪሜ ኬእꬂ እፎኦ?
flat_utterances.amharic: ቁስሉ ጥልቅ ከሆነ፣ የቴታነስ መርፌ እንዲወጋ ወደ ሐኪም ቤት እንውሰደው?
flat_utterances.english: If the wound is deep, should we take him to the clinic to get a tetanus injection and stitches?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: madhdha-y ciimma gid-ikko (wound-NOM deep be-COND.REAL) + cad-ett-anaw (inject/stab-PASS-FUT.PURP, MP-06 < cadd- + -ett-) + ef-oo (take-1PL.INTER.JUSS).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Phrasebook PHR-042; Grade 8 Ch. 1 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/160NHNy-4orPcAIk-L5t6tOEtZoWemz_-/view?usp=drivesdk, p. 15: dano)

flat_utterances.domain_name: Primary Healthcare & Maternal/Clinic Triage (Aakime Keethi)
flat_utterances.subtopic: First Aid for Farm Cuts & Snake/Insect Bite Emergency (Shemppuwaa Ashshiyaa Maaduwaa)
flat_utterances.speaker: assistant
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Ee! Birata miishshan qanxxettida ciimma madhdhaas aakime keethan sikkonne teetanasi naago marppey daro koshshees; ha77i efite!
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: እእ! ቢረተ ሚኢሽሻን ቀንጥጤትቲደ ጪኢምመ መꬍꬋአስ አአኪሜ ኬእꬃን ሲክኮንኔ ቴእተነሲ ነአጎ መርፕፔይ ደሮ ኮሽሼእስ፤ ሀዕዒ እፊቴ!
flat_utterances.amharic: አዎ! በብረት መሣሪያ ለተቆረጠ ጥልቅ ቁስል በሐኪም ቤት መሰፋትና የቴታነስ መከላከያ መርፌ በጣም ያስፈልጋል፤ አሁኑኑ ውሰዱት!
flat_utterances.english: Yes! For a deep wound cut by an iron tool, stitching and a tetanus vaccination at the clinic are essential; take him right now!
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: birata miishsha-n (iron tool-INST) + qanxx-ett-ida (cut-PASS-PAST.REL) + daro koshsh-ees (very be.needed-PRES.3MS); ef-ite (take-IMP.2PL).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Phrasebook PHR-042; Grade 8 Ch. 1 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/160NHNy-4orPcAIk-L5t6tOEtZoWemz_-/view?usp=drivesdk, p. 15: dano)

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Ooratha yelettida guutha na7aas hargge naago kittibaate awde doommii?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ኦኦረꬃ ዬሌትቲደ ጉኡꬃ ነዓአስ ሀርግጌ ነአጎ ኪትቲበአቴ አውዴ ዶኦምሚኢ?
flat_utterances.amharic: አዲስ ለተወለደ ሕፃን ልጅ የበሽታ መከላከያ ክትባት መቼ ይጀምራል?
flat_utterances.english: When does the disease-prevention vaccination schedule start for a newborn baby?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: ooratha yel-ett-ida (newly bear-PASS-PAST.REL) + guutha na7a-as (small child-DAT, ZARA-03 7) + hargge naago (disease protection) + awde doomm-ii (when start-PRES.3MS.INTER).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Phrasebook PHR-039 & PHR-043; Grade 8 Ch. 5 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/160NHNy-4orPcAIk-L5t6tOEtZoWemz_-/view?usp=drivesdk, p. 75: nayta payyatetha)

flat_utterances.domain_name: Primary Healthcare & Maternal/Clinic Triage (Aakime Keethi)
flat_utterances.subtopic: Childhood Immunization Schedule & Growth Monitoring
flat_utterances.speaker: assistant
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Kittibaatey na7ay yelettido gallassan doommidi, usuppun saaminttan, tamma saaminttan, tamma-oyddu saaminttaninne uddufun aginan xenaa keethan imettees.
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ኪትቲበአቴይ ነዓይ ዬሌትቲዶ ገልለስሰን ዶኦምሚዲ፣ ኡሱፕፑን ሰአሚንትተን፣ ተምመ ሰአሚንትተን፣ ተምመ-ኦይድዱ ሰአሚንትተኒንኔ ኡድዱፉን አጊነን ጤነአ ኬእꬃን ኢሜትቴእስ።
flat_utterances.amharic: ክትባቱ ሕፃኑ በተወለደበት ቀን ጀምሮ፣ በስድስት ሳምንት፣ በአሥር ሳምንት፣ በአሥራ አራት ሳምንትና በዘጠኝ ወር በጤና ጣቢያ ይሰጣል።
flat_utterances.english: Vaccination starts on the day the baby is born, and continues at six weeks, ten weeks, fourteen weeks, and nine months at the health center.
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: yel-ett-ido gallassa-n (bear-PASS-PAST.REL day-LOC) + doomm-idi (start-CNV2.ANT) + uddufun agina-n (nine month-LOC) + im-ett-ees (give-PASS-PRES.3MS, MP-06).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Phrasebook PHR-039 & PHR-043; Grade 8 Ch. 5 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/160NHNy-4orPcAIk-L5t6tOEtZoWemz_-/view?usp=drivesdk, p. 75: nayta payyatetha)

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Kittibaate kaarddiyaa oyqqidi baanaw bessii?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ኪትቲበአቴ ከአርድዲየአ ኦይቅቂዲ በአነው ቤስሲኢ?
flat_utterances.amharic: የክትባት ካርዱን ይዞ መሄድ ይገባል?
flat_utterances.english: Is it necessary to bring the immunization card along?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: kittibaate kaarddiya-a (vaccination card-ACC.M.DEF, MP-10) + oyqq-idi (hold-CNV2.ANT) + ba-anaw bess-ii (go-FUT.PURP ought-PRES.3MS.INTER).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Phrasebook PHR-039 & PHR-043; Grade 8 Ch. 5 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/160NHNy-4orPcAIk-L5t6tOEtZoWemz_-/view?usp=drivesdk, p. 75: nayta payyatetha)

flat_utterances.domain_name: Primary Healthcare & Maternal/Clinic Triage (Aakime Keethi)
flat_utterances.subtopic: Childhood Immunization Schedule & Growth Monitoring
flat_utterances.speaker: assistant
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Ee! Kittibaate kaarddiyaa ubba wode oyqqada ba; xenaa oosanchchati na7aa deexuwaa miizaanidi kaarddiyaa bolla xaafosona.
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: እእ! ኪትቲበአቴ ከአርድዲየአ ኡብበ ዎዴ ኦይቅቀደ በ፤ ጤነአ ኦኦሰንችቻቲ ነዓአ ዴእጡወአ ሚኢዘአኒዲ ከአርድዲየአ ቦልለ ጠአፎሶነ።
flat_utterances.amharic: አዎ! የክትባት ካርዱን ሁልጊዜ ይዘህ ሂድ፤ የጤና ባለሙያዎቹ የሕፃኑን ክብደት መዝነው ካርዱ ላይ ይጽፋሉ።
flat_utterances.english: Yes! Always bring the immunization card with you; the health workers weigh the baby and record the weight on the card.
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: oyqq-ada ba (hold-CNV1.ANT.2S go.IMP.2S); na7a-a deexuwa-a (child-GEN weight-ACC.M.DEF) + miizaan-idi (weigh-CNV2.ANT) + xaaf-oosona (write-PRES.3PL).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Phrasebook PHR-039 & PHR-043; Grade 8 Ch. 5 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/160NHNy-4orPcAIk-L5t6tOEtZoWemz_-/view?usp=drivesdk, p. 75: nayta payyatetha)

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Gaxare heeran pultto haathaa uyanaappe kase geeshshanaw ay oothanaw bessii?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ገጠሬ ሄእረን ፑልትቶ ሀአꬃአ ኡየነአፕፔ ከሴ ጌእሽሻነው አይ ኦኦꬃነው ቤስሲኢ?
flat_utterances.amharic: በገጠር አካባቢ የምንጭ ውኃ ከመጠጣታችን በፊት ለማጽዳት (ለማከም) ምን ማድረግ ይገባል?
flat_utterances.english: In rural areas, before drinking spring water, what should we do to make it safe and clean?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: gaxare heera-n (rural area-LOC) + pultto haatha-a (spring water-ACC) + uy-anaa-ppe kase (drink-FUT.NMZ-ABL before) + geeshsh-anaw (clean/purify-FUT.PURP).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Phrasebook PHR-030 & PHR-036; Grade 8 Ch. 1 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/160NHNy-4orPcAIk-L5t6tOEtZoWemz_-/view?usp=drivesdk, p. 11: Heera geeshshatethaa naago)

flat_utterances.domain_name: Primary Healthcare & Maternal/Clinic Triage (Aakime Keethi)
flat_utterances.subtopic: Clean Drinking Water & Waterborne Illness Prevention
flat_utterances.speaker: assistant
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Haathaa taman loythi kathidi irxxissidi uyo, woykko haatha xaliyaa gujjidi geeshsha miishshan kamidi oyqqo!
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ሀአꬃአ ተመን ሎይꬂ ከꬂዲ ኢርጥጢስሲዲ ኡዮ፣ ዎይክኮ ሀአꬃ ጠሊየአ ጉጅጂዲ ጌእሽሻ ሚኢሽሻን ከሚዲ ኦይቅቆ!
flat_utterances.amharic: ውኃውን በእሳት በደንብ አፍልቶ አቀዝቅዞ መጠጣት፣ ወይም የውኃ ማከሚያ መድኃኒት (ውኃ አጋር) ጨምሮ በንጹሕ ዕቃ ከድኖ መያዝ ይገባል!
flat_utterances.english: Boil the water thoroughly on the fire and let it cool before drinking, or treat it with water purification drops and keep it covered in a clean container!
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: haatha-a tama-n loythi kath-idi (water-ACC fire-LOC well boil-CNV2.ANT) + irxx-iss-idi (cool-CAUS-CNV2.ANT) + kamm-idi oyqq-o (cover-CNV2 keep-NMZ/JUSS).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Phrasebook PHR-030 & PHR-036; Grade 8 Ch. 1 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/160NHNy-4orPcAIk-L5t6tOEtZoWemz_-/view?usp=drivesdk, p. 11: Heera geeshshatethaa naago)

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Pultto haathaa yuushuwaa geeshshatethaa naaganaw deretethay ay oothii?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ፑልትቶ ሀአꬃአ ዩኡሹወአ ጌእሽሻቴꬃአ ነአገነው ዴሬቴꬃይ አይ ኦኦꬂኢ?
flat_utterances.amharic: የምንጭ ውኃ አካባቢን ንጽሕና ለመጠበቅ ማኅበረሰቡ ምን ያደርጋል?
flat_utterances.english: What does the community do to protect the cleanliness around a water spring?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: pultto haatha-a yuushuwa-a (spring water-GEN surroundings-ACC.M.DEF) + geeshshatetha-a naag-anaw (cleanliness-ACC protect-FUT.PURP) + deretetha-y (community-NOM, Gr10 Ch.1 p. 6).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Phrasebook PHR-030 & PHR-036; Grade 8 Ch. 1 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/160NHNy-4orPcAIk-L5t6tOEtZoWemz_-/view?usp=drivesdk, p. 11: Heera geeshshatethaa naago)

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Pulttuwaa yuushuwan meheti gelonna mala dirssa diridi, bolla baggaara di7oy qita gelissonna mala boohuwaa bookkoosona.
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ፑልትቱወአ ዩኡሹወን ሜሄቲ ጌሎንነ መለ ዲርስሰ ዲሪዲ፣ ቦልለ በግገአረ ዲዖይ ቂተ ጌሊስሶንነ መለ ቦኦሁወአ ቦኦክኮኦሶነ።
flat_utterances.amharic: በምንጩ ዙሪያ ከብቶች እንዳይገቡ አጥር አጥረው፣ ከላይ በኩል ጎርፍ ቆሻሻ እንዳያስገባ ቦይ ይቆፍራሉ።
flat_utterances.english: They fence the area around the spring so livestock cannot enter, and dig drainage channels above it so runoff (di7o) does not wash dirt into the water.
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: mehe-ti gel-onna mala (cattle-PL.NOM enter-NEG.PURP) + dirssa dir-idi (fence fence-CNV2.ANT) + di7o-y (flood/runoff-NOM, Gr8 Ch.1 p. 11) + bookk-oosona (dig-PRES.3PL).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Phrasebook PHR-030 & PHR-036; Grade 8 Ch. 1 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/160NHNy-4orPcAIk-L5t6tOEtZoWemz_-/view?usp=drivesdk, p. 11: Heera geeshshatethaa naago)

flat_utterances.speaker: user
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Gadha heeran irathay bukkiyaa wode shekkeere harggey darees. So asaa shekkeereppe waatidi naagoo?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ገꬋ ሄእረን ኢረꬃይ ቡክኪየአ ዎዴ ሼክኬእሬ ሀርግጌይ ደሬእስ። ሶ አሰአ ሼክኬእሬፕፔ ወአቲዲ ነአጎኦ?
flat_utterances.amharic: በቆላ አካባቢ ዝናብ በሚዘንብበት ወቅት የወባ በሽታ ይበዛል። ቤተሰብን ከወባ እንዴት እንጠብቅ?
flat_utterances.english: In the lowland areas (gadha), when the rains fall, malaria increases. How do we protect the family from malaria?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: gadha heera-n (lowland area-LOC, Gr8 Ch.5 p. 76) + iratha-y bukk-iyaa wode (rain-NOM fall-PRES.REL when) + shekkeere hargge-y (malaria disease-NOM) + dar-ees (abound-PRES.3MS); waat-idi naag-oo (how-CNV2 protect-1PL.INTER).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Grade 8 Ch. 5 & Ch. 9 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/160NHNy-4orPcAIk-L5t6tOEtZoWemz_-/view?usp=drivesdk, pp. 76, 127: gadha vs. gezze); Phrasebook PHR-038

flat_utterances.domain_name: Primary Healthcare & Maternal/Clinic Triage (Aakime Keethi)
flat_utterances.subtopic: Malaria Prevention & Bednet Usage in Lowland Gofa (Gadha Shekkeere)
flat_utterances.speaker: assistant
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Ubba qamma xaliyaara giigettida agobariyaa hiixxidi zin77ite; qassi keetha yuushuwan eqqida haathaa gukkissidi melissite.
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ኡብበ ቀምመ ጠሊየአረ ጊኢጌትቲደ አጎበሪየአ ሂኢጥጢዲ ዚንዕዒቴ፤ ቀስሲ ኬእꬃ ዩኡሹወን እቅቂደ ሀአꬃአ ጉክኪስሲዲ ሜሊስሲቴ።
flat_utterances.amharic: በየምሽቱ በመድኃኒት የተነከረ አጎበር ዘርግታችሁ ተኙ፤ ደግሞም በቤት ዙሪያ የቆመ ውኃን አፋስሳችሁ አድርቁ።
flat_utterances.english: Every night sleep under an insecticide-treated bednet (agobariyaa); and drain and dry up any stagnant water around the house.
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: ubba qamma (every night) + hiixx-idi zin77-ite (spread-CNV2.ANT sleep-IMP.2PL, ZARA-03 77); eqq-ida haatha-a (stand-PAST.REL water-ACC) + mel-iss-ite (dry-CAUS-IMP.2PL).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Grade 8 Ch. 5 & Ch. 9 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/160NHNy-4orPcAIk-L5t6tOEtZoWemz_-/view?usp=drivesdk, pp. 76, 127: gadha vs. gezze); Phrasebook PHR-038

flat_utterances.domain_name: Primary Healthcare & Maternal/Clinic Triage (Aakime Keethi)
flat_utterances.subtopic: Malaria Prevention & Bednet Usage in Lowland Gofa (Gadha Shekkeere)
flat_utterances.speaker: user
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Shahaara aayeenne guutha nayti agobariyaa garssan zin77oy ubbaappe aadhdhi koshshii?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ሻሀአረ አአዬእንኔ ጉኡꬃ ነይቲ አጎበሪየአ ገርስሰን ዚንዕዖይ ኡብበአፕፔ አአꬍꬊ ኮሽሺኢ?
flat_utterances.amharic: ነፍሰ ጡር እናትና ሕፃናት ልጆች በአጎበር ውስጥ መተኛታቸው ከሁሉም በላይ ያስፈልጋል?
flat_utterances.english: Is it especially important for pregnant mothers and young children to sleep under a bednet?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: shahaara aayee-nne guutha nay-ti (pregnant mother-and young child-PL.NOM) + agobariya-a garssa-n (bednet-GEN under-LOC) + zin77o-y (sleeping-NOM) + aadhdh-i koshsh-ii (surpass-CNV2 be.needed-PRES.3MS.INTER).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Grade 8 Ch. 5 & Ch. 9 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/160NHNy-4orPcAIk-L5t6tOEtZoWemz_-/view?usp=drivesdk, pp. 76, 127: gadha vs. gezze); Phrasebook PHR-038

flat_utterances.domain_name: Primary Healthcare & Maternal/Clinic Triage (Aakime Keethi)
flat_utterances.subtopic: Malaria Prevention & Bednet Usage in Lowland Gofa (Gadha Shekkeere)
flat_utterances.speaker: assistant
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Ee! Shekkeerey shahaara aayeenne guutha nayta bolla suutha dhayo ehiyaa gishshaw, entti ubba qamma agobariyaa garssan zin77anaw bessees.
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: እእ! ሼክኬእሬይ ሻሀአረ አአዬእንኔ ጉኡꬃ ነይተ ቦልለ ሱኡꬃ ꬋዮ እሂየአ ጊሽሻው፣ እንትቲ ኡብበ ቀምመ አጎበሪየአ ገርስሰን ዚንዕዓነው ቤስሴእስ።
flat_utterances.amharic: አዎ! ወባ በነፍሰ ጡር እናትና በሕፃናት ልጆች ላይ የደም ማነስ ስለሚያመጣ፣ እነርሱ በየምሽቱ በአጎበር ውስጥ መተኛት ይገባቸዋል።
flat_utterances.english: Yes! Because malaria causes severe anemia in pregnant mothers and young children, they must sleep under a bednet every single night.
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: suutha dhayo (blood lack / anemia) + eh-iyaa gishshaw (bring-PRES.REL because) + zin77-anaw bess-ees (sleep-FUT.PURP ought-PRES.3MS).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Grade 8 Ch. 5 & Ch. 9 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/160NHNy-4orPcAIk-L5t6tOEtZoWemz_-/view?usp=drivesdk, pp. 76, 127: gadha vs. gezze); Phrasebook PHR-038

flat_utterances.domain_name: Primary Healthcare & Maternal/Clinic Triage (Aakime Keethi)
flat_utterances.subtopic: Chronic Illness Care, Recovery & Physical Strength (Paxonne Shemppo)
flat_utterances.speaker: user
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Uddufuntho kifile Shemppo 4 ("Darota", p. 30) giddon "Hargge machcho gidis" nne "Bollay layti uttis" giyaa aaqe odati de7oosona. Entta birshshethay aybee?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ኡድዱፉንꬆ ኪፊሌ ሼምፕፖ 4 ("ደሮተ"፣ ፕ። 30) ጊድዶን "ሀርግጌ መችቾ ጊዲስ" ንኔ "ቦልለይ ለይቲ ኡትቲስ" ጊየአ አአቄ ኦደቲ ዴዖኦሶነ። እንትተ ቢርሽሼꬃይ አይቤእ?
flat_utterances.amharic: በዘጠነኛ ክፍል ምዕራፍ 4 («ዳሮታ»፣ ገጽ 30) ውስጥ «ሃርጌ ማቾ ጊዲስ» እና «ቦላይ ላይቲ ኡቲስ» የሚሉ ፈሊጣዊ ንግግሮች አሉ። ትርጉማቸው ምንድን ነው?
flat_utterances.english: In Grade 9 Chapter 4 ('Darota', p. 30), there are the idioms 'Hargge machcho gidis' and 'Bollay layti uttis'. What do they mean?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: hargge machcho gid-is (illness spouse become-PAST.3MS, Gr9 Ch.4 p. 30) + bolla-y layt-i utt-is (body-NOM waste.away-CNV2 sit-PAST.3MS, Gr9 Ch.4 p. 30).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Grade 9 Goofatho Doona Ch. 4 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/1uvGaBT4-O_Jn7oQbuNl1W88lFBFiHULU/view?usp=drivesdk, pp. 30–31: Hargge machcho gidis, Bollay layti uttis); Phrasebook PHR-040 & PHR-045

flat_utterances.domain_name: Primary Healthcare & Maternal/Clinic Triage (Aakime Keethi)
flat_utterances.subtopic: Chronic Illness Care, Recovery & Physical Strength (Paxonne Shemppo)
flat_utterances.speaker: assistant
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: "Hargge machcho gidis" guussay adussa wode harggiyaan oyqqettidi de7iis guussa; "Bollay layti uttis" guussay qassi harggeppe denddidayssaan asatethay laafidi daaburiis guussa.
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: "ሀርግጌ መችቾ ጊዲስ" ጉኡስሰይ አዱስሰ ዎዴ ሀርግጊየአን ኦይቅቄትቲዲ ዴዒኢስ ጉኡስሰ፤ "ቦልለይ ለይቲ ኡትቲስ" ጉኡስሰይ ቀስሲ ሀርግጌፕፔ ዴንድዲደይስሰአን አሰቴꬃይ ለአፊዲ ደአቡሪኢስ ጉኡስሰ።
flat_utterances.amharic: «ሃርጌ ማቾ ጊዲስ» ማለት ለረጅም ጊዜ በበሽታ ተይዞ ቆየ (የበሽታ ጓደኛ ሆነ) ማለት ነው፤ «ቦላይ ላይቲ ኡቲስ» ማለት ደግሞ ከሕመሙ የተነሣ ሰውነቱ ከስቶ ደከመ ማለት ነው።
flat_utterances.english: 'Hargge machcho gidis' (lit. 'became a spouse of illness') means suffering from a prolonged chronic illness; and 'Bollay layti uttis' means the body became frail and weakened from illness.
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: adussa wode (long time) + harggiya-an oyqq-ett-idi (illness-INST seize-PASS-CNV2.ANT); hargge-ppe dendd-idayssaa-n (illness-ABL arise-PAST.REL.NMZ-LOC) + daabur-iis (tire/weaken-PAST.3MS).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Grade 9 Goofatho Doona Ch. 4 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/1uvGaBT4-O_Jn7oQbuNl1W88lFBFiHULU/view?usp=drivesdk, pp. 30–31: Hargge machcho gidis, Bollay layti uttis); Phrasebook PHR-040 & PHR-045

flat_utterances.domain_name: Primary Healthcare & Maternal/Clinic Triage (Aakime Keethi)
flat_utterances.subtopic: Chronic Illness Care, Recovery & Physical Strength (Paxonne Shemppo)
flat_utterances.speaker: user
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Adussa harggeppe paxiyaa uraas ("Hargganchchay ha77i paxees") asatethaa minthanaw ay koshshii?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: አዱስሰ ሀርግጌፕፔ ፐጢየአ ኡረአስ ("ሀርግገንችቻይ ሀዕዒ ፐጤእስ") አሰቴꬃአ ሚንꬃነው አይ ኮሽሺኢ?
flat_utterances.amharic: ከረጅም ሕመም እያገገመ ላለ ሰው («በሽተኛው አሁን እየዳነ ነው») ሰውነቱን ለማጠንከር ምን ያስፈልጋል?
flat_utterances.english: For a person recovering from a long illness ('Hargganchchay ha77i paxees'), what is needed to rebuild bodily strength?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: hargganchcha-y ha77i pax-ees (patient-NOM now recover-PRES.3MS, PHR-040) + asatetha-a minth-anaw (body-ACC strengthen-FUT.PURP, PHR-043).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Grade 9 Goofatho Doona Ch. 4 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/1uvGaBT4-O_Jn7oQbuNl1W88lFBFiHULU/view?usp=drivesdk, pp. 30–31: Hargge machcho gidis, Bollay layti uttis); Phrasebook PHR-040 & PHR-045

flat_utterances.domain_name: Primary Healthcare & Maternal/Clinic Triage (Aakime Keethi)
flat_utterances.subtopic: Chronic Illness Care, Recovery & Physical Strength (Paxonne Shemppo)
flat_utterances.speaker: assistant
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Geeshsha quumaa - asho suuphe, maatha, itima ukkenne gommane - maanaw, guutha wode shemppanawinne aakime kaalluwaa naaganaw bessees.
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ጌእሽሻ ቁኡመአ - አሾ ሱኡጴ፣ መአꬃ፣ ኢቲመ ኡክኬንኔ ጎምመኔ - መአነው፣ ጉኡꬃ ዎዴ ሼምፕፐነዊንኔ አአኪሜ ከአልሉወአ ነአገነው ቤስሴእስ።
flat_utterances.amharic: ንጹሕና ገንቢ ምግብ—የሥጋ መረቅ፣ ወተት፣ የቡላ ገንፎና ጎመን—መመገብ፣ ለትንሽ ጊዜ ማረፍና የሐኪም ክትትልን መጠበቅ ይገባል።
flat_utterances.english: He should eat nourishing food—meat broth, milk, bulla porridge, and greens—rest adequately, and keep up with medical follow-ups.
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: geeshsha quuma-a ma-anaw (nutritious food-ACC eat-FUT.PURP, PHR-043) + shempp-anaw-inne (rest-FUT.PURP-and, PHR-045) + naag-anaw bess-ees (keep-FUT.PURP ought-PRES.3MS).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Grade 9 Goofatho Doona Ch. 4 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/1uvGaBT4-O_Jn7oQbuNl1W88lFBFiHULU/view?usp=drivesdk, pp. 30–31: Hargge machcho gidis, Bollay layti uttis); Phrasebook PHR-040 & PHR-045

flat_utterances.domain_name: Primary Healthcare & Maternal/Clinic Triage (Aakime Keethi)
flat_utterances.subtopic: Dental Pain & Oral Hygiene (Achche Sakko)
flat_utterances.speaker: user
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Qamma ta achchey daro sakkidi zin77ibekke. Achche aakimeekko baada ay gada qonccissoo?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ቀምመ ተ አችቼይ ደሮ ሰክኪዲ ዚንዕዒቤክኬ። አችቼ አአኪሜእክኮ በአደ አይ ገደ ቆንጭጪስሶኦ?
flat_utterances.amharic: ማታ ጥርሴ በጣም አሞኝ አልተኛሁም። ወደ ጥርስ ሐኪም ሄጄ ምን ብዬ ላስረዳ?
flat_utterances.english: Last night my tooth hurt badly and I did not sleep. When I go to the dentist, how should I explain it?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: qamma ta achche-y (night my tooth-NOM, geminate chch) + daro sakk-idi (very ache-CNV2.ANT) + zin77-ibekke (sleep-PAST.1S.NEG.DCL); achche aakimee-kko (tooth doctor-DIR) + qoncc-iss-oo (explain-CAUS-1S.INTER).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Sellassie Cheru (2015, p. 375: achche); Phrasebook PHR-031 & PHR-034

flat_utterances.domain_name: Primary Healthcare & Maternal/Clinic Triage (Aakime Keethi)
flat_utterances.subtopic: Dental Pain & Oral Hygiene (Achche Sakko)
flat_utterances.speaker: assistant
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Achche aakimeekko: "Haddirssa bagga gaxa achchey daro sakkees; irxxa haatha uyiyaa wodekka qanxxees" gada qonccissa.
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: አችቼ አአኪሜእክኮ፦ "ሀድዲርስሰ በግገ ገጠ አችቼይ ደሮ ሰክኬእስ፤ ኢርጥጠ ሀአꬃ ኡዪየአ ዎዴክከ ቀንጥጤእስ" ገደ ቆንጭጪስሰ።
flat_utterances.amharic: ለጥርስ ሐኪሙ፦ «በግራ በኩል ያለው የመንጋጋ ጥርሴ በጣም ያመኛል፤ ቀዝቃዛ ውኃ ስጠጣም ይሰቀጥጠኛል» ብለህ አስረዳ።
flat_utterances.english: Explain to the dentist: 'My left back molar hurts very much; and when I drink cold water, it gives a sharp pain.'
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: haddirssa bagga (left side, PHR-083) + gaxa achche-y (molar tooth-NOM) + irxxa haatha uy-iyaa wode-kka (cold water drink-PRES.REL when-ADD) + qanxx-ees (cut/sting-PRES.3MS).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Sellassie Cheru (2015, p. 375: achche); Phrasebook PHR-031 & PHR-034

flat_utterances.domain_name: Primary Healthcare & Maternal/Clinic Triage (Aakime Keethi)
flat_utterances.subtopic: Dental Pain & Oral Hygiene (Achche Sakko)
flat_utterances.speaker: user
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Achche payyatethaa ubba galla naaganaw Goofatho doonan nayta ay zoroo?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: አችቼ ፐይየቴꬃአ ኡብበ ገልለ ነአገነው ጎኦፈꬆ ዶኦነን ነይተ አይ ዞሮኦ?
flat_utterances.amharic: የጥርስ ጤንነትን በየቀኑ ለመጠበቅ በጎፋኛ ልጆችን ምን እንምከር?
flat_utterances.english: How should we advise children in Gofatho to care for their dental health every day?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: achche payyatetha-a (tooth health-ACC) + ubba galla naag-anaw (every day guard-FUT.PURP) + nay-ta ay zor-oo (child-PL.ACC what advise-1PL.INTER).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Sellassie Cheru (2015, p. 375: achche); Phrasebook PHR-031 & PHR-034

flat_utterances.domain_name: Primary Healthcare & Maternal/Clinic Triage (Aakime Keethi)
flat_utterances.subtopic: Dental Pain & Oral Hygiene (Achche Sakko)
flat_utterances.speaker: assistant
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: "Quumaappe guyye achchiyaa haathaaranne achche miishshan loythi meeccite; sukkaarey daridabaa daro mooppite!" gada zora.
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: "ቁኡመአፕፔ ጉይዬ አችቺየአ ሀአꬃአረንኔ አችቼ ሚኢሽሻን ሎይꬂ ሜእጭጪቴ፤ ሱክከአሬይ ደሪደበአ ደሮ ሞኦፕፒቴ!" ገደ ዞረ።
flat_utterances.amharic: «ከምግብ በኋላ ጥርሳችሁን በውኃና በጥርስ መፋቂያ በደንብ እጠቡ፤ ስኳር የበዛበትን ነገር አብዝታችሁ አትብሉ!» ብለህ ምከር።
flat_utterances.english: Advise them: 'After meals, brush and rinse your teeth well; and do not eat too many sugary things!'
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: quumaa-ppe guyye (food-ABL after) + achchiya-a (tooth-ACC.M.DEF) + loythi meecc-ite (well wash-IMP.2PL); m-ooppite (eat-PROH.2PL).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Sellassie Cheru (2015, p. 375: achche); Phrasebook PHR-031 & PHR-034

flat_utterances.domain_name: Primary Healthcare & Maternal/Clinic Triage (Aakime Keethi)
flat_utterances.subtopic: Visiting a Hospitalized Relative & Wishing Speedy Recovery
flat_utterances.speaker: user
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Ta gutha aaway Sawula Hospitaaliyan zin77idi akkamettees. Iya oychchanaw biyaa wode Goofa wogan ay gada anjjoo?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ተ ጉꬃ አአወይ ሰዉለ ሆስፒተአሊየን ዚንዕዒዲ አክከሜትቴእስ። ኢየ ኦይችቻነው ቢየአ ዎዴ ጎኦፈ ዎገን አይ ገደ አንጅጆኦ?
flat_utterances.amharic: አጎቴ በሳውላ ሆስፒታል ተኝቶ እየታከመ ነው። እርሱን ለመጠየቅ ስሄድ በጎፋ ባህል ምን ብዬ ልመርቀው?
flat_utterances.english: My paternal uncle is admitted and receiving treatment at Sawla Hospital. When I go to visit him, how should I bless and encourage him in Gofa custom?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: ta gutha aawa-y (my paternal.uncle-NOM) + Sawula Hospitaaliya-n zin77-idi (Sawla Hospital-LOC lie/sleep-CNV2.ANT) + akkam-ett-ees (treat-PASS-PRES.3MS); iya oychch-anaw (3MS.ACC visit-FUT.PURP).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Phrasebook PHR-009, PHR-039 & PHR-040; Grade 9 Ch. 4 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/1uvGaBT4-O_Jn7oQbuNl1W88lFBFiHULU/view?usp=drivesdk, p. 31)

flat_utterances.domain_name: Primary Healthcare & Maternal/Clinic Triage (Aakime Keethi)
flat_utterances.subtopic: Visiting a Hospitalized Relative & Wishing Speedy Recovery
flat_utterances.speaker: assistant
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Iyaakko gelada: "Saro! Ha77i waanay? Xoossi neessi kumetta payyatethaa immo, eesuwan paxada ne soo simma!" gada minthitha.
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ኢየአክኮ ጌለደ፦ "ሰሮ! ሀዕዒ ወአነይ? ጦኦስሲ ኔእስሲ ኩሜትተ ፐይየቴꬃአ ኢምሞ፣ እእሱወን ፐጠደ ኔ ሶኦ ሲምመ!" ገደ ሚንꬂꬃ።
flat_utterances.amharic: ወደ እርሱ ገብተህ፦ «ሰላም! አሁን እንዴት ነህ? እግዚአብሔር ሙሉ ጤንነትን ይስጥህ፣ በፍጥነት ድነህ ወደ ቤትህ ተመለስ!» ብለህ አበረታታው።
flat_utterances.english: When you enter to see him, encourage him saying: 'Peace! How are you feeling now? May God grant you full health, recover quickly and return to your home!'
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: iyaa-kko gel-ada (3MS-DIR enter-CNV1.ANT.2S); ha77i waan-ay (now how.be-PRES.2S.INTER); kumetta payyatetha-a (full health-ACC) + imm-o (give-JUSS.3MS); pax-ada (heal-CNV1.ANT.2S) + simm-a (return-IMP.2S).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Phrasebook PHR-009, PHR-039 & PHR-040; Grade 9 Ch. 4 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/1uvGaBT4-O_Jn7oQbuNl1W88lFBFiHULU/view?usp=drivesdk, p. 31)

flat_utterances.domain_name: Primary Healthcare & Maternal/Clinic Triage (Aakime Keethi)
flat_utterances.subtopic: Visiting a Hospitalized Relative & Wishing Speedy Recovery
flat_utterances.speaker: user
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Iikka "Aakimey xaliyaa immiis; Xoosso maarotan ha77i keha!" giikko ay gada zaaroo?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ኢኢክከ "አአኪሜይ ጠሊየአ ኢምሚኢስ፤ ጦኦስሶ መአሮተን ሀዕዒ ኬሀ!" ጊኢክኮ አይ ገደ ዘአሮኦ?
flat_utterances.amharic: እርሱም «ሐኪሙ መድኃኒት ሰጥቶኛል፤ በእግዚአብሔር ምሕረት አሁን ደህና ነኝ!» ካለ ምን ብዬ ልመልስ?
flat_utterances.english: And if he says, 'The doctor gave me medicine; by God's mercy I am better now!', how should I reply?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: Xoosso maarota-n (God mercy-LOC, Gr9 Ch.4 p. 31) + ha77i keha (now better/good); ay g-ada zaar-oo (what say-CNV1.ANT.1S answer-1S.INTER.JUSS).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Phrasebook PHR-009, PHR-039 & PHR-040; Grade 9 Ch. 4 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/1uvGaBT4-O_Jn7oQbuNl1W88lFBFiHULU/view?usp=drivesdk, p. 31)

flat_utterances.domain_name: Primary Healthcare & Maternal/Clinic Triage (Aakime Keethi)
flat_utterances.subtopic: Visiting a Hospitalized Relative & Wishing Speedy Recovery
flat_utterances.speaker: assistant
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: "Xoossi galatetto! Payyatethay ubbabaappe aadhdhees; loythi shemppada quumaakka ma!" gada zaara.
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: "ጦኦስሲ ገለቴትቶ! ፐይየቴꬃይ ኡብበበአፕፔ አአꬍꬌእስ፤ ሎይꬂ ሼምፕፐደ ቁኡመአክከ መ!" ገደ ዘአረ።
flat_utterances.amharic: «እግዚአብሔር ይመስገን! ጤና ከሁሉም ነገር ይበልጣል፤ በደንብ አርፈህ ምግብም ብላ!» ብለህ መልስ።
flat_utterances.english: Reply: 'Thanks be to God! Health surpasses everything; rest well and eat your food!'
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: Xooss-i galat-etto (God-NOM thank-PASS.JUSS.3MS, PHR-003); payyatetha-y ubbabaa-ppe aadhdh-ees (PHR-039); shempp-ada (rest-CNV1.ANT.2S) + m-a (eat-IMP.2S).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Phrasebook PHR-009, PHR-039 & PHR-040; Grade 9 Ch. 4 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/1uvGaBT4-O_Jn7oQbuNl1W88lFBFiHULU/view?usp=drivesdk, p. 31)

flat_utterances.domain_name: Primary Healthcare & Maternal/Clinic Triage (Aakime Keethi)
flat_utterances.subtopic: Warning Against Harmful Substance Overuse (Muussinne Ushshi Essay)
flat_utterances.speaker: user
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Tammantho kifile Shemppo 8 (p. 77) giddon "Muussinne Ushshi" giyaa palanthiyaa adarssoy payyatethaabaa ay tamaarissii?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ተምመንꬆ ኪፊሌ ሼምፕፖ 8 (ፕ። ዕዕ) ጊድዶን "ሙኡስሲንኔ ኡሽሺ" ጊየአ ፐለንꬂየአ አደርስሶይ ፐይየቴꬃአበአ አይ ተመአሪስሲኢ?
flat_utterances.amharic: በአሥረኛ ክፍል ምዕራፍ 8 (ገጽ 77) ውስጥ «ሙኡሲኔ ኡሺ» (መብልና መጠጥ) የሚለው የመከራከሪያ ድርሰት ስለ ጤንነት ምን ያስተምራል?
flat_utterances.english: In Grade 10 Chapter 8 (p. 77), what does the argumentative essay 'Muussinne Ushshi' ('Food and Drink') teach about health?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: muussi-nne ushshi (eating-and drinking, Gr10 Ch.8 p. 77) + palanth-iyaa adarsso-y (argue-PRES.REL essay-NOM, Gr8 Ch.2 p. 42) + payyatethaa-baa (health-ABOUT) + tamaar-iss-ii (learn-CAUS-PRES.3MS.INTER).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Grade 8 Ch. 8 & Grade 10 Ch. 8 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/160NHNy-4orPcAIk-L5t6tOEtZoWemz_-/view?usp=drivesdk, p. 114; https://drive.google.com/file/d/1mKIcfMoMgnZ9Pa657NWmE-OGND2wlveM/view?usp=drivesdk, pp. 76–77: Muussinne Ushshi Argumentative Essay)

flat_utterances.domain_name: Primary Healthcare & Maternal/Clinic Triage (Aakime Keethi)
flat_utterances.subtopic: Warning Against Harmful Substance Overuse (Muussinne Ushshi Essay)

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: He adarssoy quumaanne ushshaa keenaara go7ettoy asatethaa minthiyaaba gidikkokka, ushsha daroynne yaare muussay tiriyaa, kilahuwaanne miishshaa qohiyaaogaa qonccissees.
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ሄ አደርስሶይ ቁኡመአንኔ ኡሽሻአ ኬእነአረ ጎዔትቶይ አሰቴꬃአ ሚንꬂየአበ ጊዲክኮክከ፣ ኡሽሻ ደሮይንኔ የአሬ ሙኡስሰይ ቲሪየአ፣ ኪለሁወአንኔ ሚኢሽሻአ ቆሂየአኦገአ ቆንጭጪስሴእስ።
flat_utterances.amharic: ያ ድርሰት ምግብንና መጠጥን በልክ መጠቀም ሰውነትን የሚያጠነክር ቢሆንም፣ የአልኮል መጠጥ ማብዛትና ከልክ በላይ መብላት ጉበትን፣ ኩላሊትንና ገንዘብን እንደሚጎዳ ያብራራል።
flat_utterances.english: That essay explains that while moderate food and drink strengthen the body, excessive alcohol and gluttonous overeating damage the liver, kidneys, and family finances.
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: keenaa-ra (measure/moderation-INST) + go7etto-y (using-NOM); yaare muussa-y (gluttonous eating-NOM, Gr10 Ch.8 p. 77) + tiriya-a (liver-ACC.M.DEF) + kilahuwa-a-nne (kidney-ACC.M.DEF-and, Gr9 Ch.7 p. 59) + qoh-iyaa-ogaa (harm-PRES.REL-NMZ.ACC).

flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ተምመንꬆ ኪፊሌ ሼምፕፖ 8 (ፕ። ዕዕ) ጊድዶን፦ "ሀአꬂ ሚኢጭጪሺን ሜእስ" ንኔ "የአሬ ሙኡስሲ ቢኒ ቀአልሊስ ኡሎ ደአክኪስ" ጊየአ ቶስሴቲ ጠአፌትቲዶሶነ።

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Irathay doommishin gadiyaa goshshanaw giigettays. Zariyaa zeranaappe kase biittaa waatada giigissoo?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ኢረꬃይ ዶኦምሚሺን ገዲየአ ጎሽሻነው ጊኢጌትተይስ። ዘሪየአ ዜረነአፕፔ ከሴ ቢኢትተአ ወአተደ ጊኢጊስሶኦ?
flat_utterances.amharic: ዝናብ ሲጀምር መሬቱን ለማረስ እየተዘጋጀሁ ነው። ዘር ከመዝራቴ በፊት መሬቱን እንዴት ላዘጋጅ?
flat_utterances.english: As the rain begins, I am getting ready to plow the field. Before sowing the seed, how should I prepare the soil?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: iratha-y doomm-ishin (rain-NOM start-CNV.SIM.DS) + gadiya-a goshsh-anaw (field-ACC.M.DEF plow-FUT.PURP, PHR-046); zariya-a zer-anaa-ppe kase (seed-ACC sow-FUT.NMZ-ABL before, PHR-056) + biitta-a (soil-ACC) + giig-iss-oo (prepare-CAUS-1S.INTER).

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Zariyaa zeranaappe kase booratan biittaa na77u woy heedzu toho loythi goshsha; qassi gadiyaa maaddiyaa woga marqqaa biittan walakka!
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ዘሪየአ ዜረነአፕፔ ከሴ ቦኦረተን ቢኢትተአ ነዕዑ ዎይ ሄእꬑ ቶሆ ሎይꬂ ጎሽሻ፤ ቀስሲ ገዲየአ መአድዲየአ ዎገ መርቅቀአ ቢኢትተን ወለክከ!
flat_utterances.amharic: ዘር ከመዝራትህ በፊት በበሬዎች መሬቱን ሁለት ወይም ሦስት ጊዜ በደንብ እረስ፤ ደግሞም መሬቱን የሚያዳብር የተፈጥሮ ማዳበሪያ (ማርቃ) ከአፈሩ ጋር ቀላቅል!
flat_utterances.english: Before sowing the seed, plow the soil well two or three times with oxen; and mix natural compost/manure ('marqqa', PHR-055) into the soil!
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: boora-ta-n (ox-PL.ACC-INST, PHR-050) + heedzu toho (three times) + loythi goshsh-a (well plow-IMP.2S); gadiya-a maadd-iyaa marqqa-a (land-ACC help-PRES.REL compost-ACC, PHR-055) + walakk-a (mix-IMP.2S).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Phrasebook PHR-046, PHR-050, PHR-055 & PHR-056; Grade 8 Ch. 3 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/160NHNy-4orPcAIk-L5t6tOEtZoWemz_-/view?usp=drivesdk)

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Goofa dere goshsha wogan shooroti issippe "daggo" gididi waani goshshoikonaa?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ጎኦፈ ዴሬ ጎሽሻ ዎገን ሾኦሮቲ ኢስሲፕፔ "ደግጎ" ጊዲዲ ወአኒ ጎሽሾኢኮነአ?

flat_utterances.english: In Gofa farming tradition, how do neighbors join together in cooperative labor ('daggo') to plow?

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Daggo wogan shooroti bantta booratanne beexeta ekkidi shiiqidi, issi galla issi uraa gadiyaa, wonttetha galla haraa gadiyaa yetthaaninne ufayssan goshshoosona!
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ደግጎ ዎገን ሾኦሮቲ በንትተ ቦኦረተንኔ ቤእጤተ እክኪዲ ሺኢቂዲ፣ ኢስሲ ገልለ ኢስሲ ኡረአ ገዲየአ፣ ዎንትቴꬃ ገልለ ሀረአ ገዲየአ ዬትꬃአኒንኔ ኡፈይስሰን ጎሽሾኦሶነ!
flat_utterances.amharic: በዳጎ (ደቦ) ባህል ጎረቤቶች በሬዎቻቸውንና ዶማዎቻቸውን ይዘው ተሰብስበው፣ አንድ ቀን የአንዱን ሰው ማሳ፣ በማግስቱ የሌላውን ማሳ በዘፈንና በደስታ ያርሳሉ!
flat_utterances.english: In the 'daggo' cooperative tradition, neighbors gather with their oxen and hoes, plowing one person's field one day and another's the next day with song and joy!
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: bantta boora-ta-nne beexe-ta (3PL.REFL.GEN ox-PL.ACC-and hoe-PL.ACC) + ekk-idi shiiq-idi (take-CNV2 gather-CNV2) + yetthaa-n-nne ufayssa-n (song-INST-and joy-INST) + goshsh-oosona (plow-PRES.3PL.A.DCL).

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Tossey: "Dure duufoy uutha giddo" gees; hegeekka keetha yuushuwan daro uutha tokkiyaa asi nam77ettenna guussa.
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ቶስሴይ፦ "ዱሬ ዱኡፎይ ኡኡꬃ ጊድዶ" ጌእስ፤ ሄጌእክከ ኬእꬃ ዩኡሹወን ደሮ ኡኡꬃ ቶክኪየአ አሲ ነምዕዔትቴንነ ጉኡስሰ።
flat_utterances.amharic: ምሳሌው፦ «ዱሬ ዱፎይ ኡꬃ ጊዶ» (የሀብታም መቃብሩ በእንሰት አትክልት መካከል ነው) ይላል፤ ይህም በቤቱ ዙሪያ ብዙ እንሰት የተከለ ሰው አይራብም ማለት ነው።
flat_utterances.english: The proverb says: 'Dure duufoy uutha giddo' ('A prosperous person's resting place is amidst the flourishing enset garden'); meaning a household surrounded by thriving enset never suffers hunger.
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: dure duufo-y (rich.person grave-NOM, Gr9 Ch.5 p. 41) + uutha giddo (enset inside); tokki-yaa as-i (plant-PRES.REL person-NOM) + nam77-ett-enna (hunger-PASS-PRES.3MS.NEG).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Phrasebook PHR-048 & PHR-060; Grade 9 Ch. 5 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/1uvGaBT4-O_Jn7oQbuNl1W88lFBFiHULU/view?usp=drivesdk, p. 41: Dure duufoy uutha giddo)

flat_utterances.speaker: user
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Tammantho kifile Shemppo 2 (p. 12) giddon "cumo / cumees" giyaa Goofa goshshaanne eko gelo wogay ay guussee?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ተምመንꬆ ኪፊሌ ሼምፕፖ 2 (ፕ። 12) ጊድዶን "ጩሞ / ጩሜእስ" ጊየአ ጎኦፈ ጎሽሻአንኔ እኮ ጌሎ ዎገይ አይ ጉኡስሴእ?
flat_utterances.amharic: በአሥረኛ ክፍል ምዕራፍ 2 (ገጽ 12) ውስጥ «ጩሞ / ጩሜስ» የሚለው የጎፋ የእርሻና የጋብቻ ባህል ምን ማለት ነው?
flat_utterances.english: In Grade 10 Chapter 2 (p. 12), what does the Gofa agricultural and marriage custom 'cumo / cumees' mean?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: cumo / cum-ees (groom's pre-marital planting of perennial crops around his new homestead, Gr10 Ch.2 p. 12); ay guuss-ee (what meaning-COP.INTER).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Grade 10 Goofatho Doona Ch. 2 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/1mKIcfMoMgnZ9Pa657NWmE-OGND2wlveM/view?usp=drivesdk, pp. 12–13: cumo/cumees); Phrasebook PHR-048

flat_utterances.domain_name: Agriculture, Coffee, Enset & Weather (Goshsha)
flat_utterances.subtopic: Shade-Grown Gofa Coffee (Tukke/Buna) & Pre-Marital Homestead Planting (Cumo)
flat_utterances.speaker: assistant
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: "Cumo" guussay attuma na7ay machcho ekkanaappe kase ba ooratha keetha yuushuwan uutha, tukke, muze, boyenne suunqqo mithata tokkiyaa woga.
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: "ጩሞ" ጉኡስሰይ አትቱመ ነዓይ መችቾ እክከነአፕፔ ከሴ በ ኦኦረꬃ ኬእꬃ ዩኡሹወን ኡኡꬃ፣ ቱክኬ፣ ሙዜ፣ ቦዬንኔ ሱኡንቅቆ ሚꬃተ ቶክኪየአ ዎገ።
flat_utterances.amharic: «ጩሞ» ማለት ወንድ ልጅ ሚስት ከማግባቱ በፊት በአዲሱ ቤቱ ዙሪያ እንሰት፣ ቡና (ቱኬ)፣ ሙዝ፣ ቦዬና የቅመም ተክሎችን የሚተክልበት ባህል ነው።
flat_utterances.english: 'Cumo' is the custom whereby a young man, before marrying, plants enset, coffee ('tukke'), bananas, yam ('boye'), and spice plants around his new homestead.
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: machcho ekk-anaa-ppe kase (wife take/marry-FUT.NMZ-ABL before) + ba ooratha keetha yuushuwa-n (3REFL.GEN new house surroundings-LOC) + tokk-iyaa woga (plant-PRES.REL custom).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Grade 10 Goofatho Doona Ch. 2 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/1mKIcfMoMgnZ9Pa657NWmE-OGND2wlveM/view?usp=drivesdk, pp. 12–13: cumo/cumees); Phrasebook PHR-048

flat_utterances.domain_name: Agriculture, Coffee, Enset & Weather (Goshsha)
flat_utterances.subtopic: Shade-Grown Gofa Coffee (Tukke/Buna) & Pre-Marital Homestead Planting (Cumo)
flat_utterances.speaker: user
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Tukke mithay keyan melonna mala ayba kuya mithata garssan tokkettii?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ቱክኬ ሚꬃይ ኬየን ሜሎንነ መለ አይበ ኩየ ሚꬃተ ገርስሰን ቶክኬትቲኢ?
flat_utterances.amharic: የቡና ተክሉ በፀሐይ እንዳይደርቅ በምን ዓይነት የጥላ ዛፎች ስር ይተከላል?
flat_utterances.english: So that coffee plants do not wither in the hot sun, under what kind of shade trees are they planted?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: tukke mitha-y (coffee tree-NOM) + keya-n (sun-LOC, PHR-058) + mel-onna mala (dry-NEG.PURP) + kuya mitha-ta garssa-n (shade tree-PL.GEN under-LOC, Gr8 Ch.2 p. 34 kuya) + tokk-ett-ii (plant-PASS-PRES.3MS.INTER).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Grade 10 Goofatho Doona Ch. 2 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/1mKIcfMoMgnZ9Pa657NWmE-OGND2wlveM/view?usp=drivesdk, pp. 12–13: cumo/cumees); Phrasebook PHR-048

flat_utterances.domain_name: Agriculture, Coffee, Enset & Weather (Goshsha)
flat_utterances.subtopic: Shade-Grown Gofa Coffee (Tukke/Buna) & Pre-Marital Homestead Planting (Cumo)
flat_utterances.speaker: assistant
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Goofa gaden tukkey wola, korddo, zigaanne muziyaa kuya garssan tokkettees; mithaa haythay wukkidi biittaa marqqees.
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ጎኦፈ ገዴን ቱክኬይ ዎለ፣ ኮርድዶ፣ ዚገአንኔ ሙዚየአ ኩየ ገርስሰን ቶክኬትቴእስ፤ ሚꬃአ ሀይꬃይ ዉክኪዲ ቢኢትተአ መርቅቄእስ።
flat_utterances.amharic: በጎፋ ምድር ቡና በዋርካ (ዎላ)፣ በዋንዛ፣ በዝግባና በሙዝ ጥላ ስር ይተከላል፤ የዛፉ ቅጠልም ረግፎ አፈሩን ያዳብራል።
flat_utterances.english: In Gofa, coffee is planted under the shade of sycamore fig ('wola', Gr8 Ch.5 p. 76), cordia, podocarpus, and banana trees; the fallen leaves also enrich the soil.
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: wola (sycamore fig tree, Gr8 Ch.5 p. 76) + kuya garssa-n (shade under-LOC) + tokk-ett-ees (plant-PASS-PRES.3MS); biitta-a marqq-ees (soil-ACC fertilize-PRES.3MS).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Grade 10 Goofatho Doona Ch. 2 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/1mKIcfMoMgnZ9Pa657NWmE-OGND2wlveM/view?usp=drivesdk, pp. 12–13: cumo/cumees); Phrasebook PHR-048

flat_utterances.domain_name: Agriculture, Coffee, Enset & Weather (Goshsha)
flat_utterances.subtopic: Reforestation, Soil Conservation & Preventing Desertification (Bazzotethi)
flat_utterances.speaker: user
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Hosppuntho kifile Shemppo 6 ("Bazzotethi", p. 82) giddon woray qeexettiyaa wodenne xaraga tamay medhettiyaa wode biittaa bolla ayba qohoy gakkii?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ሆስፕፑንꬆ ኪፊሌ ሼምፕፖ 6 ("በዝዞቴꬂ"፣ ፕ። 82) ጊድዶን ዎረይ ቄእጤትቲየአ ዎዴንኔ ጠረገ ተመይ ሜꬌትቲየአ ዎዴ ቢኢትተአ ቦልለ አይበ ቆሆይ ገክኪኢ?
flat_utterances.amharic: በስምንተኛ ክፍል ምዕራፍ 6 («በረሃማነት»፣ ገጽ 82) ውስጥ ደን ሲጨፈጨፍና የሰደድ እሳት ሲነሣ በመሬቱ ላይ ምን ጉዳት ይደርሳል?
flat_utterances.english: In Grade 8 Chapter 6 ('Desertification', p. 82), when forests are cut down and wildfires occur, what damage happens to the land?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: wora-y qeex-ett-iyaa wode-nne (forest-NOM clear/cut-PASS-PRES.REL when-and, Gr8 Ch.9 p. 128) + xaraga tama-y (wildfire-NOM, Gr8 Ch.6 p. 83) + bazzotethi (desertification, Gr8 Ch.6 p. 82).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Grade 8 Goofatho Doona Ch. 1, Ch. 6 & Ch. 9 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/160NHNy-4orPcAIk-L5t6tOEtZoWemz_-/view?usp=drivesdk, pp. 11, 82–94, 127); Phrasebook PHR-049

flat_utterances.domain_name: Agriculture, Coffee, Enset & Weather (Goshsha)
flat_utterances.subtopic: Reforestation, Soil Conservation & Preventing Desertification (Bazzotethi)
flat_utterances.speaker: assistant
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Woray qeexettiyaa wode iratha di7oy marqqa biittaa meecidi efees, pulttoti meloosona, wora do7ati betoosonanne bazzotethay daayees.
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ዎረይ ቄእጤትቲየአ ዎዴ ኢረꬃ ዲዖይ መርቅቀ ቢኢትተአ ሜእጪዲ እፌእስ፣ ፑልትቶቲ ሜሎኦሶነ፣ ዎረ ዶዓቲ ቤቶኦሶነንኔ በዝዞቴꬃይ ደአዬእስ።
flat_utterances.amharic: ደን ሲጨፈጨፍ የዝናብ ጎርፍ ለም አፈሩን አጥቦ ይወስዳል፣ ምንጮች ይደርቃሉ፣ የዱር እንስሳት ይሰደዳሉ እንዲሁም በረሃማነት ይስፋፋል።
flat_utterances.english: When forests are cleared, rain runoff washes away fertile topsoil, springs dry up, wild animals flee, and desertification spreads ('daayees').
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: iratha di7o-y (rain flood-NOM, Gr8 Ch.1 p. 11) + marqqa biitta-a meec-idi ef-ees (fertile soil-ACC wash-CNV2 take-PRES.3MS); mel-oosona (dry-PRES.3PL); daay-ees (spread-PRES.3MS, Gr8 Ch.8 p. 114).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Grade 8 Goofatho Doona Ch. 1, Ch. 6 & Ch. 9 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/160NHNy-4orPcAIk-L5t6tOEtZoWemz_-/view?usp=drivesdk, pp. 11, 82–94, 127); Phrasebook PHR-049

flat_utterances.domain_name: Agriculture, Coffee, Enset & Weather (Goshsha)
flat_utterances.subtopic: Reforestation, Soil Conservation & Preventing Desertification (Bazzotethi)
flat_utterances.speaker: user
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Deretethay biittay di7on meecettonna malaanne bazzotethaa teqqanaw ay oothanaw bessii?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ዴሬቴꬃይ ቢኢትተይ ዲዖን ሜእጬትቶንነ መለአንኔ በዝዞቴꬃአ ቴቅቀነው አይ ኦኦꬃነው ቤስሲኢ?
flat_utterances.amharic: ማኅበረሰቡ አፈሩ በጎርፍ እንዳይታጠብና በረሃማነትን ለመከላከል ምን ማድረግ ይገባዋል?
flat_utterances.english: What must the community do so that the soil is not eroded by runoff and to halt desertification?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: biitta-y di7o-n meec-ett-onna mala-anne (soil-NOM flood-INST wash-PASS-NEG.PURP-and, Gr8 Ch.1 p. 11) + teqq-anaw (prevent/block-FUT.PURP).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Grade 8 Goofatho Doona Ch. 1, Ch. 6 & Ch. 9 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/160NHNy-4orPcAIk-L5t6tOEtZoWemz_-/view?usp=drivesdk, pp. 11, 82–94, 127); Phrasebook PHR-049

flat_utterances.domain_name: Agriculture, Coffee, Enset & Weather (Goshsha)
flat_utterances.subtopic: Reforestation, Soil Conservation & Preventing Desertification (Bazzotethi)
flat_utterances.speaker: assistant
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Dere zumata bolla keela keexxanaw, xaraga tamaappe woraa naaganawinne ubba balgguwan ooratha mitha xeerata tokkanaw bessees. "Mithaa tokkoy biittaa naagees!"
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ዴሬ ዙመተ ቦልለ ኬእለ ኬእጥጠነው፣ ጠረገ ተመአፕፔ ዎረአ ነአገነዊንኔ ኡብበ በልግጉወን ኦኦረꬃ ሚꬃ ጤእረተ ቶክከነው ቤስሴእስ። "ሚꬃአ ቶክኮይ ቢኢትተአ ነአጌእስ!"
flat_utterances.amharic: በተራራ ተዳፋቶች ላይ እርከን መሥራት፣ ደንን ከሰደድ እሳት መጠበቅና በየክረምቱ አዳዲስ የዛፍ ችግኞችን መትከል ይገባል። «ዛፍ መትከል አፈርን ይጠብቃል!»
flat_utterances.english: We must build terraces on mountain slopes, guard forests from wildfire, and plant new tree seedlings every rainy season. 'Planting trees protects the soil!'
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: dere zuma-ta bolla (mountain slope-PL.GEN on) + keela keexx-anaw (terrace build-FUT.PURP) + mitha-a tokko-y biitta-a naag-ees (PHR-049).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Grade 8 Goofatho Doona Ch. 1, Ch. 6 & Ch. 9 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/160NHNy-4orPcAIk-L5t6tOEtZoWemz_-/view?usp=drivesdk, pp. 11, 82–94, 127); Phrasebook PHR-049

flat_utterances.subtopic: Gofa Agro-Ecological Climate Zones (Ceco-Gezze, Gezze, Gadha) & Weather
flat_utterances.speaker: user
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Hosppuntho kifile Shemppo 9 ("Ayyere Haaro", p. 121) giddon ayyere haaroy aappun gita kifiletan shaakettii?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ሆስፕፑንꬆ ኪፊሌ ሼምፕፖ 9 ("አይዬሬ ሀአሮ"፣ ፕ። 121) ጊድዶን አይዬሬ ሀአሮይ አአፕፑን ጊተ ኪፊሌተን ሻአኬትቲኢ?
flat_utterances.amharic: በስምንተኛ ክፍል ምዕራፍ 9 («የአየር ንብረት»፣ ገጽ 121) ውስጥ የአየር ንብረት በስንት ዋና ክፍሎች ይከፈላል?
flat_utterances.english: In Grade 8 Chapter 9 ('Climate Patterns', p. 121), into how many major agro-climatic zones is climate divided?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: ayyere haaro-y (climate/weather pattern-NOM, Gr8 Ch.9 p. 121) + aappun gita kifile-ta-n (how.many major zone-PL-LOC) + shaak-ett-ii (divide-PASS-PRES.3MS.INTER, MP-06 < shaakk- + -ett-).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Grade 8 Goofatho Doona Ch. 5 & Ch. 9 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/160NHNy-4orPcAIk-L5t6tOEtZoWemz_-/view?usp=drivesdk, pp. 76, 121–132: Ayyere Haaro, ceco-gezze, gezze, gadha)

flat_utterances.domain_name: Agriculture, Coffee, Enset & Weather (Goshsha)
flat_utterances.subtopic: Gofa Agro-Ecological Climate Zones (Ceco-Gezze, Gezze, Gadha) & Weather
flat_utterances.speaker: assistant
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Hosppuntho kifile maxaafaa (p. 123) maaran: xoqqa irxxa "ceco-gezze", "gezze", "giddo-gezze", "gadha" nne "bazzo" geetettidi shaakettees.
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ሆስፕፑንꬆ ኪፊሌ መጠአፈአ (ፕ። 123) መአረን፦ ጦቅቀ ኢርጥጠ "ጬጮ-ጌዝዜ"፣ "ጌዝዜ"፣ "ጊድዶ-ጌዝዜ"፣ "ገꬋ" ንኔ "በዝዞ" ጌእቴትቲዲ ሻአኬትቴእስ።
flat_utterances.amharic: በስምንተኛ ክፍል መጽሐፍ (ገጽ 123) መሠረት፦ ከፍተኛ ቅዝቃዜ ያለው «ጨጮ-ጌዜ» (ውርጭ)፣ «ጌዜ» (ደጋ)፣ «ጊዶ-ጌዜ» (ወይና ደጋ)፣ «ጋꬋ» (ቆላ) እና «ባዞ» (በረሃ) ተብሎ ይከፈላል።
flat_utterances.english: According to the Grade 8 textbook (p. 123), it is classified into alpine frost ('ceco-gezze'), highland ('gezze'), mid-altitude ('giddo-gezze'), lowland ('gadha'), and desert ('bazzo').
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: ceco-gezze (alpine frost zone, Gr8 Ch.9 p. 123) + gezze (highland) + gadha (lowland) + bazzo (desert) + shaak-ett-ees (divide-PASS-PRES.3MS).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Grade 8 Goofatho Doona Ch. 5 & Ch. 9 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/160NHNy-4orPcAIk-L5t6tOEtZoWemz_-/view?usp=drivesdk, pp. 76, 121–132: Ayyere Haaro, ceco-gezze, gezze, gadha)

flat_utterances.speaker: user
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Goofa Zooniyan Bulqinne Melo Koza xoqqa gezzen, qassi Sawulanne Laha giddo-gezzeninne gadhan ayba katthati diccoikonaa?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ጎኦፈ ዞኦኒየን ቡልቂንኔ ሜሎ ኮዘ ጦቅቀ ጌዝዜን፣ ቀስሲ ሰዉለንኔ ለሀ ጊድዶ-ጌዝዜኒንኔ ገꬋን አይበ ከትꬃቲ ዲጭጮኢኮነአ?
flat_utterances.amharic: በጎፋ ዞን በቡልቂና መሎ ኮዛ ከፍተኛ ደጋ፣ ደግሞም በሳውላና ላሃ ወይና ደጋና ቆላ ምን ዓይነት ሰብሎች ያድጋሉ?
flat_utterances.english: In Gofa Zone, what crops grow in the Bulqi and Melo Koza highlands versus the Sawla and Laha midlands and lowlands?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: xoqqa gezze-n (high highland-LOC) + giddo-gezze-n-inne gadha-n (midland-LOC-and lowland-LOC) + ayba kattha-ti (what crop-PL.NOM) + dicc-oikonaa (grow-PRES.3PL.INTER).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Grade 8 Goofatho Doona Ch. 5 & Ch. 9 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/160NHNy-4orPcAIk-L5t6tOEtZoWemz_-/view?usp=drivesdk, pp. 76, 121–132: Ayyere Haaro, ceco-gezze, gezze, gadha)
