flat_utterances.subtopic: Gofa Agro-Ecological Climate Zones (Ceco-Gezze, Gezze, Gadha) & Weather
flat_utterances.speaker: assistant
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Bulqi gezzen bangga, qamade, atare, baqeelanne uutha daro diccees; Sawulanne Laha heeran qassi tukke, xaafe, badalla, muze, maangonne kassava loythi diccees!
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ቡልቂ ጌዝዜን በንግገ፣ ቀመዴ፣ አተሬ፣ በቄእለንኔ ኡኡꬃ ደሮ ዲጭጬእስ፤ ሰዉለንኔ ለሀ ሄእረን ቀስሲ ቱክኬ፣ ጠአፌ፣ በደልለ፣ ሙዜ፣ መአንጎንኔ ከስሰvአ ሎይꬂ ዲጭጬእስ!
flat_utterances.amharic: በቡልቂ ደጋ ገብስ፣ ስንዴ፣ አተር፣ ባቄላና እንሰት በብዛት ያድጋል፤ በሳውላና ላሃ አካባቢ ደግሞ ቡና፣ ጤፍ፣ በቆሎ፣ ሙዝ፣ ማንጎና ካሳቫ በደንብ ያድጋሉ!
flat_utterances.english: In the Bulqi highlands, barley, wheat, peas, fava beans, and enset flourish; while around Sawla and Laha, coffee, teff, maize, bananas, mangoes, and cassava grow abundantly!
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: bangga (barley), qamade (wheat), atare (pea), uutha (enset), tukke (coffee), xaafe (teff), badalla (maize), muze (banana) + loythi dicc-ees (well grow-PRES.3MS).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Grade 8 Goofatho Doona Ch. 5 & Ch. 9 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/160NHNy-4orPcAIk-L5t6tOEtZoWemz_-/view?usp=drivesdk, pp. 76, 121–132: Ayyere Haaro, ceco-gezze, gezze, gadha)

flat_utterances.speaker: user
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Boniyan keyay daro ho77iyaa wode haathay guuxxees. "Boniyaw haathaa dagayidi oyqqite" giyay waatidi oosettii?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ቦኒየን ኬየይ ደሮ ሆዕዒየአ ዎዴ ሀአꬃይ ጉኡጥጤእስ። "ቦኒየው ሀአꬃአ ደገዪዲ ኦይቅቂቴ" ጊየይ ወአቲዲ ኦኦሴትቲኢ?
flat_utterances.amharic: በበጋ ፀሐዩ በጣም በሚሞቅበት ጊዜ ውኃ ይቀንሳል። «ለበጋው ውኃ አጠራቅማችሁ ያዙ» የሚለው እንዴት ይተገበራል?
flat_utterances.english: In the dry season when the sun gets very hot, water becomes scarce. How do we put into practice 'Harvest and store water for the dry season'?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: boniya-n keya-y daro ho77-iyaa wode (dry.season-LOC sun-NOM very be.hot-PRES.REL when, PHR-058) + boniya-w haatha-a dagay-idi oyqq-ite (PHR-051) + waat-idi oos-ett-ii (how-CNV2 work-PASS-PRES.3MS.INTER).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Phrasebook PHR-047, PHR-051 & PHR-058; Grade 8 Ch. 9 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/160NHNy-4orPcAIk-L5t6tOEtZoWemz_-/view?usp=drivesdk)

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Irathay bukkiyaa balgguwaa wode kaara haathaa gita miishshan dagayon, qassi goshsha gaxan haatha ollaa bookkidi pilasttike hiixxidi haathaa oyqqon oosettees.
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ኢረꬃይ ቡክኪየአ በልግጉወአ ዎዴ ከአረ ሀአꬃአ ጊተ ሚኢሽሻን ደገዮን፣ ቀስሲ ጎሽሻ ገጠን ሀአꬃ ኦልለአ ቦኦክኪዲ ፒለስትቲኬ ሂኢጥጢዲ ሀአꬃአ ኦይቅቆን ኦኦሴትቴእስ።
flat_utterances.amharic: ዝናብ በሚዘንብበት የክረምት ወቅት የጣሪያ ውኃን በትልቅ ዕቃ በማጠራቀም፣ ደግሞም በእርሻ ዳርቻ የውኃ ጉድጓድ (ኩሬ) ቆፍሮ ፕላስቲክ አንጥፎ ውኃን በመያዝ ይተገበራል።
flat_utterances.english: During the rainy season when rain falls, it is practiced by collecting roof rainwater in large tanks and digging farm ponds lined to retain water.
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: iratha-y bukk-iyaa balgguwa-a wode (rain-NOM fall-PRES.REL rainy.season-GEN time) + haatha olla-a (water pit/pond-ACC) + bookk-idi (dig-CNV2.ANT) + oos-ett-ees (do-PASS-PRES.3MS).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Phrasebook PHR-047, PHR-051 & PHR-058; Grade 8 Ch. 9 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/160NHNy-4orPcAIk-L5t6tOEtZoWemz_-/view?usp=drivesdk)

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Dagayettida haathaara boniyan ayba katthata haatha ushshidi dichchanaw dandda7ettii?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ደገዬትቲደ ሀአꬃአረ ቦኒየን አይበ ከትꬃተ ሀአꬃ ኡሽሺዲ ዲችቻነው ደንድደዔትቲኢ?
flat_utterances.amharic: በተጠራቀመው ውኃ በበጋ ምን ዓይነት አትክልቶችንና ሰብሎችን ውኃ አጠጥቶ ማሳደግ ይቻላል?
flat_utterances.english: With the stored water, what crops and vegetables can be irrigated and grown during the dry season?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: dagay-ett-ida haathaa-ra (store-PASS-PAST.REL water-INST) + haatha ushsh-idi (water drink.CAUS-CNV2 = irrigate, MP-04/05) + dichch-anaw dandda7-ett-ii (grow.CAUS-FUT.PURP can-PASS-PRES.3MS.INTER).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Phrasebook PHR-047, PHR-051 & PHR-058; Grade 8 Ch. 9 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/160NHNy-4orPcAIk-L5t6tOEtZoWemz_-/view?usp=drivesdk)

flat_utterances.subtopic: Water Harvesting for the Dry Season (Boniya Haatha Dagayo)

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Santhi, shinkkurtte, timaatime, karootenne tukke xeerata boniyan haatha ushshidi dichchidi giyan lo77o waagan bayzzanaw dandda7ettees!
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ሰንꬂ፣ ሺንክኩርትቴ፣ ቲመአቲሜ፣ ከሮኦቴንኔ ቱክኬ ጤእረተ ቦኒየን ሀአꬃ ኡሽሺዲ ዲችቺዲ ጊየን ሎዕዖ ወአገን በይዝዘነው ደንድደዔትቴእስ!
flat_utterances.amharic: ጎመን፣ ሽንኩርት፣ ቲማቲም፣ ካሮትና የቡና ችግኞችን በበጋ ውኃ አጠጥቶ በማሳደግ በገበያ በጥሩ ዋጋ መሸጥ ይቻላል!
flat_utterances.english: Cabbage/greens ('santhi'), onions, tomatoes, carrots, and coffee seedlings can be irrigated in the dry season and sold at a good price in the market!
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: tukke xeera-ta (coffee seedling-PL.ACC) + haatha ushsh-idi (irrigate-CNV2) + dichch-idi (grow.CAUS-CNV2) + bayzz-anaw dandda7-ett-ees (sell-FUT.PURP can-PASS-PRES.3MS).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Phrasebook PHR-047, PHR-051 & PHR-058; Grade 8 Ch. 9 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/160NHNy-4orPcAIk-L5t6tOEtZoWemz_-/view?usp=drivesdk)

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Nuuni soo meheta - miizzata, dorssatanne deeshshata - heemmoos. Miizziyaa daro maatha immana mala ay oothoo?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ኑኡኒ ሶኦ ሜሄተ - ሚኢዝዘተ፣ ዶርስሰተንኔ ዴእሽሻተ - ሄእምሞኦስ። ሚኢዝዚየአ ደሮ መአꬃ ኢምመነ መለ አይ ኦኦꬆኦ?
flat_utterances.amharic: እኛ የቤት እንስሳትን—ላሞችን፣ በጎችንና ፍየሎችን—እናረባለን። ላሟ ብዙ ወተት እንድትሰጥ ምን እናድርግ?
flat_utterances.english: We herd domestic livestock—cows, sheep, and goats. What should we do so that the cow gives plenty of milk?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: soo mehe-ta (domestic livestock-PL.ACC, Gr8 Ch.5 p. 76) + miizza-ta, dorssa-ta-nne deeshsha-ta (cow-PL.ACC, sheep-PL.ACC-and goat-PL.ACC, PHR-052) + heemm-oos (herd-PRES.1PL); daro maatha imm-ana mala (much milk give-FUT.PURP).

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Miizzaas geeshsha maataa, uutha haythaa, maxiniyaanne geeshsha haathaa ubba galla imma; qassi zin77iyaa golay geeshsha gido!
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ሚኢዝዘአስ ጌእሽሻ መአተአ፣ ኡኡꬃ ሀይꬃአ፣ መጢኒየአንኔ ጌእሽሻ ሀአꬃአ ኡብበ ገልለ ኢምመ፤ ቀስሲ ዚንዕዒየአ ጎለይ ጌእሽሻ ጊዶ!
flat_utterances.amharic: ለላሟ ንጹሕ ሣር፣ የእንሰት ቅጠል፣ ጨውና ንጹሕ ውኃ በየቀኑ ስጥ፤ ደግሞም የምትተኛበት በረት ንጹሕ ይሁን!
flat_utterances.english: Give the cow fresh grass, enset leaves, salt ('maxine'), and clean water every day; and keep her sleeping stall ('gola') clean!
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: miizza-as (cow-DAT, PHR-057) + geeshsha maata-a (clean grass-ACC) + uutha haytha-a (enset leaf-ACC) + imm-a (give-IMP.2S); zin77-iyaa gola-y (sleep-PRES.REL stall-NOM) + geeshsha gid-o (clean be-JUSS.3MS).

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Uddufuntho kifile Shemppo 5 (p. 41) giddon "maatha" nne "maata" gaathidi odiyaa tossey ay gii?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ኡድዱፉንꬆ ኪፊሌ ሼምፕፖ 5 (ፕ። 41) ጊድዶን "መአꬃ" ንኔ "መአተ" ገአꬂዲ ኦዲየአ ቶስሴይ አይ ጊኢ?
flat_utterances.amharic: በዘጠነኛ ክፍል ምዕራፍ 5 (ገጽ 41) ውስጥ «ማꬃ» (ወተት) እና «ማታ» (ሣር) አያይዞ የሚናገረው ምሳሌ ምን ይላል?
flat_utterances.english: What does the proverb in Grade 9 Chapter 5 (p. 41) that plays on 'maatha' (milk) and 'maata' (grass) say?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: maatha (milk, dental fricative th /θ/) vs. maata (grass, alveolar stop t /t/); gaath-idi od-iyaa tosse-y (connect-CNV2 tell-PRES.REL proverb-NOM).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Phrasebook PHR-052 & PHR-057; Grade 9 Ch. 5 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/1uvGaBT4-O_Jn7oQbuNl1W88lFBFiHULU/view?usp=drivesdk, p. 41: Maathiw ixxanaa miiziya maatiw ixxawsu)

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Tossey: "Maathiw ixxanaa miiziya maatiw ixxawsu" gees; ha tossey 'maatha' nne 'maata' cenggurssa dummatethaa loythi besses!
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ቶስሴይ፦ "መአꬂው ኢጥጠነአ ሚኢዚየ መአቲው ኢጥጠውሱ" ጌእስ፤ ሀ ቶስሴይ 'መአꬃ' ንኔ 'መአተ' ጬንግጉርስሰ ዱምመቴꬃአ ሎይꬂ ቤስሴስ!
flat_utterances.amharic: ምሳሌው፦ «ማꬂው ኢጣና ሚኢዚያ ማቲው ኢጣዉሱ» (ወተት የምትከለክል ላም ሣሩንም ትጠላለች) ይላል፤ ይህ ምሳሌ በ«ማꬃ» (ወተት) እና «ማታ» (ሣር) መካከል ያለውን የድምፅ ልዩነት በደንብ ያሳያል!
flat_utterances.english: The proverb says: 'Maathiw ixxanaa miiziya maatiw ixxawsu' ('A cow that will refuse to give milk also refuses the grass'); it beautifully illustrates the phonemic contrast between 'maatha' (milk) and 'maata' (grass)!
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: maathi-w (milk-DAT) + ixx-anaa (refuse-FUT.REL.F) + miiz-iya (cow-NOM.F.DEF) + maati-w (grass-DAT) + ixx-awsu (refuse-PRES.3FS.A.DCL, Gr9 Ch.5 p. 41).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Phrasebook PHR-052 & PHR-057; Grade 9 Ch. 5 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/1uvGaBT4-O_Jn7oQbuNl1W88lFBFiHULU/view?usp=drivesdk, p. 41: Maathiw ixxanaa miiziya maatiw ixxawsu)

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Katthaa cakkiyaa wodey gakkiis! Banggaanne qamadiyaa cakkidaappe guyye qum77onna mala waatidi oyqqoo?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ከትꬃአ ጨክኪየአ ዎዴይ ገክኪኢስ! በንግገአንኔ ቀመዲየአ ጨክኪደአፕፔ ጉይዬ ቁምዕዖንነ መለ ወአቲዲ ኦይቅቆኦ?
flat_utterances.amharic: አዝመራውን የሚያጭዱበት ጊዜ ደረሰ! ገብሱንና ስንዴውን ካጨድን በኋላ እንዳይበላሽ (እንዳይነቅዝ) እንዴት እንያዘው?
flat_utterances.english: The time for harvesting the crops has arrived! After harvesting the barley and wheat, how should we store it so it does not spoil?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: kattha-a cakk-iyaa wode-y gakk-iis (crop-ACC harvest-PRES.REL time-NOM arrive-PAST.3MS, PHR-053); cakk-idaa-ppe guyye (harvest-PAST.REL-ABL after) + qum77-onna mala (spoil/rot-NEG.PURP, Gr10 Ch.5 p. 40).

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Katthaa cakkidi, awan loythi melissidi, buuxaa shaakkada, irxxoynne ecereti gakkonna geeshsha shonggan wothada oyqqa!
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ከትꬃአ ጨክኪዲ፣ አወን ሎይꬂ ሜሊስሲዲ፣ ቡኡጠአ ሻአክከደ፣ ኢርጥጦይንኔ እጬሬቲ ገክኮንነ ጌእሽሻ ሾንግገን ዎꬃደ ኦይቅቀ!
flat_utterances.amharic: እህሉን አጭደህ፣ በፀሐይ በደንብ አድርቀህ፣ ገለባውን ለይተህ፣ እርጥበትና አይጦች በማይደርሱበት ንጹሕ ጎተራ አድርገህ ያዝ!
flat_utterances.english: Harvest the grain, dry it thoroughly in the sun, winnow the chaff, and store it in a clean granary protected from moisture and rodents!
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: awa-n loythi mel-iss-idi (sun-LOC well dry-CAUS-CNV2.ANT) + buuxa-a shaakk-ada (chaff-ACC separate-CNV1.ANT.2S) + woth-ada oyqq-a (put-CNV1.ANT.2S keep-IMP.2S).

flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ዜሬꬂ ከትꬃአ ሞኦንነአን ዎንትቶ ዜሬꬃአስ ነአገነአበአ ኡድዱፉንꬆ ኪፊሌ ሼምፕፖ 5 ቶስሴይ አይ ጊኢ?

flat_utterances.english: What does the Grade 9 Chapter 5 proverb say about saving seed grain rather than consuming it in idleness?

flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ኡድዱፉንꬆ ኪፊሌ ሼምፕፖ 5 (ፕ። 41) ቶስሴይ፦ "ኡቴꬃ ደሮይ ዜሬꬂ ጮኦንቼእስ" ጌእስ፤ ሄስሰ ጊሾ ዜሬꬂ ከትꬃአ ዱምመ ሻአክኪዲ ኦይቅቀነው ቤስሴእስ።
flat_utterances.amharic: የዘጠነኛ ክፍል ምዕራፍ 5 (ገጽ 41) ምሳሌ፦ «ኡቴꬃ ዳሮይ ዜሬꬂ ጮንቼስ» (ቁጭ ማለት ሲበዛ የዘር እህል ያስጨርሳል) ይላል፤ ስለዚህ የዘር እህልን ለይቶ ማስቀመጥ ይገባል።
flat_utterances.english: The Grade 9 Chapter 5 (p. 41) proverb says: 'Utetha daroy zerethi coonchees' ('Sitting idle too long consumes the seed grain'); therefore seed grain must be set aside and guarded carefully.
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: utetha daro-y (sitting excess-NOM) + zerethi coonch-ees (seed chew/consume-PRES.3MS, Gr9 Ch.5 p. 41); dumma shaakk-idi oyqq-anaw bess-ees (separately divide-CNV2 keep-FUT.PURP ought-PRES.3MS).

flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ዎገ መꬂ ኮኦሮንኔ ኦኦረꬃ ሰአጢኔ መꬂ ኬእꬃአ ጪኢሽሻይነ ጌእሽሻ ሀአꬃይ መተን ዴዒየአ ኩየ ቤስሰን ዎꬃ፤ ኦኦረꬃ ሰአጢኔይ ደሮ እእስሰ ኢምሜእስ!

flat_utterances.english: Place traditional cylindrical hives and modern box hives in a shaded spot near flowers and clean water; modern box hives yield abundant honey!
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: ciishsha-y-nne geeshsha haatha-y (flower-NOM-and clean water-NOM) + mata-n de7-iyaa (near-LOC exist-PRES.REL) + daro eessa imm-ees (much honey give-PRES.3MS).

flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ሶኦ ገጠን ኩትቴተ ዲችቻደ ኡጵጳአንኔ ኩትቴተ በይዝዘነው ኮየይስ። ኩትቴቲ ሀርግጌፕፔ ነአጌትተነ መለ አይ ኦኦꬆኦ?

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Kutteta keethaa xoqqan keexxada ubba galla geeshsha, geeshsha haathaanne badalla/bangga quumaa imma, qassi kutte hargge kittibaatiyaa wodiyaan immissa!
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ኩትቴተ ኬእꬃአ ጦቅቀን ኬእጥጠደ ኡብበ ገልለ ጌእሽሻ፣ ጌእሽሻ ሀአꬃአንኔ በደልለ/በንግገ ቁኡመአ ኢምመ፣ ቀስሲ ኩትቴ ሀርግጌ ኪትቲበአቲየአ ዎዲየአን ኢምሚስሰ!
flat_utterances.amharic: የዶሮዎቹን ቤት ከፍ አድርገህ ሠርተህ በየቀኑ አጽዳ፣ ንጹሕ ውኃና የበቆሎ/የገብስ መኖ ስጥ፣ ደግሞም የዶሮ በሽታ ክትባት በወቅቱ አስከትብ!
flat_utterances.english: Build the poultry coop elevated off the ground and clean it daily, provide clean water and maize/barley feed, and administer poultry vaccinations on schedule!
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: kutte-ta keetha-a xoqqa-n keexx-ada (chicken-PL.GEN house-ACC high-LOC build-CNV1.ANT.2S) + wodiya-an imm-iss-a (time-LOC give-CAUS-IMP.2S).

flat_utterances.english: What does the fine proverb about the hen in Grade 9 Chapter 8 (p. 73) say?

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Uddufuntho kifile Shemppo 8 (p. 73) tossey: "Wonttara maxida kuttiw argganthi denthenna" gees; maallado guuraara minni oothiyaa asi ubba wode xoonanchcha gidees!
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ኡድዱፉንꬆ ኪፊሌ ሼምፕፖ 8 (ፕ። ዕ3) ቶስሴይ፦ "ዎንትተረ መጢደ ኩትቲው አርግገንꬂ ዴንꬄንነ" ጌእስ፤ መአልለዶ ጉኡረአረ ሚንኒ ኦኦꬂየአ አሲ ኡብበ ዎዴ ጦኦነንችቻ ጊዴእስ!
flat_utterances.amharic: የዘጠነኛ ክፍል ምዕራፍ 8 (ገጽ 73) ምሳሌ፦ «ዎንታራ ማጢዳ ኩቲው አርጋንꬂ ዴንꬄና» (በማለዳ የለቀመችውን ዶሮ ጭልፊት አይነጥቃትም) ይላል፤ ጠዋት በማለዳ ጠንክሮ የሚሠራ ሰው ሁልጊዜ አሸናፊ ይሆናል!
flat_utterances.english: The Grade 9 Chapter 8 (p. 73) proverb says: 'Wonttara maxida kuttiw argganthi denthenna' ('The hen that gathers her grain early in the morning is not snatched by the hawk'); one who works diligently early in the morning always succeeds!
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: wontta-ra (dawn/morning-COM) + max-ida (gather/peck-PAST.REL) + kutti-w (hen-ACC.F.DEF, MP-09/10) + argganth-i (hawk-NOM.M) + denth-enna (snatch/lift-PRES.3MS.NEG, Gr9 Ch.8 p. 73).

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Saloy shaariyaan kumiis, wol7anthaykka wol77ees. Irathay bukkanaappe kase goshshappe soo eesuwan simmoo?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ሰሎይ ሻአሪየአን ኩሚኢስ፣ ዎልዓንꬃይክከ ዎልዕዔእስ። ኢረꬃይ ቡክከነአፕፔ ከሴ ጎሽሻፕፔ ሶኦ እእሱወን ሲምሞኦ?
flat_utterances.amharic: ሰማዩ በደመና ተሞልቷል፣ መብረቅም ይብለጨለጫል። ዝናቡ ከመዝነቡ በፊት ከእርሻ ወደ ቤት በፍጥነት እንመለስ?
flat_utterances.english: The sky is filled with clouds, and lightning ('wol7anthi') is flashing. Before the rain pours, should we return home quickly from the field?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: salo-y shaariya-an kum-iis (sky-NOM cloud-INST fill-PAST.3MS); wol7antha-y-kka (lightning-NOM-ADD, ZARA-03 7, Gr9 Ch.5 p. 39) + bukk-anaa-ppe kase (pour-FUT.NMZ-ABL before) + simm-oo (return-1PL.INTER.JUSS).

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Ee! Wol7anthay wol77iyaa wode xoqqa mithaa garssan eqqoppite; booratanne miisheta ekkidi eesuwan soo gelite. "Baana iray baanara bukkees!"
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: እእ! ዎልዓንꬃይ ዎልዕዒየአ ዎዴ ጦቅቀ ሚꬃአ ገርስሰን እቅቆፕፒቴ፤ ቦኦረተንኔ ሚኢሼተ እክኪዲ እእሱወን ሶኦ ጌሊቴ። "በአነ ኢረይ በአነረ ቡክኬእስ!"
flat_utterances.amharic: አዎ! መብረቅ በሚብለጨለጭበት ጊዜ በረጅም ዛፍ ስር አትቁሙ፤ በሬዎቹንና መሣሪያዎቹን ይዛችሁ በፍጥነት ወደ ቤት ግቡ። «ሊሄድ ያለ ዝናብ እያለፈ ይዘንባል!»
flat_utterances.english: Yes! When lightning is flashing, do not stand under tall trees; take the oxen and tools and head indoors quickly. 'Passing rain pours as it moves on!'
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: xoqqa mitha-a garssa-n (tall tree-GEN under-LOC) + eqq-oppite (stand-PROH.2PL); ba-ana ira-y ba-ana-ra bukk-ees (go-FUT.REL rain-NOM go-FUT-COM pour-PRES.3MS, Gr9 Ch.5 p. 41).

flat_utterances.amharic: በዘጠነኛ ክፍል ምዕራፍ 5 (ገጽ 39) ውስጥ መብረቅን («ዎልዓንꬂ») የሚገልጸው እንቆቅልሽ ምን ይላል?
flat_utterances.english: What does the riddle in Grade 9 Chapter 5 (p. 39) that describes lightning ('wol7anthi') say?

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Sedhemenkkey: "Bukkishin eexees; awishin to7ees" gees; zaaroykka "Wol7anthi"!
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ሴꬌሜንክኬይ፦ "ቡክኪሺን እእጤእስ፤ አዊሺን ቶዔእስ" ጌእስ፤ ዘአሮይክከ "ዎልዓንꬂ"!
flat_utterances.amharic: እንቆቅልሹ፦ «ቡኪሺን ኤጤስ፤ አዊሺን ቶዔስ» (ሲዘንብ ይነዳል፤ ፀሐይ ሲወጣ ይጠፋል) ይላል፤ መልሱም «ዎልዓንꬂ» (መብረቅ) ነው!
flat_utterances.english: The riddle says: 'Bukkishin eexees; awishin to7ees' ('It blazes while it rains; it goes out when the sun shines'); and the answer is 'Wol7anthi' (lightning)!
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: bukk-ishin (rain-CNV.SIM.DS) + eex-ees (burn/blaze-PRES.3MS); aw-ishin (shine.sun-CNV.SIM.DS) + to7-ees (extinguish-PRES.3MS, ZARA-03 7, Gr9 Ch.5 p. 39).

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Goofa goshshanchchati uuthaappe harabaa ayba xapho katthata gadiyan tokkoikonaa?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ጎኦፈ ጎሽሻንችቻቲ ኡኡꬃአፕፔ ሀረበአ አይበ ጠፆ ከትꬃተ ገዲየን ቶክኮኢኮነአ?
flat_utterances.amharic: የጎፋ ገበሬዎች ከእንሰት ሌላ ምን ዓይነት የሥራሥር ሰብሎችን በማሳቸው ይተክላሉ?
flat_utterances.english: Besides enset, what root and tuber crops do Gofa farmers plant in their fields?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: uuthaa-ppe harabaa (enset-ABL other) + ayba xapho kattha-ta (what root crop-PL.ACC) + gadiya-n tokk-oikonaa (field-LOC plant-PRES.3PL.INTER).

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Goofa gaden dono, boye, kachiyaanne kassavay daro tokkettoosona; entti boniyaa dandda7iyaanne so asaa quumaas daro maaddiyaa katthata.
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ጎኦፈ ገዴን ዶኖ፣ ቦዬ፣ ከቺየአንኔ ከስሰvአይ ደሮ ቶክኬትቶኦሶነ፤ እንትቲ ቦኒየአ ደንድደዒየአንኔ ሶ አሰአ ቁኡመአስ ደሮ መአድዲየአ ከትꬃተ።
flat_utterances.amharic: በጎፋ ምድር ድንች (ዶኖ)፣ ቦዬ (ጎደሬ)፣ ስኳር ድንችና ካሳቫ በብዛት ይተከላሉ፤ እነርሱም ድርቅን የሚቋቋሙና ለቤተሰብ ምግብነት በእጅጉ የሚረዱ ሰብሎች ናቸው።
flat_utterances.english: In Gofa, potatoes ('dono'), taro/yam ('boye'), sweet potatoes ('kachiyaa'), and cassava are widely planted; they are drought-tolerant crops that greatly support household food security.
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: dono (potato), boye (taro/yam), kachiyaa (sweet potato) + daro tokk-ett-oosona (widely plant-PASS-PRES.3PL); maadd-iyaa kattha-ta (help-PRES.REL crop-PL.PRED).

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Xeeray diccidi issi kushe keena xoqqiyaa wode haramaa buqqada, beexiyan xaphuwaa yuushuwan marqqa biittaa kunththa!
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ጤእረይ ዲጭጪዲ ኢስሲ ኩሼ ኬእነ ጦቅቂየአ ዎዴ ሀረመአ ቡቅቀደ፣ ቤእጢየን ጠጱወአ ዩኡሹወን መርቅቀ ቢኢትተአ ኩንꬅꬃ!
flat_utterances.amharic: ቡቃያው አድጎ አንድ ስንዝር ያህል ከፍ ሲል አረሙን ነቅለህ፣ በዶማ በሥሩ ዙሪያ ለም አፈር አስታቅፍ!
flat_utterances.english: When the shoots grow about a handspan high, pull out the weeds and use a hoe ('beexe') to mound fertile soil around the base!
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: harama-a buqq-ada (weed-ACC uproot-CNV1.ANT.2S) + beexiya-n (hoe-INST, Gr10 Ch.5 p. 39) + xaphuwa-a yuushuwa-n (root-GEN around-LOC) + kunthth-a (heap/fill-IMP.2S).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Grade 8 Goofatho Doona Ch. 3 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/160NHNy-4orPcAIk-L5t6tOEtZoWemz_-/view?usp=drivesdk, p. 53: dono-oto); Sellassie Cheru (2015, p. 377: boye, dono)

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Hosppuntho kifile Shemppo 5 (p. 76) giddon "soo mehe" nne "wora do7a" waatidi shaakkii?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ሆስፕፑንꬆ ኪፊሌ ሼምፕፖ 5 (ፕ። ዕ6) ጊድዶን "ሶኦ ሜሄ" ንኔ "ዎረ ዶዓ" ወአቲዲ ሻአክኪኢ?
flat_utterances.amharic: በስምንተኛ ክፍል ምዕራፍ 5 (ገጽ 76) ውስጥ «ሶ ሜሄ» (የቤት እንስሳ) እና «ዎራ ዶዓ» (የዱር አውሬ) እንዴት ይለያል?
flat_utterances.english: In Grade 8 Chapter 5 (p. 76), how does it distinguish between domestic livestock ('soo mehe') and wild animals ('wora do7a')?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: soo mehe (domestic animal) vs. wora do7a (wild animal, ZARA-03 glottal 7=/ʔ/, Gr8 Ch.5 p. 76) + waat-idi shaakk-ii (how-CNV2 distinguish-PRES.3MS.INTER).

flat_utterances.subtopic: Protecting Wildlife & Forest Biodiversity in Gofa (Wora Do7ata Naago)
flat_utterances.speaker: assistant
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Hosppuntho kifile maxaafaa (p. 76) maaran: dorssa, miizzanne deeshshay "maata miya soo mehe"; gaammo nne maahe qassi "asho miya wora do7a" geetettoosona.
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ሆስፕፑንꬆ ኪፊሌ መጠአፈአ (ፕ። ዕ6) መአረን፦ ዶርስሰ፣ ሚኢዝዘንኔ ዴእሽሻይ "መአተ ሚየ ሶኦ ሜሄ"፤ ገአምሞ ንኔ መአሄ ቀስሲ "አሾ ሚየ ዎረ ዶዓ" ጌእቴትቶኦሶነ።
flat_utterances.amharic: በስምንተኛ ክፍል መጽሐፍ (ገጽ 76) መሠረት፦ በግ፣ ላምና ፍየል «ሣር የሚበሉ የቤት እንስሳት» (ማታ ሚያ ሶ ሜሄ)፤ አንበሳ (ጋሞ) እና ነብር (ማሄ) ደግሞ «ሥጋ የሚበሉ የዱር አውሬዎች» (አሾ ሚያ ዎራ ዶዓ) ይባላሉ።
flat_utterances.english: According to the Grade 8 textbook (p. 76): sheep, cows, and goats are 'grass-eating domestic animals' ('maata miya soo mehe'); while the lion ('gaammo') and leopard ('maahe') are 'meat-eating wild animals' ('asho miya wora do7a').
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: maata m-iya soo mehe (grass eat-PRES.REL domestic animal) vs. asho m-iya wora do7a (meat eat-PRES.REL wild animal, Gr8 Ch.5 p. 76); geet-ett-oosona (call-PASS-PRES.3PL).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Grade 8 Goofatho Doona Ch. 5 & Ch. 6 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/160NHNy-4orPcAIk-L5t6tOEtZoWemz_-/view?usp=drivesdk, pp. 76, 82–94: gaammo, maahe, wora do7a)

flat_utterances.speaker: user
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Woraanne wora do7ata naagoy gade dichchaasinne tuurizimiyaas ay go77ii?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ዎረአንኔ ዎረ ዶዓተ ነአጎይ ገዴ ዲችቻአሲንኔ ቱኡሪዚሚየአስ አይ ጎዕዒኢ?
flat_utterances.amharic: ደንንና የዱር እንስሳትን መጠበቅ ለአገር ልማትና ለቱሪዝም ምን ይጠቅማል?
flat_utterances.english: How does protecting forests and wildlife benefit regional development and tourism?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: wora-a-nne wora do7a-ta naago-y (forest-ACC-and wild animal-PL.ACC protecting-NOM) + ay go77-ii (what benefit-PRES.3MS.INTER, ZARA-03 77).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Grade 8 Goofatho Doona Ch. 5 & Ch. 6 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/160NHNy-4orPcAIk-L5t6tOEtZoWemz_-/view?usp=drivesdk, pp. 76, 82–94: gaammo, maahe, wora do7a)

flat_utterances.domain_name: Agriculture, Coffee, Enset & Weather (Goshsha)
flat_utterances.subtopic: Protecting Wildlife & Forest Biodiversity in Gofa (Wora Do7ata Naago)
flat_utterances.speaker: assistant
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Wora naagoy ayyere haaroy giigana mala, irathay wodiyaan bukkana malanne imatati wora do7ata xeellanaw yiidi deriyaas demisha gujjana mala maaddees!
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ዎረ ነአጎይ አይዬሬ ሀአሮይ ጊኢገነ መለ፣ ኢረꬃይ ዎዲየአን ቡክከነ መለንኔ ኢመተቲ ዎረ ዶዓተ ጤእልለነው ዪኢዲ ዴሪየአስ ዴሚሻ ጉጅጀነ መለ መአድዴእስ!
flat_utterances.amharic: ደንን መጠበቅ የአየር ንብረት እንዲስተካከል፣ ዝናብ በወቅቱ እንዲዘንብና ጎብኚዎች የዱር እንስሳትን ለማየት መጥተው ለአካባቢው ገቢ እንዲጨምሩ ይረዳል!
flat_utterances.english: Protecting forests helps stabilize the climate, brings timely rainfall, and attracts visitors to see wildlife, increasing income for the community!
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: ayyere haaro-y giig-ana mala (climate-NOM stabilize-FUT.PURP) + iratha-y wodiya-an bukk-ana mala (rain-NOM time-LOC fall-FUT.PURP) + demisha gujj-ana mala (income add-FUT.PURP) + maadd-ees (help-PRES.3MS).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Grade 8 Goofatho Doona Ch. 5 & Ch. 6 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/160NHNy-4orPcAIk-L5t6tOEtZoWemz_-/view?usp=drivesdk, pp. 76, 82–94: gaammo, maahe, wora do7a)

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Balgguwan irathay daro bukkiyaa wode shaafay kumees. Shaafaa pinnanaappe kase ay naagettanaw bessii?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: በልግጉወን ኢረꬃይ ደሮ ቡክኪየአ ዎዴ ሻአፈይ ኩሜእስ። ሻአፈአ ፒንነነአፕፔ ከሴ አይ ነአጌትተነው ቤስሲኢ?
flat_utterances.amharic: በክረምት ዝናብ በብዛት በሚዘንብበት ጊዜ ወንዙ ይሞላል። ወንዙን ከመሻገራችን በፊት ምን መጠንቀቅ ይገባል?
flat_utterances.english: In the rainy season when heavy rain falls, the river floods. Before crossing the river, what precautions must we take?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: balgguwa-n iratha-y daro bukk-iyaa wode (rainy.season-LOC rain-NOM much fall-PRES.REL when) + shaafa-y kum-ees (river-NOM fill/flood-PRES.3MS); pinn-anaa-ppe kase (cross-FUT.NMZ-ABL before, PHR-084).

flat_utterances.speaker: assistant
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Shaafay di7on kumida wode gediyan woy mehen pinnoppa! Zooziyaa go7ettada pinna, woykko haathay hirqqanaashin naaga.
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ሻአፈይ ዲዖን ኩሚደ ዎዴ ጌዲየን ዎይ ሜሄን ፒንኖፕፐ! ዞኦዚየአ ጎዔትተደ ፒንነ፣ ዎይክኮ ሀአꬃይ ሂርቅቀነአሺን ነአገ።
flat_utterances.amharic: ወንዙ በጎርፍ በሞላ ጊዜ በእግር ወይም በከብት አትሻገር! ድልድዩን («ዞዜ») ተጠቅመህ ተሻገር፣ ወይም ውኃው እስኪጎድል ድረስ ጠብቅ።
flat_utterances.english: When the river is swollen with floodwater, do not cross on foot or with livestock! Cross using the bridge ('zooze', Gr9 Ch.9 p. 77), or wait until the water subsides.
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: di7o-n kum-ida wode (flood-INST fill-PAST.REL when) + pinn-oppa (cross-PROH.2S); zooziya-a (bridge-ACC.M.DEF, Gr9 Ch.9 p. 77) + go7ett-ada pinn-a (use-CNV1.ANT.2S cross-IMP.2S).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Phrasebook PHR-084; Grade 8 Ch. 2 & Grade 9 Ch. 5 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/160NHNy-4orPcAIk-L5t6tOEtZoWemz_-/view?usp=drivesdk, p. 34 Riddle 3; https://drive.google.com/file/d/1uvGaBT4-O_Jn7oQbuNl1W88lFBFiHULU/view?usp=drivesdk, p. 41)

flat_utterances.amharic: በስምንተኛ ክፍል ምዕራፍ 2 (ገጽ 34) ውስጥ «ሻፋ ሃꬃ» (የወንዝ ውኃ) የሚገልጸው እንቆቅልሽ ምን ይላል?
flat_utterances.english: What does the riddle in Grade 8 Chapter 2 (p. 34) that describes river water ('shaafa haatha') say?

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Sedhemenkkey: "Gede bishin de7ees, haa yishin de7onaba" gees; zaaroykka "Shaafa haatha"!
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ሴꬌሜንክኬይ፦ "ጌዴ ቢሺን ዴዔእስ፣ ሀአ ዪሺን ዴዖነበ" ጌእስ፤ ዘአሮይክከ "ሻአፈ ሀአꬃ"!
flat_utterances.amharic: እንቆቅልሹ፦ «ጌዴ ቢሺን ዴዔስ፣ ሃ ዪሺን ዴዖናባ» (ወደ ፊት ሲሄድ ይታያል፣ ወደ ኋላ ሲመለስ የማይታይ ነገር) ይላል፤ መልሱም «ሻፋ ሃꬃ» (የወንዝ ውኃ) ነው!
flat_utterances.english: The riddle says: 'Gede bishin de7ees, haa yishin de7onaba' ('It is seen going forward, but never seen coming back'); and the answer is 'Shaafa haatha' (river water)!
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: gede b-ishin de7-ees (there/forward go-CNV.SIM.DS exist-PRES.3MS, ZARA-03 7) + haa y-ishin de7-onaba (here come-CNV.SIM.DS exist-NEG.NMZ, Gr8 Ch.2 p. 34).

flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ኡድዱፉንꬆ ኪፊሌ ሼምፕፖ 5 (ፕ። 41) ጊድዶን "ከሊሰነ ከꬃይ ኬሬን እሬትቴእስ" ጊየአ ቶስሴ ቢርሽሼꬃይ አይቤእ?

flat_utterances.english: In Grade 9 Chapter 5 (p. 41), what is the meaning of the proverb 'Kalisana kathay keren erettees'?

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Za birshshethay "kalisana kathay keren erettees" guussa; ge birshshethay qassi go77iyaa oosoy woy cincca na7ay koyro doomman erettees guussa.
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ዘ ቢርሽሼꬃይ "ከሊሰነ ከꬃይ ኬሬን እሬትቴእስ" ጉኡስሰ፤ ጌ ቢርሽሼꬃይ ቀስሲ ጎዕዒየአ ኦኦሶይ ዎይ ጪንጭጨ ነዓይ ኮይሮ ዶኦምመን እሬትቴእስ ጉኡስሰ።
flat_utterances.amharic: ቀጥተኛ ፍቺው «የሚያጠግብ እህል በወፍጮ ላይ ይታወቃል» ማለት ሲሆን፣ አገባባዊ (ውስጠ-ወይራ) ፍቺው ደግሞ ውጤታማ ሥራ ወይም ጎበዝ ልጅ ከጅምሩ ይታወቃል ማለት ነው።
flat_utterances.english: Its literal meaning ('za birshshethi') is 'Grain that will satisfy is known right on the grinding stone'; and its figurative meaning ('ge birshshethi', Gr9 Ch.1 p. 6) is that fruitful work or a promising person shows quality right from the start.
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: za birshshetha-y (literal meaning-NOM, Gr9 Ch.1 p. 6) vs. ge birshshetha-y (figurative/contextual meaning-NOM, Gr9 Ch.1 p. 6); koyro doomma-n er-ett-ees (first beginning-LOC know-PASS-PRES.3MS).

flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ተምመንꬆ ኪፊሌ ሼምፕፖ 5 (ፕ። 45) ጊድዶን "ዲፎ ደአብቦ" ንኔ "ቱኡቴንኔ ኡዱለ" ቆንጭጪሲየአ ሴꬌሜንክኬቲ አይ ጎኢኮነአ?
flat_utterances.amharic: በአሥረኛ ክፍል ምዕራፍ 5 (ገጽ 45) ውስጥ «ዲፎ ዳቦ» (ድፎ ዳቦ) እና «ቱቴኔ ኡዱላ» (ዘነዘናና ሙቀጫ) የሚገልጹት እንቆቅልሾች ምን ይላሉ?
flat_utterances.english: What do the riddles in Grade 10 Chapter 5 (p. 45) describing baked bread ('difo daabbo') and the pestle and mortar ('tuutenne udula') say?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: difo daabbo (baked bread) + tuute-nne udula (pestle-and mortar, Gr10 Ch.5 p. 45) + sedhemenkke-ti (riddle-PL.NOM).

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Koyroy: "Na7iyaa hello guppaws, aayiyaa tira harggaws -> Tuutenne udula"; nam77anthoy: "Bollay tama, garssay tama, giddoy shemppo ashshiyaaba -> Difo daabbo"!
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ኮይሮይ፦ "ነዒየአ ሄልሎ ጉፕፐውስ፣ አአዪየአ ቲረ ሀርግገውስ -> ቱኡቴንኔ ኡዱለ"፤ ነምዕዓንꬆይ፦ "ቦልለይ ተመ፣ ገርስሰይ ተመ፣ ጊድዶይ ሼምፕፖ አሽሺየአበ -> ዲፎ ደአብቦ"!
flat_utterances.amharic: አንደኛው፦ «ናዒያ ሄሎ ጉፓዉስ፣ አዪያ ቲራ ሃርጋዉስ -> ቱቴኔ ኡዱላ» (ዘነዘናና ሙቀጫ)፤ ሁለተኛው፦ «ቦላይ ታማ፣ ጋርሳይ ታማ፣ ጊዶይ ሼምፖ አሺያባ -> ዲፎ ዳቦ» (ድፎ ዳቦ)!
flat_utterances.english: The first is: 'The daughter jumps up and down while the mother's chest aches -> Pestle and mortar (Tuutenne udula)'; the second is: 'Fire on top, fire underneath, life-saving food in the middle -> Baked bread (Difo daabbo)'!
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: gupp-aws (jump-PRES.3FS), hargg-aws (ache-PRES.3FS); bolla-y tama, garssa-y tama, giddo-y shemppo ashsh-iyaa-ba (top-NOM fire, bottom-NOM fire, middle-NOM life save-PRES.REL-NMZ, Gr10 Ch.5 p. 45).

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Hosppuntho kifile Shemppo 1 Qawosa (p. 18) giddon "Sunthi" aappun qommotan shaakettii? Leemisora taassi qonccisarkkii?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ሆስፕፑንꬆ ኪፊሌ ሼምፕፖ 1 ቀዎሰ (ፕ። 18) ጊድዶን "ሱንꬂ" አአፕፑን ቆምሞተን ሻአኬትቲኢ? ሌእሚሶረ ተአስሲ ቆንጭጪሰርክኪኢ?
flat_utterances.amharic: በስምንተኛ ክፍል ምዕራፍ 1 ሰዋስው (ገጽ 18) ውስጥ «ሱንꬂ» (ስም) በስንት ዓይነቶች ይከፈላል? ከምሳሌ ጋር ታብራራልኛለህ?

flat_utterances.speaker: assistant
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Hosppuntho kifile maxaafaa (p. 18) maaran Sunthay: (1) Buzo sunthi (Baqulo, Zentto, Sawula), (2) Kothe sunthi (na7a, boori, tamaare), (3) Shiiqo sunthi (dago, wude), (4) Beettonabata sunthi (era, siiqo, ufayssa) nne (5) Miishe sunthi (shuchchi, saaxine) geetettidi shaakettees.
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ሆስፕፑንꬆ ኪፊሌ መጠአፈአ (ፕ። 18) መአረን ሱንꬃይ፦ (1) ቡዞ ሱንꬂ (በቁሎ፣ ዜንትቶ፣ ሰዉለ)፣ (2) ኮꬄ ሱንꬂ (ነዓ፣ ቦኦሪ፣ ተመአሬ)፣ (3) ሺኢቆ ሱንꬂ (ደጎ፣ ዉዴ)፣ (4) ቤእትቶነበተ ሱንꬂ (እረ፣ ሲኢቆ፣ ኡፈይስሰ) ንኔ (5) ሚኢሼ ሱንꬂ (ሹችቺ፣ ሰአጢኔ) ጌእቴትቲዲ ሻአኬትቴእስ።
flat_utterances.amharic: በስምንተኛ ክፍል መጽሐፍ (ገጽ 18) መሠረት ስም፦ (1) ቡዞ ሱንꬂ (የተጸውዖ ስም፦ ባቁሎ፣ ዜንቶ፣ ሳውላ)፣ (2) ኮꬄ ሱንꬂ (የወል ስም፦ ልጅ፣ በሬ፣ ተማሪ)፣ (3) ሺኢቆ ሱንꬂ (የወገን ስም፦ ዳጎ፣ መንጋ)፣ (4) ቤቶናባታ ሱንꬂ (ረቂቅ ስም፦ ዕውቀት፣ ፍቅር፣ ደስታ) እና (5) ሚኢሼ ሱንꬂ (የቁስ ስም፦ ድንጋይ፣ ሳጥን) ተብሎ ይከፈላል።
flat_utterances.english: According to the Grade 8 textbook (p. 18), nouns ('Sunthi') are divided into: (1) Proper nouns ('Buzo sunthi': Baqulo, Zentto, Sawula), (2) Common nouns ('Kothe sunthi': na7a, boori, tamaare), (3) Collective nouns ('Shiiqo sunthi': dago, wude), (4) Abstract nouns ('Beettonabata sunthi': era, siiqo, ufayssa), and (5) Material nouns ('Miishe sunthi': shuchchi, saaxine).
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: buzo sunthi (proper noun), kothe sunthi (common noun), shiiqo sunthi (collective noun), beettonabata sunthi (abstract noun < be7-ett-onna-ba-ta 'things not seen'), miishe sunthi (material noun).

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Sunqqoy ichchashu qommo (p. 19): Keena sunqqo (daro, guutha), Mala sunqqo (zo7o, bootha), Kothe sunqqo (cincca, lo77o), Qooda sunqqo (issi, nam77u) nne Oychcho sunqqo (ayba, aappun).
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ሱንቅቆይ ኢችቻሹ ቆምሞ (ፕ። 19)፦ ኬእነ ሱንቅቆ (ደሮ፣ ጉኡꬃ)፣ መለ ሱንቅቆ (ዞዖ፣ ቦኦꬃ)፣ ኮꬄ ሱንቅቆ (ጪንጭጨ፣ ሎዕዖ)፣ ቆኦደ ሱንቅቆ (ኢስሲ፣ ነምዕዑ) ንኔ ኦይችቾ ሱንቅቆ (አይበ፣ አአፕፑን)።
flat_utterances.amharic: ቅጽል (ሱንቆ) አምስት ዓይነት ነው (ገጽ 19)፦ ኬና ሱንቆ (የመጠን፦ ብዙ፣ ትንሽ)፣ ማላ ሱንቆ (የመልክ፦ ቀይ፣ ነጭ)፣ ኮꬄ ሱንቆ (የባህሪ፦ ብልህ፣ ጥሩ)፣ ቆዳ ሱንቆ (የቁጥር፦ አንድ፣ ሁለት) እና ኦይቾ ሱንቆ (የመጠይቅ፦ ምን ዓይነት፣ ስንት)።
flat_utterances.english: Adjectives ('Sunqqo', p. 19) have five types: Quantity ('Keena sunqqo': daro, guutha), Color/Appearance ('Mala sunqqo': zo7o, bootha), Quality ('Kothe sunqqo': cincca, lo77o), Number ('Qooda sunqqo': issi, nam77u), and Interrogative ('Oychcho sunqqo': ayba, aappun).
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: Modifier-Noun head-final NP syntax in Gofatho: Sunqqo always precedes Sunthi (e.g., cincca tamaare, bootha miizziya).

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Goofatho qawosa wogan koyro "Yohaadde", giddon "Kaalodde", wurssethan qassi "Peesho" eqqees (SOV).
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ጎኦፈꬆ ቀዎሰ ዎገን ኮይሮ "ዮሀአድዴ"፣ ጊድዶን "ከአሎድዴ"፣ ዉርስሴꬃን ቀስሲ "ፔእሾ" እቅቄእስ (ሶV)።
flat_utterances.amharic: በጎፋኛ ሰዋስው ሥርዓት መጀመሪያ «ዮሃዴ» (ባለቤት)፣ በመካከል «ካሎዴ» (ተሳቢ)፣ በመጨረሻ ደግሞ «ፔሾ» (ግስ) ይቆማል (ባለቤት–ተሳቢ–ግስ / SOV)።
flat_utterances.english: In Gofatho grammatical structure, first stands the Subject ('Yohaadde'), in the middle the Object ('Kaalodde'), and at the end the Verb ('Peesho') — strict SOV order.
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: koyro yohaadde + giddon kaalodde + wurssetha-n peesho + eqq-ees (stand-PRES.3MS, Gr10 Ch.3 p. 24).

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: "Tamaare-y" (-y suntha qonccissiyaa some) = Yohaadde; "maxaafa-a" (-a kaalodde some) = Kaalodde; "nabbab-ees" (-ees ha7ode 3MS) = Peesho!
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: "ተመአሬ-ይ" (-ይ ሱንꬃ ቆንጭጪስሲየአ ሶሜ) = ዮሀአድዴ፤ "መጠአፈ-አ" (-አ ከአሎድዴ ሶሜ) = ከአሎድዴ፤ "ነብበብ-እእስ" (-እእስ ሀዖዴ 3ምስ) = ፔእሾ!
flat_utterances.amharic: «ታማሬ-ይ» (-y የባለቤት ቅጥያ) = ዮሃዴ (ባለቤት)፤ «ማጣፋ-አ» (-a የተሳቢ ቅጥያ) = ካሎዴ (ተሳቢ)፤ «ናባብ-ኤስ» (-ees የአሁን ጊዜ ግስ) = ፔሾ (ግስ) ነው!
flat_utterances.english: 'Tamaare-y' (-y masculine nominative suffix) = Yohaadde (Subject); 'maxaafa-a' (-a masculine accusative suffix) = Kaalodde (Object); and 'nabbab-ees' (-ees 3MS present suffix) = Peesho (Verb)!
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: Explicit case-marking alignment: Nominative -y/-i/-iya marks Yohaadde; Accusative -a/-uwa/-iw marks Kaalodde; clause-final finite verb marks Peesho.

flat_utterances.speaker: assistant
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: "Os-meqo" giddon yohaaddey oosuwaa oothees; "Ost-meqo" giddon qassi kaaloddey yohaadde bessan eqqidi, peeshuwaa xaphuwan "-ett-" giyaa somey gujjettees.
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: "ኦስ-ሜቆ" ጊድዶን ዮሀአድዴይ ኦኦሱወአ ኦኦꬄእስ፤ "ኦስት-ሜቆ" ጊድዶን ቀስሲ ከአሎድዴይ ዮሀአድዴ ቤስሰን እቅቂዲ፣ ፔእሹወአ ጠጱወን "-እትት-" ጊየአ ሶሜይ ጉጅጄትቴእስ።
flat_utterances.amharic: በ«ኦስ-ሜቆ» (ድርጊት) ውስጥ ባለቤቱ ድርጊቱን ይፈጽማል፤ በ«ኦስት-ሜቆ» (ተደራጊ) ውስጥ ደግሞ ተሳቢው በባለቤት ቦታ ቆሞ፣ በግሱ ሥር ላይ «-ett-» የሚል ቅጥያ ይጨመራል።
flat_utterances.english: In 'Os-meqo' (active voice), the subject performs the action; whereas in 'Ost-meqo' (passive voice), the object moves to subject position and the passive suffix '-ett-' is attached to the verb stem.
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: peeshuwa-a xaphuwa-n (verb-GEN root-LOC, MP-10) + -ett- (PASS/REFL derivational suffix, MP-06) + gujj-ett-ees (add-PASS-PRES.3MS).

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Ost-mequwan: "Ashoy Shaashshotan mettis" gidees! "Asho" -> "Asho-y" (NOM.M), "Shaashshota" -> "Shaashshota-n" (INST), "m-asu" -> "m-ett-is" (eat-PASS-PAST.3MS).
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ኦስት-ሜቁወን፦ "አሾይ ሻአሽሾተን ሜትቲስ" ጊዴእስ! "አሾ" -> "አሾ-ይ" (ኖም።ም)፣ "ሻአሽሾተ" -> "ሻአሽሾተ-ን" (ኢንስት)፣ "ም-አሱ" -> "ም-እትት-ኢስ" (እአት-ፐስስ-ፐስት።3ምስ)።
flat_utterances.amharic: በተደራጊ (ኦስት-ሜቆ)፦ «አሾይ ሻሾታን ሜቲስ» (ሥጋው በሻሾታ ተበላ) ይሆናል! «አሾ» -> «አሾ-ይ» (ባለቤት)፣ «ሻሾታ» -> «ሻሾታ-ን» (በ-ቅጥያ)፣ «ማሱ» -> «ሜቲስ» (ተበላ)።
flat_utterances.english: In passive voice ('Ost-meqo'), it becomes: 'Ashoy Shaashshotan mettis' ('The meat was eaten by Shaashshota')! 'Asho' becomes 'Asho-y' (NOM.M), 'Shaashshota' takes '-n' (instrumental agent), and 'm-asu' becomes 'm-ett-is' (eat-PASS-PAST.3MS).
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: Full passive morphosyntactic derivation (Gr8 Ch.5 p. 85 & Gr10 Ch.9 p. 86): Patient promoted to NOM (-y), Agent demoted to INST (-n), Verb takes -ett- + 3MS agreement (-is).

flat_utterances.domain_name: Grade 8–10 School & Grammar Tutoring (Timirtte Keethi & Qawosa)
flat_utterances.subtopic: Grade 9 Ch. 7 Orthography Rules: Vowels (Ustta), Consonants (Guttuma) & Glottal Stop (7)
flat_utterances.speaker: assistant
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Uddufuntho kifile maxaafaa (pp. 62-65) maaran: (1) Issi qommo usttati na77aa gakkanaashin xalla kaallidi xaafettoosona (aa, ee, ii, oo, uu) - heedzu ustti issippe xaafettenna (ZARA-01); (2) Dummattiyaa na77u usttati issippe eqqokkona; entta giddon "7", "y" woy "w" gelees (ZARA-03: leemisos 'be7ees', 'lo77o').
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ኡድዱፉንꬆ ኪፊሌ መጠአፈአ (ፕፕ። 62-65) መአረን፦ (1) ኢስሲ ቆምሞ ኡስትተቲ ነዕዓአ ገክከነአሺን ጠልለ ከአልሊዲ ጠአፌትቶኦሶነ (አአ፣ እእ፣ ኢኢ፣ ኦኦ፣ ኡኡ) - ሄእꬑ ኡስትቲ ኢስሲፕፔ ጠአፌትቴንነ (ዘረ-01)፤ (2) ዱምመትቲየአ ነዕዑ ኡስትተቲ ኢስሲፕፔ እቅቆክኮነ፤ እንትተ ጊድዶን "ዕ"፣ "ይ" ዎይ "ው" ጌሌእስ (ዘረ-03፦ ሌእሚሶስ 'ቤዔእስ'፣ 'ሎዕዖ')።
flat_utterances.amharic: በዘጠነኛ ክፍል መጽሐፍ (ገጽ 62–65) መሠረት፦ (1) ተመሳሳይ አናባቢዎች እስከ ሁለት ድረስ ብቻ ተከታትለው ይጻፋሉ (aa, ee, ii, oo, uu) — ሦስት አናባቢ አንድ ላይ አይጻፍም፤ (2) የተለያዩ ሁለት አናባቢዎች አንድ ላይ አይቆሙም፤ በመካከላቸው «7» (/ʔ/)፣ «y» ወይም «w» ይገባል (ለምሳሌ 'be7ees'፣ 'lo77o')።
flat_utterances.english: According to the Grade 9 textbook (pp. 62–65): (1) Identical vowels are written at most two in a row (aa, ee, ii, oo, uu) — three vowels never occur together (ZARA-01); (2) Two dissimilar vowels never stand adjacent; '7' (/ʔ/), 'y', or 'w' intervenes between them (ZARA-03, e.g., 'be7ees', 'lo77o').
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: ZARA-01 (no *VVV), ZARA-02 (no word-initial geminate *CCV), ZARA-03 (no dissimilar vowel hiatus *V1V2; requires glottal '7' or glide y/w).

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Na77u pidalon xaafettiyaa guttumati (ch, sh, dh, th, ph, zh, ny, dz) minniyaa gidiyaa wode waani xaafettoikonaa?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ነዕዑ ፒደሎን ጠአፌትቲየአ ጉትቱመቲ (ች፣ ሽ፣ ꬍ፣ ꬅ፣ ጵ፣ ዥ፣ ኝ፣ ꬕ) ሚንኒየአ ጊዲየአ ዎዴ ወአኒ ጠአፌትቶኢኮነአ?
flat_utterances.amharic: በሁለት ፊደል የሚጻፉ ተነባቢዎች (ch, sh, dh, th, ph, zh, ny, dz) ጠብቀው (ሚንኒያ) በሚነበቡበት ጊዜ እንዴት ይጻፋሉ?
flat_utterances.english: When digraph consonants (ch, sh, dh, th, ph, zh, ny, dz) are geminated ('minniyaa'), how are they written in Gofatho orthography?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: na77u pidalo-n xaaf-ett-iyaa guttuma-ti (two letter-INST write-PASS-PRES.REL consonant-PL.NOM) + minn-iyaa gid-iyaa wode (geminate be-PRES.REL when) + waan-i xaaf-ett-oikonaa (how-CNV2 write-PASS-PRES.3PL.INTER).

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Textbook orthography rule: Koyro pidalay dakettidi xaafettees ('achche', 'gooshsha', 'aadhdhees', 'ooththees', 'haphphidi'), woykko kumetta digraph-ay dakettees. Sherpa-ONNX lexicon-ay na77aakka loythi eridi 1.85x minniyaa cenggurssan nabbabees!
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ቴጥትቦኦክ ኦርꬆግረጵይ ሩሌ፦ ኮይሮ ፒደለይ ደኬትቲዲ ጠአፌትቴእስ ('አችቼ'፣ 'ጎኦሽሻ'፣ 'አአꬍꬌእስ'፣ 'ኦኦꬅꬄእስ'፣ 'ሀጵጪዲ')፣ ዎይክኮ ኩሜትተ ዲግረጵ-አይ ደኬትቴእስ። ሼርፐ-ኦንንጥ ሌጢጮን-አይ ነዕዓአክከ ሎይꬂ እሪዲ 1።85ጥ ሚንኒየአ ጬንግጉርስሰን ነብበቤእስ!
flat_utterances.amharic: የመጽሐፉ የአጻጻፍ ሕግ፦ የመጀመሪያው ፊደል ተደግሞ ይጻፋል (ለምሳሌ፦ 'achche'፣ 'gooshsha'፣ 'aadhdhees'፣ 'ooththees'፣ 'haphphidi') ወይም ሙሉው ይደገማል። የSherpa-ONNX መዝገበ-ቃላት ሁለቱንም በደንብ አውቆ በ1.85x ጥብቅ ድምፅ ያነባል!
flat_utterances.english: In textbook orthography, either the first letter of the digraph is doubled (e.g., 'cch', 'ssh', 'ddh', 'tth', 'pph') or the full digraph is doubled ('chch', 'shsh', 'dhdh', 'thth'). The Sherpa-ONNX lexicon recognizes both and synthesizes them with 1.85x geminate closure!
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: Orthographic gemination of digraphs in SNNPR Grade 8–10 textbooks & Sellassie Cheru (2015): achche, gooshsha, aadhdhees, haphphidi.

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Uddufuntho kifile Shemppo 2 (p. 16) nne Tammantho kifile Shemppo 8 (p. 79) giddon de7iyaa heedzu peesho wodeta ("Aadhode", "Ha7ode", "Sinthode") taassi qonccisarkkii?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ኡድዱፉንꬆ ኪፊሌ ሼምፕፖ 2 (ፕ። 16) ንኔ ተምመንꬆ ኪፊሌ ሼምፕፖ 8 (ፕ። ዕ9) ጊድዶን ዴዒየአ ሄእꬑ ፔእሾ ዎዴተ ("አአꬎዴ"፣ "ሀዖዴ"፣ "ሲንꬆዴ") ተአስሲ ቆንጭጪሰርክኪኢ?
flat_utterances.amharic: በዘጠነኛ ክፍል ምዕራፍ 2 (ገጽ 16) እና በአሥረኛ ክፍል ምዕራፍ 8 (ገጽ 79) ውስጥ ያሉትን ሦስቱን የግስ ጊዜያት («አꬎዴ»፣ «ሃዖዴ»፣ «ሲንꬆዴ») ታብራራልኛለህ?
flat_utterances.english: Could you explain the three verb tenses ('Aadhode', 'Ha7ode', 'Sinthode') covered in Grade 9 Chapter 2 (p. 16) and Grade 10 Chapter 8 (p. 79)?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: aadhode (past tense < aadhdh- + wode, Gr9 p. 83 & Gr10 p. 79), ha7ode (present tense < ha77i + wode, ZARA-03 7), sinthode (future tense < sintha + wode).

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Ee! (1) "Aadhode" (kase oosettida): leemisos 'nabbabis', 'xaafasu', 'bidosona'; (2) "Ha7ode" (ha77i oosettiya): 'nabbabees', 'xaafawsu', 'boosona'; (3) "Sinthode" (sinthe oosettana): 'nabbabana', 'xaafana', 'baana'.
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: እእ! (1) "አአꬎዴ" (ከሴ ኦኦሴትቲደ)፦ ሌእሚሶስ 'ነብበቢስ'፣ 'ጠአፈሱ'፣ 'ቢዶሶነ'፤ (2) "ሀዖዴ" (ሀዕዒ ኦኦሴትቲየ)፦ 'ነብበቤእስ'፣ 'ጠአፈውሱ'፣ 'ቦኦሶነ'፤ (3) "ሲንꬆዴ" (ሲንꬄ ኦኦሴትተነ)፦ 'ነብበበነ'፣ 'ጠአፈነ'፣ 'በአነ'።
flat_utterances.amharic: አዎ! (1) «አꬎዴ» (ኃላፊ ጊዜ - ቀድሞ የተፈጸመ)፦ ለምሳሌ 'ናባቢስ' (አነበበ)፣ 'ጣፋሱ' (ጻፈች)፣ 'ቢዶሶና' (ሄዱ)፤ (2) «ሃዖዴ» (የአሁን ጊዜ)፦ 'ናባቤስ' (ያነባል)፣ 'ጣፋዉሱ' (ትጽፋለች)፣ 'ቦሶና' (ይሄዳሉ)፤ (3) «ሲንꬆዴ» (የወደፊት ጊዜ)፦ 'ናባባና' (ያነባል)፣ 'ጣፋና' (ትጽፋለች)፣ 'ባና' (ይሄዳሉ)።
flat_utterances.english: Yes! (1) 'Aadhode' (Past tense — completed action): e.g., 'nabbabis' (he read), 'xaafasu' (she wrote), 'bidosona' (they went); (2) 'Ha7ode' (Present/Habitual tense): 'nabbabees' (he reads), 'xaafawsu' (she writes), 'boosona' (they go); (3) 'Sinthode' (Future tense): 'nabbabana', 'xaafana', 'baana'.
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: Full inflectional contrast across tenses: Aadhode (-is 3MS, -asu 3FS, -idosona 3PL), Ha7ode (-ees 3MS, -awsu 3FS, -oosona 3PL), Sinthode (-ana invariant future declarative).

flat_utterances.subtopic: Grade 10 Ch. 6 Qawosa: Transitive (Pinniyaa Peesho) vs. Intransitive Verbs (Pinnonna Peesho)
flat_utterances.speaker: assistant
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: "Pinniyaa peesho" guussay kaalodde koyiyaa peesho: leemisos "shammis", "meecasu", "keexxis"; "Pinnonna peesho" qassi kaalodde koyonna peesho: leemisos "zin77is", "yeekkis", "miiccasu", "eqqis".
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: "ፒንኒየአ ፔእሾ" ጉኡስሰይ ከአሎድዴ ኮዪየአ ፔእሾ፦ ሌእሚሶስ "ሻምሚስ"፣ "ሜእጨሱ"፣ "ኬእጥጢስ"፤ "ፒንኖንነ ፔእሾ" ቀስሲ ከአሎድዴ ኮዮንነ ፔእሾ፦ ሌእሚሶስ "ዚንዕዒስ"፣ "ዬእክኪስ"፣ "ሚኢጭጨሱ"፣ "እቅቂስ"።
flat_utterances.amharic: «ፒኒያ ፔሾ» (ተሻጋሪ ግስ) ማለት ተሳቢ (ካሎዴ) የሚፈልግ ግስ ነው፦ ለምሳሌ «ሻሚስ» (ገዛ)፣ «ሜጫሱ» (አጠበች)፣ «ኬጢስ» (ሠራ)፤ «ፒኖና ፔሾ» (ኢ-ተሻጋሪ ግስ) ደግሞ ተሳቢ የማይፈልግ ግስ ነው፦ ለምሳሌ «ዚንዒስ» (ተኛ)፣ «ዬኪስ» (አለቀሰ)፣ «ሚኢጫሱ» (ሳቀች)፣ «ኤቂስ» (ቆመ)።
flat_utterances.english: 'Pinniyaa peesho' (transitive verb) is a verb that requires a direct object ('kaalodde'), such as 'shammis' (bought), 'meecasu' (washed), 'keexxis' (built); whereas 'Pinnonna peesho' (intransitive verb) does not take an object, such as 'zin77is' (slept), 'yeekkis' (wept), 'miiccasu' (laughed), 'eqqis' (stood).
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: kaalodde koy-iyaa peesho (object want-PRES.REL verb) vs. kaalodde koy-onna peesho (object want-NEG.REL verb, Gr10 Ch.6 p. 60).

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Pinnonna peeshuwaa ("zin77is", "miiccasu") Pinniyaa peesho oothanaw ayba some gujjoo?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ፒንኖንነ ፔእሹወአ ("ዚንዕዒስ"፣ "ሚኢጭጨሱ") ፒንኒየአ ፔእሾ ኦኦꬃነው አይበ ሶሜ ጉጅጆኦ?
flat_utterances.amharic: ኢ-ተሻጋሪ ግሱን («ዚንዒስ» — ተኛ፣ «ሚኢጫሱ» — ሳቀች) ወደ ተሻጋሪ (አስደራጊ) ግስ ለመቀየር ምን ቅጥያ እንጨምር?
flat_utterances.english: To turn an intransitive verb ('zin77is' slept, 'miiccasu' laughed) into a transitive/causative verb, what suffix do we attach?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: pinn-onna peeshuwa-a (intransitive verb-ACC.M.DEF) + pinn-iyaa peesho ooth-anaw (transitive verb make-FUT.PURP) + ayba some gujj-oo (what affix add-1PL.INTER).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Grade 10 Goofatho Doona Ch. 6 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/1mKIcfMoMgnZ9Pa657NWmE-OGND2wlveM/view?usp=drivesdk, pp. 60–61: Pinniyaa Peesho vs. Pinnonna Peesho)

flat_utterances.speaker: assistant
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Peeshuwaa xaphuwan "-iss-" gujja! Leemisos: "zin77-is" (Pinnonna) -> "Aayiyaa na7aa zin77-iss-asu" (Pinniyaa); "miicc-is" -> "miicc-iss-is"!
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ፔእሹወአ ጠጱወን "-ኢስስ-" ጉጅጀ! ሌእሚሶስ፦ "ዚንዕዕ-ኢስ" (ፒንኖንነ) -> "አአዪየአ ነዓአ ዚንዕዕ-ኢስስ-አሱ" (ፒንኒየአ)፤ "ሚኢጭጭ-ኢስ" -> "ሚኢጭጭ-ኢስስ-ኢስ"!
flat_utterances.amharic: በግሱ ሥር ላይ «-iss-» (የአስደራጊ ቅጥያ) ጨምር! ለምሳሌ፦ «ዚንዒስ» (ተኛ - ኢ-ተሻጋሪ) -> «አዪያ ናዓ ዚንዒሳሱ» (እናቲቱ ልጁን አስተኛችው - ተሻጋሪ)፤ «ሚኢጪስ» (ሳቀ) -> «ሚኢጪሲስ» (አሳቀ)!
flat_utterances.english: Attach the causative suffix '-iss-' to the verb root! For example: 'zin77-is' ('he slept' — intransitive) -> 'Aayiyaa na7aa zin77-iss-asu' ('The mother put the child to sleep' — transitive); 'miicc-is' ('laughed') -> 'miicc-iss-is' ('made laugh')!
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: Valency-increasing causative derivation (-iss-): converts Pinnonna peesho into Pinniyaa peesho licensing an accusative Kaalodde (na7a-a).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Grade 10 Goofatho Doona Ch. 6 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/1mKIcfMoMgnZ9Pa657NWmE-OGND2wlveM/view?usp=drivesdk, pp. 60–61: Pinniyaa Peesho vs. Pinnonna Peesho)

flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ሆስፕፑንꬆ ኪፊሌ ሼምፕፖ 6 (ፕ። 96) ንኔ ኡድዱፉንꬆ ኪፊሌ ሼምፕፖ 1 (ፕ። 9) ጊድዶን ሜእገ ቆፈይ ጎዕዓን አአፕፑን ቆምሞን ሻአኬትቲኢ?
flat_utterances.amharic: በስምንተኛ ክፍል ምዕራፍ 6 (ገጽ 96) እና በዘጠነኛ ክፍል ምዕራፍ 1 (ገጽ 9) ውስጥ ዓረፍተ ነገር በአገልግሎቱ በስንት ዓይነት ይከፈላል?

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Meega qofay go77an oyddu qommo: (1) "Qoncciso / Paate" (selle cachchan '.' wurssettees), (2) "Oysho" ('?' wurssettees), (3) "Kiita / Azazo" nne (4) "Malalo" ('!' wurssettees).
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ሜእገ ቆፈይ ጎዕዓን ኦይድዱ ቆምሞ፦ (1) "ቆንጭጪሶ / ፐአቴ" (ሴልሌ ጨችቻን '።' ዉርስሴትቴእስ)፣ (2) "ኦይሾ" ('?' ዉርስሴትቴእስ)፣ (3) "ኪኢተ / አዘዞ" ንኔ (4) "መለሎ" ('!' ዉርስሴትቴእስ)።
flat_utterances.amharic: ዓረፍተ ነገር በአገልግሎቱ አራት ዓይነት ነው፦ (1) «ቆንጪሶ / ፓቴ» (ሐተታዊ - በአራት ነጥብ '.' ይጨርሳል)፣ (2) «ኦይሾ» (መጠይቃዊ - በጥያቄ ምልክት '?' ይጨርሳል)፣ (3) «ኪኢታ / አዛዞ» (ትእዛዛዊ) እና (4) «ማላሎ» (አጋኖ - በትእምርተ አንክሮ '!' ይጨርሳል)።
flat_utterances.english: By function, sentences have four types: (1) Declarative ('Qoncciso / Paate', ending with '.'), (2) Interrogative ('Oysho', ending with '?'), (3) Imperative ('Kiita / Azazo'), and (4) Exclamative ('Malalo', ending with '!').
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: oyddu qommo (four types): Qoncciso/Paate, Oysho, Kiita, Malalo (Gr8 Ch.6 pp. 96–100 & Gr10 Ch.3 p. 25).

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Medhuwan oyddu qommo (Gr9 Ch.1 p. 10): (1) "Yeda / Kawushsha", (2) "Dakko", (3) "Gite / Walaka" nne (4) "Dakko-Gite"!
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ሜꬉወን ኦይድዱ ቆምሞ (ግር9 ች።1 ፕ። 10)፦ (1) "ዬደ / ከዉሽሻ"፣ (2) "ደክኮ"፣ (3) "ጊቴ / ወለከ" ንኔ (4) "ደክኮ-ጊቴ"!
flat_utterances.amharic: በአወቃቀሩ አራት ዓይነት ነው (9ኛ ክፍል ምዕራፍ 1 ገጽ 10)፦ (1) «ዬዳ / ካዉሻ» (ነጠላ ዓረፍተ ነገር)፣ (2) «ዳኮ» (ድርብ ዓረፍተ ነገር)፣ (3) «ጊቴ / ዋላካ» (ውስብስብ ዓረፍተ ነገር) እና (4) «ዳኮ-ጊቴ» (ድርብ ውስብስብ ዓረፍተ ነገር)!
flat_utterances.english: By structure, there are four types (Gr9 Ch.1 p. 10): (1) Simple ('Yeda / Kawushsha'), (2) Compound ('Dakko'), (3) Complex ('Gite / Walaka', containing a dependent/converb clause), and (4) Compound-Complex ('Dakko-Gite')!
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: Structural taxonomy across Gr8 Ch.9 p. 137, Gr9 Ch.1 p. 10, and Gr10 Ch.3 p. 26: Yeda, Dakko, Gite/Walaka, Dakko-Gite.

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Uddufuntho kifile Shemppo 9 (p. 80) giddon "Balakko pacce meega qofa" nne "La77a pacce meega qofa" ay guussee?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ኡድዱፉንꬆ ኪፊሌ ሼምፕፖ 9 (ፕ። 80) ጊድዶን "በለክኮ ፐጭጬ ሜእገ ቆፈ" ንኔ "ለዕዓ ፐጭጬ ሜእገ ቆፈ" አይ ጉኡስሴእ?
flat_utterances.amharic: በዘጠነኛ ክፍል ምዕራፍ 9 (ገጽ 80) ውስጥ «ባላኮ ፓቼ ሜጋ ቆፋ» (ጥገኛ ዓረፍተ ነገር) እና «ላዓ ፓቼ ሜጋ ቆፋ» (ነጻ ዓረፍተ ነገር) ምን ማለት ነው?
flat_utterances.english: In Grade 9 Chapter 9 (p. 80), what do 'Balakko pacce meega qofa' (dependent clause) and 'La77a pacce meega qofa' (independent clause) mean?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: balakko pacce meega qofa (dependent/subordinate clause, Gr9 Ch.9 p. 80) vs. la77a pacce meega qofa (free/independent clause, ZARA-03 77).

flat_utterances.subtopic: Grade 9 Ch. 4 & Ch. 9 Qawosa: Dependent (Balakko) vs. Independent Clauses (La77a Pace)
flat_utterances.speaker: assistant
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: "Balakko pacce meega qofa" barkka eqqidi kumetta qofa immenna: leemisos "Biri taw de7iyaakko..."; "La77a pacce meega qofa" qassi pana dandda7idi kumetta qofa immees: leemisos "...maxaafa shammays"!
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: "በለክኮ ፐጭጬ ሜእገ ቆፈ" በርክከ እቅቂዲ ኩሜትተ ቆፈ ኢምሜንነ፦ ሌእሚሶስ "ቢሪ ተው ዴዒየአክኮ።።።"፤ "ለዕዓ ፐጭጬ ሜእገ ቆፈ" ቀስሲ ፐነ ደንድደዒዲ ኩሜትተ ቆፈ ኢምሜእስ፦ ሌእሚሶስ "።።።መጠአፈ ሻምመይስ"!
flat_utterances.amharic: «ባላኮ ፓቼ ሜጋ ቆፋ» (ጥገኛ ዓረፍተ ነገር) ብቻውን ቆሞ ሙሉ ሐሳብ አይሰጥም፦ ለምሳሌ «ቢሪ ታው ዴዒያኮ...» (ገንዘብ ቢኖረኝ...)፤ «ላዓ ፓቼ ሜጋ ቆፋ» (ነጻ ዓረፍተ ነገር) ደግሞ ራሱን ችሎ ሙሉ ሐሳብ ይሰጣል፦ ለምሳሌ «...ማጣፋ ሻማይስ» (...መጽሐፍ እገዛለሁ)!
flat_utterances.english: 'Balakko pacce meega qofa' (dependent clause) cannot stand alone to give a complete thought, e.g., 'Biri taw de7iyaakko...' ('If I have money...'); whereas 'La77a pacce meega qofa' (independent clause) stands on its own and completes the predication, e.g., '...maxaafa shammays' ('...I buy a book')!
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: bir-i ta-w de7-iyaakko (money-NOM 1S-DAT exist-COND, Gr9 Ch.9 p. 80) = Balakko; maxaafa shamm-ays (book.ACC buy-PRES.1S) = La77a.

flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ጎኦፈꬆ ዶኦነን "-ኢዲ"፣ "-አደ"፣ "-ኢሺን" ንኔ "-ኢክኮ" ጊየአ ሶሜቲ በለክኮ ፐጭጬ ሜእገ ቆፈ ሜꬍꬎኢኮነአ?
flat_utterances.amharic: በጎፋኛ ቋንቋ «-idi»፣ «-ada»፣ «-ishin» እና «-ikko» የሚሉት ቅጥያዎች ጥገኛ ዓረፍተ ነገር (ባላኮ) ይፈጥራሉ?

flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: -idi (CNV2.ANT.3MS/PL), -ada (CNV1.ANT.1S/2S/3FS), -ishin (CNV.SIM.DS 'while'), -ikko (COND.REAL 'if') + medhdh-oikonaa (create-PRES.3PL.INTER).

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Ee, tuma! Leemisos: "Tamaarey minni tamaar-idi (Balakko), paacciyaa loythi aadhdh-iis (La77a)" - '-idi' balakko pacce medhdhees, '-iis' qassi la77a pacce wurssetha peesho!
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: እእ፣ ቱመ! ሌእሚሶስ፦ "ተመአሬይ ሚንኒ ተመአር-ኢዲ (በለክኮ)፣ ፐአጭጪየአ ሎይꬂ አአꬍꬍ-ኢኢስ (ለዕዓ)" - '-ኢዲ' በለክኮ ፐጭጬ ሜꬍꬌእስ፣ '-ኢኢስ' ቀስሲ ለዕዓ ፐጭጬ ዉርስሴꬃ ፔእሾ!
flat_utterances.amharic: አዎ፣ እውነት ነው! ለምሳሌ፦ «ታማሬይ ሚኒ ታማር-ኢዲ (ጥገኛ)፣ ፓጪያ ሎይꬂ አꬍ-ኢስ (ነጻ)» (ተማሪው ጠንክሮ ተምሮ፣ ፈተናውን በደንብ አለፈ) — '-idi' ጥገኛ ሐረግ ይፈጥራል፣ '-iis' ደግሞ ነጻ የመጨረሻ ግስ ነው!
flat_utterances.english: Yes, indeed! For example: 'Tamaarey minni tamaar-idi (Balakko), paacciyaa loythi aadhdh-iis (La77a)' ('Having studied hard, the student passed the exam well') — '-idi' forms the dependent converb clause, and '-iis' is the finite independent verb!
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: Clause-chaining architecture in North Omotic Gofatho (Sellassie Cheru 2015, Ch. 9): medial converbs (-idi, -ada, -ishin) head dependent clauses, while only the final verb bears finite TAM/person (-iis).

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Hosppuntho kifile Shemppo 3 (p. 53) giddon "Waatha qaala" waani medhettii? Maxaafaa leemisota taassi odarkkii?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ሆስፕፑንꬆ ኪፊሌ ሼምፕፖ 3 (ፕ። 53) ጊድዶን "ወአꬃ ቀአለ" ወአኒ ሜꬌትቲኢ? መጠአፈአ ሌእሚሶተ ተአስሲ ኦደርክኪኢ?
flat_utterances.amharic: በስምንተኛ ክፍል ምዕራፍ 3 (ገጽ 53) ውስጥ «ዋꬃ ቃላ» (ጥምር ቃል) እንዴት ይመሠረታል? የመጽሐፉን ምሳሌዎች ትነግረኛለህ?
flat_utterances.english: In Grade 8 Chapter 3 (p. 53), how are compound words ('Waatha qaala') formed? Could you give me the textbook examples?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: waatha qaala (compound word, Gr8 Ch.3 p. 53) + waan-i medh-ett-ii (how-CNV2 form-PASS-PRES.3MS.INTER); maxaafa-a leemiso-ta (book-GEN example-PL.ACC).

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Nam77u pana dandda7ida qaalati wolira gahettidi issi ooratha birshshethi de7iyaa qaala medhdhiyaa wode "Waatha qaala" geetettees: leemisos "keetha-ooso", "goshsha-boori", "dono-oto", "tukke-haythi" nne "woosa-keethi"!
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ነምዕዑ ፐነ ደንድደዒደ ቀአለቲ ዎሊረ ገሄትቲዲ ኢስሲ ኦኦረꬃ ቢርሽሼꬂ ዴዒየአ ቀአለ ሜꬍꬊየአ ዎዴ "ወአꬃ ቀአለ" ጌእቴትቴእስ፦ ሌእሚሶስ "ኬእꬃ-ኦኦሶ"፣ "ጎሽሻ-ቦኦሪ"፣ "ዶኖ-ኦቶ"፣ "ቱክኬ-ሀይꬂ" ንኔ "ዎኦሰ-ኬእꬂ"!
flat_utterances.amharic: ሁለት ራሳቸውን የቻሉ ቃላት እርስ በርስ ተገናኝተው አንድ አዲስ ትርጉም ያለው ቃል ሲፈጥሩ «ዋꬃ ቃላ» (ጥምር ቃል) ይባላል፦ ለምሳሌ «ኬꬃ-ኦሶ» (የቤት ሥራ)፣ «ጎሻ-ቦሪ» (የእርሻ በሬ)፣ «ዶኖ-ኦቶ» (የድንች ወጥ)፣ «ቱኬ-ሃይꬂ» (የቡና ቅጠል) እና «ዎሳ-ኬꬂ» (የጸሎት ቤት)!
flat_utterances.english: When two independent words join together to form a single word with a unified meaning, it is called a compound word ('Waatha qaala'): e.g., 'keetha-ooso' (housework), 'goshsha-boori' (plow ox), 'dono-oto' (potato stew), 'tukke-haythi' (coffee leaf), and 'woosa-keethi' (church/house of prayer)!
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: nam77u pana dandda7-ida qaala-ti (two self be.able-PAST.REL word-PL.NOM) + woli-ra gah-ett-idi (each.other-COM join-PASS-CNV2.ANT, Gr8 Ch.3 p. 53).

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: He shemppuwaa sinthe 54-55 bolla "Pexo qaala" "Masara qaala" oothanaw ayba someti gujjettoikonaa?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ሄ ሼምፕፑወአ ሲንꬄ 54-55 ቦልለ "ፔጦ ቀአለ" "መሰረ ቀአለ" ኦኦꬃነው አይበ ሶሜቲ ጉጅጄትቶኢኮነአ?
flat_utterances.amharic: በዚያው ምዕራፍ ገጽ 54–55 ላይ «ፔጦ ቃላ» (ነጠላ ቁጥር) ወደ «ማሳራ ቃላ» (ብዙ ቁጥር) ለመቀየር ምን ቅጥያዎች ይጨመራሉ?
flat_utterances.english: On pages 54–55 of that chapter, what suffixes are added to turn a singular noun ('Pexo qaala') into a plural noun ('Masara qaala')?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: pexo qaala (singular word, Gr8 Ch.3 p. 54) -> masara qaala (plural word) + ayba some-ti gujj-ett-oikonaa (what suffix-PL.NOM add-PASS-PRES.3PL.INTER).

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Yohaadde gidikko "-ti" gujjettees (leemisos: 'kafoy' -> 'kafoti', 'tamaarey' -> 'tamaareti'); Kaalodde gidikko qassi "-ta" gujjettees ('kafuwa' -> 'kafota', 'tamaariya' -> 'tamaareta')!
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ዮሀአድዴ ጊዲክኮ "-ቲ" ጉጅጄትቴእስ (ሌእሚሶስ፦ 'ከፎይ' -> 'ከፎቲ'፣ 'ተመአሬይ' -> 'ተመአሬቲ')፤ ከአሎድዴ ጊዲክኮ ቀስሲ "-ተ" ጉጅጄትቴእስ ('ከፉወ' -> 'ከፎተ'፣ 'ተመአሪየ' -> 'ተመአሬተ')!
flat_utterances.amharic: ባለቤት (ዮሃዴ) ከሆነ «-ti» ይጨመራል (ለምሳሌ፦ 'ካፎይ' -> 'ካፎቲ' ወፎቹ፣ 'ታማሬይ' -> 'ታማሬቲ' ተማሪዎቹ)፤ ተሳቢ (ካሎዴ) ከሆነ ደግሞ «-ta» ይጨመራል ('ካፉዋ' -> 'ካፎታ' ወፎቹን፣ 'ታማሪያ' -> 'ታማሬታ' ተማሪዎቹን)!
flat_utterances.english: When it is a Subject ('Yohaadde'), '-ti' is attached (e.g., 'kafoy' -> 'kafoti' the birds, 'tamaarey' -> 'tamaareti' the students); and when it is an Object ('Kaalodde'), '-ta' is attached ('kafota', 'tamaareta')!
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: Plural inflectional suffixes in Gofatho (Sellassie Cheru 2015, p. 69 & Gr8 Ch.3 p. 54): -t-i (PL.NOM) vs. -t-a (PL.ACC).

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Uddufuntho kifile Shemppo 1 (pp. 8-9) giddon "mis" giyaa issi peeshoy meega qofa gelosan waani dumma dumma birshshetha oyqqii?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ኡድዱፉንꬆ ኪፊሌ ሼምፕፖ 1 (ፕፕ። 8-9) ጊድዶን "ሚስ" ጊየአ ኢስሲ ፔእሾይ ሜእገ ቆፈ ጌሎሰን ወአኒ ዱምመ ዱምመ ቢርሽሼꬃ ኦይቅቂኢ?
flat_utterances.amharic: በዘጠነኛ ክፍል ምዕራፍ 1 (ገጽ 8–9) ውስጥ «ሚስ» (በላ) የሚለው አንድ ግስ በዓረፍተ ነገር አገባብ እንዴት የተለያየ ትርጉም ይይዛል?
flat_utterances.english: In Grade 9 Chapter 1 (pp. 8–9), how does the single verb 'mis' take on different contextual meanings ('gelosa birshshetha') across sentences?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: m-is (eat-PAST.3MS) + meega qofa gelosa-n (sentence context-LOC, Gr9 Ch.1 p. 8) + dumma dumma birshshetha (various meaning).

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Uddufuntho kifile maxaafaa (pp. 8-9) leemisota xeella: (1) "Na7ay quma mis" = qaabima/za birshshethi; (2) "Haathay asaa mis"; (3) "Tamay keethaa mis"; (4) "Gaday daro zerethi mis"!
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ኡድዱፉንꬆ ኪፊሌ መጠአፈአ (ፕፕ። 8-9) ሌእሚሶተ ጤእልለ፦ (1) "ነዓይ ቁመ ሚስ" = ቀአቢመ/ዘ ቢርሽሼꬂ፤ (2) "ሀአꬃይ አሰአ ሚስ"፤ (3) "ተመይ ኬእꬃአ ሚስ"፤ (4) "ገደይ ደሮ ዜሬꬂ ሚስ"!
flat_utterances.amharic: የዘጠነኛ ክፍል መጽሐፍ (ገጽ 8–9) ምሳሌዎችን ተመልከት፦ (1) «ናዓይ ቁማ ሚስ» = ልጁ ምግብ በላ (ቀጥተኛ ፍቺ)፤ (2) «ሃꬃይ አሳ ሚስ» = ውኃው ሰውየውን ወሰደው/አሰጠመው፤ (3) «ታማይ ኬꬃ ሚስ» = እሳቱ ቤቱን አቃጠለው፤ (4) «ጋዳይ ዳሮ ዜሬꬂ ሚስ» = ማሳው ብዙ ዘር ፈጀ!
flat_utterances.english: Look at the Grade 9 textbook examples (pp. 8–9): (1) 'Na7ay quma mis' = The boy ate food (literal meaning); (2) 'Haathay asaa mis' = The river swept away/drowned the person; (3) 'Tamay keethaa mis' = The fire burned down the house; (4) 'Gaday daro zerethi mis' = The field consumed a lot of seed!
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: Contextual polysemy ('gelosa birshshethi' vs. 'qaabima birshshethi', Gr9 Ch.1 pp. 6–9) of verb root m- ('eat/consume/burn/sweep away').

flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ሆስፕፑንꬆ ኪፊሌ ሼምፕፖ 2 (ፕ። 38) ጊድዶን "ፔንግጌ" ንኔ "ጌእሽሺዲ" ጊየአ ቀአለተስክከ ነዕዑ ጌሎሰ ቢርሽሼꬃይ ዴዒኢ?
flat_utterances.amharic: በስምንተኛ ክፍል ምዕራፍ 2 (ገጽ 38) ውስጥ ለ«ፔንጌ» እና «ጌሺዲ» ለሚሉት ቃላትም ሁለት አገባባዊ ፍቺ አላቸው?
flat_utterances.english: In Grade 8 Chapter 2 (p. 38), do the words 'pengge' and 'geeshshidi' also have two contextual meanings?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: pengge (door/opportunity, Gr8 Ch.2 p. 38) + geeshsh-idi (cleanly/fluently, Gr8 Ch.2 p. 38) + na77u gelosa birshshetha-y de7-ii.

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Ee! (1) "Pengge" = (a) wula, (b) ooso qaada; (2) "Geeshshidi" = (a) qita kessidi, (b) loythidi ('Goofatho geeshshidi haasayees')!
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: እእ! (1) "ፔንግጌ" = (አ) ዉለ፣ (ብ) ኦኦሶ ቀአደ፤ (2) "ጌእሽሺዲ" = (አ) ቂተ ኬስሲዲ፣ (ብ) ሎይꬂዲ ('ጎኦፈꬆ ጌእሽሺዲ ሀአሰዬእስ')!
flat_utterances.amharic: አዎ! (1) «ፔንጌ» = (ሀ) የቤት በር (ዉላ)፣ (ለ) የሥራ ዕድል (ኦሶ ቃዳ)፤ (2) «ጌሺዲ» = (ሀ) ቆሻሻ አጽድቶ፣ (ለ) አጥርቶ/በሚገባ (ለምሳሌ 'ጎፋꬶ ጌሺዲ ሃሳዬስ' — ጎፋኛ አጥርቶ ይናገራል)!
flat_utterances.english: Yes! (1) 'Pengge' means (a) physical door/gate ('wula') and (b) job or life opportunity ('ooso qaada'); (2) 'Geeshshidi' means (a) cleaning away dirt ('qita kessidi') and (b) fluently/thoroughly ('loythidi', e.g., 'Goofatho geeshshidi haasayees' = speaks Gofatho fluently)!
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: Gr8 Ch.2 p. 38 polysemy exercises: pengge (wula vs. ooso qaada) and geeshshidi (qita kessidi vs. loythidi).

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Uddufuntho kifile Shemppo 6 ("Ginxxo", pp. 47-53) giddon Goofatho ginxxo yarati - keso, tura, zira, kure, mixenne polo - ay guussee?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ኡድዱፉንꬆ ኪፊሌ ሼምፕፖ 6 ("ጊንጥጦ"፣ ፕፕ። 4ዕ-53) ጊድዶን ጎኦፈꬆ ጊንጥጦ የረቲ - ኬሶ፣ ቱረ፣ ዚረ፣ ኩሬ፣ ሚጤንኔ ፖሎ - አይ ጉኡስሴእ?
flat_utterances.amharic: በዘጠነኛ ክፍል ምዕራፍ 6 («ጊንጦ» / ግጥም፣ ገጽ 47–53) ውስጥ የጎፋኛ ግጥም አላባውያን—ኬሶ፣ ቱራ፣ ዚራ፣ ኩሬ፣ ሚጤ እና ፖሎ—ምን ማለት ናቸው?
flat_utterances.english: In Grade 9 Chapter 6 ('Poetry', pp. 47–53), what do the elements of Gofatho poetry—'keso', 'tura', 'zira', 'kure', 'mixe', and 'polo'—mean?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: ginxxo yara-ti (poetry element-PL.NOM, Gr9 Ch.6 p. 51): keso, tura, zira, kure, mixe, eedo, polo/dinxxo.

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Uddufuntho kifile maxaafaa (pp. 51-53) maaran: "keso" = cenggurssa shaaho; "tura" = zira bagga; "zira" = issi layne; "kure" = zira shiiqo; "mixe" = keso qooda (6/6); "polo / dinxxo" = wurssetha cenggurssa gahetetha!
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ኡድዱፉንꬆ ኪፊሌ መጠአፈአ (ፕፕ። 51-53) መአረን፦ "ኬሶ" = ጬንግጉርስሰ ሻአሆ፤ "ቱረ" = ዚረ በግገ፤ "ዚረ" = ኢስሲ ለይኔ፤ "ኩሬ" = ዚረ ሺኢቆ፤ "ሚጤ" = ኬሶ ቆኦደ (6/6)፤ "ፖሎ / ዲንጥጦ" = ዉርስሴꬃ ጬንግጉርስሰ ገሄቴꬃ!
flat_utterances.amharic: በዘጠነኛ ክፍል መጽሐፍ (ገጽ 51–53) መሠረት፦ «ኬሶ» = ቀለም (በአንድ ትንፋሽ የሚጠራ ድምፅ)፤ «ቱራ» = ሐረግ (የስንኝ ግማሽ)፤ «ዚራ» = ስንኝ (አንድ መስመር)፤ «ኩሬ» = አንጓ፤ «ሚጤ» = ምጣኔ (ለምሳሌ 6/6)፤ «ፖሎ / ዲንጦ» = ቤት መምታት (መድረሻ ድምፅ)!
flat_utterances.english: According to the Grade 9 textbook (pp. 51–53): 'keso' = poetic syllable; 'tura' = hemistich (half-line); 'zira' = single line of verse; 'kure' = stanza; 'mixe' = metrical syllable count (such as 6/6); and 'polo / dinxxo' = end-rhyme!
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: Complete prosodic and poetic terminology of Gofatho (Gr9 Ch.6 pp. 51–53).

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: He shemppuwan de7iyaa "Duuqqopa" giyaa ginxxuwaappe issi zira 6/6 mixiyan kessada bessarkkii?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ሄ ሼምፕፑወን ዴዒየአ "ዱኡቅቆፐ" ጊየአ ጊንጥጡወአፕፔ ኢስሲ ዚረ 6/6 ሚጢየን ኬስሰደ ቤስሰርክኪኢ?
flat_utterances.amharic: በዚያ ምዕራፍ ውስጥ ካለው «ዱኡቆፓ» (በፈተና አትኮርጅ!) ከሚለው ግጥም አንድ ስንኝ በ6/6 ምጣኔ ከፋፍለህ ታሳየኛለህ?
flat_utterances.english: From the poem 'Duuqqopa' ('Do Not Cheat!') in that chapter, could you scan a line into its 6/6 syllable meter ('mixe')?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: duuqq-opa (cheat/copy-PROH.2S, Gr9 Ch.6 p. 48) + issi zira (one line of verse) + 6/6 mixiya-n (6/6 meter-LOC) + kess-ada bess-arkkii.

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Uddufuntho kifile maxaafa sinthe 52 bolla: "Ti-mir-tti-yan min-ni-di (6 keso) / sa-lo-ra paal-la-naa (6 keso)" - issi issi turan usuppun kesoti de7oosona (6/6 mixe); ginxxoy tamaareti paacciyan duuqqonnaan bantta eran xoonana mala zorees!
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ኡድዱፉንꬆ ኪፊሌ መጠአፈ ሲንꬄ 52 ቦልለ፦ "ቲ-ሚር-ትቲ-የን ሚን-ኒ-ዲ (6 ኬሶ) / ሰ-ሎ-ረ ፐአል-ለ-ነአ (6 ኬሶ)" - ኢስሲ ኢስሲ ቱረን ኡሱፕፑን ኬሶቲ ዴዖኦሶነ (6/6 ሚጤ)፤ ጊንጥጦይ ተመአሬቲ ፐአጭጪየን ዱኡቅቆንነአን በንትተ እረን ጦኦነነ መለ ዞሬእስ!
flat_utterances.amharic: በዘጠነኛ ክፍል መጽሐፍ ገጽ 52 ላይ፦ «ቲ-ሚር-ቲ-ያን ሚን-ኒ-ዲ (6 ቀለም) / ሳ-ሎ-ራ ፓል-ላ-ና (6 ቀለም)» — በእያንዳንዱ ሐረግ ውስጥ ስድስት ቀለማት (ኬሶ) አሉ (6/6 ምጣኔ)፤ ግጥሙም ተማሪዎች በፈተና ሳይኮርጁ በራሳቸው ዕውቀት እንዲያሸንፉ ይመክራል!
flat_utterances.english: On page 52 of the Grade 9 textbook: 'Ti-mir-tti-yan min-ni-di (6 syllables) / sa-lo-ra paal-la-naa (6 syllables)' — each hemistich ('tura') has 6 syllables (6/6 'mixe'); and the poem advises students never to cheat on exams ('duuqqopa') but to succeed through their own hard study!
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: Exact metrical scansion from Gr9 Ch.6 p. 52: geminate consonants split across coda and onset (Ti-mir-tti-yan min-ni-di / sa-lo-ra paal-la-naa).

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Tammantho kifile Shemppo 1 (p. 11) nne Hosppuntho kifile Shemppo 10 (p. 148) giddon de7iyaa "Gasethota" meega qofan waatada go7ettoo?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ተምመንꬆ ኪፊሌ ሼምፕፖ 1 (ፕ። 11) ንኔ ሆስፕፑንꬆ ኪፊሌ ሼምፕፖ 10 (ፕ። 148) ጊድዶን ዴዒየአ "ገሴꬆተ" ሜእገ ቆፈን ወአተደ ጎዔትቶኦ?
flat_utterances.amharic: በአሥረኛ ክፍል ምዕራፍ 1 (ገጽ 11) እና በስምንተኛ ክፍል ምዕራፍ 10 (ገጽ 148) ውስጥ ያሉትን «ጋሴꬆታ» (አያያዥ ቃላት) በዓረፍተ ነገር ውስጥ እንዴት ልጠቀም?
flat_utterances.english: How do I use the discourse connectors ('Gasethota') in Grade 10 Chapter 1 (p. 11) and Grade 8 Chapter 10 (p. 148) in sentences?

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Bertte gasethoti: (1) Gaaso/Muruuta: "hessa gisho", "...gishshaw"; (2) Phalqqe/Qeeletho: "shin", "gidoppe attin"; (3) Gujjo: "gujjidinne", "hari attoshin"; (4) Dooretho: "woy / woykko".
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ቤርትቴ ገሴꬆቲ፦ (1) ገአሶ/ሙሩኡተ፦ "ሄስሰ ጊሾ"፣ "።።።ጊሽሻው"፤ (2) ጳልቅቄ/ቄእሌꬆ፦ "ሺን"፣ "ጊዶፕፔ አትቲን"፤ (3) ጉጅጆ፦ "ጉጅጂዲንኔ"፣ "ሀሪ አትቶሺን"፤ (4) ዶኦሬꬆ፦ "ዎይ / ዎይክኮ"።
flat_utterances.amharic: ዋና ዋና አያያዦች፦ (1) የምክንያትና ውጤት፦ «ሄሳ ጊሾ» (ስለዚህ)፣ «...ጊሻው» (ስለ...)፤ (2) የተቃርኖ፦ «ሺን» (ግን)፣ «ጊዶፔ አቲን» (ይሁን እንጂ)፤ (3) የተጨማሪ፦ «ጉጂዲኔ» (በተጨማሪም)፣ «ሃሪ አቶሺን» (ይህም ቀርቶ)፤ (4) የአማራጭ፦ «ዎይ / ዎይኮ» (ወይም) ናቸው።
flat_utterances.english: The primary connectors are: (1) Cause/Result: 'hessa gisho' (therefore), '...gishshaw' (because); (2) Contrast: 'shin' (but), 'gidoppe attin' (however); (3) Addition: 'gujjidinne' (furthermore), 'hari attoshin' (moreover/let alone); (4) Alternative: 'woy / woykko' (or).
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: Classification of Gasethota from Gr8 Ch.10 p. 148 & Gr10 Ch.1 p. 11.

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: "Hessa gisho" nne "Gidoppe attin" go7ettada na77u leemiso meega qofa taassi xaafarkkii?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: "ሄስሰ ጊሾ" ንኔ "ጊዶፕፔ አትቲን" ጎዔትተደ ነዕዑ ሌእሚሶ ሜእገ ቆፈ ተአስሲ ጠአፈርክኪኢ?
flat_utterances.amharic: «ሄሳ ጊሾ» (ስለዚህ) እና «ጊዶፔ አቲን» (ይሁን እንጂ) ተጠቅመህ ሁለት ምሳሌ ዓረፍተ ነገሮችን ትጽፍልኛለህ?
flat_utterances.english: Could you write two example sentences for me using 'Hessa gisho' ('therefore') and 'Gidoppe attin' ('however')?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: hessa gisho (therefore) + gidoppe attin (however) + go7ett-ada (use-CNV1.ANT.2S) + xaaf-arkkii (write-2S.POT.INTER).

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: (1) "Na7iyaa gallassan ubba wode minnada tamaarawsu; hessa gisho, paacciyan koyro keyadasu." (2) "Irathay daro bukkiis; gidoppe attin, tamaareti timirtte keethappe attibookkona."
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: (1) "ነዒየአ ገልለስሰን ኡብበ ዎዴ ሚንነደ ተመአረውሱ፤ ሄስሰ ጊሾ፣ ፐአጭጪየን ኮይሮ ኬየደሱ።" (2) "ኢረꬃይ ደሮ ቡክኪኢስ፤ ጊዶፕፔ አትቲን፣ ተመአሬቲ ቲሚርትቴ ኬእꬃፕፔ አትቲቦኦክኮነ።"
flat_utterances.amharic: (1) «ልጅቷ በየቀኑ ሁልጊዜ ጠንክራ ትማራለች፤ ስለዚህ (ሄሳ ጊሾ)፣ በፈተና አንደኛ ወጣች።» (2) «ዝናብ በብዛት ዘነበ፤ ይሁን እንጂ (ጊዶፔ አቲን)፣ ተማሪዎቹ ከትምህርት ቤት አልቀሩም።»
flat_utterances.english: (1) 'The girl studies diligently every day; therefore (hessa gisho), she stood first in the examination.' (2) 'Heavy rain fell; however (gidoppe attin), the students did not stay absent from school.'

flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ኡድዱፉንꬆ ኪፊሌ ሼምፕፖ 3 (ፕፕ። 21-22) ጊድዶን ኢስሲ "ደአስሰ" ጠአፊዮ ዎዴ ሄእꬑ ቤርትቴ ኪፊሌቲ አዉጌእቴእ?
flat_utterances.amharic: በዘጠነኛ ክፍል ምዕራፍ 3 (ገጽ 21–22) ውስጥ አንድ «ዳሳ» (አንቀጽ) በሚጻፍበት ጊዜ ሦስቱ ዋና ክፍሎች የትኞቹ ናቸው?

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Issi daassas heedzu kifileti de7oosona: (1) "Ayfe meega qofa" (daassaa waanna qofa qonccissiyaagaa), (2) "Qonccissiyaa / Kaalliya meega qofata" nne (3) "Qachcho / Wurssetha meega qofa"!
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ኢስሲ ደአስሰስ ሄእꬑ ኪፊሌቲ ዴዖኦሶነ፦ (1) "አይፌ ሜእገ ቆፈ" (ደአስሰአ ወአንነ ቆፈ ቆንጭጪስሲየአገአ)፣ (2) "ቆንጭጪስሲየአ / ከአልሊየ ሜእገ ቆፈተ" ንኔ (3) "ቀችቾ / ዉርስሴꬃ ሜእገ ቆፈ"!
flat_utterances.amharic: ለአንድ አንቀጽ (ዳሳ) ሦስት ክፍሎች አሉት፦ (1) «አይፌ ሜጋ ቆፋ» (ኃይለ ቃል / የአንቀጹን ዋና ሐሳብ የሚገልጽ)፣ (2) «ቆንጪሲያ / ካሊያ ሜጋ ቆፋታ» (አብራሪ ዓረፍተ ነገሮች) እና (3) «ቃቾ / ዉርሴꬃ ሜጋ ቆፋ» (መደምደሚያ ዓረፍተ ነገር)!
flat_utterances.english: A paragraph ('daassa') has three parts: (1) Topic sentence ('Ayfe meega qofa' — stating the central idea), (2) Supporting sentences ('Qonccissiyaa meega qofata'), and (3) Concluding sentence ('Qachcho / Wurssetha meega qofa')!
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: Gr9 Ch.3 pp. 21–22 paragraph composition terminology: daassa, ayfe meega qofa, kaalliya meega qofata, qachcho meega qofa.

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Dabddaabbey na77u gita qommo: (1) "Buzo dabddaabbe" (so asaasinne laggetas xaafettiyaagaa) nne (2) "Ooso dabddaabbe" (maatazemppenne titere go7ettidi xaafettiyaagaa)!
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ደብድደአብቤይ ነዕዑ ጊተ ቆምሞ፦ (1) "ቡዞ ደብድደአብቤ" (ሶ አሰአሲንኔ ለግጌተስ ጠአፌትቲየአገአ) ንኔ (2) "ኦኦሶ ደብድደአብቤ" (መአተዜምፕፔንኔ ቲቴሬ ጎዔትቲዲ ጠአፌትቲየአገአ)!
flat_utterances.amharic: ደብዳቤ ሁለት ዋና ዓይነት ነው፦ (1) «ቡዞ ዳብዳቤ» (የግል ደብዳቤ — ለቤተሰብና ለጓደኛ የሚጻፍ) እና (2) «ኦሶ ዳብዳቤ» (የሥራ/የመሥሪያ ቤት ደብዳቤ — ማኅተምና ቁጥር ተጠቅሞ የሚጻፍ)!
flat_utterances.english: Letters have two main types: (1) Personal letter ('Buzo dabddaabbe' — written to family and friends) and (2) Official business letter ('Ooso dabddaabbe' — written formally with reference number and official seal)!
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: buzo dabddaabbe (personal letter) vs. ooso dabddaabbe (official/business letter, Gr10 Ch.6 pp. 52–59).

flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ተምመንꬆ ኪፊሌ ሼምፕፖ ዕ ("አዱስሰ ሜꬍ-ደርስሶ"፣ ፕፕ። 62-66) ጊድዶን "አሾ ዶምዕዔ" ንኔ "ከሀ ዶምዕዔ" ጊየአ ሜꬍ-ደርስሶ ቀአለተ ቢርሽሼꬃይ አይቤእ?
flat_utterances.amharic: በአሥረኛ ክፍል ምዕራፍ 7 («ረጅም ልቦለድ»፣ ገጽ 62–66) ውስጥ «አሾ ዶምዔ» እና «ካሃ ዶምዔ» የሚሉት የሥነ-ጽሑፍ ቃላት ትርጉማቸው ምንድን ነው?
flat_utterances.english: In Grade 10 Chapter 7 ('The Novel', pp. 62–66), what do the literary terms 'asho dom77e' and 'kaha dom77e' mean?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: adussa medh-darsso (novel / long fiction, Gr10 Ch.7 p. 62) + asho dom77e (physical conflict, ZARA-03 77) vs. kaha dom77e (psychological/internal conflict).

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Tammantho kifile maxaafaa (p. 64) maaran: "asho dom77e" guussay odaaway hara asaara woykko medhetaara gahettiyaa dom77e; "kaha dom77e" qassi odaaway ba wozanaa/qofaa giddon palanthiyaa dom77e!
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ተምመንꬆ ኪፊሌ መጠአፈአ (ፕ። 64) መአረን፦ "አሾ ዶምዕዔ" ጉኡስሰይ ኦደአወይ ሀረ አሰአረ ዎይክኮ ሜꬌተአረ ገሄትቲየአ ዶምዕዔ፤ "ከሀ ዶምዕዔ" ቀስሲ ኦደአወይ በ ዎዘነአ/ቆፈአ ጊድዶን ፐለንꬂየአ ዶምዕዔ!
flat_utterances.amharic: በአሥረኛ ክፍል መጽሐፍ (ገጽ 64) መሠረት፦ «አሾ ዶምዔ» ማለት ገጸ-ባህሪው ከሌላ ሰው ወይም ከተፈጥሮ ጋር የሚገጥመው አካላዊ ግጭት፤ «ካሃ ዶምዔ» ደግሞ ገጸ-ባህሪው በራሱ ልብ/ሐሳብ ውስጥ የሚሟገተው የውስጥ (ሥነ-ልቦናዊ) ግጭት ነው!
flat_utterances.english: According to the Grade 10 textbook (p. 64): 'asho dom77e' is physical/external conflict between a character ('odaawa') and another person or nature; whereas 'kaha dom77e' is internal/psychological conflict within the character's own mind!
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: odaawa (character, Gr9 Ch.4 p. 28) + asho dom77e (body/physical conflict) vs. kaha dom77e (mind/internal conflict, Gr10 Ch.7 p. 64).

flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ሜꬍ-ደርስሱወን "ሀአስጊነ / ጤእልሊ-ጊነ" ቆምሞቲ ቀስሲ አዉጌእቴእ?

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Haasginay: (1) "Koyro moode haasgina" ('Taani / Nuuni' gidi paatethiyaagaa, leemisos Ayyala Gabayo xaafido 'Biqqala' maxaafaa), (2) "Wurssi-eraadde haasgina" nne (3) "Xii-eraadde / Sima eraadde haasgina"!
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ሀአስጊነይ፦ (1) "ኮይሮ ሞኦዴ ሀአስጊነ" ('ተአኒ / ኑኡኒ' ጊዲ ፐአቴꬂየአገአ፣ ሌእሚሶስ አይየለ ገበዮ ጠአፊዶ 'ቢቅቀለ' መጠአፈአ)፣ (2) "ዉርስሲ-እረአድዴ ሀአስጊነ" ንኔ (3) "ጢኢ-እረአድዴ / ሲመ እረአድዴ ሀአስጊነ"!
flat_utterances.amharic: የትረካ አንጻር (ሃስጊና)፦ (1) «ኮይሮ ሞዴ ሃስጊና» ('ታኒ / ኑኒ' ብሎ የሚተርክ የአንደኛ መደብ አንጻር፣ ለምሳሌ አያሌው ገበየሁ የጻፈው 'ቢቃላ' ረጅም ልቦለድ)፣ (2) «ዉርሲ-ኤራዴ ሃስጊና» (ሁሉን አዋቂ የሦስተኛ መደብ አንጻር) እና (3) «ጢ-ኤራዴ / ሲማ ኤራዴ ሃስጊና» (ውሱን አዋቂ የሦስተኛ መደብ አንጻር) ናቸው!
flat_utterances.english: Narrative point of view ('haasgina') includes: (1) First-person POV ('Koyro moode haasgina', narrating as 'Taani / Nuuni', as in Ayyala Gabayo's novel 'Biqqala', pp. 69–70), (2) Omniscient third-person POV ('Wurssi-eraadde haasgina'), and (3) Limited third-person POV ('Xii-eraadde / Sima eraadde haasgina')!
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: Complete literary theory terminology from Gr10 Ch.7 pp. 65–70.

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Tammantho kifile Shemppo 1 ("Doonanne Deretethaa", p. 6) giddon "Dooni ubbay issi gina" giyay ay guussee?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ተምመንꬆ ኪፊሌ ሼምፕፖ 1 ("ዶኦነንኔ ዴሬቴꬃአ"፣ ፕ። 6) ጊድዶን "ዶኦኒ ኡብበይ ኢስሲ ጊነ" ጊየይ አይ ጉኡስሴእ?
flat_utterances.amharic: በአሥረኛ ክፍል ምዕራፍ 1 («ቋንቋና ማኅበረሰብ»፣ ገጽ 6) ውስጥ «ሁሉም ቋንቋ እኩል ነው» («Dooni ubbay issi gina») የሚለው ምን ማለት ነው?
flat_utterances.english: In Grade 10 Chapter 1 ('Language and Society', p. 6), what does 'Dooni ubbay issi gina' ('All languages are equal') mean?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: doon-i ubba-y (language-NOM all-NOM) + issi gina (equal, Gr10 Ch.1 p. 6 & PHR-074); ay guuss-ee (what meaning-COP.INTER).

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Doona ubbaas bertte qoppobay asaa giddon gahetethi medho gididayssappe denddidayssaan, oona doonikka ba deretethaa qofaa, wogaanne hilohaa kumetta qonccissanaw dandda7ees; hessa gisho gita woy guutha dooni baawa!
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ዶኦነ ኡብበአስ ቤርትቴ ቆፕፖበይ አሰአ ጊድዶን ገሄቴꬂ ሜꬎ ጊዲደይስሰፕፔ ዴንድዲደይስሰአን፣ ኦኦነ ዶኦኒክከ በ ዴሬቴꬃአ ቆፈአ፣ ዎገአንኔ ሂሎሀአ ኩሜትተ ቆንጭጪስሰነው ደንድደዔእስ፤ ሄስሰ ጊሾ ጊተ ዎይ ጉኡꬃ ዶኦኒ በአወ!
flat_utterances.amharic: የሁሉም ቋንቋ ዋና ዓላማ በሰዎች መካከል ግንኙነት መፍጠር ከመሆኑ የተነሣ፣ የማንም ቋንቋ የማኅበረሰቡን ሐሳብ፣ ባህልና ሥልጣኔ ሙሉ በሙሉ መግለጽ ይችላል፤ ስለዚህ ትልቅ ወይም ትንሽ ቋንቋ የለም!
flat_utterances.english: Because the primary purpose of every language is creating human communication, any language can fully express its society's thoughts, culture, and civilization ('hiloha'); therefore there is no 'big' or 'small' language!
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: gahetethi medho (communication creation) + gid-idayssa-ppe dendd-idayssaa-n (be-PAST.REL.NMZ-ABL arise-PAST.REL.NMZ-LOC, Gr10 Ch.1 p. 6) + hiloha-a (civilization-ACC) + qoncc-iss-anaw dandda7-ees.

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Hayzonnaanne haasayonna asati go7ettiyaa "malla doona" baabaa he shemppoy ay tamaarissii?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ሀይዞንነአንኔ ሀአሰዮንነ አሰቲ ጎዔትቲየአ "መልለ ዶኦነ" በአበአ ሄ ሼምፕፖይ አይ ተመአሪስሲኢ?
flat_utterances.amharic: መስማትና መናገር የተሳናቸው ሰዎች ስለሚጠቀሙበት «ማላ ዶና» (የምልክት ቋንቋ) ያ ምዕራፍ ምን ያስተምራል?
flat_utterances.english: What does that chapter teach about sign language ('malla doona') used by deaf and hard-of-hearing community members?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: hayz-onna-a-nne haasay-onna asa-ti (hear-NEG.REL-and speak-NEG.REL person-PL.NOM) + go7ett-iyaa malla doona (use-PRES.REL sign language, Gr10 Ch.1 p. 7).

flat_utterances.speaker: assistant
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Tammantho kifile maxaafay (p. 7) "malla doona" cenggurssa doonaadan kumetta higgeynne qawosay de7iyaa doona gididoogaanne deretethay malla doona tamaaridi ubbay issippe gahettanaw bessiis gidi tamaarissees!
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ተምመንꬆ ኪፊሌ መጠአፈይ (ፕ። ዕ) "መልለ ዶኦነ" ጬንግጉርስሰ ዶኦነአደን ኩሜትተ ሂግጌይንኔ ቀዎሰይ ዴዒየአ ዶኦነ ጊዲዶኦገአንኔ ዴሬቴꬃይ መልለ ዶኦነ ተመአሪዲ ኡብበይ ኢስሲፕፔ ገሄትተነው ቤስሲኢስ ጊዲ ተመአሪስሴእስ!
flat_utterances.amharic: የአሥረኛ ክፍል መጽሐፍ (ገጽ 7) «ማላ ዶና» (የምልክት ቋንቋ) እንደ ድምፅ ቋንቋ ሙሉ ሕግና ሰዋስው ያለው ቋንቋ መሆኑንና ማኅበረሰቡ የምልክት ቋንቋን ተምሮ ሁሉም በአንድነት መግባባት እንደሚገባው ያስተምራል!
flat_utterances.english: The Grade 10 textbook (p. 7) teaches that sign language ('malla doona') is a complete language with its own rules and grammar just like spoken language, and that society should learn sign language for inclusive communication!
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: cenggurssa doonaa-dan (spoken/voice language-EQU) + kumetta higge-y-nne qawosa-y de7-iyaa doona (complete rule-NOM-and grammar-NOM exist-PRES.REL language, Gr10 Ch.1 p. 7).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Grade 9 Ch. 1 & Grade 10 Ch. 1 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/1uvGaBT4-O_Jn7oQbuNl1W88lFBFiHULU/view?usp=drivesdk, p. 5; https://drive.google.com/file/d/1mKIcfMoMgnZ9Pa657NWmE-OGND2wlveM/view?usp=drivesdk, pp. 6–10: Doonanne Deretethaa, Malla Doona)

flat_utterances.speaker: user
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Tammantho kifile Shemppo 2 ("Gade Wogan Eko Gelo", pp. 7-14) giddon Goofa wogan eko gelo maarati koyroppe wurssetha gakkanaw awugeetee?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ተምመንꬆ ኪፊሌ ሼምፕፖ 2 ("ገዴ ዎገን እኮ ጌሎ"፣ ፕፕ። ዕ-14) ጊድዶን ጎኦፈ ዎገን እኮ ጌሎ መአረቲ ኮይሮፕፔ ዉርስሴꬃ ገክከነው አዉጌእቴእ?
flat_utterances.amharic: በአሥረኛ ክፍል ምዕራፍ 2 («በባህላዊ ሥርዓት ጋብቻ»፣ ገጽ 7–14) ውስጥ በጎፋ ባህል የጋብቻ ቅደም ተከተሎች ከመጀመሪያ እስከ መጨረሻ የትኞቹ ናቸው?
flat_utterances.english: In Grade 10 Chapter 2 ('Traditional Marriage Customs', pp. 7–14), what are the sequential stages of marriage in Gofa tradition from beginning to end?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: gade woga-n eko gelo maara-ti (cultural custom-LOC marriage procedure-PL.NOM, Gr10 Ch.2 p. 7) + koyro-ppe wurssetha gakk-anaw (first-ABL end reach-UNTIL).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Grade 10 Goofatho Doona Ch. 2 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/1mKIcfMoMgnZ9Pa657NWmE-OGND2wlveM/view?usp=drivesdk, pp. 7–14: Gade Wogan Eko Gelo)

flat_utterances.domain_name: Gofa Cultural Traditions, Marriage & Oral Literature (Goofa Woga, Tosse, Aaqeta, Sedhemenkke)
flat_utterances.subtopic: Traditional Gofa Marriage Steps: Laazanthi, Doona Pogo, Yaagano & Githe (Grade 10 Ch. 2)
flat_utterances.speaker: assistant
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Orzaamonne Murqqenna haasaya (pp. 13-14) maaran: (1) "Laazanthi" (cima yeddidi oychcho), (2) "Doona pogo", (3) Na7iyaa puutto qolle/gaabe daddonne na7ay keetha keexxidi "cumo" tokkoy, (4) "Soofe", (5) "Yaagano" nne (6) "Githe" (meddati aayee-aawa soo biidi simmoy)!
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ኦርዘአሞንኔ ሙርቅቄንነ ሀአሰየ (ፕፕ። 13-14) መአረን፦ (1) "ለአዘንꬂ" (ጪመ ዬድዲዲ ኦይችቾ)፣ (2) "ዶኦነ ፖጎ"፣ (3) ነዒየአ ፑኡትቶ ቆልሌ/ገአቤ ደድዶንኔ ነዓይ ኬእꬃ ኬእጥጢዲ "ጩሞ" ቶክኮይ፣ (4) "ሶኦፌ"፣ (5) "የአገኖ" ንኔ (6) "ጊꬄ" (ሜድደቲ አአዬእ-አአወ ሶኦ ቢኢዲ ሲምሞይ)!
flat_utterances.amharic: በኦርዛሞና ሙርቄና ምልልስ (ገጽ 13–14) መሠረት፦ (1) «ላዛንꬂ» (ሽምግልና — ሽማግሌ ልኮ መጠየቅ)፣ (2) «ዶና ፖጎ» (የቃል ማሰሪያ)፣ (3) ልጅቷ ጥጥ መፍተሏና ልጁ ቤት ሠርቶ ተክል መትከሉ («ጩሞ»)፣ (4) «ሶፌ» (የሙሽሪት የገበያ ጉዞ)፣ (5) «ያጋኖ» (ሠርግ) እና (6) «ጊꬄ» (መልስ) ናቸው!
flat_utterances.english: According to the dialogue between Orzaamo and Murqqenna (pp. 13–14): (1) 'Laazanthi' (sending matchmaking elders), (2) 'Doona pogo' (betrothal pledge), (3) the bride spinning cotton and the groom building a house and planting 'cumo', (4) 'Soofe' (pre-wedding market outing), (5) 'Yaagano' (wedding feast), and (6) 'Githe' (post-wedding ceremonial visit to the bride's parents)!
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: Complete 6-stage Gofa marriage ethnography from Gr10 Ch.2 pp. 12–14.
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Grade 10 Goofatho Doona Ch. 2 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/1mKIcfMoMgnZ9Pa657NWmE-OGND2wlveM/view?usp=drivesdk, pp. 7–14: Gade Wogan Eko Gelo)

flat_utterances.speaker: user
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Yaagano galla meddaawaynne meddaayiyaa ooratha keetha kariyaa gakkiyaa wode aaway "xamaata" oyqqidi waani anjjii?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: የአገኖ ገልለ ሜድደአወይንኔ ሜድደአዪየአ ኦኦረꬃ ኬእꬃ ከሪየአ ገክኪየአ ዎዴ አአወይ "ጠመአተ" ኦይቅቂዲ ወአኒ አንጅጂኢ?
flat_utterances.amharic: በሠርጉ ቀን ሙሽራውና ሙሽሪት አዲሱ ቤት ደጃፍ ሲደርሱ አባትየው «ጣማታ» (እርጎ) ይዞ እንዴት ይመርቃል?
flat_utterances.english: On the wedding day when the groom and bride arrive at the threshold of the new house, how does the father bless them holding curd ('xamaata')?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: yaagano galla (wedding day) + ooratha keetha kariya-a (new house doorway-ACC, PHR-0194) + xamaata (curd/yogurt, Gr10 Ch.2 p. 14) + waan-i anjj-ii (how-CNV2 bless-PRES.3MS.INTER).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Grade 10 Goofatho Doona Ch. 2 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/1mKIcfMoMgnZ9Pa657NWmE-OGND2wlveM/view?usp=drivesdk, pp. 7–14: Gade Wogan Eko Gelo)

flat_utterances.speaker: assistant
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Kariyan yeechche sa7an hiixxidi, aaway xamaataa meddata gediyan bochchissishe: "Yelite, dichchite, na7a na7a be7ite, xamaataadan irxxite!" gidi anjjees!
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ከሪየን ዬእችቼ ሰዓን ሂኢጥጢዲ፣ አአወይ ጠመአተአ ሜድደተ ጌዲየን ቦችቺስሲሼ፦ "ዬሊቴ፣ ዲችቺቴ፣ ነዓ ነዓ ቤዒቴ፣ ጠመአተአደን ኢርጥጢቴ!" ጊዲ አንጅጄእስ!
flat_utterances.amharic: በደጃፉ የእንሰት ቅጠል (ዬችቼ) መሬት ላይ አንጥፎ፣ አባትየው እርጎውን በሙሽሮቹ እግር ላይ እያነካካ፦ «ውለዱ፣ አሳድጉ፣ የልጅ ልጅ እዩ፣ እንደ እርጎ ቀዝቅዙ (ሰላም ሁኑ)!» ብሎ ይመርቃል!
flat_utterances.english: With fresh enset leaves ('yeechche') spread on the ground at the threshold, the father touches curd ('xamaata') to the newlyweds' feet and blesses them saying: 'Bear children, raise them, see your grandchildren, and be cool and peaceful like curd!'
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: yeechche sa7a-n hiixx-idi (enset.leaf ground-LOC spread-CNV2, PHR-0197) + yel-ite, dichch-ite, na7a na7a be7-ite (bear-IMP.2PL, raise-IMP.2PL, child child see-IMP.2PL, Gr10 Ch.2 p. 14).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Grade 10 Goofatho Doona Ch. 2 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/1mKIcfMoMgnZ9Pa657NWmE-OGND2wlveM/view?usp=drivesdk, pp. 7–14: Gade Wogan Eko Gelo)

flat_utterances.speaker: user
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Tammantho kifile Shemppo 6 ("Bayrata Ooso Gisho", pp. 43-48) giddon "Dubbusha" nne "Gozdda" giyaa Goofa woga sunthati ay qonccissoikonaa?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ተምመንꬆ ኪፊሌ ሼምፕፖ 6 ("በይረተ ኦኦሶ ጊሾ"፣ ፕፕ። 43-48) ጊድዶን "ዱብቡሻ" ንኔ "ጎዝድደ" ጊየአ ጎኦፈ ዎገ ሱንꬃቲ አይ ቆንጭጪስሶኢኮነአ?
flat_utterances.amharic: በአሥረኛ ክፍል ምዕራፍ 6 («የሽማግሌዎች ሚና»፣ ገጽ 43–48) ውስጥ «ዱቡሻ» እና «ጎዝዳ» የሚሉት የጎፋ ባህላዊ ስሞች ምን ይገልጻሉ?
flat_utterances.english: In Grade 10 Chapter 6 ('The Role of Elders', pp. 43–48), what do the traditional Gofa terms 'Dubbusha' and 'Gozdda' refer to?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: bayra-ta ooso gisho (elder-PL.GEN work role, Gr10 Ch.6 p. 43) + dubbusha (traditional public assembly ground) + gozdda (council of senior elders).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Grade 10 Goofatho Doona Ch. 2 & Ch. 6 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/1mKIcfMoMgnZ9Pa657NWmE-OGND2wlveM/view?usp=drivesdk, pp. 13, 43–50: Bayrata Ooso Gisho, Dubbusha, Gozdda)

flat_utterances.domain_name: Gofa Cultural Traditions, Marriage & Oral Literature (Goofa Woga, Tosse, Aaqeta, Sedhemenkke)
flat_utterances.subtopic: Elder Peacebuilding at the Dubbusha & Gozdda Council (Grade 10 Ch. 6)
flat_utterances.speaker: assistant
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: "Dubbusha" guussay Goofa deriyan bayratinne deretethay shiiqidi wogaabaa tobbiyaanne ooyettida asata sigethiyaa gita wola mitha garssa bessa; "Gozdda" qassi deriyaa sarotethaa naagiyaanne tumaan sigethiyaa bayra cimata cuga!
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: "ዱብቡሻ" ጉኡስሰይ ጎኦፈ ዴሪየን በይረቲንኔ ዴሬቴꬃይ ሺኢቂዲ ዎገአበአ ቶብቢየአንኔ ኦኦዬትቲደ አሰተ ሲጌꬂየአ ጊተ ዎለ ሚꬃ ገርስሰ ቤስሰ፤ "ጎዝድደ" ቀስሲ ዴሪየአ ሰሮቴꬃአ ነአጊየአንኔ ቱመአን ሲጌꬂየአ በይረ ጪመተ ጩገ!
flat_utterances.amharic: «ዱቡሻ» ማለት በጎፋ ምድር ሽማግሌዎችና ማኅበረሰቡ ተሰብስበው ስለ ባህል የሚወያዩበትና የተጣሉ ሰዎችን የሚያስታርቁበት በትልቅ ዋርካ ዛፍ ስር ያለ አደባባይ ነው፤ «ጎዝዳ» ደግሞ የአካባቢውን ሰላም የሚጠብቁና በእውነት የሚያስታርቁ የታላላቅ ሽማግሌዎች ማዕረግ/ሸንጎ ነው!
flat_utterances.english: 'Dubbusha' is the traditional public assembly plaza under a great sycamore tree where Gofa elders and the community gather to deliberate and reconcile disputants; and 'Gozdda' is the respected council of senior peacemaking elders!
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: shiiq-idi (gather-CNV2.ANT) + tobb-iyaa-nne (discuss-PRES.REL-and) + ooy-ett-ida asa-ta (quarrel-RECIP-PAST.REL person-PL.ACC) + sigeth-iyaa (reconcile-PRES.REL, Gr8 Ch.10 p. 140 & Gr10 Ch.6 p. 45).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Grade 10 Goofatho Doona Ch. 2 & Ch. 6 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/1mKIcfMoMgnZ9Pa657NWmE-OGND2wlveM/view?usp=drivesdk, pp. 13, 43–50: Bayrata Ooso Gisho, Dubbusha, Gozdda)

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Bayra cimata bonchchuwaanne entta sigetho wolqqaa qonccisiyaa "Dosin ixxin cimi shi7a muzees" giyaa tosse birshshethay aybee?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: በይረ ጪመተ ቦንችቹወአንኔ እንትተ ሲጌꬆ ዎልቅቀአ ቆንጭጪሲየአ "ዶሲን ኢጥጢን ጪሚ ሺዓ ሙዜእስ" ጊየአ ቶስሴ ቢርሽሼꬃይ አይቤእ?
flat_utterances.amharic: የታላላቅ ሽማግሌዎችን ክብርና የማስታረቅ ኃይላቸውን የሚገልጸው «ዶሲን ኢጢን ጪሚ ሺዓ ሙዜስ» የሚለው ምሳሌ ትርጉሙ ምንድን ነው?
flat_utterances.english: What is the meaning of the proverb 'Dosin ixxin cimi shi7a muzees' that expresses the authority and reconciling power of elders?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: dos-in ixx-in (like-CNV.DS refuse-CNV.DS = whether one likes it or not) + cim-i (elder-NOM.M) + shi7a muz-ees (dung eat.CAUS-PRES.3MS, Gr10 Ch.2 p. 13 & Ch.6 p. 46).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Grade 10 Goofatho Doona Ch. 2 & Ch. 6 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/1mKIcfMoMgnZ9Pa657NWmE-OGND2wlveM/view?usp=drivesdk, pp. 13, 43–50: Bayrata Ooso Gisho, Dubbusha, Gozdda)

flat_utterances.domain_name: Gofa Cultural Traditions, Marriage & Oral Literature (Goofa Woga, Tosse, Aaqeta, Sedhemenkke)
flat_utterances.subtopic: Elder Peacebuilding at the Dubbusha & Gozdda Council (Grade 10 Ch. 6)
flat_utterances.speaker: assistant
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Ge birshshethay: ayba deexo ooyonne ziggire gidikkokka, bayra cimati giddo gelidi woossiyaanne sigethiyaa wode ooyettida asati cimata qaalaa bonchchidi maarotan sigettoosona guussa!
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ጌ ቢርሽሼꬃይ፦ አይበ ዴእጦ ኦኦዮንኔ ዚግጊሬ ጊዲክኮክከ፣ በይረ ጪመቲ ጊድዶ ጌሊዲ ዎኦስሲየአንኔ ሲጌꬂየአ ዎዴ ኦኦዬትቲደ አሰቲ ጪመተ ቀአለአ ቦንችቺዲ መአሮተን ሲጌትቶኦሶነ ጉኡስሰ!
flat_utterances.amharic: ውስጠ-ወይራ ፍቺው፦ ምንም ያህል ከባድ ጠብና ቂም ቢሆንም፣ ታላላቅ ሽማግሌዎች በመካከል ገብተው ሲለምኑና ሲያስታርቁ የተጣሉት ሰዎች የሽማግሌዎችን ቃል አክብረው በይቅርታ ይታረቃሉ ማለት ነው!
flat_utterances.english: Its figurative meaning is: no matter how bitter a quarrel or grudge may be, when senior elders step in to mediate and appeal for peace, the disputants honor the elders' word and reconcile in forgiveness!
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: deexo ooyo-nne (heavy quarrel-and) + bayra cima-ti giddo gel-idi (senior elder-PL.NOM middle enter-CNV2) + sig-ett-oosona (reconcile-RECIP-PRES.3PL, Gr10 Ch.6 p. 46).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Grade 10 Goofatho Doona Ch. 2 & Ch. 6 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/1mKIcfMoMgnZ9Pa657NWmE-OGND2wlveM/view?usp=drivesdk, pp. 13, 43–50: Bayrata Ooso Gisho, Dubbusha, Gozdda)

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Goofa bila-odan "Qan77ishe" giyaa kaassay waani kaa7ettii? Hosppuntho kifile Shemppo 2 (p. 32) wogaa taassi odarkkii?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ጎኦፈ ቢለ-ኦደን "ቀንዕዒሼ" ጊየአ ከአስሰይ ወአኒ ከአዔትቲኢ? ሆስፕፑንꬆ ኪፊሌ ሼምፕፖ 2 (ፕ። 32) ዎገአ ተአስሲ ኦደርክኪኢ?
flat_utterances.amharic: በጎፋ ሥነ-ቃል «ቃንጪሼ» የሚባለው የግጥም ምልልስ ጨዋታ እንዴት ይካሄዳል? የስምንተኛ ክፍል ምዕራፍ 2 (ገጽ 32) ደንቡን ትነግረኛለህ?
flat_utterances.english: In Gofa oral literature ('bila-oda'), how is the rhyming poetic duel game 'Qan77ishe' played? Could you tell me the rules from Grade 8 Chapter 2 (p. 32)?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: bila-oda-n (oral.literature-LOC, Gr9 Ch.5 p. 36) + qan77ishe (rhyming poetic duel, ZARA-03 geminate glottal 77=/ʔʔ/) + waan-i kaa7-ett-ii (how-CNV2 play-PASS-PRES.3MS.INTER).
