flat_utterances.subtopic: Qan77ishe Rhyming Poetic Duel Game & Rules (Grade 8 Ch. 2 & Grade 10 Ch. 5)
flat_utterances.speaker: assistant
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Hosppuntho kifile maxaafaa (p. 32) maaran: Qan77ishe wothiyaa uray "Qan77ishee!" giyaa wode, zaariyaa uray "Qashe!" gidi mokkees. Koyro uray issi polo/dinxxo zira gathiyaa wode, nam77antho uray he cenggurssaan polo mithidi eesuwan zaarees!
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ሆስፕፑንꬆ ኪፊሌ መጠአፈአ (ፕ። 32) መአረን፦ ቀንዕዒሼ ዎꬂየአ ኡረይ "ቀንዕዒሼእ!" ጊየአ ዎዴ፣ ዘአሪየአ ኡረይ "ቀሼ!" ጊዲ ሞክኬእስ። ኮይሮ ኡረይ ኢስሲ ፖሎ/ዲንጥጦ ዚረ ገꬂየአ ዎዴ፣ ነምዕዓንꬆ ኡረይ ሄ ጬንግጉርስሰአን ፖሎ ሚꬂዲ እእሱወን ዘአሬእስ!
flat_utterances.amharic: በስምንተኛ ክፍል መጽሐፍ (ገጽ 32) መሠረት፦ ቃንጪሼ የሚያቀርበው ሰው «ቃንጪሼ!» ሲል፣ ተቀባዩ «ቃሼ!» ብሎ ይቀበላል። የመጀመሪያው ሰው አንድ ስንኝ ሲያቀርብ፣ ሁለተኛው ሰው በዚያው መድረሻ ድምፅ ቤት መትቶ በፍጥነት ይመልሳል!
flat_utterances.english: According to the Grade 8 textbook (p. 32): when the challenger calls 'Qan77ishee!', the responder answers 'Qashe!' When the first speaker recites a verse line, the second speaker must rapidly reply with a matching end-rhyme!
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: woth-iyaa ura-y (present-PRES.REL person-NOM) + zaar-iyaa ura-y (answer-PRES.REL person-NOM); eesuwa-n zaar-ees (quickly-INST answer-PRES.3MS).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Grade 8 Ch. 2, Grade 9 Ch. 5 & Grade 10 Ch. 5 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/160NHNy-4orPcAIk-L5t6tOEtZoWemz_-/view?usp=drivesdk, pp. 32–33; https://drive.google.com/file/d/1mKIcfMoMgnZ9Pa657NWmE-OGND2wlveM/view?usp=drivesdk, pp. 46–47: Qan77ishe)

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Ane taani neessi "Qan77ishee!" goo - "Barzaapeppe luuloy baawashin tuussi eqqenna!" Zaaro taassi imma!
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: አኔ ተአኒ ኔእስሲ "ቀንዕዒሼእ!" ጎኦ - "በርዘአፔፕፔ ሉኡሎይ በአወሺን ቱኡስሲ እቅቄንነ!" ዘአሮ ተአስሲ ኢምመ!
flat_utterances.amharic: እስቲ እኔ ለአንተ «ቃንጪሼ!» ልበልህ — «ከባሕር ዛፍ የቀና የለም ግን ምሶሶ አይቆምም!» መልሱን ስጠኝ!
flat_utterances.english: Let me challenge you with 'Qan77ishee!' — 'Barzaapeppe luuloy baawashin tuussi eqqenna!' ('Nothing is straighter than eucalyptus, yet it cannot stand as a center house pole!') Give me the rhyming reply!
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: barzaape-ppe (eucalyptus-ABL) + luulo-y (straight-NOM) + baawa-shin (not.exist-CNV.SIM.DS) + tuuss-i eqq-enna (center.pole-NOM stand-PRES.3MS.NEG, Gr8 Ch.2 p. 33).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Grade 8 Ch. 2, Grade 9 Ch. 5 & Grade 10 Ch. 5 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/160NHNy-4orPcAIk-L5t6tOEtZoWemz_-/view?usp=drivesdk, pp. 32–33; https://drive.google.com/file/d/1mKIcfMoMgnZ9Pa657NWmE-OGND2wlveM/view?usp=drivesdk, pp. 46–47: Qan77ishe)

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: "Qashe! Ne aawappe durey baawashin dokke ashshenna!" - Hosppuntho kifile Shemppo 2 sinthe 33 Qan77ishe!
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: "ቀሼ! ኔ አአወፕፔ ዱሬይ በአወሺን ዶክኬ አሽሼንነ!" - ሆስፕፑንꬆ ኪፊሌ ሼምፕፖ 2 ሲንꬄ 33 ቀንዕዒሼ!
flat_utterances.amharic: «ቃሼ! ኔ አዋፔ ዱሬይ ባዋሺን ዶኬ አሼና!» (ከአባትህ የበለጠ ሀብታም የለም ግን ጥጃ አያስቀርም!) — የስምንተኛ ክፍል ምዕራፍ 2 ገጽ 33 ቃንጪሼ!
flat_utterances.english: 'Qashe! Ne aawappe durey baawashin dokke ashshenna!' ('No one is richer than your father, yet he never spares a calf!') — from Grade 8 Chapter 2, page 33!
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: Parallel morphological and metrical rhyme: barzaape-ppe ... baawa-shin ... eqq-enna // ne aawa-ppe ... baawa-shin ... ashsh-enna (Gr8 Ch.2 p. 33).

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Uddufuntho kifile Shemppo 5 (p. 40) nne Tammantho kifile Shemppo 5 (p. 44) giddon "Sedhemenkke" wothiyo wode zaariyaa uray zaaro dhayikko ay hanii?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ኡድዱፉንꬆ ኪፊሌ ሼምፕፖ 5 (ፕ። 40) ንኔ ተምመንꬆ ኪፊሌ ሼምፕፖ 5 (ፕ። 44) ጊድዶን "ሴꬌሜንክኬ" ዎꬂዮ ዎዴ ዘአሪየአ ኡረይ ዘአሮ ꬋዪክኮ አይ ሀኒኢ?
flat_utterances.amharic: በዘጠነኛ ክፍል ምዕራፍ 5 (ገጽ 40) እና በአሥረኛ ክፍል ምዕራፍ 5 (ገጽ 44) ውስጥ «ሴꬌሜንኬ» (እንቆቅልሽ) ሲጠየቅ መላሹ መልሱን ካጣ ምን ይሆናል?
flat_utterances.english: In Grade 9 Chapter 5 (p. 40) and Grade 10 Chapter 5 (p. 44), when playing traditional riddles ('Sedhemenkke'), what happens if the responder cannot find the answer?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: sedhemenkke woth-iyo wode (riddle put/pose-PRES.REL when, Gr9 Ch.5 p. 40) + zaaro dhay-ikko (answer lack-COND.REAL) + ay han-ii (what happen-PRES.3MS.INTER).

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Zaariyaa uray ichchashu toho malidi zaaro dhayikko, sedhemenkke wothida uray "Gade taaw imma!" gees; zaariyaa uray "Sawula / Bulqi immaas!" giyaa wode, wothida uray bonchcho sabaa sabidi zaaruwaa qonccissees!
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ዘአሪየአ ኡረይ ኢችቻሹ ቶሆ መሊዲ ዘአሮ ꬋዪክኮ፣ ሴꬌሜንክኬ ዎꬂደ ኡረይ "ገዴ ተአው ኢምመ!" ጌእስ፤ ዘአሪየአ ኡረይ "ሰዉለ / ቡልቂ ኢምመአስ!" ጊየአ ዎዴ፣ ዎꬂደ ኡረይ ቦንችቾ ሰበአ ሰቢዲ ዘአሩወአ ቆንጭጪስሴእስ!
flat_utterances.amharic: መላሹ አምስት ጊዜ ገምቶ መልሱን ካጣ፣ እንቆቅልሽ ጠያቂው «አገር ስጠኝ!» ይላል፤ መላሹም «ሳውላን / ቡልቂን ሰጠሁህ!» ሲል፣ ጠያቂው የክብር ሙገሳ አቅርቦ መልሱን ይገልጻል!
flat_utterances.english: If the responder guesses five times and fails, the riddler says 'Give me a land/town!'; when the responder says 'I give you Sawla / Bulqi!', the riddler recites a playful boast formula and reveals the answer!
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: ichchashu toho (five times, Gr10 Ch.5 p. 44) + gade taa-w imm-a (land 1S-DAT give-IMP.2S) + zaaruwa-a qoncc-iss-ees (answer-ACC.M.DEF reveal-CAUS-PRES.3MS).

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Ane ha sedhemenkkiyaa taassi birshsha: "Timirtte tamaaribennashin digire tookkis; kushen saatey baawashin saate eriyaba era wodha!"
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: አኔ ሀ ሴꬌሜንክኪየአ ተአስሲ ቢርሽሻ፦ "ቲሚርትቴ ተመአሪቤንነሺን ዲጊሬ ቶኦክኪስ፤ ኩሼን ሰአቴይ በአወሺን ሰአቴ እሪየበ እረ ዎꬋ!"
flat_utterances.amharic: እስቲ ይህንን እንቆቅልሽ ፍታልኝ፦ «ትምህርት ሳይማር ዲግሪ ተሸከመ፤ በእጁ ሰዓት ሳይኖረው ሰዓት የሚያውቅ ነገር እወቅ!»
flat_utterances.english: Solve this riddle for me: 'Timirtte tamaaribennashin digire tookkis; kushen saatey baawashin saate eriyaba era wodha!' ('Never went to school yet wears a degree/crown; has no watch on its hand yet knows the time!')
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: tamaar-ibenna-shin (learn-PAST.3MS.NEG-CNV.SIM.DS) + digire tookk-is (degree/comb carry-PAST.3MS); saate er-iya-ba (hour know-PRES.REL-NMZ, Gr8 Ch.2 p. 34 Riddle 2).

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Zaaroy: "Awure kutto"! Huuphiyan de7iyaa gonccoy digire milatees, maallado guuraara saate naagidi waassiyaa gishshaw saate erees!
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ዘአሮይ፦ "አዉሬ ኩትቶ"! ሁኡጪየን ዴዒየአ ጎንጭጮይ ዲጊሬ ሚለቴእስ፣ መአልለዶ ጉኡረአረ ሰአቴ ነአጊዲ ወአስሲየአ ጊሽሻው ሰአቴ እሬእስ!
flat_utterances.amharic: መልሱ፦ «አዉሬ ኩቶ» (አውራ ዶሮ) ነው! በጭንቅላቱ ላይ ያለው ኩኩሉ (ጎንጮ) ዲግሪ ይመስላል፣ ጠዋት በማለዳ ሰዓት ጠብቆ ስለሚጮኽ ሰዓት ያውቃል!
flat_utterances.english: The answer is: 'Awure kutto' (a rooster)! The crest on its head looks like a crown/degree, and because it crows punctually at dawn, it knows the time!
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: awure kutto (rooster, Gr8 Ch.2 p. 34 Riddle 2); maallado guura-ara saate naag-idi waass-iyaa gishshaw (early.morning-COM hour keep-CNV2 crow-PRES.REL because).

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Tammantho kifile Shemppo 5 (pp. 39-41) giddon Goofatho tosseti "nam77u bagga oco mashsha" geetettiday aybissee?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ተምመንꬆ ኪፊሌ ሼምፕፖ 5 (ፕፕ። 39-41) ጊድዶን ጎኦፈꬆ ቶስሴቲ "ነምዕዑ በግገ ኦጮ መሽሻ" ጌእቴትቲደይ አይቢስሴእ?
flat_utterances.amharic: በአሥረኛ ክፍል ምዕራፍ 5 (ገጽ 39–41) ውስጥ የጎፋኛ ምሳሌያዊ ንግግሮች «ናምዑ ባጋ ኦጮ ማሻ» (ሁለት አፍ ያለው ስለታም ቢላዋ) የተባሉት ለምንድን ነው?
flat_utterances.english: In Grade 10 Chapter 5 (pp. 39–41), why are Gofatho proverbs ('tosse') described as a 'double-edged sharp blade' ('nam77u bagga oco mashsha')?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: nam77u bagga oco mashsha (two side sharp knife/sword, ZARA-03 77, Gr10 Ch.5 p. 39) + geet-ett-ida-y aybiss-ee (call-PASS-PAST.REL-NOM why-INTER).

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Tossati issi baggaara issibaa "nashshishe", hara baggaara qassi hegaakka "borishe" na77u baggaara qonccissiyaa gishshaw "nam77u bagga oco mashsha" geetettoosona!
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ቶስሰቲ ኢስሲ በግገአረ ኢስሲበአ "ነሽሺሼ"፣ ሀረ በግገአረ ቀስሲ ሄገአክከ "ቦሪሼ" ነዕዑ በግገአረ ቆንጭጪስሲየአ ጊሽሻው "ነምዕዑ በግገ ኦጮ መሽሻ" ጌእቴትቶኦሶነ!
flat_utterances.amharic: ምሳሌያዊ ንግግሮች በአንድ በኩል አንድን ነገር «ናሺሼ» (እያሞገሱ)፣ በሌላ በኩል ደግሞ ያንኑ ነገር «ቦሪሼ» (እየተቹ/እያስጠነቀቁ) በሁለት አቅጣጫ ስለሚገልጹ «ሁለት አፍ ያለው ስለታም ቢላዋ» ይባላሉ!
flat_utterances.english: Because proverbs can on one side praise ('nashshishe') a quality and on the other side critique or caution against ('borishe') its hidden flaw, they are called a 'double-edged blade'!
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: nashsh-ishe (praise-CNV.SIM, Gr10 Ch.5 p. 40) vs. bor-ishe (critique/reproach-CNV.SIM, Gr10 Ch.5 p. 40).

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: "Lo77o" nne "Iita" nashshiyaanne borishe odettida Tammantho kifile (p. 40) tosseta taassi bessarkkii?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: "ሎዕዖ" ንኔ "ኢኢተ" ነሽሺየአንኔ ቦሪሼ ኦዴትቲደ ተምመንꬆ ኪፊሌ (ፕ። 40) ቶስሴተ ተአስሲ ቤስሰርክኪኢ?
flat_utterances.amharic: «ሎዖ» (ጥሩነትን) እና «ኢታ» (ክፉነትን) እያሞገሱና እየተቹ የተነገሩትን የአሥረኛ ክፍል (ገጽ 40) ምሳሌዎች ታሳየኛለህ?
flat_utterances.english: Could you show me the paired proverbs on page 40 of the Grade 10 textbook that praise and critique 'Lo77o' (goodness) and 'Iita' (badness)?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: lo77o (good, Minniyaa 77) + iita (bad) + nashsh-iyaa-nne bor-ishe od-ett-ida tosse-ta (Gr10 Ch.5 p. 40).

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Lo77uwaa nashshiyaagaa: "Lo77oy kayora lo77ees" vs. Boriyaagaa: "Lo77o dullen shi7i de7ees"; Iitaa boriyaagaa: "Iiti iissees; curqqi shaallees" vs. Nashshiyaagaa: "Iiti iita wode ashshees"!
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ሎዕዑወአ ነሽሺየአገአ፦ "ሎዕዖይ ከዮረ ሎዕዔእስ" vስ። ቦሪየአገአ፦ "ሎዕዖ ዱልሌን ሺዒ ዴዔእስ"፤ ኢኢተአ ቦሪየአገአ፦ "ኢኢቲ ኢኢስሴእስ፤ ጩርቅቂ ሻአልሌእስ" vስ። ነሽሺየአገአ፦ "ኢኢቲ ኢኢተ ዎዴ አሽሼእስ"!
flat_utterances.amharic: ጥሩነትን የሚያሞግሰው፦ «ሎዖይ ካዮራ ሎዔስ» (ጥሩ ከቡቃያው ያምራል)፣ የሚተቸው፦ «ሎዖ ዱሌን ሺዒ ዴዔስ» (ከጥሩ ስር እንከን አይጠፋም)፤ ክፉን የሚተቸው፦ «ኢቲ ኢሴስ፤ ጩርቂ ሻሌስ» (ክፋት ያጋጫል)፣ በሌላ አንጻር፦ «ኢቲ ኢታ ዎዴ አሼስ» (ክፉ ለክፉ ቀን ይደርሳል)!
flat_utterances.english: Praising the good: 'Lo77oy kayora lo77ees' ('Goodness blossoms from its young shoot') vs. Cautioning: 'Lo77o dullen shi7i de7ees' ('Beneath a fine exterior a flaw may lurk'); Critiquing malice: 'Iiti iissees; curqqi shaallees' ('Malice ruins relationships as mud stains') vs. Counter-perspective: 'Iiti iita wode ashshees' ('Even a harsh person/thing saves you in a time of crisis')!
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: Exact antithetical proverb pairs from Gr10 Ch.5 p. 40.

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Tammantho kifile maxaafa wurssetha sinthe 88 bolla de7iyaa "Aaqeta" giddoppe "Aawu mithi", "Achche mittis" nne "Aacis" birshshethaa taassi odarkkii?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ተምመንꬆ ኪፊሌ መጠአፈ ዉርስሴꬃ ሲንꬄ 88 ቦልለ ዴዒየአ "አአቄተ" ጊድዶፕፔ "አአዉ ሚꬂ"፣ "አችቼ ሚትቲስ" ንኔ "አአጪስ" ቢርሽሼꬃአ ተአስሲ ኦደርክኪኢ?
flat_utterances.amharic: በአሥረኛ ክፍል መጽሐፍ መጨረሻ ገጽ 88 ላይ ካሉት «አቄታ» (ፈሊጣዊ ንግግሮች) ውስጥ የ«አዉ ሚꬂ»፣ «አቼ ሚቲስ» እና «አጪስ» ትርጉም ትነግረኛለህ?
flat_utterances.english: From the 'Aaqeta' idioms on the final page (p. 88) of the Grade 10 textbook, could you explain 'Aawu mithi', 'Achche mittis', and 'Aacis'?

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Tammantho kifile maxaafa sinthe 88 (Book p. 83) maaran: (1) "Aawu mithi" = bare, attonnabaa; (2) "Achche mittis" = ceeggis, diccenna; (3) "Aacis" = yelettis, daris!
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ተምመንꬆ ኪፊሌ መጠአፈ ሲንꬄ 88 (ቦኦክ ፕ። 83) መአረን፦ (1) "አአዉ ሚꬂ" = በሬ፣ አትቶንነበአ፤ (2) "አችቼ ሚትቲስ" = ጬእግጊስ፣ ዲጭጬንነ፤ (3) "አአጪስ" = ዬሌትቲስ፣ ደሪስ!
flat_utterances.amharic: በአሥረኛ ክፍል መጽሐፍ ገጽ 88 (የመጽሐፉ ገጽ 83) መሠረት፦ (1) «አዉ ሚꬂ» = ባሬ፣ አቶናባ (የማይቀር ነገር)፤ (2) «አቼ ሚቲስ» = ቼጊስ፣ ዲቼና (አረጀ፣ አያድግም)፤ (3) «አጪስ» = ዬሌቲስ፣ ዳሪስ (ተወለደ፣ በዛ/ተራባ)!
flat_utterances.english: According to page 88 (Book p. 83) of the Grade 10 textbook: (1) 'Aawu mithi' = 'bare, attonnabaa' (something inevitable/unavoidable); (2) 'Achche mittis' = 'ceeggis, diccenna' (aged without growing tall / stunted); (3) 'Aacis' = 'yelettis, daris' (multiplied, reproduced abundantly)!

flat_utterances.speaker: assistant
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: "Saba" guussay Goofa deriyan xala, keha imata mokkiyaa, mino goshshanchcha woy dere kaalethiyaa kawota bonchchidi yetthaaninne qaalan sabbiyaa woga!
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: "ሰበ" ጉኡስሰይ ጎኦፈ ዴሪየን ጠለ፣ ኬሀ ኢመተ ሞክኪየአ፣ ሚኖ ጎሽሻንችቻ ዎይ ዴሬ ከአሌꬂየአ ከዎተ ቦንችቺዲ ዬትꬃአኒንኔ ቀአለን ሰብቢየአ ዎገ!
flat_utterances.amharic: «ሳባ» ማለት በጎፋ ምድር ጀግናን፣ ለጋስ እንግዳ ተቀባይን፣ ብርቱ ገበሬን ወይም አገር መሪ ነገሥታትን (ካዎ) አክብረው በዜማና በቃል የሚያሞግሱበት ባህል ነው!
flat_utterances.english: 'Saba' is the traditional panegyric chant in Gofa honoring a brave hero ('xala'), a generous host, a master farmer, or community leaders ('kawo') in rhythmic verse!
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: xala (brave hero) + keha imata mokk-iyaa (generous guest welcome-PRES.REL) + sabb-iyaa woga (praise-PRES.REL custom, Gr9 Ch.5 p. 45).

flat_utterances.amharic: በዚያ መጽሐፍ ገጽ 45–46 ላይ ካዎ ጋሞና አማዶ ዛላንና የአርባ ልጅ ቱꬄ ቡልቆን በማሞገስ የተነገረውን ሳባ ታነብልኛለህ?

flat_utterances.subtopic: Heroic Praise Chants (Saba): Kawo Gaammonaa Amaado Zaala & Tuuthe Bulqqo (Grade 9 Ch. 5)
flat_utterances.speaker: assistant
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Kawo Gaammonaa Amaado Zaala sabay: "Haathe oychin maathi immiya, mari oychin maathi woytiya!"; Tuuthe Bulqqo sabay qassi: "Atare bangga Tophphiyaas gidisiya!" gees!
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ከዎ ገአምሞነአ አመአዶ ዘአለ ሰበይ፦ "ሀአꬄ ኦይቺን መአꬂ ኢምሚየ፣ መሪ ኦይቺን መአꬂ ዎይቲየ!"፤ ቱኡꬄ ቡልቅቆ ሰበይ ቀስሲ፦ "አተሬ በንግገ ቶጵጪየአስ ጊዲሲየ!" ጌእስ!
flat_utterances.amharic: የካዎ ጋሞና አማዶ ዛላ ሙገሳ፦ «ሃꬄ ኦይቺን ማꬂ ኢሚያ፣ ማሪ ኦይቺን ማꬂ ዎይቲያ!» (ውኃ ሲጠይቁት ወተት የሚሰጥ ለጋስ!)፤ የቱꬄ ቡልቆ ሙገሳ ደግሞ፦ «አታሬ ባንጋ ቶጵጪያስ ጊዲሲያ!» (አተርና ገብስ ለኢትዮጵያ የሚያበቃ ብርቱ አራሽ!) ይላል!
flat_utterances.english: The praise chant for Kawo Gaammona Amaado Zaala goes: 'Haathe oychin maathi immiya!' ('Who gives milk when asked for water!'); and the chant for Tuuthe Bulqqo goes: 'Atare bangga Tophphiyaas gidisiya!' ('Whose harvest of peas and barley suffices for all Ethiopia!')!
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: Verbatim heroic praise lines from Grade 9 Textbook Ch. 5, pp. 45–46.

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: "Woga buqurata" giddon: beni kawota keethati, zaalla giddon woocettida gonggoloti, beni woga ma7oti, toora-gonddalle miishetinne dubbusha bessati de7oosona.
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: "ዎገ ቡቁረተ" ጊድዶን፦ ቤኒ ከዎተ ኬእꬃቲ፣ ዘአልለ ጊድዶን ዎኦጬትቲደ ጎንግጎሎቲ፣ ቤኒ ዎገ መዖቲ፣ ቶኦረ-ጎንድደልሌ ሚኢሼቲንኔ ዱብቡሻ ቤስሰቲ ዴዖኦሶነ።
flat_utterances.amharic: በ«ዎጋ ቡቁራታ» (ባህላዊ ቅርሶች) ውስጥ፦ የጥንት ነገሥታት ቦታዎች፣ ከወጥ ቋጥኝ ድንጋይ («ዛላ») የተፈለፈሉ ዋሻዎች («ጎንጎሎ»)፣ የጥንት ባህላዊ አልባሳት፣ የጦርና የጋሻ መሣሪያዎችና የዱቡሻ አደባባዮች ይገኛሉ።
flat_utterances.english: 'Woga buqurata' include historical royal sites, caves ('gonggolo') carved into monolithic rock ('zaalla'), traditional garments, ancestral shields and spears, and historic 'dubbusha' assembly grounds.
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: zaalla (monolithic rock, Gr8 Ch.2 p. 31) + gonggolo-ti (cave-PL.NOM, Gr8 Ch.2 p. 31) + de7-oosona (exist-PRES.3PL).

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Woga buqurati nu maayzata cinccatethaa, nu taarikiyaanne nu oonatethaa markkattiyaaba gidido gishshaw, ubba asay ba ayfiyaa mumuwaadan naaganaw bessees!
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ዎገ ቡቁረቲ ኑ መአይዘተ ጪንጭጨቴꬃአ፣ ኑ ተአሪኪየአንኔ ኑ ኦኦነቴꬃአ መርክከትቲየአበ ጊዲዶ ጊሽሻው፣ ኡብበ አሰይ በ አይፊየአ ሙሙወአደን ነአገነው ቤስሴእስ!
flat_utterances.amharic: ባህላዊ ቅርሶች የአያቶቻችንን ጥበብ፣ ታሪካችንንና ማንነታችንን የሚመሰክሩ ስለሆኑ፣ ሁሉም ሰው እንደ ዓይኑ ብሌን ሊጠብቃቸው ይገባል!
flat_utterances.english: Because cultural heritage artifacts bear witness to our ancestors' wisdom, our history, and our identity, everyone must guard them like the pupil of their eye!
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: nu taarikiya-a-nne nu oonatetha-a (our history-ACC-and our identity-ACC, PHR-098) + markkatt-iyaa-ba gid-ido gishshaw (witness-PRES.REL-NMZ be-PAST.REL because) + naag-anaw bess-ees.

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Mishire Amaarachi Aggido Goofa Bulqi kataman yelettada, macca nayti timirtte keethi boonna beni wode minnada tamaarada, koyro macca asttamaarenne timirtte keetha kaalethanchcha gidada daro dhalota tamaarissadasu!
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ሚሺሬ አመአረቺ አግጊዶ ጎኦፈ ቡልቂ ከተመን ዬሌትተደ፣ መጭጨ ነይቲ ቲሚርትቴ ኬእꬂ ቦኦንነ ቤኒ ዎዴ ሚንነደ ተመአረደ፣ ኮይሮ መጭጨ አስትተመአሬንኔ ቲሚርትቴ ኬእꬃ ከአሌꬃንችቻ ጊደደ ደሮ ꬋሎተ ተመአሪስሰደሱ!
flat_utterances.amharic: ወይዘሮ አማረች አጊዶ በጎፋ ቡልቂ ከተማ ተወልዳ፣ ሴት ልጆች ወደ ትምህርት ቤት በማይሄዱበት በድሮ ዘመን ጠንክራ ተምራ፣ የመጀመሪያዋ ሴት መምህርና የትምህርት ቤት ርዕሰ መምህርት ሆና ብዙ ትውልድ አስተምራለች!
flat_utterances.english: Mishire Amaarachi Aggido was born in Bulqi town in Gofa, studied diligently at a time when few girls attended school, and became a pioneering female teacher and school principal who educated generations!
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: Goofa Bulqi katama-n yel-ett-ada (Gofa Bulqi town-LOC bear-PASS-CNV1.ANT.3FS) + minn-ada tamaar-ada (be.strong-CNV1.3FS study-CNV1.3FS) + tamaar-iss-adasu (learn-CAUS-PAST.3FS.A.DCL, Gr10 Ch.3 p. 19).

flat_utterances.amharic: በአሥረኛ ክፍል ምዕራፍ 4 (ገጽ 30–31) ውስጥ ሞርጋማና ጋርዳ ስለ አካባቢው ሕዝብ አንድነት ምን ይነጋገራሉ?
flat_utterances.english: In Grade 10 Chapter 4 (pp. 30–31), what do Morggaama and Gardda discuss regarding the unity of the people in their area?

flat_utterances.speaker: assistant
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Gardday Morggaamaas: deretethaa giddon dummatethay de7ikkokka, asay wudiyan, giyan, woosa keethaaninne yaaganon woli dandda7on, woli bonchchoninne siiqon issippe de7iyaaogaa qonccissees!
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ገርድደይ ሞርግገአመአስ፦ ዴሬቴꬃአ ጊድዶን ዱምመቴꬃይ ዴዒክኮክከ፣ አሰይ ዉዲየን፣ ጊየን፣ ዎኦሰ ኬእꬃአኒንኔ የአገኖን ዎሊ ደንድደዖን፣ ዎሊ ቦንችቾኒንኔ ሲኢቆን ኢስሲፕፔ ዴዒየአኦገአ ቆንጭጪስሴእስ!
flat_utterances.amharic: ጋርዳ ለሞርጋማ፦ በማኅበረሰቡ ውስጥ ልዩነት ቢኖርም፣ ሕዝቡ በግጦሽ ቦታ (ዉዲያን)፣ በገበያ (ጊያን)፣ በጸሎት ቤትና በሠርግ ላይ በመቻቻል፣ በመከባበርና በፍቅር በአንድነት እንደሚኖር ያስረዳዋል!
flat_utterances.english: Gardda explains to Morggaama that even though diversity ('dummatethi') exists within society, the people live together in unity at grazing pastures ('wudiyan'), markets ('giyan'), places of worship, and weddings through mutual tolerance ('woli dandda7o') and respect!
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: wudiya-n (grazing.pasture-LOC), giya-n (market-LOC), woosa keetha-an-inne yaagano-n (prayer house-LOC-and wedding-LOC) + woli dandda7o-n (mutual tolerance-INST, Gr10 Ch.4 p. 30).

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Issipetethaa mooriyaa "phaxethi" nne "lancce" giyaa iita kanddotappe deretethay waani naagettii?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ኢስሲፔቴꬃአ ሞኦሪየአ "ጳጤꬂ" ንኔ "ለንጭጬ" ጊየአ ኢኢተ ከንድዶተፕፔ ዴሬቴꬃይ ወአኒ ነአጌትቲኢ?
flat_utterances.amharic: አንድነትን ከሚያበላሹት «ጳጤꬂ» (መከፋፈል) እና «ላንቼ» (ንቀት/መድልዎ) ከሚባሉ መጥፎ ባህሪያት ማኅበረሰቡ እንዴት ይጠበቃል?
flat_utterances.english: How does a community guard itself against the harmful behaviors 'phaxethi' (factional division) and 'lancce' (contempt/discrimination) that undermine unity?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: phaxethi (division/splitting, Gr10 Ch.4 p. 29) + lancce (contempt/discrimination, Gr10 Ch.4 p. 29) + waan-i naag-ett-ii (how-CNV2 guard-REFL-PRES.3MS.INTER).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Grade 10 Goofatho Doona Ch. 4 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/1mKIcfMoMgnZ9Pa657NWmE-OGND2wlveM/view?usp=drivesdk, pp. 24–33: Dummatethan De7iya Issipetethaa, Morggaama & Gardda dialogue)

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Asa ubbaa "gina xeelo", woli maaddiyaa "daggo" wogaa minthoninne cimata "zarbbe" zoriyaa kaallon phaxethaynne lanccey xayees!
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: አሰ ኡብበአ "ጊነ ጤእሎ"፣ ዎሊ መአድዲየአ "ደግጎ" ዎገአ ሚንꬆኒንኔ ጪመተ "ዘርብቤ" ዞሪየአ ከአልሎን ጳጤꬃይንኔ ለንጭጬይ ጠዬእስ!
flat_utterances.amharic: ሰውን ሁሉ በእኩልነት በማየት («ጊና ጤሎ»)፣ የመረዳዳት («ዳጎ») ባህልን በማጠናከርና የሽማግሌዎችን የሰላም («ዛርቤ») ምክር በመከተል መከፋፈልና ንቀት ይጠፋል!
flat_utterances.english: By viewing all people with equality ('gina xeelo'), strengthening cooperative mutual aid ('daggo'), and heeding elders' counsel of calm peace ('zarbbe'), division and contempt disappear!
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: gina xeelo (equal view, Gr10 Ch.4 p. 30), daggo (mutual aid), zarbbe (calm stability, Gr10 Ch.4 p. 29) + xay-ees (disappear-PRES.3MS).

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Uddufuntho kifile Shemppo 8 ("Diraama", pp. 72-75) giddon Pola, Worqqanne Ciishay kaa7ido diraamaa ayfe qofay aybee?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ኡድዱፉንꬆ ኪፊሌ ሼምፕፖ 8 ("ዲረአመ"፣ ፕፕ። ዕ2-ዕ5) ጊድዶን ፖለ፣ ዎርቅቀንኔ ጪኢሻይ ከአዒዶ ዲረአመአ አይፌ ቆፈይ አይቤእ?
flat_utterances.amharic: በዘጠነኛ ክፍል ምዕራፍ 8 («ድራማ»፣ ገጽ 72–75) ውስጥ ፖላ፣ ወርቃና ጪሻ የተጫወቱት ድራማ ዋና ጭብጥ («አይፌ ቆፋ») ምንድን ነው?
flat_utterances.english: In Grade 9 Chapter 8 ('Drama', pp. 72–75), what is the central theme ('ayfe qofa') of the play performed by the characters Pola, Worqqa, and Ciisha?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: Pola, Worqqa-nne Ciisha-y kaa7-ido diraama-a ayfe qofa-y (play-PAST.REL drama-GEN central theme-NOM, Gr9 Ch.4 p. 28 & Ch.8 p. 72).

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: He diraamaa giddon Polay "Timirtteappe nne shaloppe awugee aadhdhii?" gidi oycchees; wurssetha ayfe qofaykka timirtteynne eray shaloppe daro aadhdhiyaaogaa qonccissees!
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ሄ ዲረአመአ ጊድዶን ፖለይ "ቲሚርትቴአፕፔ ንኔ ሻሎፕፔ አዉጌእ አአꬍꬊኢ?" ጊዲ ኦይጭቼእስ፤ ዉርስሴꬃ አይፌ ቆፈይክከ ቲሚርትቴይንኔ እረይ ሻሎፕፔ ደሮ አአꬍꬊየአኦገአ ቆንጭጪስሴእስ!
flat_utterances.amharic: በዚያ ድራማ ውስጥ ፖላ «ከትምህርትና ከገንዘብ (ሻሎ) የቱ ይበልጣል?» ብሎ ይጠይቃል፤ የመጨረሻው ዋና ጭብጥም ትምህርትና ዕውቀት ከገንዘብ በእጅጉ እንደሚበልጡ ያስረዳል!
flat_utterances.english: In that drama, Pola asks whether education ('timirtte') or material wealth ('shalo') is greater; and the central conclusion demonstrates that education and knowledge far surpass mere wealth!
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: timirtte-appe-nne shalo-ppe (education-ABL-and wealth-ABL, Gr9 Ch.8 p. 72) + awu-gee aadhdh-ii (which-DEF.M surpass-PRES.3MS.INTER).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Grade 9 Goofatho Doona Ch. 8 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/1uvGaBT4-O_Jn7oQbuNl1W88lFBFiHULU/view?usp=drivesdk, pp. 65–75: Diraama of Pola, Worqqa, and Ciisha)

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: He diraamaa giddon timirtte bonchchuwaa qonccisiyaa "Shaloy timirtte gindde yedhdhenna" giyaa tosse birshshethay aybee?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ሄ ዲረአመአ ጊድዶን ቲሚርትቴ ቦንችቹወአ ቆንጭጪሲየአ "ሻሎይ ቲሚርትቴ ጊንድዴ ዬꬍꬌንነ" ጊየአ ቶስሴ ቢርሽሼꬃይ አይቤእ?
flat_utterances.amharic: በዚያ ድራማ ውስጥ የትምህርትን ክብር የሚገልጸው «ሻሎይ ቲሚርቴ ጊንዴ ዬꬌና» የሚለው ምሳሌ ትርጉሙ ምንድን ነው?
flat_utterances.english: What is the meaning of the proverb 'Shaloy timirtte gindde yedhdhenna' in that drama that highlights the supremacy of education?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: shalo-y (wealth/money-NOM) + timirtte gindde (education heel) + yedhdh-enna (step/tread-PRES.3MS.NEG, geminate implosive dhdh, Gr9 Ch.8 p. 73).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Grade 9 Goofatho Doona Ch. 8 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/1uvGaBT4-O_Jn7oQbuNl1W88lFBFiHULU/view?usp=drivesdk, pp. 65–75: Diraama of Pola, Worqqa, and Ciisha)

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: "Shaloy timirtte gindde yedhdhenna" guussay miishshay timirtte gindde yedhdhenna guussa; shaloy wurssanaw dandda7ees, shin eray ubba wode asaa goda!
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: "ሻሎይ ቲሚርትቴ ጊንድዴ ዬꬍꬌንነ" ጉኡስሰይ ሚኢሽሻይ ቲሚርትቴ ጊንድዴ ዬꬍꬌንነ ጉኡስሰ፤ ሻሎይ ዉርስሰነው ደንድደዔእስ፣ ሺን እረይ ኡብበ ዎዴ አሰአ ጎደ!
flat_utterances.amharic: «ሻሎይ ቲሚርቴ ጊንዴ ዬꬌና» ማለት ገንዘብ የትምህርትን ተረከዝ እንኳን አይረግጥም (ከትምህርት ጋር አይወዳደርም) ማለት ነው፤ ገንዘብ ሊያልቅ ይችላል፣ ዕውቀት ግን ሁልጊዜ ከሰው ጋር ይኖራል!
flat_utterances.english: 'Shaloy timirtte gindde yedhdhenna' means 'Material wealth cannot even step on the heel of education' (cannot compare to education); money can be lost, whereas knowledge stays with a person forever!
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: Verbatim proverb and moral lesson from Grade 9 Textbook Ch. 8, p. 73.

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Hosppuntho kifile Shemppo 6 (p. 89) giddon "eessi tigees", "haatha shooshi" nne "dhiille baaris" giyaa geema qaalata birshshethay aybee?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ሆስፕፑንꬆ ኪፊሌ ሼምፕፖ 6 (ፕ። 89) ጊድዶን "እእስሲ ቲጌእስ"፣ "ሀአꬃ ሾኦሺ" ንኔ "ꬊኢልሌ በአሪስ" ጊየአ ጌእመ ቀአለተ ቢርሽሼꬃይ አይቤእ?
flat_utterances.amharic: በስምንተኛ ክፍል ምዕራፍ 6 (ገጽ 89) ውስጥ «ኤሲ ቲጌስ»፣ «ሃꬃ ሾሺ» እና «ꬊኢሌ ባሪስ» የሚሉት ዘይቤያዊ ቃላት ትርጉማቸው ምንድን ነው?
flat_utterances.english: In Grade 8 Chapter 6 (p. 89), what are the figurative meanings ('geema birshshethi') of 'eessi tigees', 'haatha shooshi', and 'dhiille baaris'?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: eessi tig-ees (honey drip-PRES.3MS), haatha shooshi (water snake), dhiille baar-is (flour hold.in.mouth-PAST.3MS, Gr8 Ch.6 p. 89).

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Hosppuntho kifile maxaafaa (p. 89) maaran: (1) "Eessi tigees" = mal77iyaa qaalan cimees; (2) "Haatha shooshi" = daro lo77o mala; (3) "Dhiille baaris" = si77i giis (leemisos: 'Daashshi dhiille baarida asa mela si77i gis')!
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ሆስፕፑንꬆ ኪፊሌ መጠአፈአ (ፕ። 89) መአረን፦ (1) "እእስሲ ቲጌእስ" = መልዕዒየአ ቀአለን ጪሜእስ፤ (2) "ሀአꬃ ሾኦሺ" = ደሮ ሎዕዖ መለ፤ (3) "ꬊኢልሌ በአሪስ" = ሲዕዒ ጊኢስ (ሌእሚሶስ፦ 'ደአሽሺ ꬊኢልሌ በአሪደ አሰ ሜለ ሲዕዒ ጊስ')!
flat_utterances.amharic: በስምንተኛ ክፍል መጽሐፍ (ገጽ 89) መሠረት፦ (1) «ኤሲ ቲጌስ» = በጣፋጭ አንደበት ያቆላምጣል/ያታልላል፤ (2) «ሃꬃ ሾሺ» = እጅግ ውብ/መልከ መልካም፤ (3) «ꬊኢሌ ባሪስ» = ጭጭ አለ / ምንም አልተናገረም (ለምሳሌ፦ 'ዳሺ ዱቄት እንደጎረሰ ሰው ጭጭ አለ')!
flat_utterances.english: According to the Grade 8 textbook (p. 89): (1) 'Eessi tigees' (lit. drips honey) = flatters sweetly with honeyed words; (2) 'Haatha shooshi' (lit. water snake) = strikingly graceful/beautiful; (3) 'Dhiille baaris' (lit. held flour in the mouth) = kept completely silent!
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: Daashsh-i dhiille baar-ida asa mela si77i g-is (Daashshi-NOM flour mouthful-PAST.REL person like silent say-PAST.3MS, ZARA-03 77, Gr8 Ch.6 p. 89).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Grade 8 Goofatho Doona Ch. 6 & Ch. 10 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/160NHNy-4orPcAIk-L5t6tOEtZoWemz_-/view?usp=drivesdk, pp. 89, 145: Geema Birshshethi & Aaqe Oda)

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: (1) "Kana inxxarsi" = daro leppi (leemisos: 'soolloy kana inxxarssi aazees'); (2) "Mana bangga" = laalettida; (3) "Budon gukkida haathe" = simmonna aadhdhidaba!
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: (1) "ከነ ኢንጥጠርሲ" = ደሮ ሌፕፒ (ሌእሚሶስ፦ 'ሶኦልሎይ ከነ ኢንጥጠርስሲ አአዜእስ')፤ (2) "መነ በንግገ" = ለአሌትቲደ፤ (3) "ቡዶን ጉክኪደ ሀአꬄ" = ሲምሞንነ አአꬍꬊደበ!
flat_utterances.amharic: (1) «ካና ኢንጣርሲ» = እጅግ በጣም ስስ (ለምሳሌ፦ 'እንጀራው እንደ ውሻ ምላስ የሳሳ ነው')፤ (2) «ማና ባንጋ» = የተበታተነ/ሥርዓት ያጣ፤ (3) «ቡዶን ጉኪዳ ሃꬄ» = ከቅል የፈሰሰ ውኃ (ላይመለስ ያለፈ ነገር)!
flat_utterances.english: (1) 'Kana inxxarsi' (lit. a dog's tongue) = paper-thin (e.g., thin flatbread); (2) 'Mana bangga' (lit. potter's spilled barley) = scattered in disorder; (3) 'Budon gukkida haathe' (water spilled from a gourd) = something irretrievable once past!
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: Idiomatic expressions from Grade 8 Textbook Ch. 10, p. 145.
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Grade 8 Goofatho Doona Ch. 6 & Ch. 10 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/160NHNy-4orPcAIk-L5t6tOEtZoWemz_-/view?usp=drivesdk, pp. 89, 145: Geema Birshshethi & Aaqe Oda)

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Goofa ufayssa bonchchotaninne yaaganon yetthaasinne durssaas ayba woga miisheta go7ettoikonaa?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ጎኦፈ ኡፈይስሰ ቦንችቾተኒንኔ የአገኖን ዬትꬃአሲንኔ ዱርስሰአስ አይበ ዎገ ሚኢሼተ ጎዔትቶኢኮነአ?
flat_utterances.amharic: በጎፋ የደስታ በዓላትና በሠርግ ላይ ለዘፈንና ለጭፈራ ምን ዓይነት ባህላዊ የሙዚቃ መሣሪያዎችን ይጠቀማሉ?
flat_utterances.english: At Gofa joyous festivals and weddings, what traditional musical instruments are used for song ('yettha') and dance ('durssa')?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: ufayssa bonchcho-ta-n-inne yaagano-n (joy festival-PL-LOC-and wedding-LOC) + yettha-as-inne durssa-as (song-DAT-and dance-DAT, PHR-103) + ayba woga miishe-ta (what traditional instrument-PL.ACC).

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Goofa woga yetthaas "dimbbo", "ululliya", "zaaye" nne "dithaa" go7ettoosona!
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ጎኦፈ ዎገ ዬትꬃአስ "ዲምብቦ"፣ "ኡሉልሊየ"፣ "ዘአዬ" ንኔ "ዲꬃአ" ጎዔትቶኦሶነ!
flat_utterances.amharic: ለጎፋ ባህላዊ ዜማና ጭፈራ «ዲምቦ» (ከበሮ)፣ «ኡሉሊያ» (ዋሽንት)፣ «ዛዬ» (እምቢልታ) እና «ዲꬃ» (ክራር) ይጠቀማሉ!
flat_utterances.english: For traditional Gofa music and dance, they play the ceremonial drum ('dimbbo'), flute ('ululliya'), horn ('zaaye'), and lyre ('dithaa')!
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: dimbbo (ceremonial drum, Gr10 Ch.2 p. 13), ululliya (bamboo flute), zaaye (horn), dithaa (lyre) + go7ett-oosona (use-PRES.3PL).

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Tammantho kifile Shemppo 2 (p. 13) giddon "Dimbboy parsso lage" giyaa tosse birshshethay aybee?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ተምመንꬆ ኪፊሌ ሼምፕፖ 2 (ፕ። 13) ጊድዶን "ዲምብቦይ ፐርስሶ ለጌ" ጊየአ ቶስሴ ቢርሽሼꬃይ አይቤእ?
flat_utterances.amharic: በአሥረኛ ክፍል ምዕራፍ 2 (ገጽ 13) ውስጥ «ዲምቦይ ፓርሶ ላጌ» የሚለው ምሳሌ ትርጉሙ ምንድን ነው?
flat_utterances.english: What is the meaning of the proverb 'Dimbboy parsso lage' in Grade 10 Chapter 2 (p. 13)?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: dimbbo-y (ceremonial.drum-NOM.M) + parsso lage (traditional.beer friend/companion, Gr10 Ch.2 p. 13).

flat_utterances.speaker: assistant
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: "Dimbboy parsso lage" guussay ufayssa diggisan quumaynne ushshay de7iyaa bessan yetthaynne dimbboykka issippe de7ees guussa!
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: "ዲምብቦይ ፐርስሶ ለጌ" ጉኡስሰይ ኡፈይስሰ ዲግጊሰን ቁኡመይንኔ ኡሽሻይ ዴዒየአ ቤስሰን ዬትꬃይንኔ ዲምብቦይክከ ኢስሲፕፔ ዴዔእስ ጉኡስሰ!
flat_utterances.amharic: «ዲምቦይ ፓርሶ ላጌ» (ከበሮ የድግስ መጠጥ ጓደኛ ነው) ማለት በደስታ ድግስ ላይ ምግብና መጠጥ ባለበት ቦታ ዘፈንና ከበሮም አብረው ይኖራሉ (ደስታና መስተንግዶ አይለያዩም) ማለት ነው!
flat_utterances.english: 'Dimbboy parsso lage' ('The ceremonial drum is the companion of traditional beer') means that wherever there is festive hospitality, music and celebration go hand in hand!
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: ufayssa diggisa-n (joy feast-LOC) + yettha-y-nne dimbbo-y-kka issippe de7-ees (song-NOM-and drum-NOM-ADD together exist-PRES.3MS).

flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ጎኦፈꬆ ዶኦነይ ገሞꬆ፣ ደዉሮንኔ ዎለይትተ ዶኦነተረ ወአኒ ደብቦቲኢ? ሴልለስሲእ ቼሩ (2015) አይ ጊኢ?
flat_utterances.amharic: የጎፋኛ ቋንቋ ከጋሞኛ፣ ከዳውሮኛና ከወላይትኛ ቋንቋዎች ጋር እንዴት ይዛመዳል? Sellassie Cheru (2015) ምን ይላል?

flat_utterances.speaker: assistant
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Sellassie Cheru (2015, Ch. 1) qonccissidoogaadan, Goofatho, Gamotho, Dawuronne Wolayttay "North Ometo" doona so asaa; entta baaso qaalatinne SOV qawosay xeetappe hosppun tamma (80%+) issi mela!
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ሴልለስሲእ ቼሩ (2015፣ ች። 1) ቆንጭጪስሲዶኦገአደን፣ ጎኦፈꬆ፣ ገሞꬆ፣ ደዉሮንኔ ዎለይትተይ "ኖርꬅ ኦሜቶ" ዶኦነ ሶ አሰአ፤ እንትተ በአሶ ቀአለቲንኔ ሶV ቀዎሰይ ጤእተፕፔ ሆስፕፑን ተምመ (80%+) ኢስሲ ሜለ!
flat_utterances.amharic: Sellassie Cheru (2015, ምዕራፍ 1) እንዳብራራው፣ ጎፋኛ፣ ጋሞኛ፣ ዳውሮኛና ወላይትኛ የ«ሰሜን ኦሜቶ» (North Ometo) የቋንቋ ቤተሰብ ናቸው፤ መሠረታዊ ቃላቶቻቸውና የSOV ሰዋስዋቸው ከ80% በላይ ተመሳሳይ ነው!
flat_utterances.english: As explained by Sellassie Cheru (2015, Ch. 1), Gofatho, Gamotho, Dawuro, and Wolaytta belong to the North Ometo branch of Omotic; over 80% of their core vocabulary and SOV morphosyntax are shared cognates!
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: baaso qaala-ti-nne SOV qawosa-y (basic word-PL.NOM-and SOV grammar-NOM) + issi mela (same/alike).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Sellassie Cheru (2015, Ch. 1, pp. 1–12); Phase 7B Ometo Cognate Bridge (https://drive.google.com/file/d/10sEW32ZgmyVTaNoGNhGJy2KYZlXzDK27/view?usp=drivesdk)

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Goofatho doonan "th" nne "dh" giyaa cenggurssati Wolayttan waani laamettoikonaa? Leemiso taassi immarkkii?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ጎኦፈꬆ ዶኦነን "ꬅ" ንኔ "ꬍ" ጊየአ ጬንግጉርስሰቲ ዎለይትተን ወአኒ ለአሜትቶኢኮነአ? ሌእሚሶ ተአስሲ ኢምመርክኪኢ?
flat_utterances.amharic: በጎፋኛ ቋንቋ «th» (ꬅ) እና «dh» (ꬍ) የሚሉት ድምፆች በወላይትኛ እንዴት ይለወጣሉ? ምሳሌ ትሰጠኛለህ?
flat_utterances.english: How do the Gofatho dental fricative 'th' (ꬅ) and implosive 'dh' (ꬍ) correspond in Wolaytta? Could you give me examples?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: th (/θ/, Ethiopic Extended-A ꬁ-ꬆ) + dh (/ɗ/, ꬉ-ꬎ) + waan-i laam-ett-oikonaa (how-CNV2 change-PASS-PRES.3PL.INTER).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Sellassie Cheru (2015, Ch. 1, pp. 1–12); Phase 7B Ometo Cognate Bridge (https://drive.google.com/file/d/10sEW32ZgmyVTaNoGNhGJy2KYZlXzDK27/view?usp=drivesdk)

flat_utterances.speaker: assistant
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Goofatho "th" Wolayttan darotoo "tt" gidees: leemisos Goofatho "haatha" -> Wolaytta "haatta", Goofatho "keethi" -> Wolaytta "keetta", Goofatho "suntha" -> Wolaytta "suntta"!
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ጎኦፈꬆ "ꬅ" ዎለይትተን ደሮቶኦ "ትት" ጊዴእስ፦ ሌእሚሶስ ጎኦፈꬆ "ሀአꬃ" -> ዎለይትተ "ሀአትተ"፣ ጎኦፈꬆ "ኬእꬂ" -> ዎለይትተ "ኬእትተ"፣ ጎኦፈꬆ "ሱንꬃ" -> ዎለይትተ "ሱንትተ"!
flat_utterances.amharic: የጎፋኛ «th» (ꬅ) በወላይትኛ ብዙ ጊዜ «tt» ይሆናል፦ ለምሳሌ ጎፋኛ «ሃꬃ» (haatha - ውኃ) -> ወላይትኛ «haatta»፣ ጎፋኛ «ኬꬂ» (keethi - ቤት) -> ወላይትኛ «keetta»፣ ጎፋኛ «ሱንꬃ» (suntha - ስም) -> ወላይትኛ «suntta»!
flat_utterances.english: Gofatho 'th' (/θ/) regularly corresponds to 'tt' in Wolaytta: for example, Gofatho 'haatha' (water) -> Wolaytta 'haatta', Gofatho 'keethi' (house) -> Wolaytta 'keetta', and Gofatho 'suntha' (name) -> Wolaytta 'suntta'!
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: Systematic North Ometo sound correspondence rule (Phase 7B Ometo Cognate Bridge): Gofa/Gamo dental /θ/ (th) <-> Wolaytta geminate /tt/.
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Sellassie Cheru (2015, Ch. 1, pp. 1–12); Phase 7B Ometo Cognate Bridge (https://drive.google.com/file/d/10sEW32ZgmyVTaNoGNhGJy2KYZlXzDK27/view?usp=drivesdk)

flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ኡድዱፉንꬆ ኪፊሌ ሼምፕፖ 5 (ፕ። 41) ጊድዶን ፐነ ደንድደዒዲ ሚንኒ ኦኦꬆኦገአበአ ኦዲየአ "አአወ ፐረይ ዎꬄንነ፣ ነዓ ፐረይ ኬስሴንነ" ጊየአ ቶስሴ ቢርሽሼꬃይ አይቤእ?
flat_utterances.amharic: በዘጠነኛ ክፍል ምዕራፍ 5 (ገጽ 41) ውስጥ ራስን ችሎ ጠንክሮ ስለ መሥራት የሚናገረው «አዋ ፓራይ ዎꬄና፣ ናዓ ፓራይ ኬሴና» የሚለው ምሳሌ ትርጉሙ ምንድን ነው?
flat_utterances.english: In Grade 9 Chapter 5 (p. 41), what is the meaning of the proverb 'Aawa paray wothenna, na7a paray kessenna' regarding self-reliance?

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: He tossey "aawa paray duge wothenna, na7a paray pude kessenna" (issi issi asi ba wolqqaaninne ba ooson ammanettanaw bessees) guussa!
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ሄ ቶስሴይ "አአወ ፐረይ ዱጌ ዎꬄንነ፣ ነዓ ፐረይ ፑዴ ኬስሴንነ" (ኢስሲ ኢስሲ አሲ በ ዎልቅቀአኒንኔ በ ኦኦሶን አምመኔትተነው ቤስሴእስ) ጉኡስሰ!
flat_utterances.amharic: ያ ምሳሌ «የአባት ፈረስ ቁልቁል አያወርድም፣ የልጅ ፈረስ ዳገት አያወጣም» (እያንዳንዱ ሰው በራሱ ጥረትና ድካም መተማመን አለበት) ማለት ነው!
flat_utterances.english: That proverb means 'The father's horse does not carry one downhill, nor the son's horse uphill' — teaching that every person must rely on their own effort and hard work!
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: Antithetical morphological parallelism: aawa para-y woth-enna // na7a para-y kess-enna.

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Tammantho kifile Shemppo 5 (p. 41) giddon dandda7atethaanne balappe tamaaroogaa qonccisiyaa "Ellesoy gam7on gathees" nne "Diccana na7i gufanthin diccees" birshshethayoo?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ተምመንꬆ ኪፊሌ ሼምፕፖ 5 (ፕ። 41) ጊድዶን ደንድደዓቴꬃአንኔ በለፕፔ ተመአሮኦገአ ቆንጭጪሲየአ "እልሌሶይ ገምዖን ገꬄእስ" ንኔ "ዲጭጨነ ነዒ ጉፈንꬂን ዲጭጬእስ" ቢርሽሼꬃዮኦ?
flat_utterances.amharic: በአሥረኛ ክፍል ምዕራፍ 5 (ገጽ 41) ውስጥ ትዕግሥትንና ከስህተት መማርን የሚገልጹት «ኤሌሶይ ጋምዖን ጋꬄስ» እና «ዲጫና ናዒ ጉፋንꬂን ዲቼስ» ትርጉማቸውስ?
flat_utterances.english: And what do the proverbs 'Ellesoy gam7on gathees' and 'Diccana na7i gufanthin diccees' in Grade 10 Chapter 5 (p. 41) teach about patience and learning from mistakes?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: elleso-y gam7o-n gath-ees (haste-NOM delay-LOC make.reach-PRES.3MS, ZARA-03 7) + dicc-ana na7-i gufanth-in dicc-ees (grow-FUT.REL child-NOM stumble-CNV.DS grow-PRES.3MS, Gr10 Ch.5 p. 41).

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: "Ellesoy gam7on gathees" = eesotethi guye atethan gathees; "Diccana na7i gufanthin diccees" = dicciyaa na7i balappe tamaarishe diccees!
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: "እልሌሶይ ገምዖን ገꬄእስ" = እእሶቴꬂ ጉዬ አቴꬃን ገꬄእስ፤ "ዲጭጨነ ነዒ ጉፈንꬂን ዲጭጬእስ" = ዲጭጪየአ ነዒ በለፕፔ ተመአሪሼ ዲጭጬእስ!
flat_utterances.amharic: «ኤሌሶይ ጋምዖን ጋꬄስ» = መቸኮል ወደ መዘግየት ያደርሳል (ከችኮላ እርጋታ ይሻላል)፤ «ዲጫና ናዒ ጉፋንꬂን ዲቼስ» = የሚያድግ ልጅ እየተደናቀፈ (ከስህተቱ እየተማረ) ያድጋል!
flat_utterances.english: 'Ellesoy gam7on gathees' means 'Haste leads to delay' (patience is better than rushing); and 'Diccana na7i gufanthin diccees' means 'A growing child grows by stumbling' (we grow by learning from our mistakes)!
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: Wisdom proverbs from Grade 10 Textbook Ch. 5, p. 41.

flat_utterances.subtopic: Grade 10 Ch. 9 Entrepreneurship (Ooso Medho) & Breaking the Yoke of Poverty (Manqqotetha Kabbasha)
flat_utterances.speaker: user
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Tammantho kifile Shemppo 9 ("Ooso Medho", pp. 76-82) giddon "ooso medho" manqqotetha kabbashaa koxanaw waani maaddii?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ተምመንꬆ ኪፊሌ ሼምፕፖ 9 ("ኦኦሶ ሜꬎ"፣ ፕፕ። ዕ6-82) ጊድዶን "ኦኦሶ ሜꬎ" መንቅቆቴꬃ ከብበሻአ ኮጠነው ወአኒ መአድዲኢ?
flat_utterances.amharic: በአሥረኛ ክፍል ምዕራፍ 9 («ሥራ ፈጠራ»፣ ገጽ 76–82) ውስጥ «ኦሶ ሜꬎ» (ሥራ ፈጠራ) የድህነትን ቀንበር («ማንቆቴꬃ ካባሻ») ለመስበር እንዴት ይረዳል?
flat_utterances.english: In Grade 10 Chapter 9 ('Entrepreneurship', pp. 76–82), how does entrepreneurship ('ooso medho') help break the yoke of poverty ('manqqotetha kabbasha')?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: ooso medho (entrepreneurship / job creation, Gr10 Ch.9 p. 76 & PHR-027) + manqqotetha kabbasha-a (poverty yoke-ACC, Gr10 Ch.9 p. 81) + kox-anaw (break-FUT.PURP) + waan-i maadd-ii.

flat_utterances.subtopic: Grade 10 Ch. 9 Entrepreneurship (Ooso Medho) & Breaking the Yoke of Poverty (Manqqotetha Kabbasha)
flat_utterances.speaker: assistant
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Tammantho kifile maxaafaa (pp. 76-81) maaran: yelagati timirtte wurssidi kawo ooso xalla naagonnaan, guutha miishshaappe doommidi ooratha ooso medhdhiyaanne "tuutummiya" wode manqqotetha kabbashaa koxidi duretethaa demmoosona!
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ተምመንꬆ ኪፊሌ መጠአፈአ (ፕፕ። ዕ6-81) መአረን፦ ዬለገቲ ቲሚርትቴ ዉርስሲዲ ከዎ ኦኦሶ ጠልለ ነአጎንነአን፣ ጉኡꬃ ሚኢሽሻአፕፔ ዶኦምሚዲ ኦኦረꬃ ኦኦሶ ሜꬍꬊየአንኔ "ቱኡቱምሚየ" ዎዴ መንቅቆቴꬃ ከብበሻአ ኮጢዲ ዱሬቴꬃአ ዴምሞኦሶነ!
flat_utterances.amharic: በአሥረኛ ክፍል መጽሐፍ (ገጽ 76–81) መሠረት፦ ወጣቶች ትምህርት ጨርሰው የመንግሥት ሥራ ብቻ ሳይጠብቁ፣ ከትንሽ ካፒታል ጀምረው አዲስ ሥራ ሲፈጥሩና በጽናት ሲታገሉ («ቱቱሚያ») የድህነትን ቀንበር ሰብረው ብልጽግናን ያገኛሉ!
flat_utterances.english: According to the Grade 10 textbook (pp. 76–81): when youth, rather than waiting only for government jobs after graduation, start from small capital, create new enterprises ('ooso medho'), and strive persistently ('tuutummees'), they break the yoke of poverty and achieve prosperity!
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: kawo ooso xalla naag-onnaan (government job only wait-NEG.CNV, Gr10 Ch.9 p. 82) + tuutumm-iya wode (strive-PRES.REL when, Gr10 Ch.9 p. 81) + kox-idi (break-CNV2.ANT).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Grade 10 Goofatho Doona Ch. 9 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/1mKIcfMoMgnZ9Pa657NWmE-OGND2wlveM/view?usp=drivesdk, pp. 76–83: Ooso Medho, tuutummees, kabbasha, koxethi)

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: He shemppuwan (p. 82) uttidi wodiyaa mooronnaan qaaxxidi oothanaabaa odiyaa tossey ay gii?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ሄ ሼምፕፑወን (ፕ። 82) ኡትቲዲ ዎዲየአ ሞኦሮንነአን ቀአጥጢዲ ኦኦꬃነአበአ ኦዲየአ ቶስሴይ አይ ጊኢ?
flat_utterances.amharic: በዚያ ምዕራፍ ውስጥ (ገጽ 82) ቁጭ ብሎ ጊዜን ሳያባክኑ ተንቀሳቅሶ ስለ መሥራት የሚናገረው ምሳሌ ምን ይላል?
flat_utterances.english: What does the proverb in that chapter (p. 82) say about moving and working industriously rather than sitting idle?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: utt-idi wodiya-a moor-onnaan (sit-CNV2 time-ACC waste-NEG.CNV) + qaaxx-idi ooth-anaa-baa (move/strive-CNV2 work-FUT.NMZ-ABOUT).

flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ተምመንꬆ ኪፊሌ ሼምፕፖ 9 (ፕ። 82) ቶስሴይ፦ "ኡትቲደይ ዱልሌ ፒትቴእስ፣ ቀአጥጢደይ ቀንꬄ ፒትቴእስ" ንኔ "መአሂየአ ጎይነአ ኦይክኮፐ፤ ኦይክኪኮ ዬድዶፐ!" ጌእስ!
flat_utterances.amharic: የአሥረኛ ክፍል ምዕራፍ 9 (ገጽ 82) ምሳሌ፦ «ኡቲዳይ ዱሌ ፒቴስ፣ ቃጢዳይ ቃንꬄ ፒቴስ» (ቁጭ ያለ መቀመጫውን ያራግፋል፣ የተንቀሳቀሰ ግን ያተርፋል) እና «ማሂያ ጎይና ኦይኮፓ፤ ኦይኪኮ ዬዶፓ!» (የነብር ጭራ አትያዝ፤ ከያዝክም አትልቀቅ — የጀመርከውን ሥራ በጽናት ጨርስ!) ይላል!
flat_utterances.english: The Grade 10 Chapter 9 (p. 82) proverbs state: 'Uttiday dulle pittees, qaaxxiday qanthe pittees' ('He who sits idle brushes dust off his seat, while he who moves and works prospers') and 'Maahiyaa goynaa oykkopa; oykkiko yeddopa!' ('Do not grab a leopard by the tail; if you do, do not let go — finish what you start with resolve!')
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: utt-ida-y (sit-PAST.REL-NOM.M) vs. qaaxx-ida-y (move/work-PAST.REL-NOM.M); oykk-opa (grab-PROH.2S), yedd-opa (let.go-PROH.2S, Gr10 Ch.9 p. 82).

flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ተምመንꬆ ኪፊሌ መጠአፈአ (ፕ። ዕ3) መአረን፦ ሶጪአል ሜዲአ = "ዴሪየ ገሴꬂየአ ሚኢሼተ"፤ ዌብሲቴ/ዌብ = "ዴም-ቤስሰ"፤ ኔትዎርኪንግ = "በርበጦ / በርብበጤቴꬃ"፤ ኡፕሎአድ/ዶውንሎአድ = "ዴንꬂ-ዎሶ"!
flat_utterances.amharic: በአሥረኛ ክፍል መጽሐፍ (ገጽ 73) መሠረት፦ ማኅበራዊ ሚዲያ = «ዴሪያ ጋሴꬂያ ሚኢሼታ»፤ ድረ-ገጽ (Website) = «ዴም-ቤሳ»፤ ኔትዎርክ (Networking) = «ባርባጦ / ባርባጤቴꬃ»፤ መጫን/ማውረድ (Upload/Download) = «ዴንꬂ-ዎሶ» ይባላሉ!
flat_utterances.english: According to the Grade 10 textbook (p. 73): Social Media = 'Deriya gasethiyaa miisheta'; Website = 'Dem-bessa'; Networking = 'Barbaxo / Barbbaxetetha'; and Upload/Download = 'Denthi-woso'!

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Deriya gasethiyaa miisheta (Feesbuuke, Teelegiraame, Yuutuube) go77aynne qohoy he shemppuwan waani qonccissettidee?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ዴሪየ ገሴꬂየአ ሚኢሼተ (ፌእስቡኡኬ፣ ቴእሌጊረአሜ፣ ዩኡቱኡቤ) ጎዕዓይንኔ ቆሆይ ሄ ሼምፕፑወን ወአኒ ቆንጭጪስሴትቲዴእ?
flat_utterances.amharic: የማኅበራዊ ሚዲያ (ፌስቡክ፣ ቴሌግራም፣ ዩቲዩብ) ጥቅምና ጉዳቱ በዚያ ምዕራፍ ውስጥ እንዴት ተገልጿል?
flat_utterances.english: How are the benefits ('go77a') and harms ('qoho') of social media platforms (Facebook, Telegram, YouTube) explained in that chapter?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: go77a-y-nne qoho-y (benefit-NOM-and harm-NOM) + he shemppuwa-n waan-i qoncc-iss-ett-idee (that chapter-LOC how-CNV2 explain-CAUS-PASS-PAST.3MS.INTER).

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Go77ay: haaho bessan de7iyaa asata eesuwan gasetho, timirtte/pilggethi demmonne zal77e eriso; Qohoy qassi: akeekonna go7ettikko tamaareta tamaaro wodiyaa mooro, worddo odonne xuura qonccisso. Hessa gisho "akeekan go7ettite!" gees.
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ጎዕዓይ፦ ሀአሆ ቤስሰን ዴዒየአ አሰተ እእሱወን ገሴꬆ፣ ቲሚርትቴ/ፒልግጌꬂ ዴምሞንኔ ዘልዕዔ እሪሶ፤ ቆሆይ ቀስሲ፦ አኬእኮንነ ጎዔትቲክኮ ተመአሬተ ተመአሮ ዎዲየአ ሞኦሮ፣ ዎርድዶ ኦዶንኔ ጡኡረ ቆንጭጪስሶ። ሄስሰ ጊሾ "አኬእከን ጎዔትቲቴ!" ጌእስ።
flat_utterances.amharic: ጥቅሙ፦ በሩቅ ቦታ ያሉ ሰዎችን በፍጥነት ማገናኘት፣ ትምህርትና ምርምር ማግኘትና የንግድ ማስታወቂያ፤ ጉዳቱ ደግሞ፦ ያለ ጥንቃቄ ከተጠቀሙ የተማሪዎችን የጥናት ጊዜ ማባከንና የሐሰት ወሬ ማሰራጨት ነው። ስለዚህ «በማስተዋል ተጠቀሙ!» ይላል።
flat_utterances.english: Its benefits: rapidly connecting people across distances, accessing educational research, and promoting business; its harms if used carelessly: wasting students' study time and spreading false rumors. Therefore it advises: 'Use social media with wisdom ('akeekan go7ettite')!'
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: akeeka-n go7ett-ite (wisdom-INST use-IMP.2PL, PHR-097 & Gr10 Ch.8 p. 71).

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Nuuni ichchashu yelagati Sawulan cugan hashetidi Goofa bunanne bootha eessa giigissidi bayzziyaa ooso medhanaw koyoos. Waatidi doommoo?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ኑኡኒ ኢችቻሹ ዬለገቲ ሰዉለን ጩገን ሀሼቲዲ ጎኦፈ ቡነንኔ ቦኦꬃ እእስሰ ጊኢጊስሲዲ በይዝዚየአ ኦኦሶ ሜꬋነው ኮዮኦስ። ወአቲዲ ዶኦምሞኦ?
flat_utterances.amharic: እኛ አምስት ወጣቶች በሳውላ በቡድን ተደራጅተን የጎፋ ቡናና ነጭ ማር አዘጋጅተን የምንሸጥበት ሥራ መፍጠር እንፈልጋለን። እንዴት እንጀምር?
flat_utterances.english: Five of us young people in Sawla want to form a cooperative team and start an enterprise packaging and selling Gofa coffee and white honey. How should we start?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: cuga-n hashet-idi (group-LOC cooperate-CNV2.ANT, Gr8 Ch.7 p. 103) + giig-iss-idi bayzz-iyaa ooso medh-anaw (prepare-CAUS-CNV2 sell-PRES.REL work create-FUT.PURP) + koy-oos (want-PRES.1PL).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Grade 10 Goofatho Doona Ch. 8 & Ch. 9 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/1mKIcfMoMgnZ9Pa657NWmE-OGND2wlveM/view?usp=drivesdk, pp. 68–83)

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Koyro, hintte cuga ooso halchchuwaa xaafite; nam77antho, geeshsha eessaanne bunaa goshshanchchatappe sitta shammidi geeshsha qoriyan/bilqqaxxiyan wothite; heedzantho, sunthanne malaata Goofatho, Amaarathoonne Inggilizetho doonan bolla xaafite!
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ኮይሮ፣ ሂንትቴ ጩገ ኦኦሶ ሀልችቹወአ ጠአፊቴ፤ ነምዕዓንꬆ፣ ጌእሽሻ እእስሰአንኔ ቡነአ ጎሽሻንችቻተፕፔ ሲትተ ሻምሚዲ ጌእሽሻ ቆሪየን/ቢልቅቀጥጢየን ዎꬂቴ፤ ሄእꬓንꬆ፣ ሱንꬃንኔ መለአተ ጎኦፈꬆ፣ አመአረꬆኦንኔ ኢንግጊሊዜꬆ ዶኦነን ቦልለ ጠአፊቴ!
flat_utterances.amharic: በመጀመሪያ፣ የቡድናችሁን የሥራ ዕቅድ (Business Plan) ጻፉ፤ ሁለተኛ፣ ንጹሕ ማርና ቡና ከገበሬዎች በቀጥታ ገዝታችሁ በንጹሕ ዕቃ/ጠርሙስ አሽጉ፤ ሦስተኛ፣ ስምና ምልክት (Brand) በጎፋኛ፣ በአማርኛና በእንግሊዝኛ ቋንቋ ላይ ጻፉ!
flat_utterances.english: First, write your team's business plan ('ooso halchcho'); second, source pure honey and coffee directly from farmers and package them in clean jars; third, print a brand label in Gofatho, Amharic, and English!
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: ooso halchchuwa-a (work plan-ACC.M.DEF, MP-10) + goshshanchcha-tappe (farmer-PL.ABL) + sitta shamm-idi (directly buy-CNV2).

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Addis Ababanne hara katamatan de7iyaa shammanchchati nu oosuwaa erana mala "deriya gasethiyaa miisheta" waatidi go7ettoo?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: አድዲስ አበበንኔ ሀረ ከተመተን ዴዒየአ ሻምመንችቻቲ ኑ ኦኦሱወአ እረነ መለ "ዴሪየ ገሴꬂየአ ሚኢሼተ" ወአቲዲ ጎዔትቶኦ?
flat_utterances.amharic: በአዲስ አበባና በሌሎች ከተሞች ያሉ ገዢዎች ምርታችንን እንዲያውቁ «ማኅበራዊ ሚዲያን» እንዴት እንጠቀም?
flat_utterances.english: How can we use social media ('deriya gasethiyaa miisheta') so customers in Addis Ababa and other cities learn about our products?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: shammanchcha-ti (buyer/customer-PL.NOM) + nu oosuwa-a er-ana mala (our product-ACC know-FUT.PURP) + waat-idi go7ett-oo.

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Teelegiraame chanaaliyanne dem-bessa dooyidi, geeshsha misiliyaa, kiluwaa waagaanne moobayle payduwaa "denthi-woso" oothite; shammanchchati moobayle baankkiyan qanxxishin kaamen eesuwan yeddiyoogaa erissite!
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ቴእሌጊረአሜ ቻነአሊየንኔ ዴም-ቤስሰ ዶኦዪዲ፣ ጌእሽሻ ሚሲሊየአ፣ ኪሉወአ ወአገአንኔ ሞኦበይሌ ፐይዱወአ "ዴንꬂ-ዎሶ" ኦኦꬂቴ፤ ሻምመንችቻቲ ሞኦበይሌ በአንክኪየን ቀንጥጢሺን ከአሜን እእሱወን ዬድዲዮኦገአ እሪስሲቴ!
flat_utterances.amharic: የቴሌግራም ቻናልና ድረ-ገጽ («ዴም-ቤሳ») ከፍታችሁ፣ ጥርት ያለ ፎቶ፣ የኪሎ ዋጋውንና የሞባይል ቁጥራችሁን ጫኑ («ዴንꬂ-ዎሶ»)፤ ገዢዎች በሞባይል ባንኪንግ ሲከፍሉ በመኪና በፍጥነት እንደምትልኩ አሳውቁ!
flat_utterances.english: Open a Telegram channel and website ('dem-bessa'), upload ('denthi-woso') clear photos, prices per kilo, and your phone number; and let buyers know you ship promptly upon mobile banking payment!
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: dem-bessa dooy-idi (website open-CNV2, Gr10 Ch.8 p. 73) + denthi-woso ooth-ite (upload do-IMP.2PL, Gr10 Ch.8 p. 73) + er-iss-ite (know-CAUS-IMP.2PL).

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Uddufuntho kifile Shemppo 9 ("Miidiyanne Gahetetha", pp. 72-77) giddon "kabexa", "zeebulssi", "xolqqethi" nne "gaagla" giyaa miidiya qaalata birshshethay aybee?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ኡድዱፉንꬆ ኪፊሌ ሼምፕፖ 9 ("ሚኢዲየንኔ ገሄቴꬃ"፣ ፕፕ። ዕ2-ዕዕ) ጊድዶን "ከቤጠ"፣ "ዜእቡልስሲ"፣ "ጦልቅቄꬂ" ንኔ "ገአግለ" ጊየአ ሚኢዲየ ቀአለተ ቢርሽሼꬃይ አይቤእ?
flat_utterances.amharic: በዘጠነኛ ክፍል ምዕራፍ 9 («ሚዲያና ተግባቦት»፣ ገጽ 72–77) ውስጥ «ካቤጣ»፣ «ዜቡልሲ»፣ «ጦልቄꬂ» እና «ጋግላ» የሚሉት የሚዲያ ቃላት ትርጉማቸው ምንድን ነው?
flat_utterances.english: In Grade 9 Chapter 9 ('Media and Communication', pp. 72–77), what are the meanings of the media terms 'kabexa', 'zeebulssi', 'xolqqethi', and 'gaagla'?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: kabexa, zeebulssi, xolqqethi, gaagla (Gr9 Ch.9 p. 77 vocabulary) + birshshetha-y ayb-ee.

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Uddufuntho kifile maxaafaa (p. 77) maaran: "kabexa" = ooratha oduwaa; "zeebulssi" = iraadoone ayyere oge; "xolqqethi" = hayzanchcha zaaro; "gaagla" = gallassa, aginanne laytha!
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ኡድዱፉንꬆ ኪፊሌ መጠአፈአ (ፕ። ዕዕ) መአረን፦ "ከቤጠ" = ኦኦረꬃ ኦዱወአ፤ "ዜእቡልስሲ" = ኢረአዶኦኔ አይዬሬ ኦጌ፤ "ጦልቅቄꬂ" = ሀይዘንችቻ ዘአሮ፤ "ገአግለ" = ገልለስሰ፣ አጊነንኔ ለይꬃ!
flat_utterances.amharic: በዘጠነኛ ክፍል መጽሐፍ (ገጽ 77) መሠረት፦ «ካቤጣ» = ዜና / ትኩስ መረጃ፤ «ዜቡልሲ» = የአየር ሞገድ (የሬዲዮ ሞገድ)፤ «ጦልቄꬂ» = ግብረ-መልስ (ከአድማጭ የሚሰጥ ምላሽ)፤ «ጋግላ» = ቀን (ቀን፣ ወርና ዓመተ ምሕረት) ናቸው!
flat_utterances.english: According to the Grade 9 textbook (p. 77): 'kabexa' = news broadcast/report; 'zeebulssi' = radio airwave; 'xolqqethi' = audience feedback/response; and 'gaagla' = full date (day, month, and year)!
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: Exact broadcast and communication lexicon from Grade 9 Textbook Ch. 9, p. 77.

flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ሄ ሼምፕፑወን (ፕ። ዕ8) ኢረአዶኦኔ ቦልለ ኦኦሶ እሪሶ ሺኢሽሺዮ ዎዴ አይ ኩንꬃነው ቤስሲኢ?
flat_utterances.amharic: በዚያ ምዕራፍ ውስጥ (ገጽ 78) በሬዲዮ ላይ የሥራ ወይም የንግድ ማስታወቂያ ሲቀርብ ምን ምን ማካተት ይገባል?
flat_utterances.english: In that chapter (p. 78), when preparing a radio business announcement ('eriso'), what details must be included?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: iraadoone bolla (radio on) + ooso eriso (business announcement, Gr9 Ch.9 p. 78) + shiishsh-iyo wode (present-PRES.REL when) + ay kunth-anaw bess-ii (what include/fill-FUT.PURP ought-PRES.3MS.INTER).

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Erisuwaa giddon: ooso keethaa sunthaa, imettiyaa haggazuwaa woy miishshaa qommuwaa, de7iyaa bessaa, waagaa hirayssatethaanne silkke payduwaa qanthaninne geeshsha qaalan kunthanaw bessees!
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: እሪሱወአ ጊድዶን፦ ኦኦሶ ኬእꬃአ ሱንꬃአ፣ ኢሜትቲየአ ሀግገዙወአ ዎይ ሚኢሽሻአ ቆምሙወአ፣ ዴዒየአ ቤስሰአ፣ ወአገአ ሂረይስሰቴꬃአንኔ ሲልክኬ ፐይዱወአ ቀንꬃኒንኔ ጌእሽሻ ቀአለን ኩንꬃነው ቤስሴእስ!
flat_utterances.amharic: በማስታወቂያው ውስጥ፦ የድርጅቱን ስም፣ የሚሰጠውን አገልግሎት («ሃጋዞ») ወይም የዕቃውን ዓይነት፣ የሚገኝበትን ቦታ (አድራሻ)፣ የዋጋውን ተመጣጣኝነትና የስልክ ቁጥሩን በአጭሩና በግልጽ ቃል ማካተት ይገባል!
flat_utterances.english: In the announcement, one must concisely and clearly include the business name, the service ('haggazo') or product offered, the location ('bessa'), the fair pricing, and the telephone number!
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: im-ett-iyaa haggazuwa-a (give-PASS-PRES.REL service-ACC.M.DEF, Gr9 Ch.1 p. 6) + qantha-n-inne geeshsha qaala-n kunth-anaw bess-ees.

flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ገጠሬ ሄእረን ኢንትቴርኔእቲየአ ꬋዪየአ ዎዴ ጎፈꬆ አኢ ሞኦበይሌ አአፕሊኬሺኔይ ወአኒ ኦኦꬂኢ?

flat_utterances.english: When there is no internet in rural areas, how does the Gofatho AI mobile application work?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: gaxare heera-n intterneetiya-a dhay-iyaa wode (rural area-LOC internet-ACC lack-PRES.REL when) + waan-i ooth-ii (how-CNV2 work-PRES.3MS.INTER).

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Gofatho AI moobayle aaplikeshiney intterneetiyaa baynna (100% offline) SQLite qaala-birshshethaa, FST qawosa birshshanchchaanne Sherpa-ONNX VITS cenggurssa moodeliyaa moobayliyaa giddon oyqqidi oothees!
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ጎፈꬆ አኢ ሞኦበይሌ አአፕሊኬሺኔይ ኢንትቴርኔእቲየአ በይንነ (100% ኦፍፍሊኔ) ስቅሊቴ ቀአለ-ቢርሽሼꬃአ፣ ፍስት ቀዎሰ ቢርሽሻንችቻአንኔ ሼርፐ-ኦንንጥ Vኢትስ ጬንግጉርስሰ ሞኦዴሊየአ ሞኦበይሊየአ ጊድዶን ኦይቅቂዲ ኦኦꬄእስ!
flat_utterances.amharic: የጎፋꬶ ኤአይ የሞባይል መተግበሪያ ያለ ኢንተርኔት (ሙሉ በሙሉ ኦፍላይን) የSQLite መዝገበ-ቃላትን፣ የFST ሰዋስው ተንታኝንና የSherpa-ONNX VITS የድምፅ ሞዴልን በስልኩ ውስጥ ይዞ ይሠራል!
flat_utterances.english: The Gofatho AI mobile app operates 100% offline without internet by bundling the SQLite trilingual dictionary, FST morphological analyzer, and Sherpa-ONNX VITS voice model directly on the phone!
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: intterneetiya-a baynna (internet-ACC without, PHR-117) + qaala-birshshetha-a (dictionary-ACC) + moobayliya-a giddon oyqq-idi ooth-ees (phone-GEN inside hold-CNV2 work-PRES.3MS).

flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ጬንግጉርስሰአን ሀአሰየደ ጎኦፈꬆ ለቲን-ኢየኒንኔ ፊዴል-ኢየን ኢስሲፕፔ ጠአፊስሰነው ደንድደዖኦ?

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Ee! Maykiroofooniyaa bochchada haasayiyaa wode, Meta MMS-1B ASR-aynne Lexicon rescorer-ay '7' nne minniyaa pidaleta naagidi Latin-iyaninne Fidel-iyan issippe xaafees!
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: እእ! መይኪሮኦፎኦኒየአ ቦችቻደ ሀአሰዪየአ ዎዴ፣ ሜተ ምምስ-1ብ አስር-አይንኔ ሌጢጮን ሬስጮሬር-አይ 'ዕ' ንኔ ሚንኒየአ ፒደሌተ ነአጊዲ ለቲን-ኢየኒንኔ ፊዴል-ኢየን ኢስሲፕፔ ጠአፌእስ!
flat_utterances.amharic: አዎ! ማይክሮፎኑን ነክተህ ስትናገር፣ የMeta MMS-1B ASR እና የመዝገበ-ቃላት ማስተካከያው '7' (/ʔ/) እና የሚጠብቁ (ሚንኒያ) ፊደላትን ጠብቆ በላቲንና በፊደል አንድ ላይ ይጽፋል!
flat_utterances.english: Yes! When you tap the microphone and speak, Meta MMS-1B ASR and the lexicon hotword rescorer preserve glottal stops ('7' = /ʔ/) and geminate consonants ('minniyaa') and transcribe into both Latin and Fidel simultaneously!
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: bochch-ada haasay-iyaa wode (touch-CNV1.ANT.2S speak-PRES.REL when) + naag-idi (preserve-CNV2.ANT) + issippe xaaf-ees (together write-PRES.3MS).

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Uddufuntho kifile Shemppo 2 ("Giira", pp. 8-14) giddon zal77anchchatinne ooso medhdhiyaageeti "giira" wodiyaan qanxxoy aybis koshshii?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ኡድዱፉንꬆ ኪፊሌ ሼምፕፖ 2 ("ጊኢረ"፣ ፕፕ። 8-14) ጊድዶን ዘልዕዓንችቻቲንኔ ኦኦሶ ሜꬍꬊየአጌእቲ "ጊኢረ" ዎዲየአን ቀንጥጦይ አይቢስ ኮሽሺኢ?
flat_utterances.amharic: በዘጠነኛ ክፍል ምዕራፍ 2 («ግብር»፣ ገጽ 8–14) ውስጥ ነጋዴዎችና ሥራ ፈጣሪዎች «ጊኢራ» (ግብር) በወቅቱ መክፈላቸው ለምን ያስፈልጋል?
flat_utterances.english: In Grade 9 Chapter 2 ('Taxation', pp. 8–14), why is it important for merchants and entrepreneurs to pay tax ('giira') on time?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: giira wodiya-an qanxxo-y (tax time-LOC paying-NOM, Gr9 Ch.2 p. 8 & PHR-112) + aybis koshsh-ii (why be.needed-PRES.3MS.INTER).

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Uddufuntho kifile maxaafaa (p. 9) maaran: giiraappe shiiqiyaa demishaan "baaso dichcha" - kaame ogeti, korontte, geeshsha haathi, timirtte keethatinne aakime keethati - keexxettoosona!
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ኡድዱፉንꬆ ኪፊሌ መጠአፈአ (ፕ። 9) መአረን፦ ጊኢረአፕፔ ሺኢቂየአ ዴሚሻአን "በአሶ ዲችቻ" - ከአሜ ኦጌቲ፣ ኮሮንትቴ፣ ጌእሽሻ ሀአꬂ፣ ቲሚርትቴ ኬእꬃቲንኔ አአኪሜ ኬእꬃቲ - ኬእጥጤትቶኦሶነ!
flat_utterances.amharic: በዘጠነኛ ክፍል መጽሐፍ (ገጽ 9) መሠረት፦ ከግብር በሚሰበሰበው ገቢ «ባሶ ዲቻ» (መሠረተ ልማት) — የመኪና መንገዶች፣ ኤሌክትሪክ፣ ንጹሕ ውኃ፣ ትምህርት ቤቶችና ሐኪም ቤቶች — ይገነባሉ!
flat_utterances.english: According to the Grade 9 textbook (p. 9): revenue collected from taxes builds public infrastructure ('baaso dichcha') — roads, electricity, clean water, schools, and clinics!

flat_utterances.amharic: ሞባይል በኪስ ተይዞ የትም ሲኬድ ያነጋግራል፣ አጭር መልእክት (SMS)፣ ፎቶ፣ የባንክ ክፍያና የኢንተርኔት ድረ-ገጽ አገልግሎት ይሰጣል፤ የቤት ስልክ ደግሞ ኤሌክትሪክ ቢጠፋም በቤት ውስጥ በታማኝነት ይሠራል!
flat_utterances.english: A mobile phone can be carried in your pocket anywhere to make calls, send text messages, take photos, make mobile banking payments, and browse websites ('dem-bessa'); while a landline works reliably indoors even during power outages!

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Imeeliyaan xaafettida dabddaabbey, misileynne maxaafay issi sekondde giddon sa7aa gaxa gakkees; posttay qassi qarxxa miishshata efaanaw ichchashu woy tamma gallassa ekkees!
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ኢሜእሊየአን ጠአፌትቲደ ደብድደአብቤይ፣ ሚሲሌይንኔ መጠአፈይ ኢስሲ ሴኮንድዴ ጊድዶን ሰዓአ ገጠ ገክኬእስ፤ ፖስትተይ ቀስሲ ቀርጥጠ ሚኢሽሻተ እፈአነው ኢችቻሹ ዎይ ተምመ ገልለስሰ እክኬእስ!
flat_utterances.amharic: በኢሜይል የተጻፈ ደብዳቤ፣ ምስልና መጽሐፍ በአንድ ሰከንድ ውስጥ የዓለም ዳርቻ ይደርሳል፤ ፖስታ ደግሞ የሚጨበጡ ዕቃዎችን ለመላክ አምስት ወይም አሥር ቀናት ይወስዳል!
flat_utterances.english: A letter, image, or document sent by email reaches the far side of the world in a single second; whereas postal mail takes several days to deliver physical packages!
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: imeeliya-an xaaf-ett-ida dabddaabbe-y (email-INST write-PASS-PAST.REL letter-NOM) + issi sekondde giddon (one second within) + gakk-ees (arrive-PRES.3MS).

flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ተምመንꬆ ኪፊሌ ሼምፕፖ 9 (ፕ። 82) ሜእዜ 2 ጊድዶን "ዎዴ ሱኡሬን ጎዔቴꬃረንኔ ኦኦሶ ሜꬎረ ወአኒ ገሄትቲየአኮ ሀአሰዪቴ" ጌእስ። ዎዲየአ ቦንችቾይ ኦኦሶ ሜꬎኦስ አይ ጎዕዒኢ?
flat_utterances.amharic: በአሥረኛ ክፍል ምዕራፍ 9 (ገጽ 82) መልመጃ 2 ውስጥ «የጊዜ አጠቃቀምና ሥራ ፈጠራ እንዴት እንደሚገናኙ ተነጋገሩ» ይላል። ጊዜን ማክበር ለሥራ ፈጠራ ምን ይጠቅማል?
flat_utterances.english: In Grade 10 Chapter 9 (p. 82) Exercise 2, it asks how proper time management connects with entrepreneurship. How does respecting time benefit an entrepreneur?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: wode suure-n go7etethaa-ra-nne ooso medho-ra (time rightly-LOC using-COM-and job creation-COM, Gr10 Ch.9 p. 82) + waan-i gah-ett-iyaa-kko (how-CNV2 connect-PASS-PRES.REL-COMP).

flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ዎዲየአ ሱኡሬን ሀልችቺዲ ጎዔትቲየአ ኦኦሶ ሜꬍꬋንችቻይ ሻምመንችቻተ ቀአለአ ቦንችቼእስ፣ ገልለስሰ ኦኦሱወአ አሺርትቶ በይንነአን ዉርስሴእሲንኔ ደሮ ዴሚሻ ዴምሜእስ!
flat_utterances.amharic: ጊዜውን በትክክል አቅዶ የሚጠቀም ሥራ ፈጣሪ የደንበኞችን ቀጠሮ ያከብራል፣ የዕለት ሥራውን ያለ መስነፍ («አሺርቶ») ይጨርሳል እንዲሁም ብዙ ገቢ ያገኛል!

flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ኦኦሱወን ጉዬ አቴꬂ (አሺርትቶ) ንኔ ዎርድዶ ቀአለአፕፔ ነአጌትተነአበአ ሆስፕፑንꬆ ኪፊሌ ሼምፕፖ 1 ("ኦኦሶ ዎገ") አይ ዞሪ?
flat_utterances.amharic: በሥራ ላይ ከመዘግየት («አሺርቶ») እና ከሐሰት ቃል ስለ መጠበቅ የስምንተኛ ክፍል ምዕራፍ 1 («የሥራ ሥነ-ምግባር») ምን ይመክራል?

flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ሆስፕፑንꬆ ኪፊሌ ሼምፕፖ 1 (ፕፕ። 3-5)፦ ኦኦሰንችቻይ በ ኦኦሶ ሰአቲየአ ቦንችቻነው፣ ሀግገዞ ኮዪዲ ዪየአ ዴሪየአ ኡፈይስሰን ሞክከነዊንኔ ሱኡሬአቴꬃአን ኦኦꬃነው ቤስሲኢስ ጊዲ ዞሬእስ!
flat_utterances.amharic: የስምንተኛ ክፍል ምዕራፍ 1 (ገጽ 3–5)፦ ሠራተኛው የሥራ ሰዓቱን ማክበር፣ አገልግሎት ፈልጎ የሚመጣውን ሕዝብ በደስታ መቀበልና በቅንነት መሥራት እንደሚገባው ይመክራል!

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Nu yelagata ooso medho cugaas tal77e miishsha oychchanaw Omo Microfinance xifate keethaas "Ooso dabddaabbe" xaafanaw koyoos. Tammantho kifile Shemppo 6 (pp. 55-58) maaraa taassi odarkkii?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ኑ ዬለገተ ኦኦሶ ሜꬎ ጩገአስ ተልዕዔ ሚኢሽሻ ኦይችቻነው ኦሞ ሚጭሮፊነንጬ ጢፈቴ ኬእꬃአስ "ኦኦሶ ደብድደአብቤ" ጠአፈነው ኮዮኦስ። ተምመንꬆ ኪፊሌ ሼምፕፖ 6 (ፕፕ። 55-58) መአረአ ተአስሲ ኦደርክኪኢ?
flat_utterances.amharic: ለወጣቶች የሥራ ፈጠራ ቡድናችን የብድር ገንዘብ («ታልዔ ሚኢሻ») ለመጠየቅ ለኦሞ ማይክሮ ፋይናንስ ጽሕፈት ቤት «ኦሶ ዳብዳቤ» (የሥራ ደብዳቤ) መጻፍ እንፈልጋለን። የአሥረኛ ክፍል ምዕራፍ 6 (ገጽ 55–58) ሥርዓቱን ትነግረኛለህ?
flat_utterances.english: We want to write an official business letter ('Ooso dabddaabbe') to the microfinance office to request a startup loan ('tal77e miishsha') for our youth enterprise group. Could you tell me the format from Grade 10 Chapter 6 (pp. 55–58)?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: tal77e miishsha (loan money, ZARA-03 77) + oychch-anaw (request-FUT.PURP) + ooso dabddaabbe xaaf-anaw (official letter write-FUT.PURP, Gr10 Ch.6 p. 55).

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Tammantho kifile maxaafaa (pp. 55-58) maaran Ooso dabddaabbees usuppun kifileti de7oosona: (1) Bolla ushachcha baggan "Gaagla", (2) Bolla haddirssa baggan dabddaabbey biyaa xifate keethaa sunthaa, (3) Giddon "Kaara / Waanna Qofa", (4) Waanna kiitaa giddo daassata, (5) Galata qachchuwaanne (6) Xaafanchchaa sunthaanne kushe-malaataa!
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ተምመንꬆ ኪፊሌ መጠአፈአ (ፕፕ። 55-58) መአረን ኦኦሶ ደብድደአብቤእስ ኡሱፕፑን ኪፊሌቲ ዴዖኦሶነ፦ (1) ቦልለ ኡሻችቻ በግገን "ገአግለ"፣ (2) ቦልለ ሀድዲርስሰ በግገን ደብድደአብቤይ ቢየአ ጢፈቴ ኬእꬃአ ሱንꬃአ፣ (3) ጊድዶን "ከአረ / ወአንነ ቆፈ"፣ (4) ወአንነ ኪኢተአ ጊድዶ ደአስሰተ፣ (5) ገለተ ቀችቹወአንኔ (6) ጠአፈንችቻአ ሱንꬃአንኔ ኩሼ-መለአተአ!
flat_utterances.amharic: በአሥረኛ ክፍል መጽሐፍ (ገጽ 55–58) መሠረት ለሥራ ደብዳቤ ስድስት ክፍሎች አሉት፦ (1) ከላይ በቀኝ በኩል «ጋግላ» (ቀን)፣ (2) ከላይ በግራ በኩል ደብዳቤው የሚሄድበት ጽሕፈት ቤት ስም፣ (3) በመካከል «ካራ / ዋና ቆፋ» (ጉዳዩ፦)፣ (4) የዋናው መልእክት አንቀጾች፣ (5) የምስጋና መቋጫና (6) የጸሐፊው ስምና ፊርማ («ኩሼ-ማላታ»)!
flat_utterances.english: According to the Grade 10 textbook (pp. 55–58), an official letter ('Ooso dabddaabbe') has six parts: (1) the Date ('Gaagla') at top right, (2) the recipient office address at top left, (3) the Subject line ('Kaara / Waanna Qofa') in the center, (4) the body paragraphs, (5) the complimentary close, and (6) the sender's name and signature ('kushe-malaata')!
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: Complete 6-part official letter structure from Grade 10 Textbook Ch. 6, pp. 55–58.

flat_utterances.amharic: እንዲህ ብለህ ጻፍ፦ «ዋና ቆፋ፦ ዬላጋታ ኦሶ ሜꬎ ጩጋስ ታልዔ ሚኢሻ ኦይቾ» (ጉዳዩ፦ ለወጣቶች ሥራ ፈጠራ ቡድን የብድር ገንዘብ መጠየቅ)!
flat_utterances.english: Write it like this: 'Waanna Qofa: Yelagata Ooso Medho Cugaas Tal77e Miishsha Oychcho' ('Subject: Loan Application for Youth Entrepreneurship Cooperative')!

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Maxaafe sinthe woykko katama eriso boorddiyaa moobayle kaameran misile kaasada Goofatho AI-iyan waatada birshshissoo?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: መጠአፌ ሲንꬄ ዎይክኮ ከተመ እሪሶ ቦኦርድዲየአ ሞኦበይሌ ከአሜረን ሚሲሌ ከአሰደ ጎኦፈꬆ አኢ-ኢየን ወአተደ ቢርሽሺስሶኦ?
flat_utterances.amharic: የመጽሐፍ ገጽን ወይም የከተማ ማስታወቂያ ሰሌዳን በሞባይል ካሜራ ፎቶ አንሥቼ በጎፋꬶ ኤአይ እንዴት ላስተረጉም?

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Gofatho AI aaplikeshine giddon "OCR & Ometo Lab" giyaa kifiliyaa dooyada, maxaafaa sinthaa misile kaasa; OCR injiney xuufiyaa nabbabidi '7' nne Ethiopic Extended-A pidaleta suuren giigissidi birshshees!
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ጎፈꬆ አኢ አአፕሊኬሺኔ ጊድዶን "ኦጭር & ኦሜቶ ለብ" ጊየአ ኪፊሊየአ ዶኦየደ፣ መጠአፈአ ሲንꬃአ ሚሲሌ ከአሰ፤ ኦጭር ኢንጂኔይ ጡኡፊየአ ነብበቢዲ 'ዕ' ንኔ እꬂኦፒጭ እጥቴንዴድ-አ ፒደሌተ ሱኡሬን ጊኢጊስሲዲ ቢርሽሼእስ!
flat_utterances.amharic: በጎፋꬶ ኤአይ መተግበሪያ ውስጥ «OCR & Ometo Lab» የሚለውን ክፍል ከፍተህ፣ የመጽሐፉን ገጽ ፎቶ አንሣ፤ የOCR ሞተሩ ጽሑፉን አንብቦ '7' (/ʔ/) እና የExtended-A ፊደላትን በትክክል አስተካክሎ ይተረጉማል!
flat_utterances.english: Open the 'OCR & Ometo Lab' tab in the Gofatho AI app and snap a photo of the page; the OCR engine reads the text, normalizes glottal stop '7' (/ʔ/) and Ethiopic Extended-A characters, and translates it!
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: dooy-ada (open-CNV1.ANT.2S) + xuufiya-a nabbab-idi (text-ACC.M.DEF read-CNV2.ANT) + giig-iss-idi birshsh-ees (normalize-CAUS-CNV2 translate-PRES.3MS).

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Beni SIL PUA pidaletan xaafettida Geeshsha Maxaafa xuufiyaakka ooratha Unicode pidaletan laammii?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ቤኒ ሲል ፑአ ፒደሌተን ጠአፌትቲደ ጌእሽሻ መጠአፈ ጡኡፊየአክከ ኦኦረꬃ ኡኒጮዴ ፒደሌተን ለአምሚኢ?
flat_utterances.amharic: በድሮው የSIL PUA ፊደላት የተጻፈውን የመጽሐፍ ቅዱስ ጽሑፍም ወደ አዲሱ ዩኒኮድ («ꬁ–ꬆ»፣ «ꬉ–ꬎ»፣ «ꬑ–ꬖ») ፊደላት ይቀይራል?

flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: ooratha Unicode pidale-ta-n (new Unicode character-PL-LOC) + laamm-ii (change/convert-PRES.3MS.INTER).

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Ee! SIL PUA pidaleta ubbaa Unicode Ethiopic Extended-A (U+AB01..U+AB16) pidaletan suuren laammidi Latin-iyaninne Fidel-iyan besses!
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: እእ! ሲል ፑአ ፒደሌተ ኡብበአ ኡኒጮዴ እꬂኦፒጭ እጥቴንዴድ-አ (ኡ+አብ01።።ኡ+አብ16) ፒደሌተን ሱኡሬን ለአምሚዲ ለቲን-ኢየኒንኔ ፊዴል-ኢየን ቤስሴስ!
flat_utterances.amharic: አዎ! የSIL PUA ፊደላትን ሁሉ ወደ መደበኛ ዩኒኮድ Ethiopic Extended-A (U+AB01..U+AB16) በትክክል ቀይሮ በላቲንና በፊደል ያሳያል!
flat_utterances.english: Yes! It deterministically maps all legacy SIL PUA codepoints into standard Unicode Ethiopic Extended-A (U+AB01..U+AB16) and displays both Latin and Fidel scripts!

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Moobayle baankkiyaanne deriya gasethiyaa miisheta go7ettiyaa wode cimanchchatappe waatidi naagettoo?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ሞኦበይሌ በአንክኪየአንኔ ዴሪየ ገሴꬂየአ ሚኢሼተ ጎዔትቲየአ ዎዴ ጪመንችቻተፕፔ ወአቲዲ ነአጌትቶኦ?
flat_utterances.amharic: ሞባይል ባንኪንግና ማኅበራዊ ሚዲያን በምንጠቀምበት ጊዜ ከአጭበርባሪዎች እንዴት እንጠበቅ?
flat_utterances.english: When using mobile banking and social media, how do we protect ourselves from online scammers?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: go7ett-iyaa wode (use-PRES.REL when) + cimanchcha-tappe (deceiver/scammer-PL.ABL < cim- 'deceive' + -anchcha) + waat-idi naag-ett-oo (how-CNV2 guard-REFL-1PL.INTER).

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Ne baankke xuura payduwaa oonaskka odoppa! Silkkiyan "Baankkeppe haasayays, ne xuura koodiyaa yedda" giyaa cimanchchatas zaaro immoppa.
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ኔ በአንክኬ ጡኡረ ፐይዱወአ ኦኦነስክከ ኦዶፕፐ! ሲልክኪየን "በአንክኬፕፔ ሀአሰየይስ፣ ኔ ጡኡረ ኮኦዲየአ ዬድደ" ጊየአ ጪመንችቻተስ ዘአሮ ኢምሞፕፐ።
flat_utterances.amharic: የባንክ ምሥጢር ቁጥርህን (PIN / Password) ለማንም አትንገር! በስልክ «ከባንክ ነው የምደውለው፣ የሚስጥር ኮድህን ላክ» ለሚሉ አጭበርባሪዎች ምላሽ አትስጥ።
flat_utterances.english: Never tell your bank secret PIN or password ('xuura payduwaa') to anyone! Do not reply to scammers who call saying, 'I am calling from the bank, send your secret code.'
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: ne baankke xuura payduwa-a (your bank secret number-ACC.M.DEF, Gr8 Ch.1 p. 15 xuura) + oona-s-kka od-oppa (anyone-DAT-EVEN tell-PROH.2S); zaaro imm-oppa (answer give-PROH.2S).

flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ዴሪየ ገሴꬂየአ ሚኢሼተ ቦልለ ዎርድዶ ከቤጠይ ሺኢቂየአ ዎዴ ሻአክከነው አይ ኦኦꬆኦ?
flat_utterances.amharic: በማኅበራዊ ሚዲያ ላይ የሐሰት ዜና («ዎርዶ ካቤጣ») ሲቀርብ ለመለየት ምን እናድርግ?
flat_utterances.english: When false news ('worddo kabexa') appears on social media, what should we do to verify it?

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Issi kiitaa haratas "denthi-woso" oothanaappe kase, kiitaa pulttoy ammanettiyaa miidiyaakko qoraphpha! Tammantho kifile Shemppo 5 (p. 41) tossey "Yessi be7i yeekkees; missi be7i bookkees" gees; akeekonnaan worddo kiitaa laaloppa!
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ኢስሲ ኪኢተአ ሀረተስ "ዴንꬂ-ዎሶ" ኦኦꬃነአፕፔ ከሴ፣ ኪኢተአ ፑልትቶይ አምመኔትቲየአ ሚኢዲየአክኮ ቆረጵጳ! ተምመንꬆ ኪፊሌ ሼምፕፖ 5 (ፕ። 41) ቶስሴይ "ዬስሲ ቤዒ ዬእክኬእስ፤ ሚስሲ ቤዒ ቦኦክኬእስ" ጌእስ፤ አኬእኮንነአን ዎርድዶ ኪኢተአ ለአሎፕፐ!
flat_utterances.amharic: አንድን መልእክት ለሌሎች ከማጋራትህ በፊት፣ የመልእክቱ ምንጭ ታማኝ ሚዲያ መሆኑን መርምር! የአሥረኛ ክፍል ምዕራፍ 5 (ገጽ 41) ምሳሌ «ዬሲ ቤዒ ዬኬስ፤ ሚሲ ቤዒ ቦኬስ» (ሰው ሲያለቅስ አይቶ ማልቀስ — በጭፍን መከተል) ይላል፤ ሳታስተውል የሐሰት መልእክት አታሰራጭ!
flat_utterances.english: Before sharing a message with others, verify whether its source ('pultto') is trustworthy! The Grade 10 Chapter 5 (p. 41) proverb says 'Yessi be7i yeekkees; missi be7i bookkees' ('Crying simply because others cry; digging because others dig'); do not blindly spread unverified rumors!
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: kiita-a pultto-y (message-GEN source-NOM) + qoraphph-a (verify-IMP.2S); Gr10 Ch.5 p. 41 proverb against blind imitation.
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Grade 10 Goofatho Doona Ch. 8 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/1mKIcfMoMgnZ9Pa657NWmE-OGND2wlveM/view?usp=drivesdk, pp. 68–75: Deriya Gasethiyaa Miisheta); Grade 8 Ch. 1 (xuura)

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Nu aayetinne michcheti puutto paththidinne dungguza/gaabe daddidi ooso medho cuga medhdhanaw koyoosona. Entta oosuwaa waatidi dichchoo?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ኑ አአዬቲንኔ ሚችቼቲ ፑኡትቶ ፐꬅꬂዲንኔ ዱንግጉዘ/ገአቤ ደድዲዲ ኦኦሶ ሜꬎ ጩገ ሜꬍꬋነው ኮዮኦሶነ። እንትተ ኦኦሱወአ ወአቲዲ ዲችቾኦ?
flat_utterances.amharic: እናቶቻችንና እኅቶቻችን ጥጥ ፈትለውና ዱንጉዛ/ጋቢ ሸምነው የሥራ ፈጠራ ቡድን መመሥረት ይፈልጋሉ። ሥራቸውን እንዴት እናሳድግ?

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Koyro, woga daddo hiillaa ooratha dizaayniyaara (shaarfe, shanxa, keetha alleeqo) walakkidi oothite; nam77antho, Sawula, Arba Minchchanne Addis Ababa bazaariyan shiishshidi erissite!
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ኮይሮ፣ ዎገ ደድዶ ሂኢልለአ ኦኦረꬃ ዲዘአይኒየአረ (ሻአርፌ፣ ሻንጠ፣ ኬእꬃ አልሌእቆ) ወለክኪዲ ኦኦꬂቴ፤ ነምዕዓንꬆ፣ ሰዉለ፣ አርበ ሚንችቻንኔ አድዲስ አበበ በዘአሪየን ሺኢሽሺዲ እሪስሲቴ!
flat_utterances.amharic: በመጀመሪያ፣ ባህላዊ የሽመና ጥበብን ከዘመናዊ ዲዛይን (ሻርፕ፣ ቦርሳ፣ የቤት ጌጣጌጥ) ጋር አዋሕዳችሁ ሥሩ፤ ሁለተኛ፣ በሳውላ፣ በአርባ ምንጭና በአዲስ አበባ ባዛር (ኤግዚቢሽን) አቅርባችሁ አስተዋውቁ!
flat_utterances.english: First, combine traditional weaving artistry with modern designs (scarves, bags, home decor); second, showcase and promote them at bazaars and exhibitions in Sawla, Arba Minch, and Addis Ababa!

flat_utterances.amharic: ጎብኚዎች የጎፋ ዱንጉዛን ታሪክ እንዲያውቁ በልብሱ ላይ አጭር ጽሑፍ እናድርግ?

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Hegee daro cincca qofa! Zo7o, kareethanne boora melati Goofa dere taarikiyaa, xalatethaanne marqqa biittaa qonccissiyaaogaa Goofathoonne Inggilizethon xaafidi ma7uwaara qachchite!
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ሄጌእ ደሮ ጪንጭጨ ቆፈ! ዞዖ፣ ከሬእꬃንኔ ቦኦረ ሜለቲ ጎኦፈ ዴሬ ተአሪኪየአ፣ ጠለቴꬃአንኔ መርቅቀ ቢኢትተአ ቆንጭጪስሲየአኦገአ ጎኦፈꬆኦንኔ ኢንግጊሊዜꬆን ጠአፊዲ መዑወአረ ቀችቺቴ!
flat_utterances.amharic: ይህ በጣም ብልህ ሐሳብ ነው! ቀይ፣ ጥቁርና ቢጫ ቀለማት የጎፋን ሕዝብ ታሪክ፣ ጀግንነትና ለም መሬት እንደሚገልጹ በጎፋኛና በእንግሊዝኛ ጽፋችሁ ከልብሱ ጋር አያይዙ!
flat_utterances.english: That is a very smart idea! Write a tag in Gofatho and English explaining how the red, black, and yellow stripes symbolize Gofa history, courage, and fertile land, and attach it to each garment!

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Nu kifile tamaareti Teelegiraame giddon "Goofatho Doona Cuga" medhdhidi paacciyaaw giigettanaw koyoos. Waatidi wogan go7ettoo?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ኑ ኪፊሌ ተመአሬቲ ቴእሌጊረአሜ ጊድዶን "ጎኦፈꬆ ዶኦነ ጩገ" ሜꬍꬊዲ ፐአጭጪየአው ጊኢጌትተነው ኮዮኦስ። ወአቲዲ ዎገን ጎዔትቶኦ?
flat_utterances.amharic: የክፍላችን ተማሪዎች በቴሌግራም ውስጥ «የጎፋኛ ቋንቋ ቡድን» መሥርተን ለፈተና መዘጋጀት እንፈልጋለን። እንዴት በሥርዓት እንጠቀምበት?
flat_utterances.english: Our classmates want to create a 'Gofatho Language Study Group' on Telegram to prepare for exams. How should we use it effectively?

flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ገልለስሰን ኢስሲ ሰአቴ ዶኦሪዲ፣ ሄ ሰአቲየን ጠልለ፦ (1) ቀዎሰ ኦይሾተ፣ (2) ሚንኒየአንኔ ሌፕፒየ ቀአለተ፣ (3) አአቄተንኔ ቶስሴተ ዎሊ ኦይችቺዲንኔ "ጦልቅቄꬂ" ኢምሚዲ ቶብቢቴ!
flat_utterances.amharic: በቀን አንድ የተወሰነ ሰዓት መርጣችሁ፣ በዚያ ሰዓት ብቻ፦ (1) የሰዋስው ጥያቄዎችን፣ (2) የሚጠብቁና የሚላሉ ቃላትን፣ (3) ፈሊጣዊ ንግግሮችንና ምሳሌዎችን እርስ በርስ በመጠያየቅና ግብረ-መልስ («ጦልቄꬂ») በመስጠት ተወያዩ!
flat_utterances.english: Set a dedicated one-hour window each day and during that hour quiz one another on: (1) grammar rules ('Qawosa'), (2) geminate vs. singleton minimal pairs, and (3) idioms and proverbs, giving constructive feedback ('xolqqethi', Gr9 Ch.9 p. 77)!

flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: እእ! ሆስፕፑንꬆ፣ ኡድዱፉንꬆንኔ ተምመንꬆ ኪፊሌ መጠአፈተፕፔ ጊኢጌትቲደ 250 ሜእዜ ኦይሾተ ጩገን ሺኢሽሺዲ፣ ሼርፐ-ኦንንጥ Vኢትስ ጬንግጉርስሰአን ሱኡሬ ነብበቡወአ ኢስሲፕፔ ሀይዚቴ!

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Uddufuntho kifile Shemppo 1 (p. 7) giddon "Dooni hayqqiya gaasoti aybee?" gees. Issi dooni hayqqonna mala dijitaale wodiyan ay oothanaw bessii?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ኡድዱፉንꬆ ኪፊሌ ሼምፕፖ 1 (ፕ። ዕ) ጊድዶን "ዶኦኒ ሀይቅቂየ ገአሶቲ አይቤእ?" ጌእስ። ኢስሲ ዶኦኒ ሀይቅቆንነ መለ ዲጂተአሌ ዎዲየን አይ ኦኦꬃነው ቤስሲኢ?
flat_utterances.amharic: በዘጠነኛ ክፍል ምዕራፍ 1 (ገጽ 7) ውስጥ «ቋንቋ የሚሞትባቸው ምክንያቶች ምንድን ናቸው?» ይላል። አንድ ቋንቋ እንዳይሞት በዲጂታል ዘመን ውስጥ ምን ማድረግ ይገባል?
flat_utterances.english: In Grade 9 Chapter 1 (p. 7), it asks 'What are the causes of language endangerment/death?' What must be done in the digital era so a language does not die out?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: doon-i hayqq-iya gaaso-ti ayb-ee (language-NOM die-PRES.REL reason-PL.NOM what-INTER, Gr9 Ch.1 p. 7) + hayqq-onna mala (die-NEG.PURP).

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Uddufuntho kifile maxaafaa (pp. 5-7) maaran: issi dooni ba go7ettiyaa asay aggikko hayqqees; doonay diccana mala timirtte keethan, maxaafan, miidiyaniinne AI/komppiyuutere teknooloojiyan xaafettanawinne haasayettanaw bessees!
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ኡድዱፉንꬆ ኪፊሌ መጠአፈአ (ፕፕ። 5-ዕ) መአረን፦ ኢስሲ ዶኦኒ በ ጎዔትቲየአ አሰይ አግጊክኮ ሀይቅቄእስ፤ ዶኦነይ ዲጭጨነ መለ ቲሚርትቴ ኬእꬃን፣ መጠአፈን፣ ሚኢዲየኒኢንኔ አኢ/ኮምፕፒዩኡቴሬ ቴክኖኦሎኦጂየን ጠአፌትተነዊንኔ ሀአሰዬትተነው ቤስሴእስ!
flat_utterances.amharic: በዘጠነኛ ክፍል መጽሐፍ (ገጽ 5–7) መሠረት፦ አንድ ቋንቋ ተናጋሪው ሕዝብ መጠቀም ሲተው ይሞታል፤ ቋንቋው እንዲያድግ በትምህርት ቤት፣ በመጽሐፍ፣ በሚዲያና በኤአይ/ኮምፒውተር ቴክኖሎጂ ሊጻፍና ሊነገር ይገባል!
flat_utterances.english: According to the Grade 9 textbook (pp. 5–7): a language dies when its speakers stop using it; for a language to flourish, it must be written and spoken in schools, books, media, and AI/computer technology!
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: ba go7ett-iyaa asa-y agg-ikko (3REFL.GEN use-PRES.REL people-NOM leave-COND.REAL) + xaaf-ett-anaw-inne haasay-ett-anaw bess-ees (write-PASS-FUT.PURP-and speak-PASS-FUT.PURP ought-PRES.3MS).

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Nuuni tamaaretinne asttamaareti Gofatho AI aaplikeshiniyaa giddon ooratha qaalatanne tosse gujjanaw waatidi maaddoo?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ኑኡኒ ተመአሬቲንኔ አስትተመአሬቲ ጎፈꬆ አኢ አአፕሊኬሺኒየአ ጊድዶን ኦኦረꬃ ቀአለተንኔ ቶስሴ ጉጅጀነው ወአቲዲ መአድዶኦ?
flat_utterances.amharic: እኛ ተማሪዎችና መምህራን በጎፋꬶ ኤአይ መተግበሪያ ውስጥ አዳዲስ ቃላትንና ምሳሌዎችን ለመጨመር እንዴት እንርዳ?
flat_utterances.english: How can we students and teachers contribute new vocabulary and proverbs inside the Gofatho AI application?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: ooratha qaala-ta-nne tosse gujj-anaw (new word-PL.ACC-and proverb add-FUT.PURP, PHR-119) + waat-idi maadd-oo (how-CNV2 help-1PL.INTER).

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Aaplikeshiniyaa giddon "Feedback & Corpus Contribution" (Xolqqethi) kifiliyaa dooyidi, ooratha qaalata, suure birshshethaanne cenggurssaa yedda! "Goofatho doonay dicconnaan attenna!"
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: አአፕሊኬሺኒየአ ጊድዶን "ፌእድበጭክ & ጮርፑስ ጮንትሪቡቲኦን" (ጦልቅቄꬂ) ኪፊሊየአ ዶኦዪዲ፣ ኦኦረꬃ ቀአለተ፣ ሱኡሬ ቢርሽሼꬃአንኔ ጬንግጉርስሰአ ዬድደ! "ጎኦፈꬆ ዶኦነይ ዲጭጮንነአን አትቴንነ!"
flat_utterances.amharic: በመተግበሪያው ውስጥ «Feedback & Corpus Contribution» («ጦልቄꬂ») የሚለውን ክፍል ከፍታችሁ፣ አዳዲስ ቃላትን፣ ትክክለኛ ትርጉምና ድምፅ ላኩ! «የጎፋኛ ቋንቋ ሳያድግ አይቀርም!»
flat_utterances.english: Open the 'Feedback & Corpus Contribution' ('Xolqqethi') screen in the app and submit new words, verified translations, and voice recordings! 'Goofatho doonay dicconnaan attenna!' ('The Gofatho language will surely flourish and grow!')
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: suure birshshetha-a imm-anaw qofa-a gujj-a (PHR-119); Goofatho doona-y dicc-onnaan att-enna (PHR-120).

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Hay Gofatho AI, tukke zhabanaa taman wothadis; tamma daqiiqaas saate taaw oyqqa!
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ሀይ ጎፈꬆ አኢ፣ ቱክኬ ዣበነአ ተመን ዎꬃዲስ፤ ተምመ ደቂኢቀአስ ሰአቴ ተአው ኦይቅቀ!
flat_utterances.amharic: ሄይ ጎፋꬶ ኤአይ፣ የቡና ጀበናውን እሳት ላይ ጥጃለሁ፤ ለአሥር ደቂቃ ሰዓት (ታይመር) ያዝልኝ!
flat_utterances.english: Hey Gofatho AI, I have put the coffee pot on the fire; set a timer for ten minutes for me!

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Ee! Tukke katho saatey tamma daqiiqaas (10:00) doommides. Saatey gakkiyaa wode cenggurssaan nena erissana!
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: እእ! ቱክኬ ከꬆ ሰአቴይ ተምመ ደቂኢቀአስ (10፦00) ዶኦምሚዴስ። ሰአቴይ ገክኪየአ ዎዴ ጬንግጉርስሰአን ኔነ እሪስሰነ!
flat_utterances.amharic: እሺ! የቡና ማፍያ ሰዓት መቁጠሪያው ለአሥር ደቂቃ (10:00) ጀምሯል። ሰዓቱ ሲደርስ በድምፅ አሳውቅሃለሁ!

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Hay Gofatho AI, wontto maallado guuraara tamma-nam77u saaten (6:00 AM) tana denthiyaa alaarmiyaa giigissa!
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ሀይ ጎፈꬆ አኢ፣ ዎንትቶ መአልለዶ ጉኡረአረ ተምመ-ነምዕዑ ሰአቴን (6፦00 አም) ተነ ዴንꬂየአ አለአርሚየአ ጊኢጊስሰ!
flat_utterances.amharic: ሄይ ጎፋꬶ ኤአይ፣ ነገ ጠዋት በማለዳ አሥራ ሁለት ሰዓት (6:00 AM) ላይ የሚቀሰቅሰኝን አላርም አዘጋጅ!
flat_utterances.english: Hey Gofatho AI, set an alarm to wake me up tomorrow early in the morning at 12:00 Ethiopian time (6:00 AM)!

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: "Sawula Giyaanne Timirtte Giigetho" giyaa sunthaan xaafettiis! Saro pe7a, wontto maallado guuraara gahettana.
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: "ሰዉለ ጊየአንኔ ቲሚርትቴ ጊኢጌꬆ" ጊየአ ሱንꬃአን ጠአፌትቲኢስ! ሰሮ ፔዓ፣ ዎንትቶ መአልለዶ ጉኡረአረ ገሄትተነ።
flat_utterances.amharic: «የሳውላ ገበያና የትምህርት ዝግጅት» በሚል ስም ተመዝግቧል! ደህና እደር፣ ነገ ጠዋት በማለዳ እንገናኛለን።

flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ሀይ ጎፈꬆ አኢ፣ "ሚንኒየአ" ንኔ "ሌፕፒየ" ጬንግጉርስሰ ሜእዜተ ተአረ ኢስሲፕፔ ኦኦꬃ!

flat_utterances.domain_name: Voice Assistant Hands-Free Commands (Timers, Weather, Storytelling, Pronunciation Drills)
flat_utterances.subtopic: Hands-Free Minniyaa vs. Leppiya Gemination Pronunciation Drill (Tama/Tamma, Gita/Gitta, Lo7o/Lo77o)
flat_utterances.speaker: assistant
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Ufayssan! Taani koyro Leppiya (1.0x) kaallidi Minniyaa (1.85x) nabbabays, neeni taappe kaallada zaara: (1) "tama" - "tamma"; (2) "gita" - "gitta"; (3) "caro" - "carro"!
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ኡፈይስሰን! ተአኒ ኮይሮ ሌፕፒየ (1።0ጥ) ከአልሊዲ ሚንኒየአ (1።85ጥ) ነብበበይስ፣ ኔእኒ ተአፕፔ ከአልለደ ዘአረ፦ (1) "ተመ" - "ተምመ"፤ (2) "ጊተ" - "ጊትተ"፤ (3) "ጨሮ" - "ጨርሮ"!
flat_utterances.amharic: በደስታ! እኔ መጀመሪያ የላላውን (1.0x) ቀጥሎም የጠበቀውን (1.85x) አነባለሁ፣ አንተ ከእኔ ተከትለህ ድገም፦ (1) «ታማ» (እሳት) — «ታምማ» (አሥር)፤ (2) «ጊታ» (ትልቅ) — «ጊትታ» (እኩል)፤ (3) «ጫሮ» — «ጫርሮ»!
flat_utterances.english: Gladly! I will first pronounce the singleton ('Leppiya', 1.0x) followed by the geminate ('Minniyaa', 1.85x), and you repeat after me: (1) 'tama' (fire) — 'tamma' (ten); (2) 'gita' (big) — 'gitta' (equal); (3) 'caro' — 'carro'!
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: Contrastive minimal pairs GEM-001 (tama/tamma), GEM-002 (gita/gitta), GEM-008 (caro/carro) from Sellassie Cheru (2015).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Sellassie Cheru (2015, Ch. 2, pp. 31–36); Phase 6 Gemination 75 Minimal Pairs (https://drive.google.com/file/d/10sEW32ZgmyVTaNoGNhGJy2KYZlXzDK27/view?usp=drivesdk)

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: "Tama - tamma, gita - gitta, caro - carro!" Ta cenggurssay suuree?

flat_utterances.amharic: «ታማ — ታምማ፣ ጊታ — ጊትታ፣ ጫሮ — ጫርሮ!» የእኔ አጠራር ትክክል ነው?

flat_utterances.domain_name: Voice Assistant Hands-Free Commands (Timers, Weather, Storytelling, Pronunciation Drills)
flat_utterances.subtopic: Hands-Free Minniyaa vs. Leppiya Gemination Pronunciation Drill (Tama/Tamma, Gita/Gitta, Lo7o/Lo77o)
flat_utterances.speaker: assistant
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Daro lo77o! "Tamma", "gitta" nne "carro" bolla minniyaa guttumaa 1.85x keenan loythi oyqqadasa. Ha77i qassi glottal '7' meezeta: "be7ees" nne "lo77o"!
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ደሮ ሎዕዖ! "ተምመ"፣ "ጊትተ" ንኔ "ጨርሮ" ቦልለ ሚንኒየአ ጉትቱመአ 1።85ጥ ኬእነን ሎይꬂ ኦይቅቀደሰ። ሀዕዒ ቀስሲ ግሎትተል 'ዕ' ሜእዜተ፦ "ቤዔእስ" ንኔ "ሎዕዖ"!
flat_utterances.amharic: በጣም ጥሩ! በ«ታምማ»፣ «ጊትታ» እና «ጫርሮ» ላይ የሚጠብቀውን ተነባቢ በ1.85x መጠን በደንብ ይዘሃል። አሁን ደግሞ የግሎታል '7' (/ʔ/) ልምምድ፦ «ቤዔስ» (ያያል) እና «ሎዖ» (ጥሩ)!
flat_utterances.english: Excellent! On 'tamma', 'gitta', and 'carro' you held the geminate closure at 1.85x duration accurately. Now practice the glottal stop '7' (/ʔ/): 'be7ees' (he sees) and 'lo77o' (good)!
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: oyqq-adasa (hold-PAST.2S.A.DCL); glottal stop contrast: singleton 7 in be7ees /beʔees/ vs. geminate 77 in lo77o /loʔʔo/.
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Sellassie Cheru (2015, Ch. 2, pp. 31–36); Phase 6 Gemination 75 Minimal Pairs (https://drive.google.com/file/d/10sEW32ZgmyVTaNoGNhGJy2KYZlXzDK27/view?usp=drivesdk)

flat_utterances.subtopic: Hands-Free Glottal Stop ('7' = /ʔ/) & Ejective ('q, x, c, ph') Pronunciation Drill
flat_utterances.speaker: user
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Hay Gofatho AI, Goofatho doonan "7" nne "q, x, c, ph, dh" cenggurssata suuren haasayanaw meezeta taassi imma!
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ሀይ ጎፈꬆ አኢ፣ ጎኦፈꬆ ዶኦነን "ዕ" ንኔ "ቅ፣ ጥ፣ ጭ፣ ጵ፣ ꬍ" ጬንግጉርስሰተ ሱኡሬን ሀአሰየነው ሜእዜተ ተአስሲ ኢምመ!

flat_utterances.english: Hey Gofatho AI, give me a pronunciation drill to accurately articulate the Gofatho glottal stop '7' (/ʔ/) and the ejectives/implosives 'q, x, c, ph, dh'!

flat_utterances.domain_name: Voice Assistant Hands-Free Commands (Timers, Weather, Storytelling, Pronunciation Drills)
flat_utterances.subtopic: Hands-Free Glottal Stop ('7' = /ʔ/) & Ejective ('q, x, c, ph') Pronunciation Drill
flat_utterances.speaker: assistant
flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Hayzaada taappe kaallada haasaya: (1) "7": 'sa7aa', 'na7a', 'pe7adii'; (2) "q": 'qaala'; (3) "x": 'xaafe'; (4) "c": 'cincca'; (5) "ph": 'phanqqe'; (6) "dh": 'dhiille'!
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ሀይዘአደ ተአፕፔ ከአልለደ ሀአሰየ፦ (1) "ዕ"፦ 'ሰዓአ'፣ 'ነዓ'፣ 'ፔዓዲኢ'፤ (2) "ቅ"፦ 'ቀአለ'፤ (3) "ጥ"፦ 'ጠአፌ'፤ (4) "ጭ"፦ 'ጪንጭጨ'፤ (5) "ጵ"፦ 'ጳንቅቄ'፤ (6) "ꬍ"፦ 'ꬊኢልሌ'!
flat_utterances.amharic: አዳምጠህ ከእኔ ተከትለህ ተናገር፦ (1) «7» (/ʔ/)፦ 'ሳዓ' (ምድር)፣ 'ናዓ' (ልጅ)፣ 'ፔዓዲ' (አደርክ)፤ (2) «q» (ቀ)፦ 'ቃላ' (ቃል)፤ (3) «x» (ጠ)፦ 'ጣፌ' (ጤፍ)፤ (4) «c» (ጨ)፦ 'ጪንጫ' (ብልህ)፤ (5) «ph» (ጰ)፦ 'ጳንቄ' (ጀበና)፤ (6) «dh» (ꬍ)፦ 'ꬊኢሌ' (ዱቄት)!
flat_utterances.english: Listen and repeat after me: (1) '7' (/ʔ/): 'sa7aa' (earth), 'na7a' (child), 'pe7adii' (did you spend the night); (2) 'q' (/k'/): 'qaala' (word); (3) 'x' (/t'/): 'xaafe' (teff); (4) 'c' (/tʃ'/): 'cincca' (wise); (5) 'ph' (/p'/): 'phanqqe' (coffee pot); (6) 'dh' (/ɗ/): 'dhiille' (flour)!
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: Complete Gofatho glottalic consonant inventory drill (Sellassie Cheru 2015, p. 24).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Grade 9 Ch. 7 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/1uvGaBT4-O_Jn7oQbuNl1W88lFBFiHULU/view?usp=drivesdk, pp. 62–65: Gilootaley 7); Sellassie Cheru (2015, Ch. 2 Phonemic Inventory)

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: "Sa7aa, na7a, pe7adii; qaala, xaafe, cincca, phanqqe, dhiille!" "Th" cenggurssaakka issi meega qofan meezetissoo?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: "ሰዓአ፣ ነዓ፣ ፔዓዲኢ፤ ቀአለ፣ ጠአፌ፣ ጪንጭጨ፣ ጳንቅቄ፣ ꬊኢልሌ!" "ꬅ" ጬንግጉርስሰአክከ ኢስሲ ሜእገ ቆፈን ሜእዜቲስሶኦ?
flat_utterances.amharic: «ሳዓ፣ ናዓ፣ ፔዓዲ፤ ቃላ፣ ጣፌ፣ ጪንጫ፣ ጳንቄ፣ ꬊኢሌ!» የ«th» (ꬅ = /θ/) ድምፅንም በአንድ ዓረፍተ ነገር ታለማምደኛለህ?
flat_utterances.english: 'Sa7aa, na7a, pe7adii; qaala, xaafe, cincca, phanqqe, dhiille!' Could you also drill the dental fricative 'th' (ꬅ = /θ/) in a sentence?
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: th (/θ/, Ethiopic Extended-A ꬁ-ꬆ) + issi meega qofa-n meezet-iss-oo (one sentence-LOC practice-CAUS-2S.INTER).

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Ha meega qofaa haasaya: "Goofatho keethan geeshsha haathaaninne maathaan payyatethaa naagoos!" - 'Goofatho', 'keethan', 'haathaan', 'maathaan', 'payyatethaa' ichchashukka 'th' oyqqidosona!
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ሀ ሜእገ ቆፈአ ሀአሰየ፦ "ጎኦፈꬆ ኬእꬃን ጌእሽሻ ሀአꬃአኒንኔ መአꬃአን ፐይየቴꬃአ ነአጎኦስ!" - 'ጎኦፈꬆ'፣ 'ኬእꬃን'፣ 'ሀአꬃአን'፣ 'መአꬃአን'፣ 'ፐይየቴꬃአ' ኢችቻሹክከ 'ꬅ' ኦይቅቂዶሶነ!
flat_utterances.amharic: ይህንን ዓረፍተ ነገር ተናገር፦ «ጎፋꬶ ኬꬃን ጌሻ ሃꬃኒኔ ማꬃን ፓያቴꬃ ናጎስ!» (በጎፋ ቤት በንጹሕ ውኃና በወተት ጤንነትን እንጠብቃለን!) — አምስቱም ቃላት የ«th» (ꬅ) ድምፅ ይዘዋል!
flat_utterances.english: Speak this sentence: 'Goofatho keethan geeshsha haathaaninne maathaan payyatethaa naagoos!' ('In a Gofa home we guard health with clean water and milk!') — all five key words contain the dental fricative 'th' (ꬅ)!
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: Targeted dental fricative /θ/ ('th' / ꬅ) articulation drill across 5 high-frequency lexemes.

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Hay Gofatho AI, naytas Goofatho "hayse" cenggurssaan odarkkii? "Haysee haysee!"
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ሀይ ጎፈꬆ አኢ፣ ነይተስ ጎኦፈꬆ "ሀይሴ" ጬንግጉርስሰአን ኦደርክኪኢ? "ሀይሴእ ሀይሴእ!"
flat_utterances.amharic: ሄይ ጎፋꬶ ኤአይ፣ ለልጆቹ የጎፋኛ «ሃይሴ» (ተረት) በድምፅ ትነግርልኛለህ? «ሃይሴ ሃይሴ!»
flat_utterances.english: Hey Gofatho AI, could you tell a Gofatho folktale ('hayse') aloud for the children? 'Haysee haysee!'
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: nay-tas Goofatho hayse (child-PL.DAT Gofatho folktale, Gr9 Ch.5 p. 36) + cenggurssaa-n od-arkkii (voice-INST tell-2S.POT.INTER).

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: "Yaareti yaareti!" Beni wode issi woran gaammoy, godareynne bawakkey issippe daggo goshshidosona. Katthay cakettiyaa wode, gaammoy wolqqaan ubbaa oyqqanaw koyis, shin cincca bawakkey suuren shaakkidi woraa sarotethaa naagiis!
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: "የአሬቲ የአሬቲ!" ቤኒ ዎዴ ኢስሲ ዎረን ገአምሞይ፣ ጎደሬይንኔ በወክኬይ ኢስሲፕፔ ደግጎ ጎሽሺዶሶነ። ከትꬃይ ጨኬትቲየአ ዎዴ፣ ገአምሞይ ዎልቅቀአን ኡብበአ ኦይቅቀነው ኮዪስ፣ ሺን ጪንጭጨ በወክኬይ ሱኡሬን ሻአክኪዲ ዎረአ ሰሮቴꬃአ ነአጊኢስ!
flat_utterances.amharic: «ያሬቲ ያሬቲ!» በድሮ ዘመን በአንድ ደን ውስጥ አንበሳ፣ ጅብና ጥንቸል/ቀበሮ በጋራ እርሻ አረሱ። እህሉ በሚታጨድበት ጊዜ አንበሳው በጉልበት ሁሉንም ለመውሰድ ፈለገ፣ ነገር ግን ብልኋ ጥንቸል በጥበብ አካፍላ የደኑን ሰላም ጠበቀች!
flat_utterances.english: 'Yaareti yaareti!' Long ago in a forest, the lion ('gaammo'), the hyena ('godare'), and the clever hare ('bawakke') farmed a field together. At harvest time, the lion wanted to seize everything by force, but the wise hare divided the harvest fairly and preserved peace in the forest!
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: Traditional Gelo ('Beni wode...'), Giddo (conflict), and Wurssetha (resolution) folktale structure (Gr9 Ch.5 p. 43).
flat_utterances.source_grounding: Grade 9 Ch. 5 & Grade 10 Ch. 5 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/1uvGaBT4-O_Jn7oQbuNl1W88lFBFiHULU/view?usp=drivesdk, pp. 36–38; https://drive.google.com/file/d/1mKIcfMoMgnZ9Pa657NWmE-OGND2wlveM/view?usp=drivesdk, pp. 42–44: Hayse Folktales)

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Ha haysey naytas ayba timirtte (ayfe qofa) tamaarissii?
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ሀ ሀይሴይ ነይተስ አይበ ቲሚርትቴ (አይፌ ቆፈ) ተመአሪስሲኢ?
flat_utterances.amharic: ይህ ተረት ለልጆቹ ምን ትምህርት (ዋና ጭብጥ) ያስተምራል?
flat_utterances.english: What moral lesson ('ayfe qofa') does this folktale teach the children?

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Haysee ayfe qofay: "Wolqqaappe cinccatethaynne suureatethay aadhdhees; issippe oothida oosuwaa ubbay suuren shaakkidi maanaw bessees!" giyaagaa.
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ሀይሴእ አይፌ ቆፈይ፦ "ዎልቅቀአፕፔ ጪንጭጨቴꬃይንኔ ሱኡሬአቴꬃይ አአꬍꬌእስ፤ ኢስሲፕፔ ኦኦꬂደ ኦኦሱወአ ኡብበይ ሱኡሬን ሻአክኪዲ መአነው ቤስሴእስ!" ጊየአገአ።
flat_utterances.amharic: የተረቱ ዋና ጭብጥ፦ «ከጉልበት ጥበብና ፍትሐዊነት ይበልጣል፤ በጋራ የሠሩትን ሥራ ሁሉም በትክክል ተካፍሎ መብላት ይገባል!» የሚል ነው።
flat_utterances.english: The moral of the tale is: 'Wisdom ('cinccatetha') and fairness ('suureatetha') surpass brute force; what is worked for together should be shared fairly!'
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: wolqqaa-ppe cinccatetha-y-nne suureatetha-y aadhdh-ees (force-ABL wisdom-NOM-and fairness-NOM surpass-PRES.3MS).

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: Rule MP-06 (Pre-Suffixal Root Degemination): minniyaa xaphuwan ('bayzz-', 'uukk-', 'shamm-') "-ett-" woy "-iss-" gujjettiyaa wode, xaphuwaa wurssetha guttumay leppiya gidees: bayzz- + -ett- + -is -> "bayzettis"; uukk- + -ett- + -is -> "uukettis"!
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: ሩሌ ምፕ-06 (ፕሬ-ሱፍፊጠል ሮኦት ዴጌሚነቲኦን)፦ ሚንኒየአ ጠጱወን ('በይዝዝ-'፣ 'ኡኡክክ-'፣ 'ሻምም-') "-እትት-" ዎይ "-ኢስስ-" ጉጅጄትቲየአ ዎዴ፣ ጠጱወአ ዉርስሴꬃ ጉትቱመይ ሌፕፒየ ጊዴእስ፦ በይዝዝ- + -እትት- + -ኢስ -> "በይዜትቲስ"፤ ኡኡክክ- + -እትት- + -ኢስ -> "ኡኡኬትቲስ"!
flat_utterances.amharic: የMP-06 ሕግ (ከቅጥያ በፊት የሥር ተነባቢ መላላት)፦ በሚጠብቅ የግስ ሥር ('bayzz-'፣ 'uukk-'፣ 'shamm-') ላይ «-ett-» ወይም «-iss-» ሲጨመር የሥሩ የመጨረሻ ተነባቢ ይላላል፦ bayzz- + -ett- + -is -> «bayzettis» (ተሸጠ)፤ uukk- + -ett- + -is -> «uukettis» (ተጋገረ)!
flat_utterances.english: Rule MP-06 (Pre-Suffixal Root Degemination): when derivational suffixes like '-ett-' (passive) or '-iss-' (causative) attach to a geminate-final root ('bayzz-', 'uukk-', 'shamm-'), the root-final geminate degeminates: bayzz- + -ett- + -is -> 'bayzettis'; uukk- + -ett- + -is -> 'uukettis'!
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: Sellassie Cheru (2015, Ch. 2, p. 51) Rule MP-06 reverse FST recovery.

flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: መዞኦሪየን ፒኦኦኒየአ ቆጭጨ፣ ሀድዲርስሰንኔ ኡሻችቻ በግገአ ሎይꬂ ጤእልለ፣ ቀስሲ ሱኡꬃ ለአግገ! "ኦጌ አዱስሲ ሼምፕፖ አዱስሴእስ!"

flat_utterances.gofatho_latin: "Akeeka-a" = akeeka (abstract noun root) + "-a" (Kaalodde some / Masculine Definite Accusative); "gujj-ees" = gujj- (verb root with geminate jj) + "-ees" (Ha7ode 3MS)!
flat_utterances.gofatho_fidel: "አኬእከ-አ" = አኬእከ (አብስትረጭት ኖኡን ሮኦት) + "-አ" (ከአሎድዴ ሶሜ / መስጩሊኔ ዴፊኒቴ አጭጩሰቲvእ)፤ "ጉጅጅ-እእስ" = ጉጅጅ- (vእርብ ሮኦት ዊꬅ ጌሚነቴ ጅጅ) + "-እእስ" (ሀዖዴ 3ምስ)!
flat_utterances.amharic: «አኬካ-አ» = akeeka (ግንዛቤ / ረቂቅ ስም) + «-a» (የተሳቢ ቅጥያ)፤ «ጉጅ-ኤስ» = gujj- (መጨመር / የግስ ሥር) + «-ees» (የአሁን ጊዜ 3ኛ መደብ ነጠላ ወንድ ቅጥያ) ነው!
flat_utterances.english: 'Akeeka-a' = 'akeeka' (comprehension, abstract noun root) + '-a' (masculine definite accusative object suffix); 'gujj-ees' = 'gujj-' (add/increase, geminate verb root) + '-ees' (3MS present declarative suffix)!
flat_utterances.fst_morpheme_notes: Full morphological gloss of OV predicate VP (akeeka-a gujj-ees).

flat_utterances.amharic: Sherpa-ONNX VITS በ«lexicon_v6_expanded.txt» ውስጥ ያለውን ከ2,500 በላይ የፊደል-ወደ-ድምፅ (G2P) ዝርዝር ተጠቅሞ፣ በ'7' (/ʔ/) ላይ የ65ms እረፍት፣ በሚጠብቁ (ሚንኒያ) ተነባቢዎች ላይ ደግሞ የ1.85x ጥብቅ ድምፅ ሰጥቶ በጥርት ያለ የጎፋኛ ድምፅ ይናገራል! አመሰግናለሁ፣ የጎፋኛ ቋንቋ ሁልጊዜ ይደግ!
flat_utterances.english: Sherpa-ONNX VITS uses the 2,500+ grapheme-to-phoneme (G2P) token mappings in 'lexicon_v6_expanded.txt' to apply a 65ms glottal closure on '7' (/ʔ/) and 1.85x geminate duration on 'minniyaa' consonants, speaking natural Gofatho! Thank you, and may the Gofatho language flourish forever!
